GraphChoices.appendChoice.source: def appendChoice {n : ℕ} (f : Fin n → V) (v : V) : Fin (n+1) → V := Fin.snoc f v

GraphChoices.menuAssignments.source:
noncomputable def menuAssignments (menu : (k : ℕ) → (Fin k → V) → Finset V) :
    (n : ℕ) → Finset (Fin n → V)
  | 0 => univ
  | n+1 => (menuAssignments menu n).biUnion fun f =>
      (menu n f).image fun v => appendChoice f v

GraphChoices.MenuValid.source:
def MenuValid (menu : (k : ℕ) → (Fin k → V) → Finset V) : (n : ℕ) → (Fin n → V) → Prop
  | 0, _ => True
  | n+1, f => MenuValid menu n (Fin.init f) ∧ f (Fin.last n) ∈ menu n (Fin.init f)

GraphChoices.mem_menuAssignments_iff.source:
theorem mem_menuAssignments_iff (menu : (k : ℕ) → (Fin k → V) → Finset V)
    (n : ℕ) (f : Fin n → V) : f ∈ menuAssignments menu n ↔ MenuValid menu n f := by
  classical
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    change f ∈ (univ : Finset (Fin 0 → V)) ↔ True
    simp only [mem_univ]
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [menuAssignments, mem_biUnion, mem_image]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨g,hg,v,hv,rfl⟩
      simp only [MenuValid, appendChoice, Fin.init_snoc, Fin.snoc_last]
      exact ⟨(ih g).mp hg,hv⟩
    · rintro ⟨hg,hv⟩
      exact ⟨Fin.init f,(ih _).mpr hg,f (Fin.last n),hv,Fin.snoc_init_self f⟩

/-- The number of complete assignments is at most the product of the menu
bounds, even though each menu can depend on the prefix. -/

GraphChoices.menuAssignments_card_le.source:
theorem menuAssignments_card_le (menu : (k : ℕ) → (Fin k → V) → Finset V)
    (d : ℕ → ℕ) (n : ℕ) (hmenu : ∀ k, k < n → ∀ f, (menu k f).card ≤ d k) :
    (menuAssignments menu n).card ≤ ∏ k ∈ range n, d k := by
  classical
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [menuAssignments]
  | succ n ih =>
    have hi := ih (fun k hk f => hmenu k (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hk) f)
    rw [menuAssignments]
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ f ∈ menuAssignments menu n, ((menu n f).image fun v => appendChoice f v).card := card_biUnion_le (s := menuAssignments menu n)
        (t := fun f : Fin n → V => (menu n f).image (appendChoice f))
      _ ≤ ∑ f ∈ menuAssignments menu n, d n := by
        apply sum_le_sum
        intro f _
        exact card_image_le.trans (hmenu n (by omega) f)
      _ = (menuAssignments menu n).card * d n := by simp
      _ ≤ (∏ k ∈ range n, d k) * d n := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hi
      _ = _ := (prod_range_succ _ _).symm

end GraphChoices

GraphChoices.Patterns.extendFinZero.source:
noncomputable def extendFinZero {h : ℕ} (f : Fin h → ℝ) (i : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  if hi : i < h then f ⟨i,hi⟩ else 0

GraphChoices.Patterns.sufficientThreshol.source:
theorem sufficientThreshold_fin_scale_budget (h : ℕ) (mean x : Fin h → ℝ) (A L σ K : ℝ)
    (hmean : ∀ i, 0 ≤ mean i) (hx : ∀ i, 0 ≤ x i)
    (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hL : 1 ≤ L) (hσ : 0 ≤ σ) (hK : 1 ≤ K)
    (hbase : ∀ i, (Peeling.scaleNat i.val : ℝ)*mean i ≤ A)
    (hbranch : ∀ i, x i ≤ K*((Peeling.scaleNat i.val : ℝ)*L)^(2*σ)) :
    (∑ i : Fin h, (sufficientThreshold (mean i) (Peeling.scaleNat i.val)
      (Real.log (x i)/Real.log (Peeling.scaleNat i.val)) : ℝ)) ≤
      h*(A+2*σ+2)+(Real.log K+2*σ*Real.log L)/Real.log 2 := by
  have ht := sufficientThreshold_scale_budget h (extendFinZero mean) (extendFinZero x) A L σ K
    (fun i hi => by simpa [extendFinZero, hi] using hmean ⟨i,hi⟩)
    (fun i hi => by simpa [extendFinZero, hi] using hx ⟨i,hi⟩) hA hL hσ hK
    (fun i hi => by simpa [extendFinZero, hi] using hbase ⟨i,hi⟩)
    (fun i hi => by simpa [extendFinZero, hi] using hbranch ⟨i,hi⟩)
  rw [← Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range] at ht
  simpa only [extendFinZero, Fin.isLt, dite_true] using ht

variable {E : Type*} [Fintype E] [Nonempty E]

/-- Budget for exactly the automatic thresholds. h is the actual finite
class count, D is the actual common left cap, and z=T/|E|. -/

GraphChoices.Patterns.automaticThreshold.source:
theorem automaticThresholds_budget (h D T : ℕ) (DL DR : Fin h → ℕ) (B L σ : ℝ)
    (hh : 0 < h) (hB : 0 < B) (hL : 1 ≤ L) (hσ : 0 ≤ σ)
    (hmass : 1 ≤ 16*B*((T:ℝ)/Fintype.card E))
    (hDL : ∀ i, (DL i : ℝ) ≤ 16*B/(Peeling.scaleNat i.val : ℝ))
    (hDR : ∀ i, (DR i : ℝ) ≤ 16*B*((Peeling.scaleNat i.val : ℝ)*L)^(2*σ)) :
    (∑ i : Fin h, (automaticThresholds (E := E) DL DR D T (fun i => Peeling.scaleNat i.val) i : ℝ)) ≤
      h*(16*Real.exp 1*B*((T:ℝ)/Fintype.card E)+2*σ+2) +
      (Real.log (16*B*((T:ℝ)/Fintype.card E)/
        branchTarget D h ((T:ℝ)/Fintype.card E)) + 2*σ*Real.log L)/Real.log 2 := by
  have hz : 0 ≤ (T:ℝ)/Fintype.card E := by positivity
  have hb := branchTarget_pos D h _ hh hz
  have hb1 := (branchTarget_le_rate D h _ hh hz).trans (shapeRate_le_one h hh)
  have hK : 1 ≤ 16*B*((T:ℝ)/Fintype.card E)/branchTarget D h ((T:ℝ)/Fintype.card E) := by
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hb).mpr
    simpa only [one_mul] using hb1.trans hmass
  have ht := sufficientThreshold_fin_scale_budget h
    (fun i => Real.exp 1*T*(DL i : ℝ)/Fintype.card E)
    (fun i => (DR i : ℝ)*((T:ℝ)/Fintype.card E)/branchTarget D h ((T:ℝ)/Fintype.card E))
    (16*Real.exp 1*B*((T:ℝ)/Fintype.card E)) L σ _
    (fun _ => by positivity) (fun _ => by positivity) (by positivity) hL hσ hK ?_ ?_
  · simpa only [automaticThresholds, explicitThresholds, Fintype.card_fin] using ht
  · intro i
    have hpos : (0:ℝ) < Peeling.scaleNat i.val := by exact_mod_cast Peeling.scaleNat_pos i.val
    have hd := (le_div_iff₀ hpos).mp (hDL i)
    calc
      _ = (Real.exp 1*((T:ℝ)/Fintype.card E))*((DL i : ℝ)*(Peeling.scaleNat i.val : ℝ)) := by ring
      _ ≤ (Real.exp 1*((T:ℝ)/Fintype.card E))*(16*B) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd (by positivity)
      _ = _ := by ring
  · intro i
    calc
      _ = (DR i : ℝ)*(((T:ℝ)/Fintype.card E)/branchTarget D h ((T:ℝ)/Fintype.card E)) := by ring
      _ ≤ (16*B*((Peeling.scaleNat i.val : ℝ)*L)^(2*σ))*
          (((T:ℝ)/Fintype.card E)/branchTarget D h ((T:ℝ)/Fintype.card E)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hDR i) (by positivity)
      _ = _ := by ring

end GraphChoices.Patterns

GraphChoices.Patterns.branchTarget.source: noncomputable def branchTarget (D h : ℕ) (z : ℝ) : ℝ := (shapeRate h)^2/((D:ℝ)*z+1)

GraphChoices.Patterns.shapeRate_pos.source:
theorem shapeRate_pos (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) : 0 < shapeRate h := by
  unfold shapeRate
  positivity

GraphChoices.Patterns.shapeRate_le_one.source:
theorem shapeRate_le_one (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) : shapeRate h ≤ 1 := by
  have hhr : (1:ℝ) ≤ h := by exact_mod_cast hh
  unfold shapeRate
  apply (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < 8*h)).mpr
  linarith

GraphChoices.Patterns.shapeRate_class_fa.source:
theorem shapeRate_class_factor (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) :
    4*(h:ℝ)*shapeRate h = 1/2 := by
  have hne : (h:ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.ne_of_gt hh
  unfold shapeRate
  field_simp
  ring

GraphChoices.Patterns.branchTarget_pos.source:
theorem branchTarget_pos (D h : ℕ) (z : ℝ) (hh : 0 < h) (hz : 0 ≤ z) :
    0 < branchTarget D h z := by
  unfold branchTarget
  exact div_pos (sq_pos_of_pos (shapeRate_pos h hh)) (by positivity)

GraphChoices.Patterns.branchTarget_le_ra.source:
theorem branchTarget_le_rate (D h : ℕ) (z : ℝ) (hh : 0 < h) (hz : 0 ≤ z) :
    branchTarget D h z ≤ shapeRate h := by
  have hr := shapeRate_pos h hh
  have hr1 := shapeRate_le_one h hh
  unfold branchTarget
  apply (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < (D:ℝ)*z+1)).mpr
  have hDz : 0 ≤ (D:ℝ)*z := mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hz
  have hmul := mul_nonneg hr.le hDz
  nlinarith

GraphChoices.Patterns.branchTarget_pair.source:
theorem branchTarget_pair (D h : ℕ) (z : ℝ) (hh : 0 < h) (hz : 0 ≤ z) :
    (D:ℝ)*z*branchTarget D h z ≤ (shapeRate h)^2 := by
  have hb := (branchTarget_pos D h z hh hz).le
  have heq : branchTarget D h z * ((D:ℝ)*z+1) = (shapeRate h)^2 := by
    unfold branchTarget
    exact div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < (D:ℝ)*z+1))
  nlinarith

variable {E L R C : Type*} [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E] [Nonempty E]
  [Fintype L] [Fintype R] [Fintype C]
  [DecidableEq L] [DecidableEq R] [DecidableEq C]

GraphChoices.Patterns.class_card_pos.source:
theorem class_card_pos (encode : E → Arrival L R C) : 0 < Fintype.card C := by
  classical
  exact Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr ⟨(encode (Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty E))).cls⟩

GraphChoices.Patterns.automaticThreshold.source:
noncomputable def automaticThresholds (DL DR : C → ℕ) (D T : ℕ) (f : C → ℝ) : C → ℕ :=
  explicitThresholds (E := E) DL DR T f
    (branchTarget D (Fintype.card C) ((T:ℝ)/Fintype.card E))

/-- Canonical-shape geometric decay for an explicit integer threshold vector.
Every local numerical inequality is proved from the parameter definitions. -/

GraphChoices.Patterns.heavyShape_geometr.source:
theorem heavyShape_geometric_automatic (H : C → Peeling.Graph L R)
    (encode : E → Arrival L R C) (DL DR : C → ℕ) (D T m : ℕ) (f : C → ℝ)
    (hsimple : Function.Injective fun e => ((encode e).left,(encode e).right))
    (hDL : ∀ u c, (sourceBucket encode u c).card ≤ DL c)
    (hL : ∀ c u, Peeling.leftDegree (H c) u ≤ D)
    (hR : ∀ c v, Peeling.rightDegree (H c) v ≤ DR c)
    (hT : 0 < T) (hf : ∀ c, 1 < f c) :
    eventProbability (heavyShapeEvent H encode (automaticThresholds (E := E) DL DR D T f) T m) ≤
      (Fintype.card R : ℝ)/2^m := by
  have hh := class_card_pos encode
  have hz : 0 ≤ (T:ℝ)/Fintype.card E := by positivity
  have hdec := heavyShape_decay_explicit H encode DL DR D T m f hsimple hDL hL hR
    (branchTarget D (Fintype.card C) ((T:ℝ)/Fintype.card E)) (shapeRate (Fintype.card C)) hT
    (branchTarget_pos _ _ _ hh hz) (shapeRate_pos _ hh).le
    (branchTarget_le_rate _ _ _ hh hz) (branchTarget_pair _ _ _ hh hz) hf
  exact heavyShape_geometric_tail H encode _ T m _ (shapeRate_pos _ hh).le hdec
    (shapeRate_class_factor _ hh).le

GraphChoices.Patterns.largeShape_geometr.source:
theorem largeShape_geometric_automatic (H : C → Peeling.Graph L R)
    (encode : E → Arrival L R C) (DL DR : C → ℕ) (D T k B : ℕ) (f : C → ℝ)
    (hsimple : Function.Injective fun e => ((encode e).left,(encode e).right))
    (hDL : ∀ u c, (sourceBucket encode u c).card ≤ DL c)
    (hL : ∀ c u, Peeling.leftDegree (H c) u ≤ D)
    (hR : ∀ c v, Peeling.rightDegree (H c) v ≤ DR c)
    (hT : 0 < T) (hf : ∀ c, 1 < f c) :
    eventProbability (largeShapeEvent H encode (automaticThresholds (E := E) DL DR D T f) T k B) ≤
      2*(Fintype.card R : ℝ)/2^k := by
  apply largeShape_probability_le
  intro j _
  exact heavyShape_geometric_automatic H encode DL DR D T (k+j) f hsimple hDL hL hR hT hf

/-- Component tail for the concrete threshold vector. The only combinatorial
coverage premise is explicitly visible; no canonical probability bound or
local decay inequality is assumed. D bounds base-piece left degrees, while
d bounds sampled residual left degrees outside the degree exception. -/

GraphChoices.Patterns.largeComponent_pol.source:
theorem largeComponent_polynomial_automatic_of_coverage (H : C → Peeling.Graph L R)
    (encode : E → Arrival L R C) (DL DR : C → ℕ) (D T d k B N c : ℕ) (f : C → ℝ)
    (hsimple : Function.Injective fun e => ((encode e).left,(encode e).right))
    (hDL : ∀ u c, (sourceBucket encode u c).card ≤ DL c)
    (hL : ∀ c u, Peeling.leftDegree (H c) u ≤ D)
    (hR : ∀ c v, Peeling.rightDegree (H c) v ≤ DR c)
    (hT : 0 < T) (hf : ∀ c, 1 < f c)
    (hN : 0 < N) (hLN : Fintype.card L ≤ N) (hRN : Fintype.card R ≤ N)
    (hd : polynomialCutoff N c ≤ d+1) (hk : polynomialCutoff N c ≤ k)
    (hmean : ∀ u, Real.exp 1*T*(((leftSourceBucket encode u).card : ℝ)/Fintype.card E)/(d+1) ≤ 1/2)
    (hcoverage : largeHeavyTreeEvent encode (automaticThresholds (E := E) DL DR D T f) T k ⊆
      largeShapeEvent H encode (automaticThresholds (E := E) DL DR D T f) T k B) :
    eventProbability (largeComponentEvent encode (automaticThresholds (E := E) DL DR D T f)
      T ((d+1)*(k+1))) ≤ 3/(N:ℝ)^c := by
  apply largeComponent_polynomial_tail_of_coverage H encode _ T d k B N c hN hLN hRN hd hk hmean hcoverage
  intro j _
  exact heavyShape_geometric_automatic H encode DL DR D T (k+j) f hsimple hDL hL hR hT hf

GraphChoices.Patterns.expected_load_poly.source:
theorem expected_load_polynomial_automatic_of_coverage (H : C → Peeling.Graph L R)
    (encode : E → Arrival L R C) (DL DR : C → ℕ) (D T d k B N c : ℕ) (f : C → ℝ)
    (hsimple : Function.Injective fun e => ((encode e).left,(encode e).right))
    (hDL : ∀ u c, (sourceBucket encode u c).card ≤ DL c)
    (hL : ∀ c u, Peeling.leftDegree (H c) u ≤ D)
    (hR : ∀ c v, Peeling.rightDegree (H c) v ≤ DR c)
    (hT : 0 < T) (hf : ∀ c, 1 < f c)
    (hN : 0 < N) (hLN : Fintype.card L ≤ N) (hRN : Fintype.card R ≤ N)
    (hd : polynomialCutoff N c ≤ d+1) (hk : polynomialCutoff N c ≤ k)
    (hmean : ∀ u, Real.exp 1*T*(((leftSourceBucket encode u).card : ℝ)/Fintype.card E)/(d+1) ≤ 1/2)
    (hcoverage : largeHeavyTreeEvent encode (automaticThresholds (E := E) DL DR D T f) T k ⊆
      largeShapeEvent H encode (automaticThresholds (E := E) DL DR D T f) T k B) :
    expectedTotalMaxLoad encode (automaticThresholds (E := E) DL DR D T f) T ≤
      (∑ c, (automaticThresholds (E := E) DL DR D T f c : ℝ)) +
      (2*(Nat.log 2 ((d+1)*(k+1))+1) : ℕ)*expectedReplayOpt encode T + 3*T/(N:ℝ)^c := by
  apply expected_load_polynomial_of_coverage H encode _ T d k B N c hN hLN hRN hd hk hmean hcoverage
  intro j _
  exact heavyShape_geometric_automatic H encode DL DR D T (k+j) f hsimple hDL hL hR hT hf

end GraphChoices.Patterns

GraphChoices.paired_power_bound.source:
theorem paired_power_bound (a b r : ℝ) (q l : ℕ)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hql : q ≤ l)
    (hab : a*b ≤ r^2) (hbr : b ≤ r) : a^q*b^l ≤ r^(q+l) := by
  have hsplit : l = q + (l-q) := by omega
  calc
    _ = (a*b)^q * b^(l-q) := by nth_rw 1 [hsplit]; rw [pow_add, mul_pow]; ring
    _ ≤ (r^2)^q * r^(l-q) :=
      mul_le_mul (pow_le_pow_left₀ (mul_nonneg ha hb) hab q) (pow_le_pow_left₀ hb hbr (l-q))
        (pow_nonneg hb _) (by positivity)
    _ = _ := by rw [← pow_mul, ← pow_add]; congr 1; omega

GraphChoices.two_class_product_bound.source:
theorem two_class_product_bound {I : Type*} [Fintype I] (P : I → Prop) [DecidablePred P]
    (a b r : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hab : a*b ≤ r^2) (hbr : b ≤ r)
    (hheavy : Fintype.card I ≤ 2 * (univ.filter P).card) :
    (∏ i : I, if P i then b else a) ≤ r^(Fintype.card I) := by
  classical
  let l := (univ.filter P).card
  let q := (univ.filter fun i => ¬P i).card
  have hsum : l+q = Fintype.card I := by
    simpa [l,q] using filter_card_add_filter_neg_card_eq_card (s := (univ : Finset I)) P
  have hql : q ≤ l := by dsimp [l,q] at *; omega
  have heq : (∏ i : I, if P i then b else a) = b^l*a^q := by
    rw [prod_ite]
    simp [l,q]
  rw [heq, mul_comm, ← hsum]
  have hp := paired_power_bound a b r q l ha hb hr hql hab hbr
  simpa [Nat.add_comm] using hp

GraphChoices.subtype_product_as_ite.source:
theorem subtype_product_as_ite {I : Type*} [Fintype I] (P : I → Prop) [DecidablePred P]
    (f : I → ℝ) : (∏ j : {i // P i}, f j.val) = ∏ i, if P i then f i else 1 := by
  classical
  rw [← Finset.prod_subtype (univ.filter P) (by simp) f, prod_filter]

end GraphChoices

GraphChoices.average_pow_hits.source:
theorem average_pow_hits (A : Finset E) (T : ℕ) (r : ℝ) :
    average (fun ω : Fin T → E => r^(hitCount A ω)) =
      (1+((A.card:ℝ)/Fintype.card E)*(r-1))^T := by
  have hp (ω : Fin T → E) : r^(hitCount A ω) = ∏ t, if ω t ∈ A then r else 1 := by
    simp only [prod_ite, prod_const_one, mul_one, prod_const, hitCount]
  have hfilter : (univ.filter fun e : E => e ∈ A) = A := by ext e; simp
  have hs : (∑ e : E, if e ∈ A then r else 1) = Fintype.card E+(r-1)*A.card := by
    have hh (e : E) : (if e ∈ A then r else 1) = 1+(r-1)*(if e ∈ A then (1:ℝ) else 0) := by
      split <;> ring
    calc
      _ = ∑ e : E, (1+(r-1)*(if e ∈ A then (1:ℝ) else 0)) := sum_congr rfl (fun e _ => hh e)
      _ = _ := by simp only [sum_add_distrib, sum_const, card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one, ← mul_sum, sum_boole, hfilter]
  simp only [average, hp]
  rw [← Fintype.prod_sum (fun (_ : Fin T) (e : E) => if e ∈ A then r else 1)]
  simp only [hs, prod_const, card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, Fintype.card_fun, Nat.cast_pow, ← div_pow]
  have hm : (Fintype.card E:ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero
  congr 1
  field_simp

GraphChoices.hitLowerTail_probability.source:
theorem hitLowerTail_probability (A : Finset E) (T k : ℕ) :
    eventProbability (univ.filter fun ω : Fin T → E => hitCount A ω < k) ≤
      Real.exp ((k:ℝ)*Real.log 2-(T:ℝ)*((A.card:ℝ)/Fintype.card E)/2) := by
  let bad := univ.filter fun ω : Fin T → E => hitCount A ω < k
  have hm : average (fun ω : Fin T → E => (if ω ∈ bad then (1:ℝ) else 0)*(1/2)^k) ≤
      average (fun ω : Fin T → E => (1/2:ℝ)^(hitCount A ω)) := by
    apply average_mono
    intro ω
    split_ifs with hω
    · simp only [one_mul]
      exact pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) ((mem_filter.mp hω).2.le)
    · simp only [zero_mul]
      positivity
  have heq : average (fun ω : Fin T → E => (if ω ∈ bad then (1:ℝ) else 0)*(1/2)^k) =
      (1/2:ℝ)^k*eventProbability bad := by
    conv_lhs => arg 1; ext ω; rw [mul_comm]
    rw [average_mul, average_unit_indicator]
  rw [heq, average_pow_hits] at hm
  have hexp : (1+((A.card:ℝ)/Fintype.card E)*((1/2:ℝ)-1))^T ≤
      Real.exp (-(T:ℝ)*((A.card:ℝ)/Fintype.card E)/2) := by
    have hp : 0 ≤ 1+((A.card:ℝ)/Fintype.card E)*((1/2:ℝ)-1) := by
      have hh : (A.card:ℝ)/Fintype.card E ≤ 1 := eventProbability_le_one A
      linarith
    calc
      _ ≤ (Real.exp (-((A.card:ℝ)/Fintype.card E)/2))^T := by
        apply pow_le_pow_left₀ hp
        have hh := Real.add_one_le_exp (-((A.card:ℝ)/Fintype.card E)/2)
        linarith
      _ = _ := by rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]; congr 1; ring
  have htwo : (1/2:ℝ)^k*Real.exp ((k:ℝ)*Real.log 2) = 1 := by
    rw [Real.exp_nat_mul, Real.exp_log (by norm_num), ← mul_pow]
    norm_num
  have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hm.trans hexp) (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos ((k:ℝ)*Real.log 2)))
  have hright : Real.exp ((k:ℝ)*Real.log 2)*Real.exp (-(T:ℝ)*((A.card:ℝ)/Fintype.card E)/2) =
      Real.exp ((k:ℝ)*Real.log 2-(T:ℝ)*((A.card:ℝ)/Fintype.card E)/2) := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
  rw [← mul_assoc, mul_comm (Real.exp _), htwo, one_mul, hright] at hh
  exact hh

GraphChoices.coordinate_event_probabilit.source:
theorem coordinate_event_probability {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq Ω] [Nonempty Ω]
    (B : Finset Ω) {k : ℕ} (i : Fin k) :
    eventProbability (univ.filter fun ω : Fin k → Ω => ω i ∈ B) = eventProbability B := by
  rw [← average_unit_indicator, ← average_unit_indicator B]
  have hh := average_coordinate i (fun x : Ω => if x ∈ B then (1:ℝ) else 0)
  simpa only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and] using hh

end GraphChoices

GraphChoices.flip.source: def flip (a : Orientation T) : Orientation T := fun t => !(a t)

GraphChoices.splitInstance.source:
def splitInstance (I : Instance V T) (b : Orientation T) : Instance (V ⊕ V) T where
  left t := Sum.inl (destination I b t)
  right t := Sum.inr (destination I (flip b) t)

/-- Orientations on the copied graph and original graph are in bijection. -/

GraphChoices.transport.source:
def transport (b a : Orientation T) : Orientation T := fun t =>
  if b t then a t else !(a t)

GraphChoices.transport_involutive.source:
theorem transport_involutive (b a : Orientation T) : transport b (transport b a) = a := by
  funext t
  simp only [transport]
  cases b t <;> cases a t <;> rfl

omit [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] in

GraphChoices.collapse_destination.source:
theorem collapse_destination (I : Instance V T) (b a : Orientation T) (t : Fin T) :
    Sum.elim id id (destination (splitInstance I b) a t) = destination I (transport b a) t := by
  cases hb : b t <;> cases ha : a t <;>
    simp [destination, splitInstance, transport, flip, hb, ha]

omit [Fintype V] in

GraphChoices.collapse_load.source:
theorem collapse_load (I : Instance V T) (b a : Orientation T) (v : V) :
    load I (transport b a) v =
      load (splitInstance I b) a (Sum.inl v) + load (splitInstance I b) a (Sum.inr v) := by
  simp only [load, card_eq_sum_ones, sum_filter, ← sum_add_distrib]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro t _
  rw [← collapse_destination]
  cases h : destination (splitInstance I b) a t with
  | inl x => simp
  | inr x => simp

GraphChoices.split_maxLoad_le.source:
theorem split_maxLoad_le (I : Instance V T) (b a : Orientation T) :
    maxLoad (splitInstance I b) a ≤ maxLoad I (transport b a) := by
  apply (maxLoad_le_iff _ _ _).2
  intro w
  cases w with
  | inl v =>
    have h := collapse_load I b a v
    have hmax := load_le_maxLoad I (transport b a) v
    omega
  | inr v =>
    have h := collapse_load I b a v
    have hmax := load_le_maxLoad I (transport b a) v
    omega

GraphChoices.collapse_maxLoad_le.source:
theorem collapse_maxLoad_le (I : Instance V T) (b a : Orientation T) :
    maxLoad I (transport b a) ≤ 2 * maxLoad (splitInstance I b) a := by
  apply (maxLoad_le_iff _ _ _).2
  intro v
  rw [collapse_load]
  have hl := load_le_maxLoad (splitInstance I b) a (Sum.inl v)
  have hr := load_le_maxLoad (splitInstance I b) a (Sum.inr v)
  omega

GraphChoices.split_opt_le.source:
theorem split_opt_le (I : Instance V T) (b : Orientation T) :
    opt (splitInstance I b) ≤ opt I := by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_exact_opt I
  calc
    _ ≤ maxLoad (splitInstance I b) (transport b a) := opt_le_maxLoad _ _
    _ ≤ maxLoad I (transport b (transport b a)) := split_maxLoad_le _ _ _
    _ = opt I := by rw [transport_involutive, ha]

GraphChoices.opt_le_two_split_opt.source:
theorem opt_le_two_split_opt (I : Instance V T) (b : Orientation T) :
    opt I ≤ 2 * opt (splitInstance I b) := by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_exact_opt (splitInstance I b)
  calc
    _ ≤ maxLoad I (transport b a) := opt_le_maxLoad _ _
    _ ≤ 2 * maxLoad (splitInstance I b) a := collapse_maxLoad_le _ _ _
    _ = _ := by rw [ha]

/-- Pointwise competitive transfer; expectation preserves these inequalities. -/

GraphChoices.competitive_transfer.source:
theorem competitive_transfer (I : Instance V T) (b a : Orientation T) (c : ℕ)
    (hc : maxLoad (splitInstance I b) a ≤ c * opt (splitInstance I b)) :
    maxLoad I (transport b a) ≤ (2*c) * opt I := by
  calc
    _ ≤ 2 * maxLoad (splitInstance I b) a := collapse_maxLoad_le _ _ _
    _ ≤ 2 * (c * opt (splitInstance I b)) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hc
    _ ≤ 2 * (c * opt I) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.mul_le_mul_left c (split_opt_le I b))
    _ = _ := by ring

end GraphChoices

GraphChoices.expected_total_arrivals_bou.source:
theorem expected_total_arrivals_bound {V E : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E] [Nonempty E] (G : BaseGraph V E) (T N : ℕ)
    (hvertices : Fintype.card V ≤ N) : (T:ℝ) ≤ (N:ℝ)*expectedOpt G T := by
  have hh := expected_density_lower_bound G Finset.univ T
  have hm : (Fintype.card E:ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero
  simp only [BaseGraph.internalEdges, Finset.mem_univ, and_self, Finset.filter_true,
    Finset.card_univ, mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ hm] at hh
  exact hh.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast hvertices) (expectedOpt_nonneg G T))

GraphChoices.loglogFactor_square_bound.source:
theorem loglogFactor_square_bound (N M : ℕ) (hN : 2 ≤ N) (hM : M ≤ N^2) :
    loglogFactor M ≤ 2*loglogFactor N := by
  have hNr : (2:ℝ) ≤ N := by exact_mod_cast hN
  have hMr : (M:ℝ) ≤ (N:ℝ)^2 := by exact_mod_cast hM
  have hmax : max 2 (M:ℝ) ≤ (N:ℝ)^2 := max_le (by nlinarith) hMr
  have hlog := Real.log_le_log (by have := le_max_left (2:ℝ) (M:ℝ); linarith) hmax
  rw [Real.log_pow] at hlog
  norm_num only [Nat.cast_ofNat] at hlog
  have hlogN : 0 ≤ Real.log (N:ℝ) := Real.log_nonneg (by linarith)
  have hlogM : 0 ≤ Real.log (max 2 (M:ℝ)) := Real.log_nonneg (by have := le_max_left (2:ℝ) (M:ℝ); linarith)
  have hh := Real.log_le_log (by linarith : 0 < 1+Real.log (max 2 (M:ℝ)))
    (show 1+Real.log (max 2 (M:ℝ)) ≤ 2*(1+Real.log (N:ℝ)) by linarith)
  rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num) (by positivity)] at hh
  have hh' : 0 ≤ Real.log (1+Real.log (N:ℝ)) := Real.log_nonneg (by linarith)
  have hlog2 : Real.log 2 ≤ 1 := by linarith [Real.log_two_lt_d9]
  unfold loglogFactor
  rw [max_eq_right hNr]
  norm_num only [Nat.cast_ofNat] at hlog
  linarith

end GraphChoices

namespace GraphChoices.Peeling
open Finset
variable {L R : Type*} [Fintype L] [Fintype R] [DecidableEq L] [DecidableEq R]

/-- All arrival horizons on every left-degree-bounded bipartite graph.
The rate-adapted proof needs no auxiliary random clique augmentation. -/

GraphChoices.Peeling.exists_bipartite_po.source:
theorem exists_bipartite_policy_all_horizons (G : Graph L R) [Nonempty G] (N T : ℕ)
    (hvertices : Fintype.card (L ⊕ R) ≤ N)
    (hD : ∀ u, leftDegree G u ≤ 4*(graphBase G).referenceCap) :
    ∃ p : OnlinePolicy G, expectedCost (graphBase G) (onlineOrientation (T := T) p) ≤
      30000*loglogFactor N*expectedOpt (graphBase G) T := by
  have hfactor := loglogFactor_ge_one N
  have ho := expectedOpt_nonneg (graphBase G) T
  have htotal := expected_total_arrivals_bound (graphBase G) T N hvertices
  by_cases hT0 : T = 0
  · refine ⟨fun _ _ => true, (expectedCost_le_horizon (graphBase G) T _).trans ?_⟩
    rw [hT0, Nat.cast_zero]
    have hh := expectedOpt_nonneg (graphBase G) 0
    have hf : 0 ≤ loglogFactor N := by linarith
    positivity
  have hT : 0 < T := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hT0
  have hopt := expectedOpt_ge_one (graphBase G) T hT
  by_cases hlog : 2 ≤ Real.log (N:ℝ)
  · have hN : 2 ≤ N := by
      by_contra hn
      have hz : N = 0 ∨ N = 1 := by omega
      rcases hz with rfl | rfl <;> norm_num at hlog
    have hNr : (0:ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < N by omega)
    by_cases hshort : (T:ℝ) ≤ Real.log (N:ℝ)
    · refine ⟨simpleGreedyPolicy G, (short_horizon_policy G N T hT hlog hshort).trans ?_⟩
      have hh : 0 ≤ loglogFactor N*expectedOpt (graphBase G) T := by positivity
      nlinarith
    by_cases hlong : (N:ℝ)*Real.log (N:ℝ) < T
    · refine ⟨fun _ _ => true, (allLeft_reference_bound G T N hvertices hD).trans ?_⟩
      have hlower : Real.log (N:ℝ) ≤ expectedOpt (graphBase G) T := by nlinarith
      have hm : expectedOpt (graphBase G) T ≤ loglogFactor N*expectedOpt (graphBase G) T := by nlinarith
      nlinarith
    let M := max N T
    have hTM : T ≤ M := le_max_right _ _
    have hNM : N ≤ M := le_max_left _ _
    have hverticesM : Fintype.card (L ⊕ R) ≤ M := hvertices.trans hNM
    have hlogM : 2 ≤ Real.log (M:ℝ) := hlog.trans (Real.log_le_log hNr (by exact_mod_cast hNM))
    have hlogMT : Real.log (M:ℝ) ≤ T := by
      by_cases hTN : T ≤ N
      · rw [show M = N by exact max_eq_left hTN]
        exact le_of_not_ge hshort
      · rw [show M = T by exact max_eq_right (le_of_not_ge hTN)]
        exact (Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by exact_mod_cast hT)).trans (by linarith)
    have hMsquare : M ≤ N^2 := by
      have hNN : N ≤ N^2 := by nlinarith
      apply max_le hNN
      have hlogN := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hNr
      have hbound : (T:ℝ) ≤ (N:ℝ)^2 := by
        have hh : (T:ℝ) ≤ (N:ℝ)*Real.log (N:ℝ) := le_of_not_gt hlong
        nlinarith
      exact_mod_cast hbound
    let d : ℝ := 2*(G.card:ℝ)/T
    have hMpos : (0:ℝ) < G.card := by
      exact_mod_cast (show 0 < G.card by simpa only [← Fintype.card_coe] using Fintype.card_pos (α := G))
    have hTr : (0:ℝ) < T := by exact_mod_cast hT
    have hd : 0 < d := by dsimp [d]; positivity
    have havg : 2*(G.card:ℝ) = (T:ℝ)*d := by dsimp [d]; field_simp
    by_cases hleft : ∀ u, (leftDegree G u:ℝ) ≤ d*Real.log (M:ℝ)
    · obtain ⟨p,hp⟩ := exists_rate_competitive_policy G M T d hT hd hlogM hlogMT hTM hleft hD hverticesM havg
      refine ⟨p, hp.trans ?_⟩
      have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (loglogFactor_square_bound N M hN hMsquare)
        (show 0 ≤ 15000*expectedOpt (graphBase G) T by positivity)
      nlinarith
    · push_neg at hleft
      obtain ⟨u,hu⟩ := hleft
      have hmax : d*Real.log (M:ℝ) ≤ (maxLeftDegree G:ℝ) := hu.le.trans (by exact_mod_cast leftDegree_le_max G u)
      have hdmax : (maxLeftDegree G:ℝ) ≤ 4*(graphBase G).referenceCap := by exact_mod_cast maxLeftDegree_le G _ hD
      have hz : 0 ≤ (T:ℝ)/G.card := by positivity
      have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hmax hz
      have hm' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hdmax hz
      have heq : d*((T:ℝ)/G.card) = 2 := by dsimp [d]; field_simp
      have href := expected_reference_cap_bound (graphBase G) T
      rw [Fintype.card_coe] at href
      have hmul : d*Real.log (M:ℝ)*((T:ℝ)/G.card) = 2*Real.log (M:ℝ) := by
        calc
          _ = (d*((T:ℝ)/G.card))*Real.log (M:ℝ) := by ring
          _ = _ := by rw [heq]
      rw [hmul] at hm
      have hlogopt : Real.log (M:ℝ) ≤ 6*expectedOpt (graphBase G) T := by nlinarith
      refine ⟨fun _ _ => true, (allLeft_reference_bound G T M hverticesM hD).trans ?_⟩
      have hh : expectedOpt (graphBase G) T ≤ loglogFactor N*expectedOpt (graphBase G) T := by nlinarith
      nlinarith
  · refine ⟨fun _ _ => true, (expectedCost_le_horizon (graphBase G) T _).trans ?_⟩
    have hN8 : (N:ℝ) ≤ 8 := by exact_mod_cast small_log_vertex_bound N (lt_of_not_ge hlog)
    have hh : expectedOpt (graphBase G) T ≤ loglogFactor N*expectedOpt (graphBase G) T := by nlinarith
    nlinarith

end GraphChoices.Peeling

GraphChoices.average_equiv.source:
theorem average_equiv {Ω Ω' : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [Fintype Ω']
    (e : Ω ≃ Ω') (f : Ω' → ℝ) : average (fun ω => f (e ω)) = average f := by
  simp only [average, e.sum_comp, Fintype.card_congr e]

GraphChoices.blockFlatten_apply.source:
theorem blockFlatten_apply {E : Type*} (k s : ℕ) (ω : Fin k → Fin s → E)
    (i : Fin k) (j : Fin s) : blockFlatten k s ω (finProdFinEquiv (i,j)) = ω i j := by
  simp [blockFlatten, Equiv.arrowCongr]

variable {L R E : Type*} [Fintype L] [Fintype R] [Fintype E]
  [DecidableEq L] [DecidableEq R] [DecidableEq E] [Nonempty E]

GraphChoices.bipartiteBase.source:
def bipartiteBase (left : E → L) (right : E → R) : BaseGraph (L ⊕ R) E where
  left e := Sum.inl (left e)
  right e := Sum.inr (right e)

/-- No independence is used here: selected left vertices hit in every block
force at least k edges per selected vertex in the same sampled induced set. -/

GraphChoices.block_success_density.source:
theorem block_success_density (left : E → L) (right : E → R)
    (A : Finset L) (B : Finset R) (bucket : L → Finset E)
    (hsource : ∀ u ∈ A, ∀ e ∈ bucket u, left e = u ∧ right e ∈ B)
    (k s : ℕ) (ω : Fin k → Fin s → E) :
    let Z := successNumber (fun u : A => allBlocksEvent (bucket u.val) k s) ω
    (k:ℝ)*Z ≤ (Z+B.card)*(opt ((bipartiteBase left right).sample (blockFlatten k s ω)) : ℝ) := by
  classical
  let H : Finset L := A.filter fun u => ω ∈ allBlocksEvent (bucket u) k s
  let S : Finset (L ⊕ R) := H.map Function.Embedding.inl ∪ B.map Function.Embedding.inr
  let I := (bipartiteBase left right).sample (blockFlatten k s ω)
  have hsuccess (u : H) (i : Fin k) : ∃ j : Fin s, ω i j ∈ bucket u.val := by
    have hu := (mem_filter.mp u.property).2
    have hh := (Fintype.mem_piFinset.mp hu) i
    exact (mem_filter.mp hh).2
  let time (u : H) (i : Fin k) : Fin (k*s) :=
    finProdFinEquiv (i, Classical.choose (hsuccess u i))
  have htime (u : H) (i : Fin k) :
      I.left (time u i) ∈ S ∧ I.right (time u i) ∈ S := by
    have hb := Classical.choose_spec (hsuccess u i)
    have hs := hsource u.val (mem_filter.mp u.property).1 _ hb
    dsimp only [I, BaseGraph.sample, bipartiteBase, time]
    rw [blockFlatten_apply]
    constructor
    · apply mem_union_left
      exact mem_map.mpr ⟨u.val, u.property, by simp [hs.1]⟩
    · apply mem_union_right
      exact mem_map.mpr ⟨right (ω i (Classical.choose (hsuccess u i))), hs.2, rfl⟩
  let f : H × Fin k → {t : Fin (k*s) // I.left t ∈ S ∧ I.right t ∈ S} :=
    fun p => ⟨time p.1 p.2, htime p.1 p.2⟩
  have hinj : Function.Injective f := by
    rintro ⟨u,i⟩ ⟨v,j⟩ h
    have he : time u i = time v j := congrArg Subtype.val h
    have hij := congrArg Prod.fst (finProdFinEquiv.injective he)
    have hs1 := hsource u.val (mem_filter.mp u.property).1 _ (Classical.choose_spec (hsuccess u i))
    have hs2 := hsource v.val (mem_filter.mp v.property).1 _ (Classical.choose_spec (hsuccess v j))
    have ht : ω i (Classical.choose (hsuccess u i)) = ω j (Classical.choose (hsuccess v j)) :=
      by simpa only [time, blockFlatten_apply] using congrArg (fun t => blockFlatten k s ω t) he
    have huv : u = v := Subtype.ext (by rw [← hs1.1, ht, hs2.1])
    exact Prod.ext huv hij
  have hedge : H.card*k ≤ internalCount I S := by
    have hh := Fintype.card_le_of_injective f hinj
    rw [Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_coe, Fintype.card_fin] at hh
    simpa only [Fintype.card_subtype, internalCount] using hh
  have hdisj : Disjoint (H.map Function.Embedding.inl) (B.map Function.Embedding.inr) := by
    apply disjoint_left.mpr
    intro x hx hy
    obtain ⟨u,_,hu⟩ := mem_map.mp hx
    obtain ⟨v,_,hv⟩ := mem_map.mp hy
    exact Sum.noConfusion (hu.trans hv.symm)
  have hScard : S.card = H.card+B.card := by simp [S, card_union_of_disjoint hdisj]
  have hZ : successNumber (fun u : A => allBlocksEvent (bucket u.val) k s) ω = H.card := by
    simp only [successNumber, H, card_filter]
    push_cast
    exact Finset.sum_coe_sort A (fun u => if ω ∈ allBlocksEvent (bucket u) k s then (1:ℝ) else 0)
  dsimp only
  rw [hZ]
  have hd := hedge.trans (density_le_opt I S)
  rw [hScard] at hd
  exact_mod_cast (by simpa only [Nat.mul_comm] using hd)

GraphChoices.expectedOpt_block_lower.source:
theorem expectedOpt_block_lower (left : E → L) (right : E → R)
    (A : Finset L) (B : Finset R) (bucket : L → Finset E)
    (hsource : ∀ u ∈ A, ∀ e ∈ bucket u, left e = u ∧ right e ∈ B)
    (k s : ℕ) (hB : B.Nonempty)
    (hmean : (B.card:ℝ) ≤ ∑ u : A, eventProbability (allBlocksEvent (bucket u.val) k s)) :
    (k:ℝ)/3 ≤ expectedOpt (bipartiteBase left right) (k*s) := by
  let events := fun u : A => allBlocksEvent (bucket u.val) k s
  have hcov : ∀ u v : A, u ≠ v → eventProbability (events u ∩ events v) ≤
      eventProbability (events u)*eventProbability (events v) := by
    intro u v huv
    apply allBlocks_disjoint_covariance
    apply disjoint_left.mpr
    intro e he hf
    apply huv
    exact Subtype.ext (((hsource u.val u.property e he).1).symm.trans (hsource v.val v.property e hf).1)
  have hh := expected_density_of_second_moment (successNumber events)
    (fun ω => (opt ((bipartiteBase left right).sample (blockFlatten k s ω)):ℝ))
    k B.card (successNumber_nonneg events) (Nat.cast_nonneg k)
    (by exact_mod_cast hB.card_pos) (by rwa [average_successNumber])
    (by rw [average_successNumber]; exact successNumber_second_moment events hcov)
    (block_success_density left right A B bucket hsource k s)
  rw [average_equiv (blockFlatten k s) (fun ω => (opt ((bipartiteBase left right).sample ω):ℝ))] at hh
  exact hh

end GraphChoices

GraphChoices.LowerBound.block_size_pair_.source:
theorem block_size_pair_bound (m t a b k : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (ht : 1 ≤ t)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (ham : a ≤ m) (hbtm : b ≤ t*m) (hk : 16 ≤ k)
    (hscale : Real.exp 1*(t:ℝ)*(2*Real.exp 1/(k:ℝ))^k ≤ 1/256) :
    (m.choose a:ℝ)*((t*m).choose b:ℝ)*
      (2*Real.exp 1*(a:ℝ)*b/((m:ℝ)*k*(a+b)))^(k*(a+b)) ≤ 1/(m:ℝ)^8 := by
  let z := min a b
  let n := a+b
  have hz : 0 < z := lt_min ha hb
  have hzm : z ≤ m := (min_le_left _ _).trans ham
  have hzn : z ≤ n := (min_le_left a b).trans (by dsimp [n]; omega)
  have hmr : (0:ℝ) < m := by exact_mod_cast hm
  have hzr : (0:ℝ) < z := by exact_mod_cast hz
  have hkr : (0:ℝ) < k := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < k by omega)
  have har : (0:ℝ) < a := by exact_mod_cast ha
  have hbr : (0:ℝ) < b := by exact_mod_cast hb
  have htr : (1:ℝ) ≤ t := by exact_mod_cast ht
  have hnr : (0:ℝ) < n := by dsimp [n]; positivity
  let C := Real.exp 1*t*m/z
  let D := 2*Real.exp 1*z/((m:ℝ)*k)
  have hC : 0 ≤ C := by dsimp [C]; positivity
  have hD : 0 ≤ D := by dsimp [D]; positivity
  have hca : (m.choose a:ℝ) ≤ C^a := by
    apply (choose_le_exp_div_pow m a).trans
    apply pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity)
    dsimp [C]
    have hza : (z:ℝ) ≤ a := by dsimp only [z]; exact_mod_cast min_le_left a b
    calc
      _ ≤ Real.exp 1*m/z := div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by positivity) hzr hza
      _ ≤ _ := by
        have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right htr (show 0 ≤ Real.exp 1*m/z by positivity)
        convert hh using 1 <;> ring
  have hcb : ((t*m).choose b:ℝ) ≤ C^b := by
    apply (choose_le_exp_div_pow (t*m) b).trans
    apply pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity)
    dsimp [C]
    push_cast
    have hzb : (z:ℝ) ≤ b := by dsimp only [z]; exact_mod_cast min_le_right a b
    convert div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (show 0 ≤ Real.exp 1*(t:ℝ)*m by positivity) hzr hzb using 1 <;> ring
  have htail : 2*Real.exp 1*(a:ℝ)*b/((m:ℝ)*k*(a+b)) ≤ D := by
    dsimp [D]
    apply (div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : (0:ℝ)<(m:ℝ)*k*(a+b)) (by positivity : (0:ℝ)<(m:ℝ)*k)).mpr
    have hab : (a:ℝ)*b ≤ (z:ℝ)*(a+b) := by
      by_cases hh : a ≤ b
      · have he : z = a := min_eq_left hh
        rw [he]
        nlinarith
      · have he : z = b := min_eq_right (le_of_not_ge hh)
        rw [he]
        nlinarith
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2*Real.exp 1*m*k) (sub_nonneg.mpr hab)]
  have hfactor : C*D^k = (Real.exp 1*(t:ℝ)*(2*Real.exp 1/(k:ℝ))^k)*((z:ℝ)/m)^(k-1) := by
    have hk' : k = (k-1)+1 := by omega
    have heq : D = (2*Real.exp 1/(k:ℝ))*((z:ℝ)/m) := by dsimp [D]; ring
    have hzpow : ((z:ℝ)/m)^k = ((z:ℝ)/m)^(k-1)*((z:ℝ)/m) := by
      conv_lhs => rw [hk']
      rw [pow_succ]
    rw [heq, mul_pow, hzpow]
    dsimp [C]
    field_simp <;> ring
  have hpow : ((z:ℝ)/m)^((k-1)*n) ≤ ((z:ℝ)/m)^8 := by
    apply pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by positivity) ((div_le_one hmr).mpr (by exact_mod_cast hzm))
    have hn : 2 ≤ n := by dsimp [n]; omega
    have hkm : 15 ≤ k-1 := by omega
    nlinarith
  have hz8 : (z:ℝ)^8 ≤ (256:ℝ)^n := by
    have hz2 : z ≤ 2^z := (Nat.lt_two_pow_self : z < 2^z).le
    have hh : z^8 ≤ 256^n := by
      calc
        _ ≤ (2^z)^8 := Nat.pow_le_pow_left hz2 _
        _ = 256^z := by rw [← pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm z 8, pow_mul]; norm_num
        _ ≤ _ := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) hzn
    exact_mod_cast hh
  calc
    _ ≤ C^a*C^b*D^(k*n) := by
      apply mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul hca hcb (by positivity) (pow_nonneg hC _)) _ (by positivity) (by positivity)
      apply pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) htail
    _ = (C*D^k)^n := by rw [mul_pow, ← pow_mul, ← pow_add]
    _ ≤ ((1/256:ℝ)*((z:ℝ)/m)^(k-1))^n := by
      apply pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity)
      rw [hfactor]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hscale (by positivity)
    _ = (1/256:ℝ)^n*((z:ℝ)/m)^((k-1)*n) := by rw [mul_pow, ← pow_mul]
    _ ≤ (1/256:ℝ)^n*((z:ℝ)/m)^8 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpow (by positivity)
    _ ≤ 1/(m:ℝ)^8 := by
      rw [div_pow, div_pow, one_pow]
      have hh : (z:ℝ)^8/(256:ℝ)^n ≤ 1 := (div_le_one (by positivity)).mpr hz8
      calc
        _ = ((z:ℝ)^8/(256:ℝ)^n)/(m:ℝ)^8 := by ring
        _ ≤ _ := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hh (by positivity)

end GraphChoices.LowerBound

GraphChoices.average_unit_indicator.source:
theorem average_unit_indicator {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq Ω] (A : Finset Ω) :
    average (fun ω => if ω ∈ A then (1 : ℝ) else 0) = eventProbability A := by
  simp [average, eventProbability]

GraphChoices.eventProbability_le_one.source:
theorem eventProbability_le_one {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] (A : Finset Ω) :
    eventProbability A ≤ 1 := by
  unfold eventProbability
  by_cases h : Fintype.card Ω = 0
  · simp [h]
  · apply (div_le_one (by exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero h)).mpr
    exact_mod_cast card_le_univ A

GraphChoices.eventProbability_compl.source:
theorem eventProbability_compl {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [Nonempty Ω]
    [DecidableEq Ω] (A : Finset Ω) :
    eventProbability (univ \ A) = 1 - eventProbability A := by
  simp only [eventProbability, card_sdiff, inter_univ, card_univ]
  rw [Nat.cast_sub (card_le_univ A)]
  have h : (Fintype.card Ω : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero
  field_simp

GraphChoices.eventProbability_union_inte.source:
theorem eventProbability_union_inter {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq Ω]
    (A B : Finset Ω) :
    eventProbability (A ∪ B) + eventProbability (A ∩ B) =
      eventProbability A + eventProbability B := by
  unfold eventProbability
  rw [← add_div, ← add_div]
  congr 1
  exact_mod_cast card_union_add_card_inter A B

variable {E : Type*} [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E] [Nonempty E]

GraphChoices.blockHitEvent.source:
def blockHitEvent (A : Finset E) (s : ℕ) : Finset (Fin s → E) :=
  univ.filter fun ω => ∃ t, ω t ∈ A

GraphChoices.blockHitEvent_compl.source:
theorem blockHitEvent_compl (A : Finset E) (s : ℕ) :
    univ \ blockHitEvent A s = Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : Fin s => univ \ A) := by
  ext ω
  simp [blockHitEvent, Fintype.mem_piFinset]

GraphChoices.blockHit_probability.source:
theorem blockHit_probability (A : Finset E) (s : ℕ) :
    eventProbability (blockHitEvent A s) =
      1 - (1 - (A.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card E)^s := by
  have h := eventProbability_compl (blockHitEvent A s)
  rw [blockHitEvent_compl, probability_coordinate_constraints] at h
  have hm : (Fintype.card E : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero
  have hc : ((univ \ A).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card E =
      1 - (A.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card E := by
    rw [card_sdiff, inter_univ, card_univ, Nat.cast_sub (card_le_univ A)]
    field_simp
  simp only [hc, prod_const, card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] at h
  linarith

GraphChoices.blockHit_union.source:
theorem blockHit_union (A B : Finset E) (s : ℕ) :
    blockHitEvent A s ∪ blockHitEvent B s = blockHitEvent (A ∪ B) s := by
  ext ω
  simp only [mem_union, blockHitEvent, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, mem_union]
  exact exists_or.symm

GraphChoices.blockHit_disjoint_covarianc.source:
theorem blockHit_disjoint_covariance (A B : Finset E) (s : ℕ) (hAB : Disjoint A B) :
    eventProbability (blockHitEvent A s ∩ blockHitEvent B s) ≤
      eventProbability (blockHitEvent A s) * eventProbability (blockHitEvent B s) := by
  have hi := eventProbability_union_inter (blockHitEvent A s) (blockHitEvent B s)
  rw [blockHit_union] at hi
  simp only [blockHit_probability] at hi ⊢
  have ha : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 - (A.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card E := by
    have h := eventProbability_le_one A
    unfold eventProbability at h
    linarith
  have hb : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 - (B.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card E := by
    have h := eventProbability_le_one B
    unfold eventProbability at h
    linarith
  have hab : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 - ((A.card : ℝ) + B.card) / Fintype.card E := by
    have h := eventProbability_le_one (A ∪ B)
    simp only [eventProbability, card_union_of_disjoint hAB, Nat.cast_add] at h
    linarith
  have hh : 1 - ((A.card : ℝ) + B.card) / Fintype.card E ≤
      (1 - (A.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card E) * (1 - (B.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card E) := by
    have hprod : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ((A.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card E) *
        ((B.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card E) := by positivity
    rw [add_div]
    nlinarith
  have hp := pow_le_pow_left₀ hab hh s
  rw [mul_pow] at hp
  simp only [card_union_of_disjoint hAB, Nat.cast_add] at hi
  nlinarith

GraphChoices.allBlocksEvent.source:
noncomputable def allBlocksEvent (A : Finset E) (k s : ℕ) :
    Finset (Fin k → Fin s → E) := Fintype.piFinset fun _ => blockHitEvent A s

GraphChoices.allBlocks_probability.source:
theorem allBlocks_probability (A : Finset E) (k s : ℕ) :
    eventProbability (allBlocksEvent A k s) = (eventProbability (blockHitEvent A s))^k := by
  rw [allBlocksEvent, probability_coordinate_constraints]
  simp [eventProbability, div_pow]

GraphChoices.allBlocks_inter.source:
theorem allBlocks_inter (A B : Finset E) (k s : ℕ) :
    allBlocksEvent A k s ∩ allBlocksEvent B k s =
      Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : Fin k => blockHitEvent A s ∩ blockHitEvent B s) := by
  ext ω
  simp only [allBlocksEvent, mem_inter, Fintype.mem_piFinset]
  exact forall_and.symm

GraphChoices.allBlocks_disjoint_covarian.source:
theorem allBlocks_disjoint_covariance (A B : Finset E) (k s : ℕ) (hAB : Disjoint A B) :
    eventProbability (allBlocksEvent A k s ∩ allBlocksEvent B k s) ≤
      eventProbability (allBlocksEvent A k s) * eventProbability (allBlocksEvent B k s) := by
  rw [allBlocks_inter, probability_coordinate_constraints]
  simp only [prod_const, card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
  change (eventProbability (blockHitEvent A s ∩ blockHitEvent B s))^k ≤ _
  rw [allBlocks_probability, allBlocks_probability, ← mul_pow]
  exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (eventProbability_nonneg _) (blockHit_disjoint_covariance A B s hAB) k

GraphChoices.bernoulli_miss_bound.source:
theorem bernoulli_miss_bound (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (s : ℕ) :
    (1-p)^s * (1+s*p) ≤ 1 := by
  induction s with
  | zero => simp
  | succ s ih =>
    have hh : (1-p)*(1+((s+1 : ℕ) : ℝ)*p) ≤ 1+s*p := by
      push_cast
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (s:ℝ)+1) (sq_nonneg p)]
    calc
      _ = (1-p)^s * ((1-p)*(1+((s+1 : ℕ) : ℝ)*p)) := by rw [pow_succ]; ring
      _ ≤ (1-p)^s * (1+s*p) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hh (pow_nonneg (by linarith) _)
      _ ≤ 1 := ih

/-- A direct binomial lower bound, valid without an asymptotic quantile lemma. -/

GraphChoices.blockHit_probability_lower.source:
theorem blockHit_probability_lower (A : Finset E) (s : ℕ) :
    ((s:ℝ)*((A.card : ℝ)/Fintype.card E)) /
      (1+(s:ℝ)*((A.card : ℝ)/Fintype.card E)) ≤ eventProbability (blockHitEvent A s) := by
  have hp : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (A.card : ℝ)/Fintype.card E := by positivity
  have hp1 : (A.card : ℝ)/Fintype.card E ≤ 1 := eventProbability_le_one A
  rw [blockHit_probability]
  apply (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 1+(s:ℝ)*((A.card : ℝ)/Fintype.card E))).mpr
  have h := bernoulli_miss_bound _ hp hp1 s
  nlinarith

GraphChoices.blockHit_probability_lower_.source:
theorem blockHit_probability_lower_of_mean (A : Finset E) (s : ℕ) (x : ℝ)
    (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hx1 : x ≤ 1)
    (hmean : x ≤ (s:ℝ)*((A.card : ℝ)/Fintype.card E)) :
    x/2 ≤ eventProbability (blockHitEvent A s) := by
  have hm : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (s:ℝ)*((A.card : ℝ)/Fintype.card E) := by positivity
  apply le_trans _ (blockHit_probability_lower A s)
  apply (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 1+(s:ℝ)*((A.card : ℝ)/Fintype.card E))).mpr
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hmean) (sub_nonneg.mpr hx1)]

end GraphChoices

GraphChoices.Patterns.log_reference_bran.source:
theorem log_reference_branch_bound (B h : ℕ) (z : ℝ)
    (hB : 0 < B) (hh : 0 < h) (hz : 0 < z) :
    Real.log (16*(B:ℝ)*z/branchTarget (4*B) h z) ≤ 10+5*((B:ℝ)*z)+2*h := by
  have hBr : (0:ℝ) < B := by exact_mod_cast hB
  have hhr : (0:ℝ) < h := by exact_mod_cast hh
  have hne : (h:ℝ) ≠ 0 := hhr.ne'
  have hden : (4*(B:ℝ)*z+1) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (by positivity)
  have heq : 16*(B:ℝ)*z/branchTarget (4*B) h z =
      1024*((B:ℝ)*z)*(4*((B:ℝ)*z)+1)*(h:ℝ)^2 := by
    unfold branchTarget shapeRate
    push_cast
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [heq]
  have hM : 0 < (B:ℝ)*z := mul_pos hBr hz
  have hlog : Real.log (1024*((B:ℝ)*z)*(4*((B:ℝ)*z)+1)*(h:ℝ)^2) =
      Real.log 1024 + Real.log ((B:ℝ)*z) + Real.log (4*((B:ℝ)*z)+1) + 2*Real.log h := by
    rw [Real.log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity), Real.log_pow,
      Real.log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity), Real.log_mul (by norm_num) hM.ne']
    norm_num
  rw [hlog]
  have hconst : Real.log 1024 ≤ 10 := by
    have he : (1024:ℝ) = 2^10 := by norm_num
    rw [he, Real.log_pow]
    norm_num only [Nat.cast_ofNat]
    linarith [Real.log_two_lt_d9]
  have hm := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hM
  have hm' := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < 4*((B:ℝ)*z)+1)
  have hhh := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hhr
  linarith

GraphChoices.Patterns.scalar_budget_le.source:
theorem scalar_budget_le (h M σ l K : ℝ) (hh : 1 ≤ h) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hσ : 0 ≤ σ)
    (hl : 0 ≤ l) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hKbound : K ≤ 10+5*M+2*h) :
    h*(16*Real.exp 1*M+2*σ+2)+(K+2*σ*l)/Real.log 2 ≤
      64*(M+σ+1)*(h+l+1) := by
  have he : Real.exp 1 ≤ 3 := by linarith [Real.exp_one_lt_d9]
  have hlog : (1:ℝ)/2 ≤ Real.log 2 := by linarith [Real.log_two_gt_d9]
  have hnum : 0 ≤ K+2*σ*l := by positivity
  have hdiv : (K+2*σ*l)/Real.log 2 ≤ 2*(K+2*σ*l) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ (K+2*σ*l)/((1:ℝ)/2) := div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hnum (by norm_num) hlog
      _ = _ := by ring
  have heM := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right he hM
  have hhead : h*(16*Real.exp 1*M+2*σ+2) ≤ h*(48*M+2*σ+2) := by
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by linarith)
    nlinarith
  have hMh := mul_nonneg hM (show 0 ≤ h by linarith)
  have hσh := mul_nonneg hσ (show 0 ≤ h by linarith)
  have hMl := mul_nonneg hM hl
  have hσl := mul_nonneg hσ hl
  nlinarith

end GraphChoices.Patterns

namespace GraphChoices.Peeling
open Patterns
variable {L R : Type*} [Fintype L] [Fintype R] [DecidableEq L] [DecidableEq R]
  {G : Graph L R} {B N : ℕ} {d : ℝ} [Nonempty G]

GraphChoices.Peeling.PreparedDecompositi.source:
theorem PreparedDecomposition.budget_simplified (P : PreparedDecomposition G B N d)
    (haverage : 2*(G.card : ℝ) = (N:ℝ)*d) :
    P.budget N ≤ 64*((B:ℝ)*((N:ℝ)/Fintype.card G)+graphLogSkewness G d (N:ℝ)+1)*
      (P.pieces.length+Real.log (Real.log (N:ℝ))+1) := by
  have hz : 0 < (N:ℝ)/Fintype.card G := div_pos
    (by exact_mod_cast P.vertex_count_pos) (by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos)
  have hh := P.class_count_pos
  have hhr : (1:ℝ) ≤ P.pieces.length := by exact_mod_cast hh
  have hb := branchTarget_pos (4*B) P.pieces.length _ hh hz.le
  have hb1 := (branchTarget_le_rate (4*B) P.pieces.length _ hh hz.le).trans (shapeRate_le_one _ hh)
  have hmass := P.mass_at_vertex_horizon haverage
  have hK : 1 ≤ 16*(B:ℝ)*((N:ℝ)/Fintype.card G)/branchTarget (4*B) P.pieces.length ((N:ℝ)/Fintype.card G) := by
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hb).mpr
    simpa only [one_mul] using hb1.trans hmass
  have hl : 0 ≤ Real.log (Real.log (N:ℝ)) := Real.log_nonneg P.large_log.le
  have hbound := log_reference_branch_bound B P.pieces.length ((N:ℝ)/Fintype.card G) P.reference_cap_pos hh hz
  have hs := scalar_budget_le (P.pieces.length : ℝ) ((B:ℝ)*((N:ℝ)/Fintype.card G))
    (graphLogSkewness G d (N:ℝ)) (Real.log (Real.log (N:ℝ))) _ hhr (by positivity)
    (graphLogSkewness_nonneg G d (N:ℝ)) hl (Real.log_nonneg hK) hbound
  convert hs using 1 <;> unfold PreparedDecomposition.budget <;> ring

end GraphChoices.Peeling

GraphChoices.Patterns.largeHeavyTree_sub.source:
theorem largeHeavyTree_subset_largeShape (H : C → Peeling.Graph L R)
    (encode : E → Arrival L R C) (α : C → ℕ)
    (hsource : ∀ e, ((encode e).left, (encode e).right) ∈ H (encode e).cls)
    (T k : ℕ) :
    largeHeavyTreeEvent encode α T k ⊆
      largeShapeEvent H encode α T k (Fintype.card (L ⊕ R)) := by
  classical
  intro ω hω
  obtain ⟨v, s, G, htree, hadj, hlarge, hheavy, root, hroot⟩ := (mem_filter.mp hω).2
  letI : Fintype s := Fintype.ofFinite s
  let color : s → Bool := fun x => isLeft x.val.val
  have hcolor : ∀ x y, G.Adj x y → color x ≠ color y :=
    fun x y hxy => replay_adj_sides _ _ _ (hadj x y hxy)
  obtain ⟨m, shape, e, hsize, heroot, hspec⟩ :=
    exists_canonical_embedding G htree.isConnected color hcolor root hroot
  let f : Fin (m+1) → L ⊕ R := fun i => (e i).val.val
  have hf : Function.Injective f :=
    Subtype.val_injective.comp (Subtype.val_injective.comp e.injective)
  have hroot' : ∃ w, f ⟨0, by omega⟩ = Sum.inr w := by
    change ∃ w, (e ⟨0, by omega⟩).val.val = Sum.inr w
    rw [heroot]
    cases hr : root.val.val with
    | inl u => simp [hr, isLeft] at hroot
    | inr w => exact ⟨w, rfl⟩
  have hside : ∀ i, isLeft (f (childIndex i)) = (skeletonPattern shape).childLeft i :=
    fun i => (hspec i).2
  have hedge : ∀ i, (arrivalGraph (residualInstance α (sampleArrivals encode ω))).Adj
      (f (childIndex i)) (f (parentIndex (skeletonPattern shape) i)) :=
    fun i => hadj _ _ (hspec i).1
  have hsize' : m+1 = Nat.card s := by simpa only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using hsize
  have hpart : Nat.card {x : s // color x = true} + Nat.card {x : s // color x = false} = Nat.card s := by
    simpa only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_subtype] using bool_partition_card color
  have hcount := left_index_card m e color (by rw [heroot]; exact hroot)
  have hleft : m ≤ 2*(univ.filter fun i : Fin m => isLeft (f (childIndex i)) = true).card := by
    change m ≤ 2*(univ.filter fun i : Fin m => color (e (childIndex i)) = true).card
    rw [hcount]
    change Nat.card {x : s // color x = false}+1 ≤ Nat.card {x : s // color x = true} at hheavy
    omega
  have hshape := mem_heavyShapeEvent_of_geometric_embedding H encode α hsource
    ω shape f hf hroot' hside hedge hleft
  have hk : k ≤ m := by omega
  have hbound : m+1 ≤ Fintype.card (L ⊕ R) := by
    simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using Fintype.card_le_of_injective f hf
  change ω ∈ (range (Fintype.card (L ⊕ R)+1)).biUnion (fun j => heavyShapeEvent H encode α T (k+j))
  apply mem_biUnion.mpr
  refine ⟨m-k, mem_range.mpr (by omega), ?_⟩
  have heq : k+(m-k) = m := by omega
  simpa only [heq] using hshape

/-- Actual component shattering for concrete automatic thresholds. There is
no canonical-coverage or per-shape probability premise in this theorem. -/

GraphChoices.Patterns.largeComponent_pol.source:
theorem largeComponent_polynomial_automatic (H : C → Peeling.Graph L R)
    (encode : E → Arrival L R C) (DL DR : C → ℕ) (D T d k N c : ℕ) (f : C → ℝ)
    (hsimple : Function.Injective fun e => ((encode e).left,(encode e).right))
    (hsource : ∀ e, ((encode e).left, (encode e).right) ∈ H (encode e).cls)
    (hDL : ∀ u c, (sourceBucket encode u c).card ≤ DL c)
    (hL : ∀ c u, Peeling.leftDegree (H c) u ≤ D)
    (hR : ∀ c v, Peeling.rightDegree (H c) v ≤ DR c)
    (hT : 0 < T) (hf : ∀ c, 1 < f c)
    (hN : 0 < N) (hLN : Fintype.card L ≤ N) (hRN : Fintype.card R ≤ N)
    (hd : polynomialCutoff N c ≤ d+1) (hk : polynomialCutoff N c ≤ k)
    (hmean : ∀ u, Real.exp 1*T*(((leftSourceBucket encode u).card : ℝ)/Fintype.card E)/(d+1) ≤ 1/2) :
    eventProbability (largeComponentEvent encode (automaticThresholds (E := E) DL DR D T f)
      T ((d+1)*(k+1))) ≤ 3/(N:ℝ)^c := by
  apply largeComponent_polynomial_automatic_of_coverage H encode DL DR D T d k
    (Fintype.card (L ⊕ R)) N c f hsimple hDL hL hR hT hf hN hLN hRN hd hk hmean
  exact largeHeavyTree_subset_largeShape H encode _ hsource T k

GraphChoices.Patterns.expected_load_poly.source:
theorem expected_load_polynomial_automatic (H : C → Peeling.Graph L R)
    (encode : E → Arrival L R C) (DL DR : C → ℕ) (D T d k N c : ℕ) (f : C → ℝ)
    (hsimple : Function.Injective fun e => ((encode e).left,(encode e).right))
    (hsource : ∀ e, ((encode e).left, (encode e).right) ∈ H (encode e).cls)
    (hDL : ∀ u c, (sourceBucket encode u c).card ≤ DL c)
    (hL : ∀ c u, Peeling.leftDegree (H c) u ≤ D)
    (hR : ∀ c v, Peeling.rightDegree (H c) v ≤ DR c)
    (hT : 0 < T) (hf : ∀ c, 1 < f c)
    (hN : 0 < N) (hLN : Fintype.card L ≤ N) (hRN : Fintype.card R ≤ N)
    (hd : polynomialCutoff N c ≤ d+1) (hk : polynomialCutoff N c ≤ k)
    (hmean : ∀ u, Real.exp 1*T*(((leftSourceBucket encode u).card : ℝ)/Fintype.card E)/(d+1) ≤ 1/2) :
    expectedTotalMaxLoad encode (automaticThresholds (E := E) DL DR D T f) T ≤
      (∑ a, (automaticThresholds (E := E) DL DR D T f a : ℝ)) +
      (2*(Nat.log 2 ((d+1)*(k+1))+1) : ℕ)*expectedReplayOpt encode T + 3*T/(N:ℝ)^c := by
  apply expected_load_polynomial_automatic_of_coverage H encode DL DR D T d k
    (Fintype.card (L ⊕ R)) N c f hsimple hDL hL hR hT hf hN hLN hRN hd hk hmean
  exact largeHeavyTree_subset_largeShape H encode _ hsource T k

end GraphChoices.Patterns

GraphChoices.Patterns.exists_canonical_e.source:
theorem exists_canonical_embedding (G : SimpleGraph V) (hc : G.Connected)
    (color : V → Bool) (hcolor : ∀ u v, G.Adj u v → color u ≠ color v)
    (root : V) (hroot : color root = false) :
    ∃ m : ℕ, ∃ s : UnlabelledShape m, ∃ e : Fin (m+1) ≃ V,
      m+1 = Fintype.card V ∧ e ⟨0, by omega⟩ = root ∧
      ∀ i : Fin m, G.Adj (e (childIndex i)) (e (parentIndex (skeletonPattern s) i)) ∧
        color (e (childIndex i)) = (skeletonPattern s).childLeft i := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hn, hcover, hsize⟩ := exists_spanning_labelled_forest G hc root
  let xs := root :: forestLabels t
  have hlen : xs.length = t.numNodes+1 := by simp [xs, forestLabels_length]
  let F : ℕ → V := fun i => if hi : i < xs.length then xs[i] else root
  have hF (i : ℕ) (hi : i < xs.length) : F i = xs[i] := dif_pos hi
  have hF0 : F 0 = root := by simp [F, xs]
  have hbij : Function.Bijective (fun i : Fin (t.numNodes+1) => F i.val) := by
    constructor
    · intro i j hij
      change F i.val = F j.val at hij
      have hi : i.val < xs.length := by rw [hlen]; exact i.isLt
      have hj : j.val < xs.length := by rw [hlen]; exact j.isLt
      rw [hF i.val hi, hF j.val hj] at hij
      exact Fin.ext ((hn.getElem_inj_iff).mp hij)
    · intro v
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := List.mem_iff_get.mp (hcover v)
      let j : Fin (t.numNodes+1) := ⟨i.val, by simpa only [List.length_cons, forestLabels_length] using i.isLt⟩
      refine ⟨j, ?_⟩
      change F j.val = v
      rw [hF j.val (by exact i.isLt)]
      exact hi
  let e : Fin (t.numNodes+1) ≃ V := Equiv.ofBijective _ hbij
  let s : UnlabelledShape t.numNodes :=
    ⟨eraseForest t, Tree.mem_treesOfNumNodesEq.mpr (eraseForest_numNodes t)⟩
  have hvalid : ForestValid G (F 0) t := by simpa only [hF0] using ht
  have hparent : color (F 0) = !true := by simpa only [hF0] using hroot
  have hvalues : ∀ i < t.numNodes, F (0+i+1) = forestValue t root i := by
    intro i hi
    rw [hF (0+i+1) (by rw [hlen]; omega)]
    simpa only [xs, Nat.zero_add, List.getElem_cons_succ] using (forestValue_eq_get t root i hi).symm
  have hspec := forest_index_spec G color hcolor t F root 0 0 true hvalid hparent hvalues
  refine ⟨t.numNodes, s, e, hsize, hF0, ?_⟩
  intro i
  have h := hspec i.val i.isLt
  have hpar : (parentIndex (skeletonPattern s) i).val = parentPos t 0 0 i.val := by
    change (forestParent (eraseForest t) 0 0 le_rfl _).val = _
    exact forestParent_eq_parentPos t 0 0 le_rfl _
  have hside : (skeletonPattern s).childLeft i = sidePos t true i.val := by
    change forestSide (eraseForest t) true _ = _
    exact forestSide_eq_sidePos t true _
  constructor
  · change G.Adj (F (i.val+1)) (F (parentIndex (skeletonPattern s) i).val)
    rw [hpar]
    simpa only [Nat.zero_add] using h.1
  · change color (F (i.val+1)) = _
    rw [hside]
    simpa only [Nat.zero_add] using h.2

/-- The right root contributes no left vertex, so the non-root left-index
count equals the number of left vertices of the encoded graph exactly. -/

GraphChoices.Patterns.left_index_card.source:
theorem left_index_card (m : ℕ) (e : Fin (m+1) ≃ V) (color : V → Bool)
    (hroot : color (e ⟨0, by omega⟩) = false) :
    (univ.filter fun i : Fin m => color (e (childIndex i)) = true).card =
      Nat.card {v : V // color v = true} := by
  classical
  let A := {i : Fin m // i ∈ univ.filter (fun i => color (e (childIndex i)) = true)}
  let f : A → {v : V // color v = true} := fun i =>
    ⟨e (childIndex i.val), (mem_filter.mp i.property).2⟩
  have hf : Function.Bijective f := by
    constructor
    · intro i j hij
      have hidx := e.injective (congrArg Subtype.val hij)
      apply Subtype.ext
      apply Fin.ext
      have hval := congrArg Fin.val hidx
      simp only [childIndex] at hval
      omega
    · intro v
      let j := e.symm v.val
      have hj0 : j.val ≠ 0 := by
        intro hj
        have hj' : j = ⟨0, by omega⟩ := Fin.ext hj
        have he : e ⟨0, by omega⟩ = v.val := by rw [← hj']; exact e.apply_symm_apply _
        rw [he, v.property] at hroot
        contradiction
      let i : Fin m := ⟨j.val-1, by have := j.isLt; omega⟩
      have hij : childIndex i = j := by apply Fin.ext; dsimp [childIndex, i]; omega
      have hcol : color (e (childIndex i)) = true := by
        rw [hij]
        simpa only [j, e.apply_symm_apply] using v.property
      refine ⟨⟨i, mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, hcol⟩⟩, ?_⟩
      apply Subtype.ext
      change e (childIndex i) = v.val
      rw [hij]
      exact e.apply_symm_apply _
  have hcard := Fintype.card_congr (Equiv.ofBijective f hf)
  simpa only [A, Fintype.card_coe, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using hcard

end GraphChoices.Patterns

GraphChoices.neighbors.source:
def neighbors (r : L → R → Prop) [DecidableRel r] (A : Finset L) : Finset R :=
  univ.filter fun v => ∃ u ∈ A, r u v

omit [DecidableEq L] in
/-- A capacity-b matching covering every left vertex. Capacities are integers. -/

GraphChoices.exists_capacity_matching.source:
theorem exists_capacity_matching (r : L → R → Prop) [DecidableRel r] (b : ℕ)
    (hexpand : ∀ A : Finset L, A.card ≤ b * (neighbors r A).card) :
    ∃ f : L → R, (∀ u, r u (f u)) ∧
      ∀ v, (univ.filter fun u => f u = v).card ≤ b := by
  classical
  have hhall : ∀ A : Finset L,
      A.card ≤ (univ.filter fun p : R × Fin b => ∃ u ∈ A, r u p.1).card := by
    intro A
    have heq : (univ.filter fun p : R × Fin b => ∃ u ∈ A, r u p.1) =
        (neighbors r A) ×ˢ (univ : Finset (Fin b)) := by
      ext p
      simp [neighbors]
    rw [heq, card_product]
    simpa [mul_comm] using hexpand A
  let family (u : L) : Finset (R × Fin b) := univ.filter fun p => r u p.1
  have hfamily (A : Finset L) : A.biUnion family =
      (univ.filter fun p : R × Fin b => ∃ u ∈ A, r u p.1) := by
    ext p
    simp [family]
  obtain ⟨g, hginj, hg⟩ :=
    (Finset.all_card_le_biUnion_card_iff_existsInjective' family).mp
      (fun A => by rw [hfamily]; exact hhall A)
  simp only [family, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and] at hg
  refine ⟨fun u => (g u).1, hg, ?_⟩
  intro v
  have hh := card_le_card_of_injOn (fun u : L => (g u).2)
    (s := univ.filter fun u => (g u).1 = v) (t := univ)
    (fun _ _ => mem_univ _)
    (by
      intro u hu w hw hslots
      apply hginj
      apply Prod.ext
      · exact (mem_filter.mp hu).2.trans (mem_filter.mp hw).2.symm
      · exact hslots)
  simpa using hh

end GraphChoices

GraphChoices.LowerBound.blockBase.source:
def blockBase (left : C × Fin m → V) (right : C × Fin r → V) : BaseGraph V (C × (Fin m × Fin r)) where
  left e := left (e.1,e.2.1)
  right e := right (e.1,e.2.2)

GraphChoices.LowerBound.blockAllowed.source:
def blockAllowed (c : C) (A : Finset (Fin m)) (B : Finset (Fin r)) : Finset (C × (Fin m × Fin r)) :=
  {c} ×ˢ (A ×ˢ B)

GraphChoices.LowerBound.blockAllowed_car.source:
theorem blockAllowed_card (c : C) (A : Finset (Fin m)) (B : Finset (Fin r)) :
    (blockAllowed c A B).card = A.card*B.card := by simp [blockAllowed]

GraphChoices.LowerBound.blockLeftSet.source:
def blockLeftSet (left : C × Fin m → V) (S : Finset V) (c : C) : Finset (Fin m) :=
  univ.filter fun a => left (c,a) ∈ S

GraphChoices.LowerBound.blockRightSet.source:
def blockRightSet (right : C × Fin r → V) (S : Finset V) (c : C) : Finset (Fin r) :=
  univ.filter fun a => right (c,a) ∈ S

GraphChoices.LowerBound.sum_block_sets_l.source:
theorem sum_block_sets_le (f : C × Fin m → V) (hf : Function.Injective f) (S : Finset V) :
    (∑ c, (univ.filter fun a : Fin m => f (c,a) ∈ S).card) ≤ S.card := by
  have heq : (∑ c, (univ.filter fun a : Fin m => f (c,a) ∈ S).card) =
      (univ.filter fun p : C × Fin m => f p ∈ S).card := by
    simp only [card_eq_sum_ones, sum_filter, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  rw [heq]
  apply card_le_card_of_injOn f
  · intro p hp
    exact (mem_filter.mp hp).2
  · exact fun _ _ _ _ h => hf h

GraphChoices.LowerBound.internalCount_bl.source:
theorem internalCount_block_sum (left : C × Fin m → V) (right : C × Fin r → V)
    (ω : Fin T → C × (Fin m × Fin r)) (S : Finset V) :
    internalCount ((blockBase left right).sample ω) S =
      ∑ c, hitCount (blockAllowed c (blockLeftSet left S c) (blockRightSet right S c)) ω := by
  have heq (c : C) : hitCount (blockAllowed c (blockLeftSet left S c) (blockRightSet right S c)) ω =
      ((univ.filter fun j => (blockBase left right).left (ω j) ∈ S ∧
        (blockBase left right).right (ω j) ∈ S).filter fun j => (ω j).1 = c).card := by
    unfold hitCount
    congr 1
    ext j
    simp only [blockAllowed, blockLeftSet, blockRightSet, hitCount, mem_filter,
      mem_univ, true_and, mem_product, mem_singleton, blockBase]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨h,hl,hr⟩
      subst c
      exact ⟨⟨hl,hr⟩,rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨⟨hl,hr⟩,h⟩
      subst c
      exact ⟨rfl,hl,hr⟩
  simp_rw [heq]
  exact card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise (fun _ _ => mem_univ _)

/-- Each vertex belongs to at most one left block and at most one right
block. Density bounds within every complete bipartite block therefore add. -/

GraphChoices.LowerBound.opt_le_of_block_.source:
theorem opt_le_of_block_density (left : C × Fin m → V) (right : C × Fin r → V)
    (hl : Function.Injective left) (hr : Function.Injective right)
    (ω : Fin T → C × (Fin m × Fin r)) (k : ℕ)
    (hblock : ∀ c A B, A.Nonempty → B.Nonempty →
      hitCount (blockAllowed c A B) ω ≤ k*(A.card+B.card)) :
    opt ((blockBase left right).sample ω) ≤ 2*k := by
  apply (opt_le_iff_density _ _).mpr
  intro S
  rw [internalCount_block_sum]
  have heach (c : C) :
      hitCount (blockAllowed c (blockLeftSet left S c) (blockRightSet right S c)) ω ≤
        k*((blockLeftSet left S c).card+(blockRightSet right S c).card) := by
    by_cases hA : (blockLeftSet left S c).Nonempty
    · by_cases hB : (blockRightSet right S c).Nonempty
      · exact hblock c _ _ hA hB
      · have hz := not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hB
        simp [blockAllowed, hz, hitCount]
    · have hz := not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hA
      simp [blockAllowed, hz, hitCount]
  have hh := sum_le_sum (fun c (_ : c ∈ (univ : Finset C)) => heach c)
  rw [← mul_sum, sum_add_distrib] at hh
  have hL := sum_block_sets_le left hl S
  have hR := sum_block_sets_le right hr S
  change (∑ c, (blockLeftSet left S c).card) ≤ S.card at hL
  change (∑ c, (blockRightSet right S c).card) ≤ S.card at hR
  nlinarith

end GraphChoices.LowerBound

GraphChoices.LowerBound.sizeDensityEvent.source:
noncomputable def sizeDensityEvent (m r T k : ℕ) (c : C) (a b : ℕ) :
    Finset (Fin T → C × (Fin m × Fin r)) := by
  classical
  exact ((univ.powersetCard a) ×ˢ (univ.powersetCard b)).biUnion
    (fun p => hitTailEvent (blockAllowed c p.1 p.2) T (k*(a+b)))

theorem sizeDensityEvent_probability (m t T k : ℕ) (c : C) (a b : ℕ)
    (hm : 0 < m) (ht : 1 ≤ t) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (ham : a ≤ m) (hbtm : b ≤ t*m) (hk : 16 ≤ k)
    (hrate : (T:ℝ)*(m:ℝ) ≤ 2*(Fintype.card (C × (Fin m × Fin (t*m))):ℝ))
    (hscale : Real.exp 1*(t:ℝ)*(2*Real.exp 1/(k:ℝ))^k ≤ 1/256) :
    eventProbability (sizeDensityEvent m (t*m) T k c a b) ≤ 1/(m:ℝ)^8 := by
  classical
  letI : Nonempty (Fin m) := ⟨⟨0,hm⟩⟩
  letI : Nonempty (Fin (t*m)) := ⟨⟨0,by positivity⟩⟩
  let E := C × (Fin m × Fin (t*m))
  have hE : (0:ℝ) < Fintype.card E := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
  have hmr : (0:ℝ) < m := by exact_mod_cast hm
  have hkr : (0:ℝ) < k := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < k by omega)
  let tail := (2*Real.exp 1*(a:ℝ)*b/((m:ℝ)*k*(a+b)))^(k*(a+b))
  have heach (p : Finset (Fin m) × Finset (Fin (t*m)))
      (hp : p ∈ (univ.powersetCard a) ×ˢ (univ.powersetCard b)) :
      eventProbability (hitTailEvent (blockAllowed c p.1 p.2) T (k*(a+b))) ≤ tail := by
    have hcards := mem_product.mp hp
    have hA := (mem_powersetCard.mp hcards.1).2
    have hB := (mem_powersetCard.mp hcards.2).2
    apply (hitTail_probability_le_exp _ T (k*(a+b))).trans
    apply pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity)
    rw [blockAllowed_card,hA,hB]
    push_cast
    have hr : (T:ℝ)/Fintype.card E ≤ 2/(m:ℝ) :=
      (div_le_div_iff₀ hE hmr).mpr hrate
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hr
      (show 0 ≤ Real.exp 1*(a:ℝ)*b/((k:ℝ)*(a+b)) by positivity)
    convert hh using 1 <;> field_simp <;> ring
  apply (witness_union_bound _ _).trans
  apply (sum_le_sum heach).trans
  have heq : (∑ _p ∈ ((univ : Finset (Fin m)).powersetCard a) ×ˢ ((univ : Finset (Fin (t*m))).powersetCard b), tail) =
      (m.choose a:ℝ)*((t*m).choose b:ℝ)*tail := by
    simp only [sum_const, card_product, card_powersetCard, card_univ,
      Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_mul]
  rw [heq]
  exact block_size_pair_bound m t a b k hm ht ha hb ham hbtm hk hscale

GraphChoices.LowerBound.badBlockDensity.source:
noncomputable def badBlockDensity (m r T k : ℕ) : Finset (Fin T → C × (Fin m × Fin r)) := by
  classical
  exact univ.biUnion fun p : C × (Fin m × Fin r) =>
    sizeDensityEvent m r T k p.1 (p.2.1.val+1) (p.2.2.val+1)

GraphChoices.LowerBound.badBlockDensity_.source:
theorem badBlockDensity_probability (m t T k : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (ht : 1 ≤ t) (hk : 16 ≤ k)
    (hrate : (T:ℝ)*(m:ℝ) ≤ 2*(Fintype.card (C × (Fin m × Fin (t*m))):ℝ))
    (hscale : Real.exp 1*(t:ℝ)*(2*Real.exp 1/(k:ℝ))^k ≤ 1/256) :
    eventProbability (badBlockDensity (C := C) m (t*m) T k) ≤
      (Fintype.card C:ℝ)*m*(t*m)/(m:ℝ)^8 := by
  apply (witness_union_bound _ _).trans
  have hh := sum_le_sum (fun p (_ : p ∈ (univ : Finset (C × (Fin m × Fin (t*m))))) =>
    sizeDensityEvent_probability m t T k p.1 (p.2.1.val+1) (p.2.2.val+1)
      hm ht (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) hk hrate hscale)
  convert hh using 1 <;> simp only [sum_const, card_univ, Fintype.card_prod,
    Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_mul] <;> ring

GraphChoices.LowerBound.not_badBlockDens.source:
theorem not_badBlockDensity (m r T k : ℕ) (ω : Fin T → C × (Fin m × Fin r))
    (hω : ω ∉ badBlockDensity m r T k) :
    ∀ c A B, A.Nonempty → B.Nonempty → hitCount (blockAllowed c A B) ω ≤ k*(A.card+B.card) := by
  classical
  intro c A B hA hB
  by_contra h
  have ha : A.card-1 < m := by have hh := card_le_univ A; have hp := hA.card_pos; simp only [Fintype.card_fin] at hh; omega
  have hb : B.card-1 < r := by have hh := card_le_univ B; have hp := hB.card_pos; simp only [Fintype.card_fin] at hh; omega
  apply hω
  apply mem_biUnion.mpr
  refine ⟨(c,⟨A.card-1,ha⟩,⟨B.card-1,hb⟩),mem_univ _,?_⟩
  apply mem_biUnion.mpr
  refine ⟨(A,B),mem_product.mpr ⟨mem_powersetCard.mpr ⟨subset_univ _,by change A.card = A.card-1+1; have := hA.card_pos; omega⟩,
    mem_powersetCard.mpr ⟨subset_univ _,by change B.card = B.card-1+1; have := hB.card_pos; omega⟩⟩,?_⟩
  apply mem_filter.mpr
  refine ⟨mem_univ _,?_⟩
  have hsum : (A.card-1+1)+(B.card-1+1) = A.card+B.card := by have := hA.card_pos; have := hB.card_pos; omega
  change k*((A.card-1+1)+(B.card-1+1)) ≤ hitCount (blockAllowed c A B) ω
  rw [hsum]
  omega

end GraphChoices.LowerBound

GraphChoices.average_add.source:
theorem average_add {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] (f g : Ω → ℝ) :
    average (fun ω => f ω + g ω) = average f + average g := by
  simp only [average, sum_add_distrib, add_div]

GraphChoices.average_indicator.source:
theorem average_indicator {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq Ω]
    (A : Finset Ω) (M : ℝ) :
    average (fun ω => if ω ∈ A then M else 0) = M * eventProbability A := by
  simp [average, eventProbability, mul_div_assoc, mul_comm]

/-- A finite expectation bound with an explicit additive exceptional-sample cost. -/

GraphChoices.average_le_good_add_bad.source:
theorem average_le_good_add_bad {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq Ω]
    (X B : Ω → ℝ) (A : Finset Ω) (M : ℝ)
    (hgood : ∀ ω, ω ∉ A → X ω ≤ B ω)
    (hbad : ∀ ω, ω ∈ A → X ω ≤ B ω + M) :
    average X ≤ average B + M * eventProbability A := by
  calc
    _ ≤ average (fun ω => B ω + if ω ∈ A then M else 0) := by
      apply average_mono
      intro ω
      split_ifs with h
      · exact hbad ω h
      · simpa using hgood ω h
    _ = _ := by rw [average_add, average_indicator]

end GraphChoices

namespace GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy
open Finset
variable {E L R C : Type*} [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E] [Nonempty E]
  [Fintype L] [Fintype R] [Fintype C]
  [DecidableEq L] [DecidableEq R] [DecidableEq C]

/-- The actual large-component event, rather than a canonical pattern event. -/

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.largeCompon.source:
noncomputable def largeComponentEvent (encode : E → Arrival L R C) (α : C → ℕ)
    (T s : ℕ) : Finset (Fin T → E) := by
  classical
  exact univ.filter fun ω => ∃ v,
    s < (componentVertices (residualInstance α (sampleArrivals encode ω)) v).card

omit [DecidableEq E] [Nonempty E] [Fintype C] in

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.not_mem_lar.source:
theorem not_mem_largeComponentEvent (encode : E → Arrival L R C) (α : C → ℕ)
    (T s : ℕ) (ω : Fin T → E) :
    ω ∉ largeComponentEvent encode α T s ↔
      ∀ v, (componentVertices (residualInstance α (sampleArrivals encode ω)) v).card ≤ s := by
  classical
  simp [largeComponentEvent]

/-- Expected offline optimum of the full encoded arrival sequence. -/

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.expectedRep.source:
noncomputable def expectedReplayOpt (encode : E → Arrival L R C) (T : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  average (fun ω : Fin T → E => (opt (replayInstance (sampleArrivals encode ω)) : ℝ))

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.expectedTot.source:
noncomputable def expectedTotalMaxLoad (encode : E → Arrival L R C) (α : C → ℕ) (T : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  average (fun ω : Fin T → E => (totalMaxLoad α (sampleArrivals encode ω) : ℝ))

/-- The expectation step of Theorem 4.1. Its error is T times the probability
of an actual large residual component; that probability is not assumed small. -/

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.expected_lo.source:
theorem expected_load_le_component_tail (encode : E → Arrival L R C) (α : C → ℕ)
    (T s : ℕ) :
    expectedTotalMaxLoad encode α T ≤ (∑ c, (α c : ℝ)) +
      (2 * (Nat.log 2 s + 1) : ℕ) * expectedReplayOpt encode T +
      T * eventProbability (largeComponentEvent encode α T s) := by
  let B : (Fin T → E) → ℝ := fun ω => (∑ c, (α c : ℝ)) +
    (2 * (Nat.log 2 s + 1) : ℕ) * (opt (replayInstance (sampleArrivals encode ω)) : ℝ)
  have hb : ∀ ω : Fin T → E, (∑ c, (α c : ℝ)) ≤ B ω := by
    intro ω
    dsimp [B]
    exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (by positivity)
  have h := average_le_good_add_bad
    (fun ω : Fin T → E => (totalMaxLoad α (sampleArrivals encode ω) : ℝ))
    B (largeComponentEvent encode α T s) (T : ℝ) ?_ ?_
  · change expectedTotalMaxLoad encode α T ≤ _ at h
    have heq : average B = (∑ c, (α c : ℝ)) +
        (2 * (Nat.log 2 s + 1) : ℕ) * expectedReplayOpt encode T := by
      dsimp only [B]
      rw [average_add, average_const, average_mul]
      rfl
    rwa [heq] at h
  · intro ω hω
    have hsmall := (not_mem_largeComponentEvent encode α T s ω).mp hω
    have hh := totalMaxLoad_of_small_components α (sampleArrivals encode ω) s hsmall
    have hh' : (totalMaxLoad α (sampleArrivals encode ω) : ℝ) ≤
        (∑ c, (α c : ℝ)) +
          (2 * opt (replayInstance (sampleArrivals encode ω)) * (Nat.log 2 s + 1) : ℕ) := by
      exact_mod_cast hh
    dsimp [B]
    convert hh' using 1 <;> push_cast <;> ring
  · intro ω _
    have hh := totalMaxLoad_le_budget_add_length α (sampleArrivals encode ω)
    rw [sampleArrivals_length] at hh
    have hh' : (totalMaxLoad α (sampleArrivals encode ω) : ℝ) ≤ (∑ c, (α c : ℝ)) + T := by
      exact_mod_cast hh
    exact hh'.trans (add_le_add_right (hb ω) _)

theorem expected_load_of_component_tail (encode : E → Arrival L R C) (α : C → ℕ)
    (T s : ℕ) (ε : ℝ)
    (htail : eventProbability (largeComponentEvent encode α T s) ≤ ε) :
    expectedTotalMaxLoad encode α T ≤ (∑ c, (α c : ℝ)) +
      (2 * (Nat.log 2 s + 1) : ℕ) * expectedReplayOpt encode T + T * ε := by
  apply (expected_load_le_component_tail encode α T s).trans
  exact add_le_add_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htail (Nat.cast_nonneg T)) _

end GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy

GraphChoices.endpoints_mem_of_destinatio.source:
theorem endpoints_mem_of_destination_mem (I : Instance V T) (a : Orientation T)
    (S : Finset V) (hS : EdgeClosed I S) (t : Fin T)
    (ht : destination I a t ∈ S) : I.left t ∈ S ∧ I.right t ∈ S := by
  rcases destination_endpoint I a t with h | h
  · rw [h] at ht
    exact ⟨ht, (hS t).mp ht⟩
  · rw [h] at ht
    exact ⟨(hS t).mpr ht, ht⟩

GraphChoices.localHighVertices.source:
def localHighVertices (I : Instance V T) (a : Orientation T) (S : Finset V) (k : ℕ) :=
  S.filter fun v => k ≤ load I a v

GraphChoices.localHighArrivals.source:
def localHighArrivals (I : Instance V T) (a : Orientation T) (S : Finset V) (k : ℕ) :=
  (highArrivals I a k).filter fun t => destination I a t ∈ S

GraphChoices.localHighArrivals_internal.source:
theorem localHighArrivals_internal (I : Instance V T) (a : Orientation T)
    (hg : IsGreedy I a) (S : Finset V) (hS : EdgeClosed I S) (k : ℕ) :
    localHighArrivals I a S k ⊆ univ.filter (fun t =>
      I.left t ∈ localHighVertices I a S k ∧ I.right t ∈ localHighVertices I a S k) := by
  intro t ht
  obtain ⟨hhigh, hmem⟩ := mem_filter.mp ht
  have he := endpoints_mem_of_destination_mem I a S hS t hmem
  have hh := (mem_filter.mp (highArrivals_internal I a hg k hhigh)).2
  simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, localHighVertices, highVertices] at hh ⊢
  exact ⟨⟨he.1, hh.1⟩, ⟨he.2, hh.2⟩⟩

GraphChoices.greedy_local_layer_bound.source:
theorem greedy_local_layer_bound (I : Instance V T) (a : Orientation T)
    (hg : IsGreedy I a) (S : Finset V) (hS : EdgeClosed I S) (k d : ℕ) :
    d * (localHighVertices I a S (k+d)).card ≤
      opt I * (localHighVertices I a S k).card := by
  calc
    _ = ∑ v ∈ localHighVertices I a S (k+d), d := by simp [mul_comm]
    _ ≤ ∑ v ∈ localHighVertices I a S (k+d),
        ((localHighArrivals I a S k).filter fun t => destination I a t = v).card := by
      apply sum_le_sum
      intro v hv
      obtain ⟨hvS, hvload⟩ := mem_filter.mp hv
      have heq : ((localHighArrivals I a S k).filter fun t => destination I a t = v) =
          ((highArrivals I a k).filter fun t => destination I a t = v) := by
        ext t
        simp only [localHighArrivals, mem_filter]
        constructor
        · exact fun h => ⟨h.1.1, h.2⟩
        · exact fun h => ⟨⟨h.1, h.2 ▸ hvS⟩, h.2⟩
      rw [heq]
      have hb := load_le_low_add_high I a v k
      omega
    _ ≤ ∑ v, ((localHighArrivals I a S k).filter fun t => destination I a t = v).card :=
      sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (subset_univ _) (fun _ _ _ => Nat.zero_le _)
    _ = (localHighArrivals I a S k).card := by
      symm
      exact card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise (fun _ _ => mem_univ _)
    _ ≤ internalCount I (localHighVertices I a S k) :=
      card_le_card (localHighArrivals_internal I a hg S hS k)
    _ ≤ opt I * (localHighVertices I a S k).card := by
      simpa [mul_comm] using density_le_opt I (localHighVertices I a S k)

GraphChoices.greedy_local_layers_decay.source:
theorem greedy_local_layers_decay (I : Instance V T) (a : Orientation T)
    (hg : IsGreedy I a) (S : Finset V) (hS : EdgeClosed I S)
    (hc : 0 < opt I) (j : ℕ) :
    2^j * (localHighVertices I a S (2*opt I*j)).card ≤ S.card := by
  induction j with
  | zero => simp [localHighVertices]
  | succ j ih =>
    have h := greedy_local_layer_bound I a hg S hS (2*opt I*j) (2*opt I)
    have hstep : 2 * (localHighVertices I a S (2*opt I*(j+1))).card ≤
        (localHighVertices I a S (2*opt I*j)).card := by
      have heq : 2*opt I*j + 2*opt I = 2*opt I*(j+1) := by ring
      rw [heq] at h
      nlinarith
    calc
      _ = 2^j * (2 * (localHighVertices I a S (2*opt I*(j+1))).card) := by
        rw [pow_succ]; ring
      _ ≤ 2^j * (localHighVertices I a S (2*opt I*j)).card := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hstep
      _ ≤ _ := ih

GraphChoices.greedy_load_lt_of_closed.source:
theorem greedy_load_lt_of_closed (I : Instance V T) (a : Orientation T)
    (hg : IsGreedy I a) (S : Finset V) (hS : EdgeClosed I S)
    (hT : 0 < T) (j : ℕ) (hj : S.card < 2^j) (v : V) (hv : v ∈ S) :
    load I a v < 2*opt I*j := by
  have hd := greedy_local_layers_decay I a hg S hS (opt_pos I hT) j
  by_contra h
  have hm : v ∈ localHighVertices I a S (2*opt I*j) := mem_filter.mpr ⟨hv, by omega⟩
  have hp := card_pos.mpr ⟨v, hm⟩
  have hh := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (2^j) (show 1 ≤ (localHighVertices I a S (2*opt I*j)).card by omega)
  omega

/-- Forget multiplicities only for connectivity. Loads still count all times. -/

GraphChoices.arrivalGraph.source:
def arrivalGraph (I : Instance V T) : SimpleGraph V where
  Adj u v := u ≠ v ∧ ∃ t, (I.left t = u ∧ I.right t = v) ∨
    (I.left t = v ∧ I.right t = u)
  symm := by
    intro u v h
