    obtain ⟨hne, t, ht⟩ := h
    exact ⟨hne.symm, t, ht.symm⟩
  loopless := by intro u h; exact h.1 rfl

GraphChoices.componentVertices.source:
noncomputable def componentVertices (I : Instance V T) (v : V) : Finset V := by
  classical
  exact univ.filter fun w => (arrivalGraph I).Reachable v w

omit [DecidableEq V] in

GraphChoices.mem_componentVertices.source:
theorem mem_componentVertices (I : Instance V T) (v w : V) :
    w ∈ componentVertices I v ↔ (arrivalGraph I).Reachable v w := by
  classical
  simp [componentVertices]

omit [DecidableEq V] in

GraphChoices.self_mem_componentVertices.source:
theorem self_mem_componentVertices (I : Instance V T) (v : V) :
    v ∈ componentVertices I v :=
  (mem_componentVertices I v v).mpr (SimpleGraph.Reachable.refl v)

omit [Fintype V] in

GraphChoices.arrival_endpoints_reachable.source:
theorem arrival_endpoints_reachable (I : Instance V T) (t : Fin T) :
    (arrivalGraph I).Reachable (I.left t) (I.right t) := by
  by_cases h : I.left t = I.right t
  · rw [h]
  · exact SimpleGraph.Adj.reachable ⟨h, t, Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩

GraphChoices.componentVertices_closed.source:
theorem componentVertices_closed (I : Instance V T) (v : V) :
    EdgeClosed I (componentVertices I v) := by
  intro t
  rw [mem_componentVertices, mem_componentVertices]
  have h := arrival_endpoints_reachable I t
  exact ⟨fun hv => hv.trans h, fun hv => hv.trans h.symm⟩

/-- Component-local Fact 3.6, benchmarked against the full arrival instance. -/

GraphChoices.greedy_component_competitiv.source:
theorem greedy_component_competitive (I : Instance V T) (a : Orientation T)
    (hg : IsGreedy I a) (hT : 0 < T) (v : V) :
    load I a v < 2*opt I*(Nat.log 2 (componentVertices I v).card + 1) :=
  greedy_load_lt_of_closed I a hg _ (componentVertices_closed I v) hT _
    (Nat.lt_pow_succ_log_self (by decide) _) v (self_mem_componentVertices I v)

end GraphChoices

GraphChoices.connected_both_colors.source:
theorem connected_both_colors (G : SimpleGraph V) (left : V → Bool)
    (hc : G.Connected) (hcolor : ∀ x y, G.Adj x y → left x ≠ left y)
    (hcard : 1 < Fintype.card V) :
    (∃ v, left v = true) ∧ (∃ v, left v = false) := by
  haveI : Nontrivial V := Fintype.one_lt_card_iff_nontrivial.mp hcard
  obtain ⟨u, v, hne⟩ := exists_pair_ne V
  obtain ⟨p⟩ := hc u v
  cases p with
  | nil => exact (hne rfl).elim
  | @cons u w v h p =>
    have hdiff := hcolor u w h
    cases hu : left u <;> cases hw : left w
    · exact (hdiff (hu.trans hw.symm)).elim
    · exact ⟨⟨w, hw⟩, ⟨u, hu⟩⟩
    · exact ⟨⟨u, hu⟩, ⟨w, hw⟩⟩
    · exact (hdiff (hu.trans hw.symm)).elim

GraphChoices.component_induce_degree.source:
theorem component_induce_degree {T : ℕ} (I : Instance V T) (v : V)
    (x : {w : V // w ∈ componentVertices I v}) :
    let G := arrivalGraph I
    letI : DecidableRel G.Adj := Classical.decRel _
    (G.induce (componentVertices I v : Set V)).degree x = G.degree x.val := by
  classical
  dsimp only
  simp only [← SimpleGraph.card_neighborSet_eq_degree]
  apply Fintype.card_congr
  refine {
    toFun := fun w => ⟨w.val.val, w.property⟩
    invFun := fun w => ⟨⟨w.val, ?_⟩, w.property⟩
    left_inv := fun w => rfl
    right_inv := fun w => rfl }
  exact (mem_componentVertices I v w.val).mpr
    (((mem_componentVertices I v x.val).mp x.property).trans w.property.reachable)

end GraphChoices

namespace GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy
open Finset
variable {L R C : Type*} [Fintype L] [Fintype R]
  [DecidableEq L] [DecidableEq R] [DecidableEq C]

/-- Every nontrivial replay component has a large left-heavy tree with a
right root and edges in the actual residual graph. The subtree's vertex type
is a subset of the component, so its ambient vertex map is injective. -/

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.replay_comp.source:
theorem replay_component_left_heavy_tree (es : List (Arrival L R C)) (v : L ⊕ R)
    (D : ℕ) (hD : ∀ u, (listLeftNeighbors es u).card ≤ D)
    (hlarge : 1 < (componentVertices (replayInstance es) v).card) :
    let U := {w : L ⊕ R // w ∈ componentVertices (replayInstance es) v}
    ∃ s : Set U, ∃ H : SimpleGraph s,
      H.IsTree ∧
      (∀ x y, H.Adj x y → (arrivalGraph (replayInstance es)).Adj x.val.val y.val.val) ∧
      (componentVertices (replayInstance es) v).card ≤ (D+1) * Nat.card s ∧
      Nat.card {x : s // isLeft x.val.val = false} + 1 ≤
        Nat.card {x : s // isLeft x.val.val = true} ∧
      (1 < Nat.card s → ∃ root : s, isLeft root.val.val = false) := by
  classical
  let U := {w : L ⊕ R // w ∈ componentVertices (replayInstance es) v}
  let G : SimpleGraph U := (arrivalGraph (replayInstance es)).induce
    (componentVertices (replayInstance es) v : Set (L ⊕ R))
  have hconn : G.Connected := component_induce_connected _ _
  have hcolor : ∀ x y, G.Adj x y → isLeft x.val ≠ isLeft y.val :=
    fun x y hxy => replay_adj_sides es x.val y.val hxy
  have hcard : 1 < Fintype.card U := by simpa only [U, Fintype.card_coe] using hlarge
  obtain ⟨root, hroot⟩ := (connected_both_colors G (fun x => isLeft x.val) hconn hcolor hcard).1
  have hdeg : ∀ x : U, isLeft x.val = true → G.degree x ≤ D := by
    intro x hx
    rw [component_induce_degree]
    cases heq : x.val with
    | inl u => rw [replay_left_degree]; exact hD u
    | inr w => simp [heq, isLeft] at hx
  obtain ⟨s, H, htree, hsub, _, hsize, hheavy⟩ :=
    exists_large_left_heavy_tree G (fun x => isLeft x.val) hconn hcolor root hroot D hdeg
  refine ⟨s, H, htree, ?_, ?_, hheavy, ?_⟩
  · intro x y hxy
    exact hsub hxy
  · simpa only [U, Fintype.card_coe] using hsize
  · intro hs
    have hcol : ∀ x y, H.Adj x y → isLeft x.val.val ≠ isLeft y.val.val :=
      fun x y hxy => hcolor x.val y.val (hsub hxy)
    have hcard' : 1 < Fintype.card s := by simpa only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using hs
    exact (connected_both_colors H (fun x => isLeft x.val.val) htree.isConnected hcol hcard').2

end GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy

GraphChoices.eventProbability_union_le.source:
theorem eventProbability_union_le {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq Ω]
    (A B : Finset Ω) : eventProbability (A ∪ B) ≤ eventProbability A + eventProbability B := by
  unfold eventProbability
  rw [← add_div]
  apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
  exact_mod_cast card_union_le A B

end GraphChoices

namespace GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy
open Finset
variable {E L R C : Type*} [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E] [Nonempty E]
  [Fintype L] [Fintype R] [DecidableEq L] [DecidableEq R] [DecidableEq C]

/-- A genuine geometric tree in an actual replay component. Its vertices are
a subset of that component, and every edge is an actual replay adjacency. -/

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.HasLargeHea.source:
def HasLargeHeavyTree (es : List (Arrival L R C)) (k : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ v : L ⊕ R,
  ∃ s : Set {w : L ⊕ R // w ∈ componentVertices (replayInstance es) v},
  ∃ H : SimpleGraph s,
    H.IsTree ∧
    (∀ x y, H.Adj x y → (arrivalGraph (replayInstance es)).Adj x.val.val y.val.val) ∧
    k+1 < Nat.card s ∧
    Nat.card {x : s // isLeft x.val.val = false} + 1 ≤
      Nat.card {x : s // isLeft x.val.val = true} ∧
    ∃ root : s, isLeft root.val.val = false

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.largeHeavyT.source:
noncomputable def largeHeavyTreeEvent (encode : E → Arrival L R C) (α : C → ℕ)
    (T k : ℕ) : Finset (Fin T → E) := by
  classical
  exact univ.filter fun ω => HasLargeHeavyTree (residualArrivals (trace α (sampleArrivals encode ω))) k

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.largeLeftDe.source:
noncomputable def largeLeftDegreeEvent (encode : E → Arrival L R C) (α : C → ℕ)
    (T D : ℕ) : Finset (Fin T → E) := by
  classical
  exact univ.filter fun ω => ∃ u,
    D < (listLeftNeighbors (residualArrivals (trace α (sampleArrivals encode ω))) u).card

/-- The deterministic reduction applied to actual random executions. There is
no assumed tree-extraction or side/degree agreement in this containment. -/

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.largeCompon.source:
theorem largeComponent_subset_degree_or_tree (encode : E → Arrival L R C) (α : C → ℕ)
    (T D k : ℕ) :
    largeComponentEvent encode α T ((D+1)*(k+1)) ⊆
      largeLeftDegreeEvent encode α T D ∪ largeHeavyTreeEvent encode α T k := by
  classical
  intro ω hω
  by_cases hbad : ω ∈ largeLeftDegreeEvent encode α T D
  · exact mem_union_left _ hbad
  apply mem_union_right
  have hD : ∀ u, (listLeftNeighbors (residualArrivals (trace α (sampleArrivals encode ω))) u).card ≤ D := by
    simpa only [largeLeftDegreeEvent, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, not_exists, not_lt] using hbad
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := (mem_filter.mp hω).2
  have hlarge : 1 < (componentVertices (residualInstance α (sampleArrivals encode ω)) v).card := by
    have hpos : 1 ≤ (D+1)*(k+1) := Nat.mul_pos (by omega) (by omega)
    omega
  obtain ⟨s, H, ht, hadj, hsize, hheavy, hroot⟩ :=
    replay_component_left_heavy_tree (residualArrivals (trace α (sampleArrivals encode ω))) v D hD hlarge
  have hs : k+1 < Nat.card s := by
    have hmult : (D+1)*(k+1) < (D+1)*Nat.card s := hv.trans_le hsize
    exact (Nat.mul_lt_mul_left (by omega : 0 < D+1)).mp hmult
  exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, v, s, H, ht, hadj, hs, hheavy, hroot (by omega)⟩

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.largeLeftDe.source:
theorem largeLeftDegree_probability_le (encode : E → Arrival L R C) (α : C → ℕ)
    (T D : ℕ) (r : ℝ)
    (hmean : ∀ u, Real.exp 1*T*(((leftSourceBucket encode u).card : ℝ)/Fintype.card E)/(D+1) ≤ r) :
    eventProbability (largeLeftDegreeEvent encode α T D) ≤ Fintype.card L * r^(D+1) := by
  have h := residual_left_degree_tail encode α T (D+1) r
    (by simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using hmean)
  simpa only [largeLeftDegreeEvent, Nat.add_one_le_iff] using h

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.largeCompon.source:
theorem largeComponent_probability_le_tree_tail (encode : E → Arrival L R C) (α : C → ℕ)
    (T D k : ℕ) (r ε : ℝ)
    (hmean : ∀ u, Real.exp 1*T*(((leftSourceBucket encode u).card : ℝ)/Fintype.card E)/(D+1) ≤ r)
    (htree : eventProbability (largeHeavyTreeEvent encode α T k) ≤ ε) :
    eventProbability (largeComponentEvent encode α T ((D+1)*(k+1))) ≤
      Fintype.card L * r^(D+1) + ε := by
  calc
    _ ≤ eventProbability (largeLeftDegreeEvent encode α T D ∪ largeHeavyTreeEvent encode α T k) :=
      eventProbability_mono (largeComponent_subset_degree_or_tree encode α T D k)
    _ ≤ eventProbability (largeLeftDegreeEvent encode α T D) +
        eventProbability (largeHeavyTreeEvent encode α T k) := eventProbability_union_le _ _
    _ ≤ _ := add_le_add (largeLeftDegree_probability_le encode α T D r hmean) htree

end GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy

namespace GraphChoices.Patterns
open ThresholdGreedy
variable {E L R C : Type*} [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E] [Nonempty E]
  [Fintype L] [Fintype R] [Fintype C]
  [DecidableEq L] [DecidableEq R] [DecidableEq C]

/-- Conditional shattering assembly. `hcoverage` is the remaining deterministic
canonical-enumeration containment; it is not established by this theorem. -/

GraphChoices.Patterns.largeComponent_tai.source:
theorem largeComponent_tail_of_canonical_coverage (H : C → Peeling.Graph L R)
    (encode : E → Arrival L R C) (α : C → ℕ) (T D k B : ℕ) (r : ℝ)
    (hmean : ∀ u, Real.exp 1*T*(((leftSourceBucket encode u).card : ℝ)/Fintype.card E)/(D+1) ≤ r)
    (hcoverage : largeHeavyTreeEvent encode α T k ⊆ largeShapeEvent H encode α T k B)
    (hshape : ∀ j ≤ B, eventProbability (heavyShapeEvent H encode α T (k+j)) ≤
      (Fintype.card R : ℝ)/2^(k+j)) :
    eventProbability (largeComponentEvent encode α T ((D+1)*(k+1))) ≤
      Fintype.card L * r^(D+1) + 2*(Fintype.card R : ℝ)/2^k := by
  apply largeComponent_probability_le_tree_tail encode α T D k r _ hmean
  exact (eventProbability_mono hcoverage).trans (largeShape_probability_le H encode α T k B hshape)

end GraphChoices.Patterns

GraphChoices.componentVertices_coe_eq_su.source:
theorem componentVertices_coe_eq_supp (I : Instance V T) (v : V) :
    (componentVertices I v : Set V) = ((arrivalGraph I).connectedComponentMk v).supp := by
  ext w
  simp only [Finset.mem_coe, mem_componentVertices,
    SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff, SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.eq]
  exact SimpleGraph.reachable_comm

GraphChoices.component_induce_connected.source:
theorem component_induce_connected (I : Instance V T) (v : V) :
    ((arrivalGraph I).induce (componentVertices I v : Set V)).Connected := by
  rw [componentVertices_coe_eq_supp]
  exact SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.connected_toSimpleGraph _

/-- Spanning-tree extraction from an actual component, including its exact
vertex count. Edges inherit original occurrence times, with no sampling premise. -/

GraphChoices.exists_component_spanning_t.source:
theorem exists_component_spanning_tree (I : Instance V T) (v : V) :
    ∃ H : SimpleGraph {w : V // w ∈ componentVertices I v},
      H.IsTree ∧
      (∀ x y, H.Adj x y → ∃ t : Fin T,
        (I.left t = x.val ∧ I.right t = y.val) ∨
        (I.left t = y.val ∧ I.right t = x.val)) ∧
      Fintype.card {w : V // w ∈ componentVertices I v} = (componentVertices I v).card := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨H, hle, htree⟩ := (component_induce_connected I v).exists_isTree_le
  refine ⟨H, htree, ?_, Fintype.card_coe _⟩
  intro x y hxy
  exact (hle hxy).2

end GraphChoices

GraphChoices.Patterns.sampledDegreeCutof.source:
noncomputable def sampledDegreeCutoff (M T N c : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ⌈2*Real.exp 1*T*(M:ℝ)/Fintype.card E⌉₊ + polynomialCutoff N c

theorem sampledDegreeCutoff_ge (M T N c : ℕ) :
    polynomialCutoff N c ≤ sampledDegreeCutoff (E := E) M T N c + 1 := by
  unfold sampledDegreeCutoff
  omega

theorem sampledDegreeCutoff_mean (encode : E → Arrival L R C) (M T N c : ℕ)
    (hM : ∀ u, (leftSourceBucket encode u).card ≤ M) :
    ∀ u, Real.exp 1*T*(((leftSourceBucket encode u).card : ℝ)/Fintype.card E)/
      ((sampledDegreeCutoff (E := E) M T N c : ℕ)+1 : ℝ) ≤ 1/2 := by
  intro u
  have hbucket : ((leftSourceBucket encode u).card : ℝ) ≤ M := by exact_mod_cast hM u
  have hmean := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hbucket (Nat.cast_nonneg (Fintype.card E)))
    (show 0 ≤ Real.exp 1*(T:ℝ) by positivity)
  have hc := Nat.le_ceil (2*Real.exp 1*T*(M:ℝ)/Fintype.card E)
  have hcut : ⌈2*Real.exp 1*T*(M:ℝ)/Fintype.card E⌉₊ ≤ sampledDegreeCutoff (E := E) M T N c := by
    unfold sampledDegreeCutoff
    omega
  have hcut' : (⌈2*Real.exp 1*T*(M:ℝ)/Fintype.card E⌉₊ : ℝ) ≤ sampledDegreeCutoff (E := E) M T N c := by
    exact_mod_cast hcut
  apply (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < (sampledDegreeCutoff (E := E) M T N c : ℝ)+1)).mpr
  have heq : Real.exp 1*T*((M:ℝ)/Fintype.card E) = Real.exp 1*T*(M:ℝ)/Fintype.card E := by ring
  rw [heq] at hmean
  have htwo : 2*(Real.exp 1*T*(M:ℝ)/Fintype.card E) ≤
      (⌈2*Real.exp 1*T*(M:ℝ)/Fintype.card E⌉₊ : ℝ) := by
    convert hc using 1 <;> ring
  linarith

/-- Actual component failure at most 3/N^c with a concrete cutoff. The graph
and sampling degree bounds are explicit input data, not probability premises. -/

GraphChoices.Patterns.concrete_component.source:
theorem concrete_component_tail (H : C → Peeling.Graph L R)
    (encode : E → Arrival L R C) (DL DR : C → ℕ) (D M T N c : ℕ) (f : C → ℝ)
    (hsimple : Function.Injective fun e => ((encode e).left,(encode e).right))
    (hsource : ∀ e, ((encode e).left, (encode e).right) ∈ H (encode e).cls)
    (hDL : ∀ u a, (sourceBucket encode u a).card ≤ DL a)
    (hL : ∀ a u, Peeling.leftDegree (H a) u ≤ D)
    (hR : ∀ a v, Peeling.rightDegree (H a) v ≤ DR a)
    (hM : ∀ u, (leftSourceBucket encode u).card ≤ M)
    (hT : 0 < T) (hf : ∀ a, 1 < f a)
    (hN : 0 < N) (hLN : Fintype.card L ≤ N) (hRN : Fintype.card R ≤ N) :
    eventProbability (largeComponentEvent encode (automaticThresholds (E := E) DL DR D T f)
      T ((sampledDegreeCutoff (E := E) M T N c+1)*(polynomialCutoff N c+1))) ≤ 3/(N:ℝ)^c :=
  largeComponent_polynomial_automatic H encode DL DR D T _ _ N c f hsimple hsource hDL hL hR hT hf
    hN hLN hRN (sampledDegreeCutoff_ge M T N c) le_rfl (sampledDegreeCutoff_mean encode M T N c hM)

GraphChoices.Patterns.concrete_expected_.source:
theorem concrete_expected_load (H : C → Peeling.Graph L R)
    (encode : E → Arrival L R C) (DL DR : C → ℕ) (D M T N c : ℕ) (f : C → ℝ)
    (hsimple : Function.Injective fun e => ((encode e).left,(encode e).right))
    (hsource : ∀ e, ((encode e).left, (encode e).right) ∈ H (encode e).cls)
    (hDL : ∀ u a, (sourceBucket encode u a).card ≤ DL a)
    (hL : ∀ a u, Peeling.leftDegree (H a) u ≤ D)
    (hR : ∀ a v, Peeling.rightDegree (H a) v ≤ DR a)
    (hM : ∀ u, (leftSourceBucket encode u).card ≤ M)
    (hT : 0 < T) (hf : ∀ a, 1 < f a)
    (hN : 0 < N) (hLN : Fintype.card L ≤ N) (hRN : Fintype.card R ≤ N) :
    expectedTotalMaxLoad encode (automaticThresholds (E := E) DL DR D T f) T ≤
      (∑ a, (automaticThresholds (E := E) DL DR D T f a : ℝ)) +
      (2*(Nat.log 2 ((sampledDegreeCutoff (E := E) M T N c+1)*(polynomialCutoff N c+1))+1) : ℕ)*
        expectedReplayOpt encode T + 3*T/(N:ℝ)^c :=
  expected_load_polynomial_automatic H encode DL DR D T _ _ N c f hsimple hsource hDL hL hR hT hf
    hN hLN hRN (sampledDegreeCutoff_ge M T N c) le_rfl (sampledDegreeCutoff_mean encode M T N c hM)

GraphChoices.Patterns.sampledDegreeCutof.source:
theorem sampledDegreeCutoff_le_three_cutoffs (M T N c : ℕ)
    (hmean : Real.exp 1*T*(M:ℝ)/Fintype.card E ≤ (polynomialCutoff N c : ℝ)) :
    sampledDegreeCutoff (E := E) M T N c ≤ 3*polynomialCutoff N c := by
  have hceil : ⌈2*Real.exp 1*T*(M:ℝ)/Fintype.card E⌉₊ ≤ 2*polynomialCutoff N c := by
    apply Nat.ceil_le.mpr
    push_cast
    calc
      _ = 2*(Real.exp 1*T*(M:ℝ)/Fintype.card E) := by ring
      _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmean (by norm_num)
  unfold sampledDegreeCutoff
  omega

GraphChoices.Patterns.largeComponentEven.source:
theorem largeComponentEvent_antitone (encode : E → Arrival L R C) (α : C → ℕ)
    (T a b : ℕ) (hab : a ≤ b) :
    largeComponentEvent encode α T b ⊆ largeComponentEvent encode α T a := by
  classical
  intro ω hω
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := (mem_filter.mp hω).2
  exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, v, hab.trans_lt hv⟩

/-- The log-squared component bound, with all tree-coverage and numerical
tail conditions discharged. The sole additional mean condition is an explicit
upper bound on the expected sampled left degree (including its factor e). -/

GraphChoices.Patterns.log_squared_compon.source:
theorem log_squared_component_tail (H : C → Peeling.Graph L R)
    (encode : E → Arrival L R C) (DL DR : C → ℕ) (D M T N c : ℕ) (f : C → ℝ)
    (hsimple : Function.Injective fun e => ((encode e).left,(encode e).right))
    (hsource : ∀ e, ((encode e).left, (encode e).right) ∈ H (encode e).cls)
    (hDL : ∀ u a, (sourceBucket encode u a).card ≤ DL a)
    (hL : ∀ a u, Peeling.leftDegree (H a) u ≤ D)
    (hR : ∀ a v, Peeling.rightDegree (H a) v ≤ DR a)
    (hM : ∀ u, (leftSourceBucket encode u).card ≤ M)
    (hT : 0 < T) (hf : ∀ a, 1 < f a)
    (hN : 0 < N) (hLN : Fintype.card L ≤ N) (hRN : Fintype.card R ≤ N)
    (hmean : Real.exp 1*T*(M:ℝ)/Fintype.card E ≤ (polynomialCutoff N c : ℝ)) :
    eventProbability (largeComponentEvent encode (automaticThresholds (E := E) DL DR D T f)
      T (3*(polynomialCutoff N c+1)^2)) ≤ 3/(N:ℝ)^c := by
  have hd := sampledDegreeCutoff_le_three_cutoffs M T N c hmean
  have hsize : (sampledDegreeCutoff (E := E) M T N c+1)*(polynomialCutoff N c+1) ≤
      3*(polynomialCutoff N c+1)^2 := by
    have hm := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (polynomialCutoff N c+1) (Nat.add_le_add_right hd 1)
    nlinarith
  apply (eventProbability_mono (largeComponentEvent_antitone encode _ T _ _ hsize)).trans
  exact concrete_component_tail H encode DL DR D M T N c f hsimple hsource hDL hL hR hM hT hf hN hLN hRN

GraphChoices.Patterns.log_squared_expect.source:
theorem log_squared_expected_load (H : C → Peeling.Graph L R)
    (encode : E → Arrival L R C) (DL DR : C → ℕ) (D M T N c : ℕ) (f : C → ℝ)
    (hsimple : Function.Injective fun e => ((encode e).left,(encode e).right))
    (hsource : ∀ e, ((encode e).left, (encode e).right) ∈ H (encode e).cls)
    (hDL : ∀ u a, (sourceBucket encode u a).card ≤ DL a)
    (hL : ∀ a u, Peeling.leftDegree (H a) u ≤ D)
    (hR : ∀ a v, Peeling.rightDegree (H a) v ≤ DR a)
    (hM : ∀ u, (leftSourceBucket encode u).card ≤ M)
    (hT : 0 < T) (hf : ∀ a, 1 < f a)
    (hN : 0 < N) (hLN : Fintype.card L ≤ N) (hRN : Fintype.card R ≤ N)
    (hmean : Real.exp 1*T*(M:ℝ)/Fintype.card E ≤ (polynomialCutoff N c : ℝ)) :
    expectedTotalMaxLoad encode (automaticThresholds (E := E) DL DR D T f) T ≤
      (∑ a, (automaticThresholds (E := E) DL DR D T f a : ℝ)) +
      (2*(Nat.log 2 (3*(polynomialCutoff N c+1)^2)+1) : ℕ)*expectedReplayOpt encode T + 3*T/(N:ℝ)^c := by
  have ht := log_squared_component_tail H encode DL DR D M T N c f hsimple hsource hDL hL hR hM hT hf
    hN hLN hRN hmean
  have h := expected_load_of_component_tail encode _ T _ _ ht
  convert h using 1 <;> ring

end GraphChoices.Patterns

GraphChoices.Peeling.PreparedDecompositi.source:
theorem PreparedDecomposition.component_tail (P : PreparedDecomposition G B N d) (T c : ℕ)
    (hT : 0 < T) (hTN : T ≤ N) (hc : 5 ≤ c)
    (hvertices : Fintype.card (L ⊕ R) ≤ N)
    (haverage : 2*(G.card : ℝ) = (N:ℝ)*d) :
    eventProbability (largeComponentEvent P.encode (P.thresholds T) T
      (3*(polynomialCutoff N c+1)^2)) ≤ 3/(N:ℝ)^c := by
  have hv : Fintype.card L + Fintype.card R ≤ N := by simpa only [Fintype.card_sum] using hvertices
  have hLN : Fintype.card L ≤ N := by omega
  have hRN : Fintype.card R ≤ N := by omega
  exact preprocessed_log_squared_component_tail P.pieces.get P.encode P.DL P.DR
    (4*B) (maxLeftDegree G) T N c (fun i => scaleNat i.val) d P.simple P.source
    P.bucket_bound P.piece_left_cap P.piece_right_cap P.global_bucket_bound
    hT hTN P.scale_gt_one P.vertex_count_pos hLN hRN hc P.max_degree_preprocessing
    (by simpa only [Fintype.card_coe] using haverage)

/-- Concrete finite form of the preprocessed T=N algorithmic guarantee.
The policy is nonanticipating by construction, and its cost and benchmark
are the original indexed sampling definitions. The threshold budget is the
explicit formula derived from this exact decomposition's real degree bounds. -/

theorem PreparedDecomposition.expected_cost_at_vertex_horizon (P : PreparedDecomposition G B N d)
    (c : ℕ) (hc : 5 ≤ c) (hvertices : Fintype.card (L ⊕ R) ≤ N)
    (haverage : 2*(G.card : ℝ) = (N:ℝ)*d) :
    expectedCost (graphBase G) (onlineOrientation (T := N) (P.policy N)) ≤
      P.budget N + (2*(Nat.log 2 (3*(polynomialCutoff N c+1)^2)+1) : ℕ)*
        expectedOpt (graphBase G) N + 3*N/(N:ℝ)^c := by
  have ht := P.component_tail N c P.vertex_count_pos le_rfl hc hvertices haverage
  have h := expected_load_of_component_tail P.encode (P.thresholds N) N _ _ ht
  rw [expectedTotalMaxLoad_eq_expectedCost, expectedReplayOpt_eq_expectedOpt] at h
  change expectedCost (graphBase G) (onlineOrientation (T := N) (P.policy N)) ≤
    (∑ i, (P.thresholds N i : ℝ)) + (2*(Nat.log 2 (3*(polynomialCutoff N c+1)^2)+1) : ℕ)*
      expectedOpt (graphBase G) N + N*(3/(N:ℝ)^c) at h
  have hb := P.threshold_budget N (P.mass_at_vertex_horizon haverage)
  calc
    _ ≤ _ := h
    _ ≤ P.budget N + (2*(Nat.log 2 (3*(polynomialCutoff N c+1)^2)+1) : ℕ)*
        expectedOpt (graphBase G) N + N*(3/(N:ℝ)^c) := add_le_add_right (add_le_add_right hb _) _
    _ = _ := by ring

/-- Existence of an actual source-edge online policy from the graph-level
preprocessing assumptions. The decomposition is constructed by the proved
peeling theorem; it is not an input existence hypothesis. -/

GraphChoices.Peeling.exists_decomposed_o.source:
theorem exists_decomposed_online_policy (G : Graph L R) [Nonempty G] (B N : ℕ) (d : ℝ)
    (hd : 0 < d) (hlog : 1 < Real.log (N:ℝ))
    (hleft : ∀ u, (leftDegree G u : ℝ) ≤ d*Real.log (N:ℝ))
    (hB : d ≤ 16*B) (hD : ∀ u, leftDegree G u ≤ 4*B)
    (hvertices : Fintype.card (L ⊕ R) ≤ N)
    (haverage : 2*(G.card : ℝ) = (N:ℝ)*d) (c : ℕ) (hc : 5 ≤ c) :
    ∃ P : PreparedDecomposition G B N d, ∃ p : OnlinePolicy G,
      p = P.policy N ∧
      expectedCost (graphBase G) (onlineOrientation (T := N) p) ≤ P.budget N +
        (2*(Nat.log 2 (3*(polynomialCutoff N c+1)^2)+1) : ℕ)*expectedOpt (graphBase G) N +
          3*N/(N:ℝ)^c := by
  obtain ⟨P⟩ := exists_preparedDecomposition G B N d hd hlog hleft hB hD
  exact ⟨P, P.policy N, rfl, P.expected_cost_at_vertex_horizon c hc hvertices haverage⟩

end GraphChoices.Peeling

GraphChoices.Peeling.unionPieces.source:
def unionPieces : List (Graph L R) → Graph L R
  | [] => ∅
  | P::Ps => P ∪ unionPieces Ps

GraphChoices.Peeling.finalBudget.source:
def finalBudget : ℕ → List (ℕ × ℕ) → ℕ
  | D, [] => D
  | _, (k,_)::ss => finalBudget k ss

/-- The left cap and right cap promised for each successive piece. -/

GraphChoices.Peeling.PeelingRun.source:
inductive PeelingRun : Graph L R → ℕ → List (ℕ × ℕ) → List (Graph L R) → Graph L R → Prop
  | nil (H : Graph L R) (D : ℕ) (hD : ∀ u, leftDegree H u ≤ D) : PeelingRun H D [] [] H
  | cons {H P : Graph L R} {D k b : ℕ} {ss : List (ℕ × ℕ)} {Ps : List (Graph L R)} {F : Graph L R}
      (hP : P ⊆ H) (hPL : ∀ u, leftDegree P u ≤ D)
      (hPR : ∀ v, rightDegree P v ≤ D*b)
      (tail : PeelingRun (H \ P) k ss Ps F) :
      PeelingRun H D ((k,b)::ss) (P::Ps) F

GraphChoices.Peeling.mem_subset_unionPie.source:
theorem mem_subset_unionPieces {P : Graph L R} {Ps : List (Graph L R)} (hP : P ∈ Ps) :
    P ⊆ unionPieces Ps := by
  induction Ps with
  | nil => simp at hP
  | cons Q Qs ih =>
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hP with rfl | hp
    · exact subset_union_left
    · exact (ih hp).trans subset_union_right

/-- Finite construction of a complete peeling execution. -/

GraphChoices.Peeling.exists_peeling_run.source:
theorem exists_peeling_run (G H : Graph L R) (hHG : H ⊆ G) (D : ℕ)
    (hD : ∀ u, leftDegree H u ≤ D) (ss : List (ℕ × ℕ))
    (hexpand : ∀ kb ∈ ss, PeelingExpansion G kb.1 kb.2) :
    ∃ Ps F, PeelingRun H D ss Ps F := by
  induction ss generalizing H D with
  | nil => exact ⟨[],H,PeelingRun.nil H D hD⟩
  | cons kb ss ih =>
    obtain ⟨k,b⟩ := kb
    obtain ⟨P,hPH,hnext,hPR⟩ := exists_peeling_piece H k b D hD
      ((hexpand (k,b) (by simp)).mono hHG)
    obtain ⟨Ps,F,htail⟩ := ih (H \ P) (sdiff_subset.trans hHG) k hnext
      (fun kb hkb => hexpand kb (by simp [hkb]))
    refine ⟨P::Ps,F,PeelingRun.cons hPH ?_ hPR htail⟩
    intro u
    exact (leftDegree_mono hPH u).trans (hD u)

GraphChoices.Peeling.PeelingRun.length_e.source:
theorem PeelingRun.length_eq {H F : Graph L R} {D : ℕ}
    {ss : List (ℕ × ℕ)} {Ps : List (Graph L R)} (h : PeelingRun H D ss Ps F) :
    Ps.length = ss.length := by
  induction h with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons _ _ _ _ ih => simpa using ih

GraphChoices.Peeling.PeelingRun.degree_b.source:
theorem PeelingRun.degree_bounds {H F : Graph L R} {D : ℕ}
    {ss : List (ℕ × ℕ)} {Ps : List (Graph L R)} (h : PeelingRun H D ss Ps F) :
    List.Forall₂ (fun P kb => (∀ u, leftDegree P u ≤ kb.1) ∧
      (∀ v, rightDegree P v ≤ kb.2)) Ps (pieceBudgets D ss) := by
  induction h with
  | nil => exact List.Forall₂.nil
  | cons _ hPL hPR _ ih => exact List.Forall₂.cons ⟨hPL,hPR⟩ ih

GraphChoices.Peeling.PeelingRun.final_de.source:
theorem PeelingRun.final_degree_bound {H F : Graph L R} {D : ℕ}
    {ss : List (ℕ × ℕ)} {Ps : List (Graph L R)} (h : PeelingRun H D ss Ps F) :
    ∀ u, leftDegree F u ≤ finalBudget D ss := by
  induction h with
  | nil _ _ hD => exact hD
  | cons _ _ _ _ ih => exact ih

/-- Every recorded execution really is an edge-disjoint extraction; the final
residual is precisely the complement of all pieces in the original graph. -/

GraphChoices.Peeling.PeelingRun.partitio.source:
theorem PeelingRun.partition_properties {H F : Graph L R} {D : ℕ}
    {ss : List (ℕ × ℕ)} {Ps : List (Graph L R)} (h : PeelingRun H D ss Ps F) :
    unionPieces Ps ⊆ H ∧ F = H \ unionPieces Ps ∧ Ps.Pairwise Disjoint := by
  induction h with
  | nil => simp [unionPieces]
  | @cons H P D k b ss Ps F hPH hPL hPR htail ih =>
    obtain ⟨hPs,hF,hdisj⟩ := ih
    refine ⟨union_subset hPH (hPs.trans sdiff_subset), ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hF]
      ext p
      simp [unionPieces]
      tauto
    · apply List.pairwise_cons.mpr
      refine ⟨?_,hdisj⟩
      intro Q hQ
      apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
      intro e heP heQ
      have he : e ∈ H \ P := hPs (mem_subset_unionPieces hQ heQ)
      exact (mem_sdiff.mp he).2 heP

GraphChoices.Peeling.graph_empty_of_left.source:
theorem graph_empty_of_left_degrees_zero (H : Graph L R)
    (h : ∀ u, leftDegree H u ≤ 0) : H = ∅ := by
  apply eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
  intro p hp
  have hn : p.2 ∈ leftNeighbors H p.1 := by simpa [leftNeighbors] using hp
  have hc : 0 < leftDegree H p.1 := card_pos.mpr ⟨p.2,hn⟩
  have := h p.1
  omega

/-- An exact edge partition with one piece per scheduled round and all degree
bounds, provided the schedule ends at zero. -/

GraphChoices.Peeling.exists_edge_partiti.source:
theorem exists_edge_partition (G : Graph L R) (D : ℕ)
    (hD : ∀ u, leftDegree G u ≤ D) (ss : List (ℕ × ℕ))
    (hexpand : ∀ kb ∈ ss, PeelingExpansion G kb.1 kb.2)
    (hfinal : finalBudget D ss = 0) :
    ∃ Ps : List (Graph L R), Ps.length = ss.length ∧ Ps.Pairwise Disjoint ∧
      unionPieces Ps = G ∧
      List.Forall₂ (fun P kb => (∀ u, leftDegree P u ≤ kb.1) ∧
        (∀ v, rightDegree P v ≤ kb.2)) Ps (pieceBudgets D ss) := by
  obtain ⟨Ps,F,h⟩ := exists_peeling_run G G (subset_refl _) D hD ss hexpand
  obtain ⟨hsub,hF,hpair⟩ := h.partition_properties
  have hz : F = ∅ := graph_empty_of_left_degrees_zero F (by simpa [hfinal] using h.final_degree_bound)
  have hcover : unionPieces Ps = G := by
    apply subset_antisymm hsub
    intro e he
    by_contra hn
    have : e ∈ F := by rw [hF]; exact mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨he,hn⟩
    simpa [hz] using this
  exact ⟨Ps,h.length_eq,hpair,hcover,h.degree_bounds⟩

end GraphChoices.Peeling

GraphChoices.exists_orientation_iff_dens.source:
theorem exists_orientation_iff_density (I : Instance V T) (c : ℕ) :
    (∃ a : Orientation T, maxLoad I a ≤ c) ↔
      ∀ S : Finset V, internalCount I S ≤ S.card * c := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, ha⟩ S
    exact (density_obstruction I a S).trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ ha)
  · intro hdensity
    let r (t : Fin T) (v : V) := v = I.left t ∨ v = I.right t
    have hexpand (A : Finset (Fin T)) : A.card ≤ c * (neighbors r A).card := by
      have hsub : A ⊆ univ.filter (fun t => I.left t ∈ neighbors r A ∧ I.right t ∈ neighbors r A) := by
        intro t ht
        simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, neighbors]
        exact ⟨⟨t, ht, Or.inl rfl⟩, ⟨t, ht, Or.inr rfl⟩⟩
      exact (card_le_card hsub).trans (by simpa [mul_comm] using hdensity (neighbors r A))
    obtain ⟨f, hf, hcap⟩ := exists_capacity_matching r c hexpand
    let a : Orientation T := fun t => decide (f t = I.left t)
    have hdest (t : Fin T) : destination I a t = f t := by
      by_cases h : f t = I.left t
      · simp [destination, a, h]
      · have hr : f t = I.right t := (hf t).resolve_left h
        simp only [destination, a, decide_eq_true_eq, if_neg h]
        exact hr.symm
    refine ⟨a, (maxLoad_le_iff I a c).2 ?_⟩
    intro v
    simpa only [load, hdest] using hcap v

GraphChoices.opt_le_iff_density.source:
theorem opt_le_iff_density (I : Instance V T) (c : ℕ) :
    opt I ≤ c ↔ ∀ S : Finset V, internalCount I S ≤ S.card * c := by
  constructor
  · intro hc S
    exact (density_le_opt I S).trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hc)
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := (exists_orientation_iff_density I c).2 h
    exact (opt_le_maxLoad I a).trans ha

GraphChoices.density.source:
noncomputable def density (I : Instance V T) (S : Finset V) : ℝ :=
  internalCount I S / (S.card : ℝ)

GraphChoices.maxDensity.source:
noncomputable def maxDensity (I : Instance V T) : ℝ :=
  (univ.powerset).sup' (by simp) (density I)

omit [Fintype V] in

GraphChoices.density_nonneg.source:
theorem density_nonneg (I : Instance V T) (S : Finset V) : 0 ≤ density I S := by
  exact div_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)

omit [Fintype V] in

GraphChoices.density_le_nat_iff.source:
theorem density_le_nat_iff (I : Instance V T) (S : Finset V) (c : ℕ) :
    density I S ≤ c ↔ internalCount I S ≤ S.card * c := by
  by_cases hS : S.card = 0
  · have hs : S = ∅ := card_eq_zero.mp hS
    simp [hs, density, internalCount]
  · have hp : (0:ℝ) < S.card := by exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hS
    rw [density, div_le_iff₀ hp]
    norm_cast
    rw [mul_comm]

GraphChoices.maxDensity_le_nat_iff.source:
theorem maxDensity_le_nat_iff (I : Instance V T) (c : ℕ) :
    maxDensity I ≤ c ↔ ∀ S : Finset V, internalCount I S ≤ S.card * c := by
  simp only [maxDensity, sup'_le_iff, mem_powerset, subset_univ, forall_true_left,
    density_le_nat_iff]

GraphChoices.maxDensity_nonneg.source:
theorem maxDensity_nonneg (I : Instance V T) : 0 ≤ maxDensity I := by
  exact (density_nonneg I ∅).trans (le_sup' (density I) (by simp))

/-- The ceiling in the paper's exact density identity is retained. -/

GraphChoices.opt_eq_ceil_maxDensity.source:
theorem opt_eq_ceil_maxDensity (I : Instance V T) : opt I = ⌈maxDensity I⌉₊ := by
  apply Nat.le_antisymm
  · apply (opt_le_iff_density I _).2
    apply (maxDensity_le_nat_iff I _).1
    exact Nat.le_ceil _
  · apply Nat.ceil_le.mpr
    exact (maxDensity_le_nat_iff I _).2 (density_le_opt I)

end GraphChoices

GraphChoices.Examples.repeated_opt.source:
theorem repeated_opt : opt repeated = 2 := by
  let a : Orientation 3 := fun t => decide (t.val < 2)
  have hm : maxLoad repeated a = 2 := by decide
  have hu := opt_le_maxLoad repeated a
  rw [hm] at hu
  have hl := total_le_card_mul_opt repeated
  norm_num at hl
  omega

private def oneEdge : ThresholdGreedy.Arrival (Fin 1) (Fin 1) (Fin 1) := ⟨0,0,0⟩

/-- Threshold one followed by residual Greedy with ties sent right. -/

GraphChoices.Examples.threshold_executio.source:
theorem threshold_execution :
    let s := ThresholdGreedy.run (fun _ : Fin 1 => 1) [oneEdge, oneEdge, oneEdge, oneEdge]
    s.threshold 0 0 = 1 ∧ s.greedyLeft 0 = 1 ∧ s.greedyRight 0 = 2 := by decide

end GraphChoices.Examples

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.traceFrom_m.source:
theorem traceFrom_mem_spec (α : C → ℕ) (s : State L R C) (k : ℕ)
    (es : List (Arrival L R C)) (ev : Event L R C) (hev : ev ∈ traceFrom α s k es) :
    ∃ i : Fin es.length, ev.time = k+i.val ∧ ev.arrival = es.get i ∧
      ev.threshold = isThreshold α (runFrom α s (es.take i.val)) (es.get i) := by
  induction es generalizing s k with
  | nil => simp [traceFrom] at hev
  | cons e es ih =>
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hev with rfl | hev
    · exact ⟨⟨0,by simp⟩,by simp, rfl, rfl⟩
    · obtain ⟨i,hti,hai,hthi⟩ := ih (step α s e) (k+1) hev
      refine ⟨i.succ,?_,?_,?_⟩
      · simpa [Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm] using hti
      · simpa using hai
      · simpa [List.take_succ_cons, runFrom] using hthi

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.trace_mem_a.source:
theorem trace_mem_arrival (α : C → ℕ) (es : List (Arrival L R C))
    (ev : Event L R C) (hev : ev ∈ trace α es) :
    ∃ i : Fin es.length, ev.time = i.val ∧ ev.arrival = es.get i := by
  obtain ⟨i,ht,ha,_⟩ := traceFrom_mem_spec α initial 0 es ev hev
  exact ⟨i,by simpa using ht,ha⟩

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.step_counte.source:
theorem step_counter_mono (α : C → ℕ) (s : State L R C) (e : Arrival L R C) (u : L) (i : C) :
    s.threshold u i ≤ (step α s e).threshold u i := by
  unfold step
  split_ifs <;> simp

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.runFrom_cou.source:
theorem runFrom_counter_mono (α : C → ℕ) (s : State L R C)
    (es : List (Arrival L R C)) (u : L) (i : C) :
    s.threshold u i ≤ (runFrom α s es).threshold u i := by
  induction es generalizing s with
  | nil => exact le_rfl
  | cons e es ih => exact (step_counter_mono α s e u i).trans (ih (step α s e))

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.run_counter.source:
theorem run_counter_mono_append (α : C → ℕ) (xs ys : List (Arrival L R C)) (u : L) (i : C) :
    (run α xs).threshold u i ≤ (run α (xs ++ ys)).threshold u i := by
  unfold run
  rw [runFrom_append]
  exact runFrom_counter_mono α _ ys u i

/-- A residual occurrence saturates its bucket in the complete execution. -/

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.residual_ev.source:
theorem residual_event_final_saturated (α : C → ℕ) (es : List (Arrival L R C))
    (ev : Event L R C) (hev : ev ∈ trace α es) (hr : ev.threshold = false) :
    (run α es).threshold ev.arrival.left ev.arrival.cls = α ev.arrival.cls := by
  obtain ⟨i,ht,ha,hth⟩ := traceFrom_mem_spec α initial 0 es ev hev
  have hres : isThreshold α (run α (es.take i.val)) (es.get i) = false := by
    simpa only [run] using hth.symm.trans hr
  have hsat := residual_counter_saturated α (es.take i.val) (es.get i) hres
  have hmono := run_counter_mono_append α (es.take i.val) (es.drop i.val) (es.get i).left (es.get i).cls
  rw [List.take_append_drop, hsat] at hmono
  have hcap := threshold_cap α es (es.get i).left (es.get i).cls
  simpa [ha] using Nat.le_antisymm hcap hmono

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.finiteThres.source:
noncomputable def finiteThresholdTimes (α : C → ℕ) (es : List (Arrival L R C))
    (T : ℕ) (hlen : es.length = T) (u : L) (i : C) : Finset (Fin T) := by
  classical
  let K := (thresholdWitnessTimes α es u i).toFinset
  exact K.attach.image fun t => ⟨t.val, by
    have ht := thresholdWitnessTimes_earlier α es u i t.val (List.mem_toFinset.mp t.property)
    omega⟩

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.mem_finiteT.source:
theorem mem_finiteThresholdTimes (α : C → ℕ) (es : List (Arrival L R C))
    (T : ℕ) (hlen : es.length = T) (u : L) (i : C) (t : Fin T) :
    t ∈ finiteThresholdTimes α es T hlen u i ↔ t.val ∈ thresholdWitnessTimes α es u i := by
  classical
  unfold finiteThresholdTimes
  simp only [mem_image, mem_attach, true_and]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨s,hs⟩
    have hv := congrArg Fin.val hs
    change s.val = t.val at hv
    rw [← hv]
    exact List.mem_toFinset.mp s.property
  · intro ht
    exact ⟨⟨t.val,List.mem_toFinset.mpr ht⟩,Fin.ext rfl⟩

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.finiteThres.source:
theorem finiteThresholdTimes_card (α : C → ℕ) (es : List (Arrival L R C))
    (T : ℕ) (hlen : es.length = T) (u : L) (i : C) :
    (finiteThresholdTimes α es T hlen u i).card = (run α es).threshold u i := by
  classical
  unfold finiteThresholdTimes
  rw [card_image_of_injective _ (by
    intro a b hab
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact congrArg Fin.val hab)]
  rw [card_attach, List.toFinset_card_of_nodup (thresholdWitnessTimes_nodup α es u i)]
  exact thresholdWitnessTimes_length α es u i

/-- Time labels identify a unique event, even across buckets. -/

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.trace_event.source:
theorem trace_event_eq_of_time (α : C → ℕ) (es : List (Arrival L R C))
    (ev ev' : Event L R C) (h : ev ∈ trace α es) (h' : ev' ∈ trace α es)
    (ht : ev.time = ev'.time) : ev = ev' :=
  List.inj_on_of_nodup_map (traceFrom_unique_times α initial 0 es) h h' ht

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.finiteThres.source:
theorem finiteThresholdTimes_buckets_disjoint (α : C → ℕ) (es : List (Arrival L R C))
    (T : ℕ) (hlen : es.length = T) (u u' : L) (i i' : C) (hne : (u,i) ≠ (u',i')) :
    Disjoint (finiteThresholdTimes α es T hlen u i) (finiteThresholdTimes α es T hlen u' i') := by
  apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
  intro t ht ht'
  obtain ⟨ev,hev,hetime,_,hu,hi⟩ := thresholdWitnessTimes_spec α es u i t.val
    ((mem_finiteThresholdTimes α es T hlen u i t).mp ht)
  obtain ⟨ev',hev',hetime',_,hu',hi'⟩ := thresholdWitnessTimes_spec α es u' i' t.val
    ((mem_finiteThresholdTimes α es T hlen u' i' t).mp ht')
  have heq := trace_event_eq_of_time α es ev ev' hev hev' (hetime.trans hetime'.symm)
  apply hne
  exact Prod.ext (hu.symm.trans ((congrArg (fun e : Event L R C => e.arrival.left) heq).trans hu'))
    (hi.symm.trans ((congrArg (fun e : Event L R C => e.arrival.cls) heq).trans hi'))

end GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy

GraphChoices.BaseGraph.baseDensity.source:
noncomputable def BaseGraph.baseDensity (G : BaseGraph V E) (S : Finset V) : ℝ :=
  (G.internalEdges S).card/(S.card : ℝ)

GraphChoices.BaseGraph.maxBaseDensity.source:
noncomputable def BaseGraph.maxBaseDensity (G : BaseGraph V E) : ℝ :=
  (univ.powerset).sup' (by simp) (G.baseDensity)

GraphChoices.BaseGraph.referenceCap.source: noncomputable def BaseGraph.referenceCap (G : BaseGraph V E) : ℕ := ⌈G.maxBaseDensity⌉₊

GraphChoices.expectedOpt_nonneg.source:
theorem expectedOpt_nonneg (G : BaseGraph V E) (T : ℕ) : 0 ≤ expectedOpt G T := by
  unfold expectedOpt average
  positivity

GraphChoices.BaseGraph.baseDensity_nonne.source:
theorem BaseGraph.baseDensity_nonneg (G : BaseGraph V E) (S : Finset V) : 0 ≤ G.baseDensity S := by
  unfold BaseGraph.baseDensity
  positivity

GraphChoices.BaseGraph.maxBaseDensity_no.source:
theorem BaseGraph.maxBaseDensity_nonneg (G : BaseGraph V E) : 0 ≤ G.maxBaseDensity :=
  (G.baseDensity_nonneg ∅).trans (le_sup' G.baseDensity (by simp))

GraphChoices.expected_density_ratio.source:
theorem expected_density_ratio (G : BaseGraph V E) (S : Finset V) (T : ℕ) :
    G.baseDensity S*((T:ℝ)/Fintype.card E) ≤ expectedOpt G T := by
  by_cases hz : S.card = 0
  · simp only [BaseGraph.baseDensity, hz, Nat.cast_zero, div_zero, zero_mul]
    exact expectedOpt_nonneg G T
  have hS : (0:ℝ) < S.card := by exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hz
  calc
    _ = ((T:ℝ)*(G.internalEdges S).card/Fintype.card E)/(S.card : ℝ) := by
      unfold BaseGraph.baseDensity
      ring
    _ ≤ ((S.card : ℝ)*expectedOpt G T)/(S.card : ℝ) :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (expected_density_lower_bound G S T) hS.le
    _ = _ := by field_simp

GraphChoices.expected_max_density_lower_.source:
theorem expected_max_density_lower_bound (G : BaseGraph V E) (T : ℕ) :
    G.maxBaseDensity*((T:ℝ)/Fintype.card E) ≤ expectedOpt G T := by
  by_cases hT : T = 0
  · simpa only [hT, Nat.cast_zero, zero_div, mul_zero] using expectedOpt_nonneg G 0
  have hz : (0:ℝ) < (T:ℝ)/Fintype.card E := by
    exact div_pos (by exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hT) (by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos)
  apply (le_div_iff₀ hz).mp
  apply (Finset.sup'_le_iff _ _).mpr
  intro S _
  exact (le_div_iff₀ hz).mpr (expected_density_ratio G S T)

/-- The expected count of a fixed source-edge label is at most twice the
expected optimum. Its endpoint pair has at most two vertices, including loops. -/

GraphChoices.expected_edge_rate_le_two_o.source:
theorem expected_edge_rate_le_two_opt (G : BaseGraph V E) (T : ℕ) :
    (T:ℝ)/Fintype.card E ≤ 2*expectedOpt G T := by
  classical
  let e : E := Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty E)
  let S : Finset V := {G.left e, G.right e}
  have he : e ∈ G.internalEdges S := by simp [BaseGraph.internalEdges, S]
  have hcount : 1 ≤ (G.internalEdges S).card := card_pos.mpr ⟨e,he⟩
  have hcount' : (1:ℝ) ≤ (G.internalEdges S).card := by exact_mod_cast hcount
  have hs : S.card ≤ 2 := (card_insert_le _ _).trans (by simp)
  calc
    _ ≤ (T:ℝ)*(G.internalEdges S).card/Fintype.card E := by
      apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
      simpa only [mul_one] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcount' (Nat.cast_nonneg T)
    _ ≤ (S.card : ℝ)*expectedOpt G T := expected_density_lower_bound G S T
    _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast hs) (expectedOpt_nonneg G T)

/-- The integer ceiling in the reference capacity costs at most another two
expected optimum units; it is not silently dropped from the density identity. -/

GraphChoices.expected_reference_cap_boun.source:
theorem expected_reference_cap_bound (G : BaseGraph V E) (T : ℕ) :
    (G.referenceCap : ℝ)*((T:ℝ)/Fintype.card E) ≤ 3*expectedOpt G T := by
  have hc : (G.referenceCap : ℝ) ≤ G.maxBaseDensity+1 := (Nat.ceil_lt_add_one G.maxBaseDensity_nonneg).le
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc (show 0 ≤ (T:ℝ)/Fintype.card E by positivity)
  have hd := expected_max_density_lower_bound G T
  have he := expected_edge_rate_le_two_opt G T
  nlinarith

GraphChoices.BaseGraph.referenceCap_le_e.source:
theorem BaseGraph.referenceCap_le_edges (G : BaseGraph V E) : G.referenceCap ≤ Fintype.card E := by
  apply Nat.ceil_le.mpr
  apply (Finset.sup'_le_iff _ _).mpr
  intro S _
  by_cases hS : S.card = 0
  · simp [BaseGraph.baseDensity, hS]
  have hp : (0:ℝ) < S.card := by exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hS
  have hone : (1:ℝ) ≤ S.card := by exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hS
  have he : ((G.internalEdges S).card : ℝ) ≤ Fintype.card E := by exact_mod_cast card_le_card (subset_univ _)
  change ((G.internalEdges S).card : ℝ)/(S.card : ℝ) ≤ Fintype.card E
  apply (div_le_iff₀ hp).mpr
  have hE0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ Fintype.card E := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  nlinarith

GraphChoices.BaseGraph.total_edges_le_ca.source:
theorem BaseGraph.total_edges_le_card_mul_referenceCap (G : BaseGraph V E) :
    (Fintype.card E : ℝ) ≤ (Fintype.card V : ℝ)*G.referenceCap := by
  classical
  have hV : Nonempty V := ⟨G.left (Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty E))⟩
  have hp : (0:ℝ) < Fintype.card V := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr hV
  have hd : G.baseDensity univ ≤ G.maxBaseDensity := le_sup' G.baseDensity (by simp)
  have hc : G.maxBaseDensity ≤ (G.referenceCap : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil _
  have heq : G.baseDensity univ = (Fintype.card E : ℝ)/Fintype.card V := by
    simp [BaseGraph.baseDensity, BaseGraph.internalEdges]
  rw [heq] at hd
  have hh := (div_le_iff₀ hp).mp (hd.trans hc)
  simpa only [mul_comm] using hh

end GraphChoices

GraphChoices.exp_average_le.source:
theorem exp_average_le {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [Nonempty Ω] (f : Ω → ℝ) :
    Real.exp (average f) ≤ average (fun ω => Real.exp (f ω)) := by
  have hm : (Fintype.card Ω : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero
  have h := convexOn_exp.map_sum_le (t := (univ : Finset Ω))
    (w := fun _ => (Fintype.card Ω : ℝ)⁻¹) (p := f)
    (fun _ _ => by positivity) (by simp [hm]) (fun _ _ => Set.mem_univ _)
  have havg (g : Ω → ℝ) : (∑ ω, (Fintype.card Ω:ℝ)⁻¹*g ω) = average g := by
    simp only [average, ← mul_sum, div_eq_mul_inv]
    ring
  simp only [smul_eq_mul] at h
  rwa [havg, havg] at h

variable {E : Type*} [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E] [Nonempty E]

GraphChoices.average_two_pow_hits.source:
theorem average_two_pow_hits (A : Finset E) (T : ℕ) :
    average (fun ω : Fin T → E => (2:ℝ)^(hitCount A ω)) =
      (1+(A.card:ℝ)/Fintype.card E)^T := by
  have hp (ω : Fin T → E) : (2:ℝ)^(hitCount A ω) =
      ∏ t, if ω t ∈ A then (2:ℝ) else 1 := by
    simp only [prod_ite, prod_const_one, mul_one, prod_const, hitCount]
  have hs : (∑ e : E, if e ∈ A then (2:ℝ) else 1) = Fintype.card E+A.card := by
    have hh (e : E) : (if e ∈ A then (2:ℝ) else 1) = 1+(if e ∈ A then 1 else 0) := by
      split <;> norm_num
    calc
      _ = ∑ e : E, (1+(if e ∈ A then (1:ℝ) else 0)) := sum_congr rfl (fun e _ => hh e)
      _ = _ := by
        simp only [sum_add_distrib, sum_const, card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one, sum_boole]
        congr 3
        ext e
        simp
  simp only [average, hp]
  rw [← Fintype.prod_sum (fun (_ : Fin T) (e : E) => if e ∈ A then (2:ℝ) else 1)]
  simp only [hs, prod_const, card_univ,
    Fintype.card_fin, Fintype.card_fun, Nat.cast_pow, ← div_pow]
  have hm : (Fintype.card E:ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero
  congr 1
  field_simp

GraphChoices.average_two_pow_hits_le.source:
theorem average_two_pow_hits_le (A : Finset E) (T : ℕ) (μ : ℝ)
    (hmean : (T:ℝ)*((A.card:ℝ)/Fintype.card E) ≤ μ) :
    average (fun ω : Fin T → E => (2:ℝ)^(hitCount A ω)) ≤ Real.exp μ := by
  rw [average_two_pow_hits]
  calc
    _ ≤ (Real.exp ((A.card:ℝ)/Fintype.card E))^T :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) (by simpa only [add_comm] using Real.add_one_le_exp ((A.card:ℝ)/Fintype.card E)) T
    _ = Real.exp ((T:ℝ)*((A.card:ℝ)/Fintype.card E)) := (Real.exp_nat_mul _ T).symm
    _ ≤ _ := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hmean

/-- Every bucket may overlap other buckets; only its marginal mean matters. -/

GraphChoices.expected_max_hits.source:
theorem expected_max_hits {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [Nonempty I]
    (bucket : I → Finset E) (T : ℕ) (μ : ℝ)
    (hmean : ∀ i, (T:ℝ)*(((bucket i).card:ℝ)/Fintype.card E) ≤ μ) :
    average (fun ω : Fin T → E => ((univ.sup fun i => hitCount (bucket i) ω : ℕ):ℝ)) ≤
      2*(Real.log (Fintype.card I:ℝ)+μ) := by
  classical
  let X := fun ω : Fin T → E => ((univ.sup fun i => hitCount (bucket i) ω : ℕ):ℝ)
  have hpoint (ω : Fin T → E) : Real.exp (Real.log 2*X ω) ≤
      ∑ i, (2:ℝ)^(hitCount (bucket i) ω) := by
    obtain ⟨i,_,hi⟩ := exists_mem_eq_sup (s := (univ : Finset I)) (by simp) (fun i => hitCount (bucket i) ω)
    have he : Real.exp (Real.log 2*X ω) = (2:ℝ)^(hitCount (bucket i) ω) := by
      dsimp only [X]
      rw [hi, mul_comm, Real.exp_nat_mul, Real.exp_log (by norm_num)]
    rw [he]
    exact single_le_sum (f := fun i => (2:ℝ)^(hitCount (bucket i) ω)) (fun _ _ => by positivity) (mem_univ i)
  have hupper : average (fun ω => Real.exp (Real.log 2*X ω)) ≤
      (Fintype.card I:ℝ)*Real.exp μ := by
    apply (average_mono hpoint).trans
    rw [average_sum]
    simpa using sum_le_sum (fun i (_ : i ∈ (univ : Finset I)) => average_two_pow_hits_le (bucket i) T μ (hmean i))
  have hj := exp_average_le (fun ω => Real.log 2*X ω)
  rw [average_mul] at hj
  have hexp := hj.trans hupper
  have hcard : (0:ℝ) < Fintype.card I := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
  rw [← Real.exp_log hcard, ← Real.exp_add, Real.exp_le_exp] at hexp
  have hX' : 0 ≤ average X := by unfold average X; positivity
  have hl2 : (1:ℝ)/2 ≤ Real.log 2 := by linarith [Real.log_two_gt_d9]
  change average X ≤ _
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hl2 hX']

end GraphChoices

GraphChoices.sufficientThreshold_upper.source:
theorem sufficientThreshold_upper (mean f z A B : ℝ)
    (hfm : 0 ≤ f*mean) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hbase : f*mean ≤ A) (hlog : z ≤ B) :
    (sufficientThreshold mean f z : ℝ) ≤ A+B+2 := by
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ max (f*mean) z := hfm.trans (le_max_left _ _)
  have hc := Nat.ceil_lt_add_one hnonneg
  have hm : max (f*mean) z ≤ A+B := max_le
    (hbase.trans (le_add_of_nonneg_right hB))
    (hlog.trans (le_add_of_nonneg_left hA))
  simp only [sufficientThreshold, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
  linarith

GraphChoices.log_branching_bound.source:
theorem log_branching_bound (x f L σ K : ℝ)
    (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hf : 1 < f) (hL : 1 ≤ L) (hσ : 0 ≤ σ) (hK : 1 ≤ K)
    (hbranch : x ≤ K*(f*L)^(2*σ)) :
    Real.log x ≤ Real.log K + 2*σ*(Real.log f + Real.log L) := by
  have hfpos : 0 < f := by linarith
  have hLpos : 0 < L := by linarith
  have hKpos : 0 < K := by linarith
  by_cases hxpos : 0 < x
  · have h := Real.log_le_log hxpos hbranch
    rwa [Real.log_mul hKpos.ne' (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (mul_pos hfpos hLpos) _).ne',
      Real.log_rpow (mul_pos hfpos hLpos), Real.log_mul hfpos.ne' hLpos.ne'] at h
  · have hxzero : x = 0 := by linarith
    rw [hxzero, Real.log_zero]
    exact add_nonneg (Real.log_nonneg hK)
      (mul_nonneg (by positivity) (add_nonneg (Real.log_pos hf).le (Real.log_nonneg hL)))

GraphChoices.log_branching_requirement.source:
theorem log_branching_requirement (x f L σ K : ℝ)
    (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hf : 1 < f) (hL : 1 ≤ L) (hσ : 0 ≤ σ) (hK : 1 ≤ K)
    (hbranch : x ≤ K*(f*L)^(2*σ)) :
    Real.log x / Real.log f ≤ 2*σ + (Real.log K + 2*σ*Real.log L)/Real.log f := by
  have hlog := Real.log_pos hf
  apply (div_le_iff₀ hlog).mpr
  have h := log_branching_bound x f L σ K hx hf hL hσ hK hbranch
  have heq : (2*σ + (Real.log K + 2*σ*Real.log L)/Real.log f) * Real.log f =
      Real.log K + 2*σ*(Real.log f + Real.log L) := by
    field_simp
    ring
  rwa [heq]

GraphChoices.scale_log.source:
theorem scale_log (i : ℕ) :
    Real.log (Peeling.scaleNat i : ℝ) = (2:ℝ)^(i+1)*Real.log 2 := by
  simp [Peeling.scaleNat, Real.log_pow]

GraphChoices.inverse_shifted_powers_sum_.source:
theorem inverse_shifted_powers_sum_le_one (h : ℕ) :
    ∑ i ∈ range h, (1:ℝ)/2^(i+1) ≤ 1 := by
  have heq : (∑ i ∈ range h, (1:ℝ)/2^(i+1)) =
      (1/2:ℝ)*(∑ i ∈ range h, (1:ℝ)/2^i) := by
    rw [mul_sum]
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    rw [pow_succ]
    ring
  rw [heq]
  have hsum := ThresholdGreedy.inverse_powers_sum_le_two h
  linarith

GraphChoices.inverse_scale_logs_sum_le.source:
theorem inverse_scale_logs_sum_le (h : ℕ) :
    ∑ i ∈ range h, (1:ℝ)/Real.log (Peeling.scaleNat i : ℝ) ≤ 1/Real.log 2 := by
  have hp : (0:ℝ) < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have heq : (∑ i ∈ range h, (1:ℝ)/Real.log (Peeling.scaleNat i : ℝ)) =
      (1/Real.log 2)*(∑ i ∈ range h, (1:ℝ)/2^(i+1)) := by
    rw [mul_sum]
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    rw [scale_log]
    ring
  rw [heq]
  exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (inverse_shifted_powers_sum_le_one h) (by positivity)).trans_eq (by ring)

/-- At each scale, mu is the binomial-tail base mean including the factor e,
and x is the right branching factor divided by the desired decay target.
The total budget is explicit, including both ceiling and increment errors. -/

GraphChoices.sufficientThreshold_scale_b.source:
theorem sufficientThreshold_scale_budget (h : ℕ) (mean x : ℕ → ℝ) (A L σ K : ℝ)
    (hmean : ∀ i < h, 0 ≤ mean i) (hx : ∀ i < h, 0 ≤ x i)
    (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hL : 1 ≤ L) (hσ : 0 ≤ σ) (hK : 1 ≤ K)
    (hbase : ∀ i < h, (Peeling.scaleNat i : ℝ)*mean i ≤ A)
    (hbranch : ∀ i < h, x i ≤ K*((Peeling.scaleNat i : ℝ)*L)^(2*σ)) :
    (∑ i ∈ range h, (sufficientThreshold (mean i) (Peeling.scaleNat i)
      (Real.log (x i)/Real.log (Peeling.scaleNat i)) : ℝ)) ≤
      h*(A+2*σ+2) + (Real.log K + 2*σ*Real.log L)/Real.log 2 := by
  have hq : 0 ≤ Real.log K + 2*σ*Real.log L :=
    add_nonneg (Real.log_nonneg hK) (mul_nonneg (by positivity) (Real.log_nonneg hL))
  have hlocal (i : ℕ) (hi : i < h) :
      (sufficientThreshold (mean i) (Peeling.scaleNat i)
        (Real.log (x i)/Real.log (Peeling.scaleNat i)) : ℝ) ≤
      A+2*σ+2 + (Real.log K + 2*σ*Real.log L)/Real.log (Peeling.scaleNat i : ℝ) := by
    have hf : (1:ℝ) < Peeling.scaleNat i := by
      have hh := Peeling.scaleNat_ge_two i
      exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1 < Peeling.scaleNat i)
    have hlog := log_branching_requirement (x i) _ L σ K (hx i hi) hf hL hσ hK (hbranch i hi)
    have hB : 0 ≤ 2*σ + (Real.log K + 2*σ*Real.log L)/Real.log (Peeling.scaleNat i : ℝ) := by
      exact add_nonneg (by positivity) (div_nonneg hq (Real.log_pos hf).le)
    have ht := sufficientThreshold_upper (mean i) (Peeling.scaleNat i)
      (Real.log (x i)/Real.log (Peeling.scaleNat i)) A _
      (mul_nonneg (by positivity) (hmean i hi)) hA hB (hbase i hi) hlog
    linarith
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ range h, (A+2*σ+2 + (Real.log K + 2*σ*Real.log L)/Real.log (Peeling.scaleNat i : ℝ)) :=
      sum_le_sum fun i hi => hlocal i (mem_range.mp hi)
    _ = h*(A+2*σ+2) + (Real.log K + 2*σ*Real.log L)*
        (∑ i ∈ range h, (1:ℝ)/Real.log (Peeling.scaleNat i : ℝ)) := by
      rw [sum_add_distrib, mul_sum]
      simp only [sum_const, card_range, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one_div]
    _ ≤ h*(A+2*σ+2) + (Real.log K + 2*σ*Real.log L)*(1/Real.log 2) :=
      add_le_add_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (inverse_scale_logs_sum_le h) hq) _
    _ = _ := by ring

/-- Specialization to the real degree bounds provided by the structural
decomposition. z is the expected number of occurrences per base-edge label.
The result includes all ceiling errors and does not assume a log bound. -/

GraphChoices.decomposition_threshold_bud.source:
theorem decomposition_threshold_budget (h : ℕ) (DL DR : ℕ → ℕ) (B z b L σ : ℝ)
    (hB : 0 < B) (hz : 0 ≤ z) (hb : 0 < b) (hL : 1 ≤ L) (hσ : 0 ≤ σ)
    (hK : 1 ≤ 16*B*z/b)
    (hDL : ∀ i < h, (DL i : ℝ) ≤ 16*B/(Peeling.scaleNat i : ℝ))
    (hDR : ∀ i < h, (DR i : ℝ) ≤ 16*B*((Peeling.scaleNat i : ℝ)*L)^(2*σ)) :
    (∑ i ∈ range h, (sufficientThreshold (Real.exp 1*z*(DL i : ℝ)) (Peeling.scaleNat i)
      (Real.log ((DR i : ℝ)*z/b)/Real.log (Peeling.scaleNat i)) : ℝ)) ≤
      h*(16*Real.exp 1*B*z+2*σ+2) +
        (Real.log (16*B*z/b) + 2*σ*Real.log L)/Real.log 2 := by
  apply sufficientThreshold_scale_budget h (fun i => Real.exp 1*z*(DL i : ℝ))
    (fun i => (DR i : ℝ)*z/b) (16*Real.exp 1*B*z) L σ (16*B*z/b)
    (fun _ _ => by positivity) (fun _ _ => by positivity) (by positivity) hL hσ hK
  · intro i hi
    have hpos : (0:ℝ) < Peeling.scaleNat i := by exact_mod_cast Peeling.scaleNat_pos i
    have hd := (le_div_iff₀ hpos).mp (hDL i hi)
    calc
      _ = (Real.exp 1*z)*((DL i : ℝ)*(Peeling.scaleNat i : ℝ)) := by ring
      _ ≤ (Real.exp 1*z)*(16*B) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd (by positivity)
      _ = _ := by ring
  · intro i hi
    calc
      _ = (DR i : ℝ)*(z/b) := by ring
      _ ≤ (16*B*((Peeling.scaleNat i : ℝ)*L)^(2*σ))*(z/b) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hDR i hi) (div_nonneg hz hb.le)
      _ = _ := by ring

end GraphChoices

GraphChoices.sufficientThreshold.source:
noncomputable def sufficientThreshold (mean f logRequirement : ℝ) : ℕ :=
  ⌈max (f * mean) logRequirement⌉₊ + 1

GraphChoices.sufficientThreshold_pos.source:
theorem sufficientThreshold_pos (mean f z : ℝ) : 0 < sufficientThreshold mean f z := by
  unfold sufficientThreshold
  omega

GraphChoices.sufficientThreshold_dominat.source:
theorem sufficientThreshold_dominates (mean f z : ℝ) :
    max (f*mean) z ≤ (sufficientThreshold mean f z : ℝ) := by
  have h := Nat.le_ceil (max (f*mean) z)
  simp only [sufficientThreshold, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
  linarith

GraphChoices.sufficientThreshold_base.source:
theorem sufficientThreshold_base (mean f z : ℝ) (hf : 0 < f) :
    mean / sufficientThreshold mean f z ≤ 1/f := by
  have hpos : (0:ℝ) < sufficientThreshold mean f z := by
    exact_mod_cast sufficientThreshold_pos mean f z
  apply (div_le_div_iff₀ hpos hf).mpr
  have h := (le_max_left (f*mean) z).trans (sufficientThreshold_dominates mean f z)
  nlinarith

GraphChoices.sufficientThreshold_log.source:
theorem sufficientThreshold_log (mean f z : ℝ) :
    z ≤ (sufficientThreshold mean f z : ℝ) :=
  (le_max_right (f*mean) z).trans (sufficientThreshold_dominates mean f z)

end GraphChoices

namespace GraphChoices.Patterns
open ThresholdGreedy
variable {E L R C : Type*} [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E] [Nonempty E]
  [Fintype L] [Fintype R] [Fintype C]
  [DecidableEq L] [DecidableEq R] [DecidableEq C]

GraphChoices.Patterns.explicitThresholds.source:
noncomputable def explicitThresholds (DL DR : C → ℕ) (T : ℕ) (f : C → ℝ) (b : ℝ) : C → ℕ :=
  fun c => sufficientThreshold (Real.exp 1*T*(DL c : ℝ)/Fintype.card E) (f c)
    (Real.log (((DR c : ℝ)*((T:ℝ)/Fintype.card E))/b) / Real.log (f c))

/-- Geometric pattern-union decay for concrete rounded integer thresholds;
no local threshold inequalities are left as premises. -/

GraphChoices.Patterns.heavyShape_decay_e.source:
theorem heavyShape_decay_explicit (H : C → Peeling.Graph L R)
    (encode : E → Arrival L R C) (DL DR : C → ℕ) (D T m : ℕ) (f : C → ℝ)
    (hsimple : Function.Injective fun e => ((encode e).left,(encode e).right))
    (hDL : ∀ u c, (sourceBucket encode u c).card ≤ DL c)
    (hL : ∀ c u, Peeling.leftDegree (H c) u ≤ D)
    (hR : ∀ c v, Peeling.rightDegree (H c) v ≤ DR c)
    (b r : ℝ) (hT : 0 < T) (hb : 0 < b) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hbr : b ≤ r)
    (hpair : (D : ℝ)*((T:ℝ)/Fintype.card E)*b ≤ r^2)
    (hf : ∀ c, 1 < f c) :
    eventProbability (heavyShapeEvent H encode (explicitThresholds (E := E) DL DR T f b) T m) ≤
      (Fintype.card R : ℝ)*(4*(Fintype.card C : ℝ)*r)^m := by
  apply heavyShape_decay_of_thresholds H encode _ DL DR D f hsimple hDL hL hR
    b r hT hb hr hbr hpair hf
  · intro c
    exact sufficientThreshold_base _ _ _ (by linarith [hf c])
  · intro c _
    exact sufficientThreshold_log _ _ _

end GraphChoices.Patterns

GraphChoices.Patterns.map_numNodes.source:
theorem map_numNodes {W : Type*} (t : Tree V) (f : V → W) : (t.map f).numNodes = t.numNodes := by
  induction t with
  | nil => rfl
  | node v l r hl hr => simp [Tree.map, Tree.numNodes, hl, hr]

GraphChoices.Patterns.eraseForest.source: def eraseForest (t : Tree V) : Tree Unit := t.map (fun _ => ())

GraphChoices.Patterns.eraseForest_numNod.source:
theorem eraseForest_numNodes (t : Tree V) : (eraseForest t).numNodes = t.numNodes := by
  induction t with
  | nil => rfl
  | node v l r hl hr => simp [eraseForest, Tree.map, Tree.numNodes] at *; omega

GraphChoices.Patterns.forestValue_eq_get.source:
theorem forestValue_eq_get (t : Tree V) (fallback : V) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < t.numNodes) :
    forestValue t fallback i = (forestLabels t)[i]'(by rw [forestLabels_length]; exact hi) := by
  induction t generalizing i with
  | nil => simp at hi
  | node v l r hl hr =>
    cases i with
    | zero => simp [forestValue, forestLabels]
    | succ i =>
      simp only [forestLabels, List.getElem_cons_succ]
      by_cases hil : i+1 ≤ l.numNodes
      · rw [List.getElem_append_left (by rw [forestLabels_length]; omega)]
        simpa [forestValue, hil] using hl i (by omega)
      · rw [List.getElem_append_right (by rw [forestLabels_length]; omega)]
        have hir : i-l.numNodes < r.numNodes := by simp only [Tree.numNodes] at hi; omega
        simpa [forestValue, hil, forestLabels_length] using hr (i-l.numNodes) hir

GraphChoices.Patterns.forestParent_eq_pa.source:
theorem forestParent_eq_parentPos (t : Tree V) (p start : ℕ) (hp : p ≤ start)
    (i : Fin (eraseForest t).numNodes) :
    (forestParent (eraseForest t) p start hp i).val = parentPos t p start i.val := by
  induction t generalizing p start with
  | nil => exact Fin.elim0 i
  | node v l r hl hr =>
    by_cases hz : i.val = 0
    · simp [eraseForest, Tree.map, forestParent, parentPos, hz]
    by_cases hil : i.val ≤ l.numNodes
    · simp only [eraseForest, Tree.map, forestParent, parentPos, hz, if_false,
        map_numNodes, hil, dite_true, dite_false, if_true]
      exact hl (start+1) (start+1) le_rfl _
    · simp only [eraseForest, Tree.map, forestParent, parentPos, hz, if_false,
        map_numNodes, hil, dite_true, dite_false]
      have hir : i.val-1-(eraseForest l).numNodes < (eraseForest r).numNodes := by
        have hbound := i.isLt
        simp only [eraseForest_numNodes, Tree.numNodes] at hbound ⊢
        omega
      have h := hr p (start+1+(eraseForest l).numNodes) (by omega)
        ⟨i.val-1-(eraseForest l).numNodes, hir⟩
      convert h using 1 <;> simp only [eraseForest_numNodes]

GraphChoices.Patterns.forestSide_eq_side.source:
theorem forestSide_eq_sidePos (t : Tree V) (side : Bool) (i : Fin (eraseForest t).numNodes) :
    forestSide (eraseForest t) side i = sidePos t side i.val := by
  induction t generalizing side with
  | nil => exact Fin.elim0 i
  | node v l r hl hr =>
    by_cases hz : i.val = 0
    · simp [eraseForest, Tree.map, forestSide, sidePos, hz]
    by_cases hil : i.val ≤ l.numNodes
    · simp only [eraseForest, Tree.map, forestSide, sidePos, hz, if_false,
        map_numNodes, hil, dite_true, dite_false, if_true]
      exact hl (!side) _
    · simp only [eraseForest, Tree.map, forestSide, sidePos, hz, if_false,
        map_numNodes, hil, dite_true, dite_false]
      exact hr side _

/-- Indexed edges and side labels are inherited from the labelled forest's
recursive graph edges. The lookup may be embedded in any larger preorder. -/

GraphChoices.Patterns.forest_index_spec.source:
theorem forest_index_spec (G : SimpleGraph V) (color : V → Bool)
    (hcolor : ∀ u v, G.Adj u v → color u ≠ color v)
    (t : Tree V) (F : ℕ → V) (fallback : V) (p start : ℕ) (side : Bool)
    (ht : ForestValid G (F p) t) (hparent : color (F p) = !side)
    (hvalues : ∀ i < t.numNodes, F (start+i+1) = forestValue t fallback i) :
    ∀ i < t.numNodes,
      G.Adj (F (start+i+1)) (F (parentPos t p start i)) ∧
      color (F (start+i+1)) = sidePos t side i := by
  induction t generalizing p start side with
  | nil => intro i hi; simp at hi
  | node v l r hl hr =>
    obtain ⟨hpv, hvl, hpr⟩ := ht
    have hv : F (start+1) = v := by simpa [forestValue] using hvalues 0 (by simp)
    have hcv : color v = side := by
      have hne := hcolor (F p) v hpv
      cases side <;> cases hc : color v <;> simp_all
    intro i hi
    by_cases hz : i = 0
    · subst i
      simpa [parentPos, sidePos, hv] using And.intro hpv.symm hcv
    by_cases hil : i ≤ l.numNodes
    · have hvals : ∀ j < l.numNodes, F ((start+1)+j+1) = forestValue l fallback j := by
        intro j hj
        have h := hvalues (j+1) (by simp only [Tree.numNodes]; omega)
        have hsplit : forestValue (.node v l r) fallback (j+1) = forestValue l fallback j := by
          simp [forestValue, show j+1 ≤ l.numNodes by omega]
        rw [hsplit] at h
        convert h using 1 <;> congr 1 <;> omega
      have hvalid : ForestValid G (F (start+1)) l := by simpa only [hv] using hvl
      have hcparent : color (F (start+1)) = !(!side) := by simpa [hv] using hcv
      have h := hl (start+1) (start+1) (!side) hvalid hcparent hvals (i-1) (by omega)
      have heq : start+1+(i-1)+1 = start+i+1 := by omega
      simpa only [parentPos, sidePos, hz, if_false, hil, if_true, heq] using h
    · have hvals : ∀ j < r.numNodes, F ((start+1+l.numNodes)+j+1) = forestValue r fallback j := by
        intro j hj
        have h := hvalues (j+1+l.numNodes) (by simp only [Tree.numNodes]; omega)
        have hnot : ¬j+1+l.numNodes ≤ l.numNodes := by omega
        have hsplit : forestValue (.node v l r) fallback (j+1+l.numNodes) = forestValue r fallback j := by
          rw [forestValue, if_neg (by omega), if_neg hnot]
          congr 1
          omega
        rw [hsplit] at h
        convert h using 1 <;> congr 1 <;> omega
      have h := hr p (start+1+l.numNodes) side hpr hparent hvals (i-1-l.numNodes)
        (by simp only [Tree.numNodes] at hi; omega)
      have heq : start+1+l.numNodes+(i-1-l.numNodes)+1 = start+i+1 := by omega
      simpa only [parentPos, sidePos, hz, if_false, hil, heq] using h

end GraphChoices.Patterns

GraphChoices.Peeling.minLeftDegree.source:
noncomputable def minLeftDegree (F : Graph L R) (A : Finset L) : ℕ :=
  if h : A.Nonempty then A.inf' h (leftDegree F) else 0

GraphChoices.Peeling.minLeftDegree_le.source:
theorem minLeftDegree_le (F : Graph L R) {A : Finset L} {u : L} (hu : u ∈ A) :
    minLeftDegree F A ≤ leftDegree F u := by
  rw [minLeftDegree, dif_pos ((show A.Nonempty from ⟨u,hu⟩))]
  exact inf'_le _ hu

GraphChoices.Peeling.le_minLeftDegree.source:
theorem le_minLeftDegree (F : Graph L R) {A : Finset L} (hA : A.Nonempty)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : ∀ u ∈ A, k ≤ leftDegree F u) : k ≤ minLeftDegree F A := by
  rw [minLeftDegree, dif_pos hA]
  exact le_inf' hA (leftDegree F) hk

GraphChoices.Peeling.neighborSet.source:
def neighborSet (F : Graph L R) (A : Finset L) : Finset R :=
  GraphChoices.neighbors (fun u v => (u,v) ∈ F) A

GraphChoices.Peeling.skewValue.source:
noncomputable def skewValue (F : Graph L R) (A : Finset L) (d n : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  GraphChoices.localLogSkewness A.card (neighborSet F A).card (minLeftDegree F A) d n

GraphChoices.Peeling.SkewAdmissible.source:
noncomputable def SkewAdmissible (F : Graph L R) (A : Finset L) (d n : ℝ) : Prop :=
  A.Nonempty ∧ (neighborSet F A).Nonempty ∧ (neighborSet F A).card ≤ A.card ∧
    0 < minLeftDegree F A ∧ 1 < d * (Real.log n)^2 / minLeftDegree F A

GraphChoices.Peeling.skewValues.source:
noncomputable def skewValues (G : Graph L R) (d n : ℝ) : Finset ℝ := by
  classical
  exact insert 0 (((G.powerset ×ˢ (univ : Finset L).powerset).filter
    fun p => SkewAdmissible p.1 p.2 d n).image fun p => skewValue p.1 p.2 d n)

GraphChoices.Peeling.graphLogSkewness.source:
noncomputable def graphLogSkewness (G : Graph L R) (d n : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (skewValues G d n).sup' (by
    classical
    simp [skewValues]) id

GraphChoices.Peeling.graphLogSkewness_no.source:
theorem graphLogSkewness_nonneg (G : Graph L R) (d n : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ graphLogSkewness G d n := by
  classical
  unfold graphLogSkewness
  exact le_sup' id (by simp [skewValues])

GraphChoices.Peeling.skewValue_le_graphL.source:
theorem skewValue_le_graphLogSkewness {G F : Graph L R} (hF : F ⊆ G)
    (A : Finset L) (d n : ℝ) (ha : SkewAdmissible F A d n) :
    skewValue F A d n ≤ graphLogSkewness G d n := by
  classical
  unfold graphLogSkewness
  apply le_sup' id
  apply mem_insert_of_mem
  apply mem_image.mpr
  refine ⟨(F,A), ?_, rfl⟩
  simp [hF, ha]

GraphChoices.Peeling.scaleCapacity.source:
noncomputable def scaleCapacity (G : Graph L R) (d n f : ℝ) : ℕ :=
  ⌈(f * Real.log n)^(2 * graphLogSkewness G d n)⌉₊

GraphChoices.Peeling.scaleCapacity_pos.source:
theorem scaleCapacity_pos (G : Graph L R) (d n f : ℝ)
    (hf : 1 ≤ f) (hn : 1 < Real.log n) : 1 ≤ scaleCapacity G d n f := by
  have hb : 1 ≤ f * Real.log n := by nlinarith
  have hp : (1:ℝ) ≤ (f * Real.log n)^(2 * graphLogSkewness G d n) :=
    Real.one_le_rpow hb (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (graphLogSkewness_nonneg G d n))
  have hc := Nat.le_ceil ((f * Real.log n)^(2 * graphLogSkewness G d n))
  exact_mod_cast hp.trans hc

/-- Bounded log-skewness supplies the actual Hall expansion premise in every
residual graph. The left-degree hypothesis is the preprocessing degree bound. -/

GraphChoices.Peeling.peelingExpansion_of.source:
theorem peelingExpansion_of_graphLogSkewness (G : Graph L R) (k : ℕ) (d n f : ℝ)
    (hd : 0 < d) (hf : 1 ≤ f) (hn : 1 < Real.log n)
    (hleft : ∀ u, (leftDegree G u : ℝ) ≤ d * Real.log n)
    (hcut : d / f^2 ≤ (k+1 : ℕ)) :
    PeelingExpansion G k (scaleCapacity G d n f) := by
  classical
  intro F hF A hA
  by_cases hAempty : A = ∅
  · simp [hAempty]
  have hAne : A.Nonempty := nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr hAempty
  have hkmin : k+1 ≤ minLeftDegree F A :=
    le_minLeftDegree F hAne (k+1) (fun u hu => hA u hu)
  have hmin : 0 < minLeftDegree F A := by omega
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hAne
  have hAne : A.Nonempty := ⟨u,hu⟩
  have hdmin : (0:ℝ) < minLeftDegree F A := by exact_mod_cast hmin
  have hminmax : (minLeftDegree F A : ℝ) ≤ d * Real.log n := by
    have hh := (minLeftDegree_le F hu).trans (leftDegree_mono hF u)
    have hreal : (minLeftDegree F A : ℝ) ≤ leftDegree G u := by exact_mod_cast hh
    exact hreal.trans (hleft u)
  have hden : 1 < d * (Real.log n)^2 / minLeftDegree F A := by
    apply (lt_div_iff₀ hdmin).mpr
    have hh : d * Real.log n < d * (Real.log n)^2 := by
      nlinarith [mul_pos hd (mul_pos (by linarith : 0 < Real.log n) (by linarith : 0 < Real.log n - 1))]
    linarith
  have hNne : (neighborSet F A).Nonempty := by
    have hdu : 0 < leftDegree F u := (Nat.zero_le k).trans_lt (hA u hu)
    obtain ⟨v,hv⟩ := card_pos.mp hdu
    refine ⟨v, ?_⟩
    simp only [leftNeighbors, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and] at hv
    simp only [neighborSet, GraphChoices.neighbors, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
    exact ⟨u,hu,hv⟩
  by_cases hbal : A.card ≤ (neighborSet F A).card
  · have hcap := scaleCapacity_pos G d n f hf hn
    change A.card ≤ scaleCapacity G d n f * (neighborSet F A).card
    exact hbal.trans (by nlinarith)
  · have hadm : SkewAdmissible F A d n :=
      ⟨hAne, hNne, by omega, hmin, hden⟩
    have hskew := skewValue_le_graphLogSkewness hF A d n hadm
    have hdeg : d / f^2 ≤ (minLeftDegree F A : ℝ) :=
      hcut.trans (by exact_mod_cast hkmin)
    have hexp := GraphChoices.expansion_at_scale
      (a := (A.card : ℝ)) (b := ((neighborSet F A).card : ℝ))
      (d := (minLeftDegree F A : ℝ)) (D := d) (n := n) (f := f)
      (by exact_mod_cast hAne.card_pos) (by exact_mod_cast hNne.card_pos) hdmin
      (by linarith) (by linarith) (graphLogSkewness_nonneg G d n) hdeg hden hskew
    have hceil := Nat.le_ceil ((f * Real.log n)^(2 * graphLogSkewness G d n))
    have hbnonneg : (0:ℝ) ≤ (neighborSet F A).card := Nat.cast_nonneg _
    have hh := hexp.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hceil hbnonneg)
    change A.card ≤ scaleCapacity G d n f * (neighborSet F A).card
    rw [Nat.mul_comm]
    exact_mod_cast hh

/-- One full extraction round, including finite termination, derived from the
maximum over concrete log-skewness witnesses. -/

GraphChoices.Peeling.exists_graph_skew_p.source:
theorem exists_graph_skew_piece (G : Graph L R) (k D : ℕ) (d n f : ℝ)
    (hd : 0 < d) (hf : 1 ≤ f) (hn : 1 < Real.log n)
    (hleft : ∀ u, (leftDegree G u : ℝ) ≤ d * Real.log n)
    (hcut : d / f^2 ≤ (k+1 : ℕ)) (hD : ∀ u, leftDegree G u ≤ D) :
    ∃ P : Graph L R, P ⊆ G ∧
      (∀ u, leftDegree (G \ P) u ≤ k) ∧
      (∀ v, rightDegree P v ≤ D * scaleCapacity G d n f) := by
  exact exists_peeling_piece G k _ D hD
    (peelingExpansion_of_graphLogSkewness G k d n f hd hf hn hleft hcut)

end GraphChoices.Peeling

GraphChoices.IsGreedy.source:
def IsGreedy (I : Instance V T) (a : Orientation T) : Prop :=
  ∀ t, ∀ v, (v = I.left t ∨ v = I.right t) →
    prefixLoad I a t.val (destination I a t) ≤ prefixLoad I a t.val v

omit [Fintype V] in

GraphChoices.prefixLoad_le_load.source:
theorem prefixLoad_le_load (I : Instance V T) (a : Orientation T) (k : ℕ) (v : V) :
    prefixLoad I a k v ≤ load I a v := by
  apply card_le_card
  intro t ht
  simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and] at ht ⊢
  exact ht.2

omit [Fintype V] in

GraphChoices.prefixLoad_strict.source:
theorem prefixLoad_strict (I : Instance V T) (a : Orientation T) (v : V)
    (t u : Fin T) (htu : t < u) (ht : destination I a t = v) :
    prefixLoad I a t.val v < prefixLoad I a u.val v := by
  have hnot : t ∉ univ.filter (fun s : Fin T => s.val < t.val ∧ destination I a s = v) := by simp
  have hsub : insert t (univ.filter fun s : Fin T => s.val < t.val ∧ destination I a s = v) ⊆
      univ.filter (fun s : Fin T => s.val < u.val ∧ destination I a s = v) := by
    intro s hs
    rcases mem_insert.mp hs with rfl | hs
    · simp [htu, ht]
    · simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and] at hs ⊢
      exact ⟨lt_trans hs.1 htu, hs.2⟩
  have hc := card_le_card hsub
  rw [card_insert_of_notMem hnot] at hc
  exact hc

omit [Fintype V] in
/-- A vertex has at most k arrivals assigned before its load reaches k. -/

GraphChoices.low_arrivals_le.source:
theorem low_arrivals_le (I : Instance V T) (a : Orientation T) (v : V) (k : ℕ) :
    (univ.filter fun t => destination I a t = v ∧ prefixLoad I a t.val v < k).card ≤ k := by
  have h := card_le_card_of_injOn (fun t : Fin T => prefixLoad I a t.val v)
    (s := univ.filter fun t => destination I a t = v ∧ prefixLoad I a t.val v < k)
    (t := range k)
    (by intro t ht; simpa using (mem_filter.mp ht).2.2)
    (by
      intro t ht u hu heq
      dsimp at heq
      by_contra hne
      rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with h | h
      · have := prefixLoad_strict I a v t u h (mem_filter.mp ht).2.1
        omega
      · have := prefixLoad_strict I a v u t h (mem_filter.mp hu).2.1
        omega)
  simpa using h

GraphChoices.highVertices.source:
def highVertices (I : Instance V T) (a : Orientation T) (k : ℕ) : Finset V :=
  univ.filter fun v => k ≤ load I a v

GraphChoices.highArrivals.source:
def highArrivals (I : Instance V T) (a : Orientation T) (k : ℕ) : Finset (Fin T) :=
  univ.filter fun t => k ≤ prefixLoad I a t.val (destination I a t)

GraphChoices.highArrivals_internal.source:
theorem highArrivals_internal (I : Instance V T) (a : Orientation T) (hg : IsGreedy I a)
    (k : ℕ) :
    highArrivals I a k ⊆ univ.filter
      (fun t => I.left t ∈ highVertices I a k ∧ I.right t ∈ highVertices I a k) := by
  intro t ht
  have hk := (mem_filter.mp ht).2
  simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, highVertices]
  exact ⟨le_trans hk ((hg t _ (Or.inl rfl)).trans (prefixLoad_le_load I a _ _)),
    le_trans hk ((hg t _ (Or.inr rfl)).trans (prefixLoad_le_load I a _ _))⟩

omit [Fintype V] in

GraphChoices.load_le_low_add_high.source:
theorem load_le_low_add_high (I : Instance V T) (a : Orientation T) (v : V) (k : ℕ) :
    load I a v ≤ k + ((highArrivals I a k).filter fun t => destination I a t = v).card := by
  have heq : load I a v =
      (univ.filter fun t => destination I a t = v ∧ prefixLoad I a t.val v < k).card +
      ((highArrivals I a k).filter fun t => destination I a t = v).card := by
    rw [load, ← filter_card_add_filter_neg_card_eq_card (s := univ.filter fun t => destination I a t = v)
      (p := fun t => prefixLoad I a t.val v < k)]
    congr 1
    · congr 1
      ext t
      simp
    · congr 1
      ext t
      simp only [highArrivals, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, not_lt]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨hd, hk⟩; exact ⟨by simpa [hd] using hk, hd⟩
      · rintro ⟨hk, hd⟩; exact ⟨hd, by simpa [hd] using hk⟩
  rw [heq]
  exact Nat.add_le_add_right (low_arrivals_le I a v k) _

/-- The key deterministic layer inequality, with the true offline optimum. -/

GraphChoices.greedy_layer_bound.source:
theorem greedy_layer_bound (I : Instance V T) (a : Orientation T) (hg : IsGreedy I a)
    (k d : ℕ) :
    d * (highVertices I a (k + d)).card ≤ opt I * (highVertices I a k).card := by
  calc
    d * (highVertices I a (k + d)).card = ∑ v ∈ highVertices I a (k+d), d := by simp [mul_comm]
    _ ≤ ∑ v ∈ highVertices I a (k+d),
        ((highArrivals I a k).filter fun t => destination I a t = v).card := by
      apply sum_le_sum
      intro v hv
      have hl := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
      have hb := load_le_low_add_high I a v k
      omega
    _ ≤ ∑ v, ((highArrivals I a k).filter fun t => destination I a t = v).card :=
      sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (subset_univ _) (fun _ _ _ => Nat.zero_le _)
    _ = (highArrivals I a k).card := by
      symm
      exact card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise (fun _ _ => mem_univ _)
    _ ≤ internalCount I (highVertices I a k) := card_le_card (highArrivals_internal I a hg k)
    _ ≤ opt I * (highVertices I a k).card := by
      simpa [mul_comm] using density_le_opt I (highVertices I a k)

GraphChoices.greedy_layers_decay.source:
theorem greedy_layers_decay (I : Instance V T) (a : Orientation T) (hg : IsGreedy I a)
    (hc : 0 < opt I) (j : ℕ) :
    2^j * (highVertices I a (2 * opt I * j)).card ≤ Fintype.card V := by
  induction j with
  | zero => simp [highVertices]
  | succ j ih =>
    have h := greedy_layer_bound I a hg (2 * opt I * j) (2 * opt I)
    have hstep : 2 * (highVertices I a (2 * opt I * (j+1))).card ≤
        (highVertices I a (2 * opt I * j)).card := by
      have heq : 2 * opt I * j + 2 * opt I = 2 * opt I * (j+1) := by ring
      rw [heq] at h
      nlinarith
    calc
      _ = 2^j * (2 * (highVertices I a (2 * opt I * (j+1))).card) := by rw [pow_succ]; ring
      _ ≤ 2^j * (highVertices I a (2 * opt I * j)).card := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hstep
      _ ≤ _ := ih

/-- Explicit adversarial bound. Any j with 2^j > |V| is sufficient. -/

GraphChoices.greedy_maxLoad_lt.source:
theorem greedy_maxLoad_lt (I : Instance V T) (a : Orientation T) (hg : IsGreedy I a)
    (hT : 0 < T) (j : ℕ) (hj : Fintype.card V < 2^j) :
    maxLoad I a < 2 * opt I * j := by
  have hd := greedy_layers_decay I a hg (opt_pos I hT) j
  have hz : (highVertices I a (2 * opt I * j)).card = 0 := by
    by_contra hn
    have : 1 ≤ (highVertices I a (2 * opt I * j)).card := by omega
    have := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (2^j) this
    omega
  have hn : Nonempty V := ⟨I.left ⟨0,hT⟩⟩
  have hp : 0 < 2 * opt I * j := by
    have : 0 < j := by
      by_contra h
      have hj0 : j = 0 := by omega
      have := Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr hn
      simp [hj0] at hj
    exact Nat.mul_pos (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) (opt_pos I hT)) this
  have hbound : maxLoad I a ≤ 2 * opt I * j - 1 := by
    apply (maxLoad_le_iff I a _).2
    intro v
    have hnot : v ∉ highVertices I a (2 * opt I * j) := by
      rw [card_eq_zero.mp hz]; simp
    simp only [highVertices, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, not_le] at hnot
    omega
  omega

/-- Fact 3.6, with an explicit constant and base-two logarithm. -/

GraphChoices.greedy_competitive.source:
theorem greedy_competitive (I : Instance V T) (a : Orientation T) (hg : IsGreedy I a)
    (hT : 0 < T) :
    maxLoad I a < 2 * opt I * (Nat.log 2 (Fintype.card V) + 1) := by
  exact greedy_maxLoad_lt I a hg hT _ (Nat.lt_pow_succ_log_self (by decide) _)

end GraphChoices

GraphChoices.RandomGreedy.batch_forces_l.source:
theorem batch_forces_load (G : BaseGraph V E) (k s : ℕ)
    (ω : Fin k → Fin s → E × Bool) (i : Fin k) (h : ℕ) (u : V)
    (A : Finset (Fin s)) (hcount : h+1 ≤ A.card)
    (hsource : ∀ j ∈ A, G.left (ω i j).1 = u ∧ (ω i j).2 = true ∧
      h ≤ state G (blockFlatten k s ω) (i.val*s) (G.right (ω i j).1)) :
