    h+1 ≤ state G (blockFlatten k s ω) ((i.val+1)*s) u := by
  let τ := blockFlatten k s ω
  have hend : (i.val+1)*s ≤ k*s := Nat.mul_le_mul_right s (by omega)
  by_contra hbad
  have hu : state G τ ((i.val+1)*s) u ≤ h := by
    change ¬ h+1 ≤ state G τ ((i.val+1)*s) u at hbad
    omega
  have htime (j : Fin s) : (finProdFinEquiv (i,j)).val = i.val*s+j.val := by
    change j.val+s*i.val = i.val*s+j.val
    ring
  have hdest (j : Fin s) (hj : j ∈ A) :
      destination ((coinGraph G).sample τ) (onlineOrientation (policy G) τ) (finProdFinEquiv (i,j)) = u := by
    obtain ⟨hl,hcoin,hr⟩ := hsource j hj
    let t : Fin (k*s) := finProdFinEquiv (i,j)
    have ht : t.val < (i.val+1)*s := by dsimp only [t]; rw [htime]; nlinarith [j.isLt]
    have hstart : i.val*s ≤ t.val := by dsimp only [t]; rw [htime]; omega
    have hlcur : state G τ t.val u ≤ h :=
      (state_mono G τ ht.le hend u).trans hu
    have hrcur : h ≤ state G τ t.val (G.right (ω i j).1) :=
      hr.trans (state_mono G τ hstart (Nat.le_of_lt t.isLt) _)
    have hmark : τ t = ω i j := blockFlatten_apply k s ω i j
    change (if choice G (state G τ t.val) (τ t) then G.left (τ t).1 else G.right (τ t).1) = u
    rw [hmark]
    rw [choice_favours_left G _ _ hcoin (by rw [hl]; omega), if_pos rfl, hl]
  have hc : A.card ≤ prefixLoad ((coinGraph G).sample τ) (onlineOrientation (policy G) τ)
      ((i.val+1)*s) u := by
    apply card_le_card_of_injOn (fun j => finProdFinEquiv (i,j))
    · intro j hj
      change finProdFinEquiv (i,j) ∈ univ.filter (fun t => t.val < (i.val+1)*s ∧
        destination ((coinGraph G).sample τ) (onlineOrientation (policy G) τ) t = u)
      exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _,by rw [htime]; nlinarith [j.isLt],hdest j hj⟩
    · intro j _ j' _ he
      exact congrArg Prod.snd (finProdFinEquiv.injective he)
  rw [← state_eq_prefixLoad G τ _ hend] at hc
  omega

end GraphChoices.RandomGreedy

namespace GraphChoices.LowerBound
open Finset

GraphChoices.LowerBound.markedBucket.source:
def markedBucket {b t m : ℕ} (c : Blocks b t) (a : Fin m) : Finset (Edges b t m × Bool) :=
  (({c} : Finset (Blocks b t)) ×ˢ (({a} : Finset (Fin m)) ×ˢ univ)) ×ˢ {true}

GraphChoices.LowerBound.markedBucket_car.source:
theorem markedBucket_card {b t m : ℕ} (c : Blocks b t) (a : Fin m) :
    (markedBucket c a).card = t*m := by simp [markedBucket]

GraphChoices.LowerBound.markedBucket_sou.source:
theorem markedBucket_source {b t m : ℕ} (c : Blocks b t) (a : Fin m)
    (x : Edges b t m × Bool) (hx : x ∈ markedBucket c a) :
    (graph b t m).left x.1 = leftVertex (c,a) ∧ x.2 = true ∧
      ((graph b t m).right x.1).1.val = c.1.val+1 := by
  simp only [markedBucket, mem_product, mem_singleton, mem_univ, and_true] at hx
  rcases x with ⟨⟨c',a',r⟩,coin⟩
  rcases hx with ⟨⟨rfl,rfl⟩,rfl⟩
  exact ⟨rfl,rfl,rfl⟩

GraphChoices.LowerBound.allBatchesGood.source:
def allBatchesGood (b t m s : ℕ) (ω : Fin b → Fin s → Edges b t m × Bool) : Prop :=
  ∀ i c a, b ≤ hitCount (markedBucket c a) (ω i)

GraphChoices.LowerBound.propagation.source:
theorem propagation (b t m s : ℕ) (ω : Fin b → Fin s → Edges b t m × Bool)
    (hgood : allBatchesGood b t m s ω) :
    ∀ i, i ≤ b → ∀ v : Vertices b t m, v.1.val = b-i →
      i ≤ RandomGreedy.state (graph b t m) (blockFlatten b s ω) (i*s) v := by
  intro i
  induction i with
  | zero => intro _ _ _; omega
  | succ i ih =>
    intro hib v hv
    have hib' : i < b := by omega
    let ci : Fin b := ⟨v.1.val,by omega⟩
    let c : Blocks b t := ⟨ci,v.2.1⟩
    have hleft : leftVertex (c,v.2.2) = v := by
      rcases v with ⟨j,g,a⟩
      rfl
    let A := univ.filter fun j : Fin s => ω ⟨i,hib'⟩ j ∈ markedBucket c v.2.2
    have hcount : i+1 ≤ A.card := (by omega : i+1 ≤ b).trans (hgood ⟨i,hib'⟩ c v.2.2)
    have hh := RandomGreedy.batch_forces_load (graph b t m) b s ω ⟨i,hib'⟩ i v A hcount
      (fun j hj => by
        have hs := markedBucket_source c v.2.2 _ ((mem_filter.mp hj).2)
        refine ⟨hs.1.trans hleft,hs.2.1,?_⟩
        exact ih (by omega) _ (by rw [hs.2.2]; dsimp only [c,ci]; omega))
    exact hh

end GraphChoices.LowerBound

GraphChoices.RandomGreedy.choice_at_tie.source:
theorem choice_at_tie (G : BaseGraph V E) (s : V → ℕ) (e : E) (c : Bool)
    (h : s (G.left e) = s (G.right e)) : choice G s (e,c) = c := by
  simp [choice,h]

GraphChoices.RandomGreedy.fair_tie_proba.source:
theorem fair_tie_probability (G : BaseGraph V E) (s : V → ℕ) (e : E)
    (h : s (G.left e) = s (G.right e)) :
    eventProbability (univ.filter fun c : Bool => choice G s (e,c) = true) = 1/2 := by
  have heq : (univ.filter fun c : Bool => choice G s (e,c) = true) = {true} := by
    ext c
    simp [choice_at_tie G s e c h]
  rw [heq]
  norm_num [eventProbability]

variable [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E] [Nonempty E]

GraphChoices.RandomGreedy.coin_expectedO.source:
theorem coin_expectedOpt (G : BaseGraph V E) (T : ℕ) :
    expectedOpt (coinGraph G) T = expectedOpt G T := by
  unfold expectedOpt
  let e := (Equiv.arrowProdEquivProdArrow (Fin T) (fun _ => E) (fun _ => Bool)).symm
  rw [← average_equiv e]
  change average (fun p : (Fin T → E) × (Fin T → Bool) => (opt (G.sample p.1):ℝ)) =
    average (fun ω : Fin T → E => (opt (G.sample ω):ℝ))
  exact average_product_fst (Ω' := Fin T → Bool) (fun ω : Fin T → E => (opt (G.sample ω):ℝ))

end GraphChoices.RandomGreedy

GraphChoices.prefixLoad_succ.source:
theorem prefixLoad_succ (I : Instance V T) (a : Orientation T) (t : Fin T) (v : V) :
    prefixLoad I a (t.val+1) v = prefixLoad I a t.val v + if destination I a t = v then 1 else 0 := by
  classical
  have htime (s : Fin T) : s.val < t.val+1 ↔ s.val < t.val ∨ s = t := by
    constructor
    · intro hs
      by_cases heq : s.val = t.val
      · exact Or.inr (Fin.ext heq)
      · exact Or.inl (by omega)
    · rintro (h | rfl) <;> omega
  have hnot : t ∉ univ.filter (fun s : Fin T => s.val < t.val ∧ destination I a s = v) := by simp
  by_cases hd : destination I a t = v
  · have heq : (univ.filter fun s : Fin T => s.val < t.val+1 ∧ destination I a s = v) =
        insert t (univ.filter fun s : Fin T => s.val < t.val ∧ destination I a s = v) := by
      ext s
      simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, mem_insert, htime]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨h,hs⟩
        rcases h with h | rfl
        · exact Or.inr ⟨h,hs⟩
        · exact Or.inl rfl
      · rintro (rfl | h)
        · exact ⟨Or.inr rfl,hd⟩
        · exact ⟨Or.inl h.1,h.2⟩
    simp only [prefixLoad, heq, card_insert_of_notMem hnot, if_pos hd]
  · have heq : (univ.filter fun s : Fin T => s.val < t.val+1 ∧ destination I a s = v) =
        univ.filter (fun s : Fin T => s.val < t.val ∧ destination I a s = v) := by
      ext s
      simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, htime]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨h,hs⟩
        rcases h with h | rfl
        · exact ⟨h,hs⟩
        · exact False.elim (hd hs)
      · intro h; exact ⟨Or.inl h.1,h.2⟩
    simp only [prefixLoad, heq, if_neg hd, Nat.add_zero]

GraphChoices.execution_counts_prefix.source:
theorem execution_counts_prefix (I : Instance V T) (a : Orientation T) (x : ℕ → V → ℕ)
    (hzero : ∀ v, x 0 v = 0)
    (hstep : ∀ t : Fin T, ∀ v, x (t.val+1) v = x t.val v + if destination I a t = v then 1 else 0)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ T) (v : V) : x k v = prefixLoad I a k v := by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [hzero, prefixLoad]
  | succ k ih =>
    let t : Fin T := ⟨k,by omega⟩
    have hs := hstep t v
    have hp := prefixLoad_succ I a t v
    have hi := ih (by omega)
    simpa only [t, hi, hp] using hs

GraphChoices.isGreedy_of_execution.source:
theorem isGreedy_of_execution (I : Instance V T) (a : Orientation T) (x : ℕ → V → ℕ)
    (hzero : ∀ v, x 0 v = 0)
    (hstep : ∀ t : Fin T, ∀ v, x (t.val+1) v = x t.val v + if destination I a t = v then 1 else 0)
    (hchoice : ∀ t : Fin T, ∀ v, (v = I.left t ∨ v = I.right t) →
      x t.val (destination I a t) ≤ x t.val v) : IsGreedy I a := by
  intro t v hv
  rw [← execution_counts_prefix I a x hzero hstep t.val (Nat.le_of_lt t.isLt) _,
    ← execution_counts_prefix I a x hzero hstep t.val (Nat.le_of_lt t.isLt) _]
  exact hchoice t v hv

GraphChoices.execution_final_load.source:
theorem execution_final_load (I : Instance V T) (a : Orientation T) (x : ℕ → V → ℕ)
    (hzero : ∀ v, x 0 v = 0)
    (hstep : ∀ t : Fin T, ∀ v, x (t.val+1) v = x t.val v + if destination I a t = v then 1 else 0)
    (v : V) : x T v = load I a v := by
  rw [execution_counts_prefix I a x hzero hstep T le_rfl v]
  unfold prefixLoad load
  congr 1
  ext t
  simp [t.isLt]

end GraphChoices

GraphChoices.LowerBound.family_greedy_lo.source:
theorem family_greedy_lower (b : ℕ) (hb : 16 ≤ b) :
    letI := family_edges_nonempty b hb
    (b:ℝ)/2 ≤ RandomGreedy.expectedLoad (graph b (branching b) (width b)) (size b) := by
  letI := family_edges_nonempty b hb
  have hp := family_parameter_bounds b hb
  have hh := expectedGreedy_lower b (branching b) (width b) (batchLength b) (by have := hp.2.1; omega)
  rw [← size_eq_batches b (by omega)] at hh
  have he := family_propagation_error b hb
  have hNr : (16:ℝ) ≤ size b := by exact_mod_cast (show 16 ≤ size b by have := hp.2.2.2.2.1; omega)
  have hhalf : 1/(size b:ℝ)^2 ≤ 1/2 := (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)).mpr (by nlinarith)
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg b : (0:ℝ) ≤ b) (sub_nonneg.mpr (he.trans hhalf))]

GraphChoices.LowerBound.family_optimum_b.source:
theorem family_optimum_bound (b : ℕ) (hb : 16 ≤ b) :
    letI := family_edges_nonempty b hb
    expectedOpt (graph b (branching b) (width b)) (size b) ≤ 500*Real.log ((b:ℝ)+1) := by
  letI := family_edges_nonempty b hb
  have hp := family_parameter_bounds b hb
  have hh := family_offline_bound b hb
  have hk := densityThreshold_upper (branching b) (by have := hp.1; omega)
  obtain ⟨hl,_,ht⟩ := family_elementary_logs b hb
  linarith

GraphChoices.LowerBound.family_optimum_l.source:
theorem family_optimum_loglog (b : ℕ) (hb : 16 ≤ b) :
    letI := family_edges_nonempty b hb
    expectedOpt (graph b (branching b) (width b)) (size b) ≤ 500*Real.log (Real.log (size b:ℝ)) := by
  letI := family_edges_nonempty b hb
  have hlog := Real.log_le_log (show (0:ℝ)<(b:ℝ)+1 by positivity) (family_log_bounds b hb).1
  exact (family_optimum_bound b hb).trans (by linarith)

GraphChoices.LowerBound.eventProbability.source:
theorem eventProbability_pullback {Ω Ω' : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [Fintype Ω']
    [DecidableEq Ω] [DecidableEq Ω'] (e : Ω ≃ Ω') (A : Finset Ω') :
    eventProbability (univ.filter fun ω => e ω ∈ A) = eventProbability A := by
  rw [← average_unit_indicator,← average_unit_indicator A]
  have hh := average_equiv e (fun ω => if ω ∈ A then (1:ℝ) else 0)
  simpa only [mem_filter,mem_univ,true_and] using hh

GraphChoices.LowerBound.family_greedy_hi.source:
theorem family_greedy_high_probability (b : ℕ) (hb : 16 ≤ b) :
    letI := family_edges_nonempty b hb
    eventProbability (univ.filter fun ω : Fin (size b) → Edges b (branching b) (width b) × Bool =>
      maxLoad ((RandomGreedy.coinGraph (graph b (branching b) (width b))).sample ω)
        (onlineOrientation (RandomGreedy.policy (graph b (branching b) (width b))) ω) < b) ≤
      1/(size b:ℝ)^2 := by
  classical
  letI := family_edges_nonempty b hb
  have hp := family_parameter_bounds b hb
  rw [size_eq_batches b (by omega)]
  rw [← eventProbability_pullback (blockFlatten b (batchLength b))]
  simp only [mem_filter,mem_univ,true_and]
  have hsub : (univ.filter fun ω : Fin b → Fin (batchLength b) → Edges b (branching b) (width b) × Bool =>
      maxLoad ((RandomGreedy.coinGraph (graph b (branching b) (width b))).sample (blockFlatten b (batchLength b) ω))
        (onlineOrientation (RandomGreedy.policy (graph b (branching b) (width b))) (blockFlatten b (batchLength b) ω)) < b) ⊆
        badBatches b (branching b) (width b) (batchLength b) := by
    intro ω hω
    have hh := (mem_filter.mp hω).2
    apply mem_filter.mpr
    refine ⟨mem_univ _,fun hg => ?_⟩
    have hl := goodBatches_maxLoad b (branching b) (width b) (batchLength b)
      (by have := hp.2.1; omega) ω hg
    omega
  apply (eventProbability_mono hsub).trans
  apply (badBatches_probability b (branching b) (width b) (batchLength b)).trans
  rw [← size_eq_batches b (by omega)]
  exact family_propagation_error b hb

GraphChoices.LowerBound.family_competiti.source:
theorem family_competitive_gap (b : ℕ) (hb : 16 ≤ b) :
    letI := family_edges_nonempty b hb
    (1/30000:ℝ)*Real.log (size b:ℝ)/(Real.log (Real.log (size b:ℝ)))^2*
      expectedOpt (graph b (branching b) (width b)) (size b) ≤
        RandomGreedy.expectedLoad (graph b (branching b) (width b)) (size b) := by
  letI := family_edges_nonempty b hb
  let A := Real.log (size b:ℝ)
  let D := Real.log A
  let l := Real.log ((b:ℝ)+1)
  let O := expectedOpt (graph b (branching b) (width b)) (size b)
  have hl : 1 ≤ l := (family_elementary_logs b hb).1
  have hD : l ≤ D := Real.log_le_log (by positivity) (family_log_bounds b hb).1
  have hA : A ≤ 26*(b:ℝ)*l := (family_log_bounds b hb).2
  have hO : O ≤ 500*l := family_optimum_bound b hb
  have hO0 : 0 ≤ O := expectedOpt_nonneg _ _
  have hprod : A*O ≤ 13000*(b:ℝ)*l^2 := by
    have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hA hO0
    have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hO (show 0 ≤ 26*(b:ℝ)*l by positivity)
    nlinarith
  have hsq : l^2 ≤ D^2 := by nlinarith
  have hprod' : A*O ≤ 13000*(b:ℝ)*D^2 := hprod.trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsq (by positivity))
  apply le_trans _ (family_greedy_lower b hb)
  change (1/30000:ℝ)*A/D^2*O ≤ (b:ℝ)/2
  have hDpos : 0 < D := by linarith
  apply (le_of_mul_le_mul_right (a := D^2) ?_ (sq_pos_of_pos hDpos))
  have heq : ((1/30000:ℝ)*A/D^2*O)*D^2 = A*O/30000 := by field_simp
  rw [heq]
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg b : (0:ℝ) ≤ b) (sq_nonneg D)]

GraphChoices.LowerBound.family_log_load_.source:
theorem family_log_load_threshold (b : ℕ) (hb : 16 ≤ b) :
    Real.log (size b:ℝ)/(26*Real.log (Real.log (size b:ℝ))) ≤ (b:ℝ) := by
  have hl := (family_elementary_logs b hb).1
  have hD := Real.log_le_log (show (0:ℝ)<(b:ℝ)+1 by positivity) (family_log_bounds b hb).1
  have hA := (family_log_bounds b hb).2
  apply (div_le_iff₀ (by linarith : 0 < 26*Real.log (Real.log (size b:ℝ)))).mpr
  have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hD (show 0 ≤ 26*(b:ℝ) by positivity)
  nlinarith

/-- Lemma 5.1 in the literal log N / log log N scale, with failure N⁻². -/

GraphChoices.LowerBound.family_greedy_lo.source:
theorem family_greedy_logarithmic_high_probability (b : ℕ) (hb : 16 ≤ b) :
    letI := family_edges_nonempty b hb
    eventProbability (univ.filter fun ω : Fin (size b) → Edges b (branching b) (width b) × Bool =>
      (maxLoad ((RandomGreedy.coinGraph (graph b (branching b) (width b))).sample ω)
        (onlineOrientation (RandomGreedy.policy (graph b (branching b) (width b))) ω):ℝ) <
          Real.log (size b:ℝ)/(26*Real.log (Real.log (size b:ℝ)))) ≤ 1/(size b:ℝ)^2 := by
  letI := family_edges_nonempty b hb
  apply le_trans _ (family_greedy_high_probability b hb)
  apply eventProbability_mono
  intro ω hω
  apply mem_filter.mpr
  refine ⟨mem_univ _,?_⟩
  have hh := ((mem_filter.mp hω).2).trans_le (family_log_load_threshold b hb)
  exact_mod_cast hh

/-- An explicit infinite family witnesses the Greedy competitive lower
bound, including the precise degree interval asserted in Theorem 1.2. -/

GraphChoices.LowerBound.greedyLowerBound.source:
theorem greedyLowerBound :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ M : ℕ, ∃ b : ℕ, ∃ hb : 16 ≤ b,
      M ≤ size b ∧ (graph b (branching b) (width b)).IsSimple ∧
      (∀ v, Real.sqrt (size b:ℝ) ≤ (baseDegree (graph b (branching b) (width b)) v:ℝ) ∧
        (baseDegree (graph b (branching b) (width b)) v:ℝ) ≤
          Real.sqrt (size b:ℝ)*(Real.log (size b:ℝ))^3) ∧
      (letI := family_edges_nonempty b hb
       c*Real.log (size b:ℝ)/(Real.log (Real.log (size b:ℝ)))^2*
         expectedOpt (graph b (branching b) (width b)) (size b) ≤
           RandomGreedy.expectedLoad (graph b (branching b) (width b)) (size b)) := by
  refine ⟨1/30000,by norm_num,fun M => ?_⟩
  let b := max 16 M
  have hb : 16 ≤ b := le_max_left _ _
  refine ⟨b,hb,(le_max_right _ _).trans (family_parameter_bounds b hb).2.2.2.2.1,
    graph_isSimple _ _ _,family_degree_range b hb,?_⟩
  exact family_competitive_gap b hb

end GraphChoices.LowerBound

GraphChoices.LowerBound.badBatches.source:
noncomputable def badBatches (b t m s : ℕ) : Finset (Fin b → Fin s → Edges b t m × Bool) := by
  classical
  exact univ.filter fun ω => ¬ allBatchesGood b t m s ω

GraphChoices.LowerBound.badBatches_proba.source:
theorem badBatches_probability (b t m s : ℕ) [Nonempty (Edges b t m)] :
    eventProbability (badBatches b t m s) ≤
      (b:ℝ)*(Fintype.card (Blocks b t):ℝ)*m*
        Real.exp ((b:ℝ)*Real.log 2-(s:ℝ)*(t*m)/(4*(Fintype.card (Edges b t m):ℝ))) := by
  classical
  let events := fun p : Fin b × (Blocks b t × Fin m) =>
    univ.filter fun ω : Fin b → Fin s → Edges b t m × Bool =>
      hitCount (markedBucket p.2.1 p.2.2) (ω p.1) < b
  have hsub : badBatches b t m s ⊆ univ.biUnion events := by
    intro ω hω
    have hh := (mem_filter.mp hω).2
    simp only [allBatchesGood, not_forall, not_le] at hh
    obtain ⟨i,c,a,h⟩ := hh
    exact mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨(i,c,a),mem_univ _,mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _,h⟩⟩
  have heach (p : Fin b × (Blocks b t × Fin m)) : eventProbability (events p) ≤
      Real.exp ((b:ℝ)*Real.log 2-(s:ℝ)*(t*m)/(4*(Fintype.card (Edges b t m):ℝ))) := by
    have hc := coordinate_event_probability
      (univ.filter fun η : Fin s → Edges b t m × Bool => hitCount (markedBucket p.2.1 p.2.2) η < b) p.1
    have heq : events p = univ.filter (fun ω : Fin b → Fin s → Edges b t m × Bool =>
      ω p.1 ∈ univ.filter fun η : Fin s → Edges b t m × Bool => hitCount (markedBucket p.2.1 p.2.2) η < b) := by
      ext ω
      simp [events]
    have hceq : eventProbability (events p) = eventProbability
        (univ.filter fun η : Fin s → Edges b t m × Bool => hitCount (markedBucket p.2.1 p.2.2) η < b) := by
      convert hc using 1
      congr 1
      ext ω
      simp [events]
    rw [hceq]
    apply (hitLowerTail_probability (markedBucket p.2.1 p.2.2) s b).trans_eq
    congr 1
    rw [markedBucket_card, Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_bool]
    push_cast
    ring
  apply (eventProbability_mono hsub).trans
  apply (witness_union_bound univ events).trans
  have hh := sum_le_sum (fun p (_ : p ∈ (univ : Finset (Fin b × (Blocks b t × Fin m)))) => heach p)
  simpa only [sum_const, card_univ, Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_mul, mul_assoc] using hh

GraphChoices.LowerBound.goodBatches_maxL.source:
theorem goodBatches_maxLoad (b t m s : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m)
    (ω : Fin b → Fin s → Edges b t m × Bool) (hgood : allBatchesGood b t m s ω) :
    b ≤ maxLoad ((RandomGreedy.coinGraph (graph b t m)).sample (blockFlatten b s ω))
      (onlineOrientation (RandomGreedy.policy (graph b t m)) (blockFlatten b s ω)) := by
  let v : Vertices b t m := ⟨0,(⟨0,by simp⟩,⟨0,hm⟩)⟩
  have hh := propagation b t m s ω hgood b le_rfl v (by simp [v])
  have heq := execution_final_load _ _ _
    (RandomGreedy.state_zero (graph b t m) (blockFlatten b s ω))
    (RandomGreedy.state_step (graph b t m) (blockFlatten b s ω)) v
  rw [heq] at hh
  exact hh.trans (load_le_maxLoad _ _ _)

GraphChoices.LowerBound.expectedGreedy_l.source:
theorem expectedGreedy_lower (b t m s : ℕ) [Nonempty (Edges b t m)] (hm : 0 < m) :
    (b:ℝ)*(1-(b:ℝ)*(Fintype.card (Blocks b t):ℝ)*m*
      Real.exp ((b:ℝ)*Real.log 2-(s:ℝ)*(t*m)/(4*(Fintype.card (Edges b t m):ℝ)))) ≤
      RandomGreedy.expectedLoad (graph b t m) (b*s) := by
  classical
  let good := univ \ badBatches b t m s
  have hpoint (ω : Fin b → Fin s → Edges b t m × Bool) :
      (b:ℝ)*(if ω ∈ good then (1:ℝ) else 0) ≤
        (maxLoad ((RandomGreedy.coinGraph (graph b t m)).sample (blockFlatten b s ω))
          (onlineOrientation (RandomGreedy.policy (graph b t m)) (blockFlatten b s ω)):ℝ) := by
    split_ifs with hω
    · rw [mul_one]
      have hh : allBatchesGood b t m s ω := by
        have h := (mem_sdiff.mp hω).2
        simpa only [badBatches, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, not_not] using h
      exact_mod_cast goodBatches_maxLoad b t m s hm ω hh
    · rw [mul_zero]
      positivity
  have hh := average_mono hpoint
  rw [average_mul, average_unit_indicator, eventProbability_compl,
    average_equiv (blockFlatten b s) (fun ω => (maxLoad ((RandomGreedy.coinGraph (graph b t m)).sample ω)
      (onlineOrientation (RandomGreedy.policy (graph b t m)) ω):ℝ))] at hh
  apply le_trans _ hh
  have hb := badBatches_probability b t m s
  have hbr : (0:ℝ) ≤ b := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  nlinarith

end GraphChoices.LowerBound

GraphChoices.Peeling.PreparedDecompositi.source:
theorem PreparedDecomposition.mass_at_horizon (P : PreparedDecomposition G B N d) (T : ℕ)
    (haverage : 2*(G.card : ℝ) = (T:ℝ)*d) :
    1 ≤ 16*(B:ℝ)*((T:ℝ)/Fintype.card G) := by
  have hE : (0:ℝ) < Fintype.card G := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
  rw [← mul_div_assoc]
  apply (le_div_iff₀ hE).mpr
  have hp := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left P.average_cap (Nat.cast_nonneg T : (0:ℝ) ≤ T)
  have heq : (Fintype.card G : ℝ) = G.card := by rw [Fintype.card_coe]
  rw [heq]
  nlinarith

theorem PreparedDecomposition.budget_simplified_horizon (P : PreparedDecomposition G B N d) (T : ℕ) (hT : 0 < T)
    (haverage : 2*(G.card : ℝ) = (T:ℝ)*d) :
    P.budget T ≤ 64*((B:ℝ)*((T:ℝ)/Fintype.card G)+graphLogSkewness G d (N:ℝ)+1)*
      (P.pieces.length+Real.log (Real.log (N:ℝ))+1) := by
  have hz : 0 < (T:ℝ)/Fintype.card G := div_pos
    (by exact_mod_cast hT) (by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos)
  have hh := P.class_count_pos
  have hhr : (1:ℝ) ≤ P.pieces.length := by exact_mod_cast hh
  have hb := branchTarget_pos (4*B) P.pieces.length _ hh hz.le
  have hb1 := (branchTarget_le_rate (4*B) P.pieces.length _ hh hz.le).trans (shapeRate_le_one _ hh)
  have hmass := P.mass_at_horizon T haverage
  have hK : 1 ≤ 16*(B:ℝ)*((T:ℝ)/Fintype.card G)/branchTarget (4*B) P.pieces.length ((T:ℝ)/Fintype.card G) := by
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hb).mpr
    simpa only [one_mul] using hb1.trans hmass
  have hl : 0 ≤ Real.log (Real.log (N:ℝ)) := Real.log_nonneg P.large_log.le
  have hbound := log_reference_branch_bound B P.pieces.length ((T:ℝ)/Fintype.card G) P.reference_cap_pos hh hz
  have hs := scalar_budget_le (P.pieces.length : ℝ) ((B:ℝ)*((T:ℝ)/Fintype.card G))
    (graphLogSkewness G d (N:ℝ)) (Real.log (Real.log (N:ℝ))) _ hhr (by positivity)
    (graphLogSkewness_nonneg G d (N:ℝ)) hl (Real.log_nonneg hK) hbound
  convert hs using 1 <;> unfold PreparedDecomposition.budget <;> ring

theorem PreparedDecomposition.budget_loglog_horizon (P : PreparedDecomposition G B N d) (T : ℕ) (hT : 0 < T)
    (hB : B ≤ N^2) (haverage : 2*(G.card : ℝ) = (T:ℝ)*d) :
    P.budget T ≤ 320*((B:ℝ)*((T:ℝ)/Fintype.card G)+graphLogSkewness G d (N:ℝ)+1)*(iteratedLog N : ℝ) := by
  have hn : P.pieces.length ≤ iteratedLog N+2 := by
    rw [P.count]
    exact numberRounds_le_iteratedLog B N P.vertex_count_pos hB
  have hnr : (P.pieces.length : ℝ) ≤ (iteratedLog N : ℝ)+2 := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hQ : (1:ℝ) ≤ iteratedLog N := by exact_mod_cast iteratedLog_pos N
  have hl := real_loglog_le_iteratedLog N P.large_log
  have hs := graphLogSkewness_nonneg G d (N:ℝ)
  have hfactor : (P.pieces.length : ℝ)+Real.log (Real.log (N:ℝ))+1 ≤ 5*(iteratedLog N : ℝ) := by linarith
  calc
    _ ≤ _ := P.budget_simplified_horizon T hT haverage
    _ ≤ 64*((B:ℝ)*((T:ℝ)/Fintype.card G)+graphLogSkewness G d (N:ℝ)+1)*(5*(iteratedLog N : ℝ)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfactor (by positivity)
    _ = _ := by ring

theorem PreparedDecomposition.component_tail_horizon (P : PreparedDecomposition G B N d)
    (T c : ℕ) (hT : 0 < T) (hc : 5 ≤ c)
    (hvertices : Fintype.card (L ⊕ R) ≤ N)
    (haverage : 2*(G.card:ℝ) = (T:ℝ)*d) :
    eventProbability (largeComponentEvent P.encode (P.thresholds T) T
      (3*(polynomialCutoff N c+1)^2)) ≤ 3/(N:ℝ)^c := by
  have hv : Fintype.card L+Fintype.card R ≤ N := by simpa only [Fintype.card_sum] using hvertices
  apply log_squared_component_tail P.pieces.get P.encode P.DL P.DR (4*B)
    (maxLeftDegree G) T N c (fun i => scaleNat i.val) P.simple P.source P.bucket_bound
    P.piece_left_cap P.piece_right_cap P.global_bucket_bound hT P.scale_gt_one
    P.vertex_count_pos (by omega) (by omega)
  have hm : (T:ℝ)*(maxLeftDegree G:ℝ)/G.card ≤ 2*Real.log (N:ℝ) := by
    have he : (0:ℝ) < G.card := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < G.card by simpa only [← Fintype.card_coe] using Fintype.card_pos (α := G))
    apply (div_le_iff₀ he).mpr
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left P.max_degree_preprocessing (Nat.cast_nonneg T : (0:ℝ) ≤ T)
    rw [← mul_assoc, ← haverage] at hh
    nlinarith
  have hh := preprocessed_mean_below_cutoff N c ((T:ℝ)*(maxLeftDegree G:ℝ)/G.card)
    P.vertex_count_pos hc (by positivity) hm
  rw [Fintype.card_coe]
  convert hh using 1 <;> ring

theorem PreparedDecomposition.expected_cost_horizon (P : PreparedDecomposition G B N d)
    (T : ℕ) (hT : 0 < T) (hTN : T ≤ N)
    (hvertices : Fintype.card (L ⊕ R) ≤ N)
    (haverage : 2*(G.card:ℝ) = (T:ℝ)*d) (hB : B ≤ N^2) :
    expectedCost (graphBase G) (onlineOrientation (T := T) (P.policy T)) ≤
      320*((B:ℝ)*((T:ℝ)/G.card)+graphLogSkewness G d (N:ℝ)+1)*(iteratedLog N:ℝ)+
        20*(iteratedLog N:ℝ)*expectedOpt (graphBase G) T+3 := by
  have ht := P.component_tail_horizon T 5 hT (by decide) hvertices haverage
  have hh := expected_load_of_component_tail P.encode (P.thresholds T) T _ _ ht
  rw [expectedTotalMaxLoad_eq_expectedCost, expectedReplayOpt_eq_expectedOpt] at hh
  change expectedCost (graphBase G) (onlineOrientation (T := T) (P.policy T)) ≤
    (∑ i, (P.thresholds T i:ℝ))+
      (2*(Nat.log 2 (3*(polynomialCutoff N 5+1)^2)+1):ℕ)*expectedOpt (graphBase G) T+
        T*(3/(N:ℝ)^5) at hh
  have hb := (P.threshold_budget T (P.mass_at_horizon T haverage)).trans
    (P.budget_loglog_horizon T hT hB haverage)
  rw [Fintype.card_coe] at hb
  have hg : (((2*(Nat.log 2 (3*(polynomialCutoff N 5+1)^2)+1):ℕ):ℝ)) ≤ 20*(iteratedLog N:ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast greedy_multiplier_le_iteratedLog N
  have hgm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hg (expectedOpt_nonneg (graphBase G) T)
  have he : (T:ℝ)*(3/(N:ℝ)^5) ≤ 3 := by
    apply le_trans _ (exceptional_error_le_three N P.vertex_count_pos)
    have htr : (T:ℝ) ≤ N := by exact_mod_cast hTN
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right htr (show 0 ≤ 3/(N:ℝ)^5 by positivity)
    convert hmul using 1 <;> ring
  linarith

end GraphChoices.Peeling

GraphChoices.requirementsEvent.source:
def requirementsEvent (τ : J → Fin T) (A : J → Finset E) : Finset (Fin T → E) :=
  univ.filter fun ω => ∀ j, ω (τ j) ∈ A j

GraphChoices.constraintsAt.source:
noncomputable def constraintsAt (τ : J → Fin T) (A : J → Finset E) (t : Fin T) : Finset E := by
  classical
  exact if h : ∃ j, τ j = t then A (Classical.choose h) else univ

GraphChoices.constraintsAt_selected.source:
theorem constraintsAt_selected (τ : J → Fin T) (A : J → Finset E)
    (hτ : Function.Injective τ) (j : J) : constraintsAt τ A (τ j) = A j := by
  classical
  unfold constraintsAt
  rw [dif_pos (show ∃ k, τ k = τ j from ⟨j,rfl⟩)]
  congr 1
  exact hτ (Classical.choose_spec (show ∃ k, τ k = τ j from ⟨j,rfl⟩))

GraphChoices.requirementsEvent_eq_pi.source:
theorem requirementsEvent_eq_pi (τ : J → Fin T) (A : J → Finset E)
    (hτ : Function.Injective τ) :
    requirementsEvent τ A = Fintype.piFinset (constraintsAt τ A) := by
  classical
  ext ω
  simp only [requirementsEvent, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, Fintype.mem_piFinset]
  constructor
  · intro h t
    unfold constraintsAt
    split_ifs with ht
    · have hchoose := Classical.choose_spec ht
      simpa [hchoose] using h (Classical.choose ht)
    · exact mem_univ _
  · intro h j
    have ht := h (τ j)
    simpa [constraintsAt_selected τ A hτ j] using ht

/-- Injective assignment of all witness slots makes the probability a product
of the permitted fractions of base-edge labels. -/

GraphChoices.requirements_probability.source:
theorem requirements_probability (τ : J → Fin T) (A : J → Finset E)
    (hτ : Function.Injective τ) :
    eventProbability (requirementsEvent τ A) =
      ∏ j, ((A j).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card E := by
  classical
  rw [requirementsEvent_eq_pi τ A hτ, probability_coordinate_constraints]
  let S : Finset (Fin T) := univ.image τ
  have hm : (Fintype.card E : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero
  calc
    _ = ∏ t ∈ S, ((constraintsAt τ A t).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card E := by
      symm
      apply prod_subset (subset_univ _)
      intro t ht hnot
      have hnone : ¬∃ j, τ j = t := by
        rintro ⟨j,hj⟩
        exact hnot (mem_image.mpr ⟨j,mem_univ _,hj⟩)
      simp [constraintsAt, hnone, hm]
    _ = ∏ j, ((constraintsAt τ A (τ j)).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card E := by
      exact prod_image hτ.injOn
    _ = _ := by simp only [constraintsAt_selected τ A hτ]

/-- A finite family of injective time witnesses can be union-bounded without
assuming independence between the different witness events. -/

GraphChoices.injected_witness_union_boun.source:
theorem injected_witness_union_bound {W : Type*} [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W]
    (τ : W → J → Fin T) (A : J → Finset E) :
    eventProbability (univ.biUnion fun w : W =>
      if Function.Injective (τ w) then requirementsEvent (τ w) A else ∅) ≤
      Fintype.card W * (∏ j, ((A j).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card E) := by
  classical
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ w : W, eventProbability
        (if Function.Injective (τ w) then requirementsEvent (τ w) A else ∅) := witness_union_bound _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ _w : W, ∏ j, ((A j).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card E := by
      apply sum_le_sum
      intro w _
      split_ifs with h
      · rw [requirements_probability _ _ h]
      · have hp : (0:ℝ) ≤ ∏ j : J, ((A j).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card E :=
          prod_nonneg (fun _ _ => div_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
        simpa [eventProbability] using hp
    _ = _ := by simp

end GraphChoices

GraphChoices.iteratedLog.source: def iteratedLog (N : ℕ) : ℕ := Nat.log 2 (Nat.log 2 N+1)+1

GraphChoices.iteratedLog_pos.source: theorem iteratedLog_pos (N : ℕ) : 0 < iteratedLog N := by unfold iteratedLog; omega

GraphChoices.nat_log_mul_two_pow.source:
theorem nat_log_mul_two_pow (a k : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) : Nat.log 2 (a*2^k) = Nat.log 2 a+k := by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [pow_succ, ← mul_assoc, Nat.log_mul_base (by decide) (by positivity), ih]
    omega

GraphChoices.nat_log_square_bound.source:
theorem nat_log_square_bound (a : ℕ) : Nat.log 2 (a^2)+1 ≤ 2*(Nat.log 2 a+1) := by
  by_cases ha : a = 0
  · simp [ha]
  have hp := Nat.lt_pow_succ_log_self (by decide : 1 < 2) a
  have hs : a^2 < 2^(2*(Nat.log 2 a+1)) := by
    calc
      _ < (2^(Nat.log 2 a+1))^2 := Nat.pow_lt_pow_left hp (by decide)
      _ = _ := by rw [← pow_mul]; congr 1; omega
  have hh := Nat.log_lt_of_lt_pow (pow_ne_zero 2 ha) hs
  omega

GraphChoices.numberRounds_le_iteratedLog.source:
theorem numberRounds_le_iteratedLog (B N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (hB : B ≤ N^2) :
    Peeling.numberRounds B ≤ iteratedLog N+2 := by
  by_cases hB0 : B = 0
  · simp [hB0, Peeling.numberRounds]
  let l := Nat.log 2 N+1
  have hl : 1 ≤ l := by dsimp [l]; omega
  have hpow := Nat.lt_pow_succ_log_self (by decide : 1 < 2) N
  have hbound : 16*B < 2^(2*l+4) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ 16*N^2 := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hB
      _ < 16*(2^l)^2 := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (Nat.pow_lt_pow_left hpow (by decide)) (by decide)
      _ = _ := by
        have he : 2^(2*l+4) = (2^l)^2*16 := by
          rw [pow_add, show 2*l = l*2 by omega, pow_mul]
          norm_num
        rw [he]
        ring
  have hin := Nat.log_lt_of_lt_pow (by positivity : 16*B ≠ 0) hbound
  have hinner : Nat.log 2 (16*B)+1 ≤ 8*l := by omega
  have hmono := Nat.log_mono_right hinner (b := 2)
  have heq : Nat.log 2 (8*l) = Nat.log 2 l+3 := by
    simpa only [show 2^3 = 8 by norm_num, mul_comm] using nat_log_mul_two_pow l 3 (by omega)
  unfold Peeling.numberRounds
  rw [heq] at hmono
  change Nat.log 2 (Nat.log 2 (16*B)+1) ≤ Nat.log 2 l+1+2
  omega

GraphChoices.real_loglog_le_iteratedLog.source:
theorem real_loglog_le_iteratedLog (N : ℕ) (hlog : 1 < Real.log (N:ℝ)) :
    Real.log (Real.log (N:ℝ)) ≤ (iteratedLog N : ℝ) := by
  have hN : 0 < N := by
    by_contra hn
    have hz : N = 0 := by omega
    norm_num [hz] at hlog
  have hl := Patterns.real_log_le_nat_log_shift N hN
  have hpos : 0 < Real.log (N:ℝ) := by linarith
  have hh := Real.log_le_log hpos hl
  exact hh.trans (Patterns.real_log_le_nat_log_shift (Nat.log 2 N+1) (by omega))

GraphChoices.greedy_multiplier_le_iterat.source:
theorem greedy_multiplier_le_iteratedLog (N : ℕ) :
    2*(Nat.log 2 (3*(polynomialCutoff N 5+1)^2)+1) ≤ 20*iteratedLog N := by
  let l := Nat.log 2 N+1
  have hl : 1 ≤ l := by dsimp [l]; omega
  have hl2 : l ≤ l*l := Nat.le_mul_self l
  have hsize : 3*(6*l+1)^2 ≤ (16*l)^2 := by nlinarith
  have hmono := Nat.log_mono_right hsize (b := 2)
  have hsquare := nat_log_square_bound (16*l)
  have hlog : Nat.log 2 (16*l) = Nat.log 2 l+4 := by
    simpa only [show 2^4 = 16 by norm_num, mul_comm] using nat_log_mul_two_pow l 4 (by omega)
  rw [hlog] at hsquare
  change 2*(Nat.log 2 (3*(6*l+1)^2)+1) ≤ 20*(Nat.log 2 l+1)
  omega

GraphChoices.exceptional_error_le_three.source:
theorem exceptional_error_le_three (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) : 3*(N:ℝ)/(N:ℝ)^5 ≤ 3 := by
  have hNr : (0:ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN
  have hN1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ N := by exact_mod_cast hN
  have hp : (1:ℝ) ≤ (N:ℝ)^4 := one_le_pow₀ hN1
  calc
    _ = 3/(N:ℝ)^4 := by rw [pow_succ]; field_simp
    _ ≤ 3 := (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)).mpr (by linarith)

end GraphChoices

namespace GraphChoices.Peeling
open Patterns
variable {L R : Type*} [Fintype L] [Fintype R] [DecidableEq L] [DecidableEq R]
  {G : Graph L R} {B N : ℕ} {d : ℝ} [Nonempty G]

GraphChoices.Peeling.PreparedDecompositi.source:
theorem PreparedDecomposition.budget_loglog (P : PreparedDecomposition G B N d)
    (hB : B ≤ N^2) (haverage : 2*(G.card : ℝ) = (N:ℝ)*d) :
    P.budget N ≤ 320*((B:ℝ)*((N:ℝ)/Fintype.card G)+graphLogSkewness G d (N:ℝ)+1)*(iteratedLog N : ℝ) := by
  have hn : P.pieces.length ≤ iteratedLog N+2 := by
    rw [P.count]
    exact numberRounds_le_iteratedLog B N P.vertex_count_pos hB
  have hnr : (P.pieces.length : ℝ) ≤ (iteratedLog N : ℝ)+2 := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hQ : (1:ℝ) ≤ iteratedLog N := by exact_mod_cast iteratedLog_pos N
  have hl := real_loglog_le_iteratedLog N P.large_log
  have hs := graphLogSkewness_nonneg G d (N:ℝ)
  have hfactor : (P.pieces.length : ℝ)+Real.log (Real.log (N:ℝ))+1 ≤ 5*(iteratedLog N : ℝ) := by linarith
  calc
    _ ≤ _ := P.budget_simplified haverage
    _ ≤ 64*((B:ℝ)*((N:ℝ)/Fintype.card G)+graphLogSkewness G d (N:ℝ)+1)*(5*(iteratedLog N : ℝ)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfactor (by positivity)
    _ = _ := by ring

end GraphChoices.Peeling

GraphChoices.Patterns.forestLabels.source:
def forestLabels : Tree V → List V
  | .nil => []
  | .node v l r => v :: (forestLabels l ++ forestLabels r)

GraphChoices.Patterns.ForestValid.source:
def ForestValid (G : SimpleGraph V) : V → Tree V → Prop
  | _, .nil => True
  | p, .node v l r => G.Adj p v ∧ ForestValid G v l ∧ ForestValid G p r

GraphChoices.Patterns.forestLabels_lengt.source:
theorem forestLabels_length (t : Tree V) : (forestLabels t).length = t.numNodes := by
  induction t with
  | nil => rfl
  | node v l r hl hr => simp [forestLabels, Tree.numNodes, hl, hr]

/-- Insert a new child at any named vertex in the forest, without imposing
an ordering on the old vertices. The labels change by exactly one insertion. -/

GraphChoices.Patterns.forest_grow.source:
theorem forest_grow {G : SimpleGraph V} (t : Tree V) (p u x : V)
    (ht : ForestValid G p t) (hu : u = p ∨ u ∈ forestLabels t) (hux : G.Adj u x) :
    ∃ t' : Tree V, ForestValid G p t' ∧ (forestLabels t').Perm (x :: forestLabels t) := by
  induction t generalizing p with
  | nil =>
    have hup : u = p := by simpa [forestLabels] using hu
    subst u
    exact ⟨.node x .nil .nil, ⟨hux, trivial, trivial⟩, by simp [forestLabels]⟩
  | node v l r hl hr =>
    by_cases hup : u = p
    · subst u
      exact ⟨.node x .nil (.node v l r), ⟨hux, trivial, ht⟩, by simp [forestLabels]⟩
    have hu' : u ∈ forestLabels (.node v l r) := hu.resolve_left hup
    obtain ⟨hpv, hvl, hpr⟩ := ht
    simp only [forestLabels, List.mem_cons, List.mem_append] at hu'
    rcases hu' with rfl | hu | hu
    · refine ⟨.node u (.node x .nil l) r, ⟨hpv, ⟨hux, trivial, hvl⟩, hpr⟩, ?_⟩
      simp only [forestLabels, List.nil_append, List.cons_append]
      exact List.Perm.swap _ _ _
    · obtain ⟨l', hl', hperm⟩ := hl v hvl (Or.inr hu)
      refine ⟨.node v l' r, ⟨hpv, hl', hpr⟩, ?_⟩
      have h := (hperm.append_right (forestLabels r)).cons v
      exact h.trans (List.Perm.swap _ _ _)
    · obtain ⟨r', hr', hperm⟩ := hr p hpr (Or.inr hu)
      refine ⟨.node v l r', ⟨hpv, hvl, hr'⟩, ?_⟩
      have h := (hperm.append_left (forestLabels l)).cons v
      apply h.trans
      simpa only [forestLabels, List.cons_append] using
        (List.perm_middle (a := x) (l₁ := v :: forestLabels l) (l₂ := forestLabels r))

GraphChoices.Patterns.walk_mem_of_closed.source:
theorem walk_mem_of_closed {G : SimpleGraph V} {u v : V} (p : G.Walk u v)
    (S : Set V) (hu : u ∈ S) (hclosed : ∀ a ∈ S, ∀ b, G.Adj a b → b ∈ S) : v ∈ S := by
  induction p with
  | nil => exact hu
  | @cons a b c hab p ih => exact ih (hclosed a hu b hab)

/-- Every finite connected graph has a nonrepeating spanning labelled binary
forest with the designated root external to that forest. -/

GraphChoices.Patterns.exists_spanning_la.source:
theorem exists_spanning_labelled_forest [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V)
    (hc : G.Connected) (root : V) :
    ∃ t : Tree V, ForestValid G root t ∧ (root :: forestLabels t).Nodup ∧
      (∀ v, v ∈ root :: forestLabels t) ∧ t.numNodes+1 = Fintype.card V := by
  classical
  let P (n : ℕ) : Prop := ∃ t : Tree V,
    t.numNodes = n ∧ ForestValid G root t ∧ (root :: forestLabels t).Nodup
  have hzero : P 0 := ⟨.nil, rfl, trivial, by simp [forestLabels]⟩
  let n := Nat.findGreatest P (Fintype.card V)
  obtain ⟨t, hcount, ht, hn⟩ := Nat.findGreatest_spec (Nat.zero_le (Fintype.card V)) hzero
  have hclosed : ∀ u ∈ root :: forestLabels t, ∀ x, G.Adj u x → x ∈ root :: forestLabels t := by
    intro u hu x hux
    by_contra hx
    have hu' : u = root ∨ u ∈ forestLabels t := by simpa using hu
    obtain ⟨t', ht', hperm⟩ := forest_grow t root u x ht hu' hux
    have hn0 : (x :: root :: forestLabels t).Nodup := List.nodup_cons.mpr ⟨hx, hn⟩
    have hn1 : (root :: x :: forestLabels t).Nodup := (List.Perm.swap _ _ _).nodup_iff.mpr hn0
    have hn' : (root :: forestLabels t').Nodup := (hperm.cons root).nodup_iff.mpr hn1
    have hlen := hperm.length_eq
    simp only [forestLabels_length, List.length_cons] at hlen
    have hsize : t'.numNodes = n+1 := by omega
    have hbound := hn'.length_le_card
    simp only [List.length_cons, forestLabels_length] at hbound
    have hnew : P (n+1) := ⟨t', hsize, ht', hn'⟩
    exact Nat.findGreatest_is_greatest (show n < n+1 by omega) (by omega) hnew
  have hcover : ∀ v, v ∈ root :: forestLabels t := by
    intro v
    obtain ⟨p⟩ := hc root v
    exact walk_mem_of_closed p {w | w ∈ root :: forestLabels t} (by simp) hclosed
  refine ⟨t, ht, hn, hcover, ?_⟩
  have hfin : (root :: forestLabels t).toFinset = univ := by
    apply Finset.eq_univ_of_forall
    intro v
    exact List.mem_toFinset.mpr (hcover v)
  have hcard := congrArg Finset.card hfin
  simpa only [List.toFinset_card_of_nodup hn, card_univ, List.length_cons, forestLabels_length] using hcard

end GraphChoices.Patterns

GraphChoices.Patterns.largeShapeEvent.source:
noncomputable def largeShapeEvent (H : C → Peeling.Graph L R)
    (encode : E → ThresholdGreedy.Arrival L R C) (α : C → ℕ) (T k B : ℕ) : Finset (Fin T → E) :=
  (range (B+1)).biUnion fun j => heavyShapeEvent H encode α T (k+j)

GraphChoices.Patterns.largeShape_probabi.source:
theorem largeShape_probability_le (H : C → Peeling.Graph L R)
    (encode : E → ThresholdGreedy.Arrival L R C) (α : C → ℕ) (T k B : ℕ)
    (htail : ∀ j ≤ B, eventProbability (heavyShapeEvent H encode α T (k+j)) ≤
      (Fintype.card R : ℝ)/2^(k+j)) :
    eventProbability (largeShapeEvent H encode α T k B) ≤ 2*(Fintype.card R : ℝ)/2^k := by
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ range (B+1), eventProbability (heavyShapeEvent H encode α T (k+j)) :=
      witness_union_bound _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ range (B+1), (Fintype.card R : ℝ)/2^(k+j) := by
      apply sum_le_sum
      intro j hj
      exact htail j (by have := mem_range.mp hj; omega)
    _ = ((Fintype.card R : ℝ)/2^k) * (∑ j ∈ range (B+1), (1:ℝ)/2^j) := by
      rw [mul_sum]
      apply sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      rw [pow_add]
      ring
    _ ≤ ((Fintype.card R : ℝ)/2^k) * 2 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (ThresholdGreedy.inverse_powers_sum_le_two _) (by positivity)
    _ = _ := by ring

end GraphChoices.Patterns

GraphChoices.LowerBound.Vertices.source: abbrev Vertices (b t m : ℕ) := (i : Fin (b+1)) × (Fin (t^i.val) × Fin m)

GraphChoices.LowerBound.Blocks.source: abbrev Blocks (b t : ℕ) := (i : Fin b) × Fin (t^i.val)

GraphChoices.LowerBound.Edges.source: abbrev Edges (b t m : ℕ) := Blocks b t × (Fin m × Fin (t*m))

GraphChoices.LowerBound.leftVertex.source:
def leftVertex {b t m : ℕ} (p : Blocks b t × Fin m) : Vertices b t m :=
  ⟨p.1.1.castSucc,(p.1.2,p.2)⟩

GraphChoices.LowerBound.childGroup.source:
def childGroup {t m i : ℕ} (g : Fin (t^i)) (r : Fin (t*m)) : Fin (t^(i+1)) :=
  Fin.cast (pow_succ t i).symm (finProdFinEquiv (g,(finProdFinEquiv.symm r).1))

GraphChoices.LowerBound.rightVertex.source:
def rightVertex {b t m : ℕ} (p : Blocks b t × Fin (t*m)) : Vertices b t m :=
  ⟨p.1.1.succ,(childGroup p.1.2 p.2,(finProdFinEquiv.symm p.2).2)⟩

GraphChoices.LowerBound.graph.source:
def graph (b t m : ℕ) : BaseGraph (Vertices b t m) (Edges b t m) where
  left e := leftVertex (e.1,e.2.1)
  right e := rightVertex (e.1,e.2.2)

GraphChoices.LowerBound.leftVertex_injec.source:
theorem leftVertex_injective (b t m : ℕ) : Function.Injective (@leftVertex b t m) := by
  rintro ⟨⟨i,g⟩,a⟩ ⟨⟨j,h⟩,a'⟩ he
  have hij : i = j := Fin.ext (congrArg (fun v => v.1.val) he)
  subst j
  have hp : (g,a) = (h,a') := eq_of_heq (Sigma.mk.inj_iff.mp he).2
  obtain ⟨rfl,rfl⟩ := Prod.mk.inj hp
  rfl

GraphChoices.LowerBound.rightVertex_inje.source:
theorem rightVertex_injective (b t m : ℕ) : Function.Injective (@rightVertex b t m) := by
  rintro ⟨⟨i,g⟩,r⟩ ⟨⟨j,h⟩,s⟩ he
  have hij : i = j := by
    have hh := congrArg (fun v => v.1.val) he
    exact Fin.ext (by simpa only [rightVertex, Fin.val_succ] using Nat.succ.inj hh)
  subst j
  have hp : (childGroup g r,(finProdFinEquiv.symm r).2) =
      (childGroup h s,(finProdFinEquiv.symm s).2) := eq_of_heq (Sigma.mk.inj_iff.mp he).2
  have hc := Fin.cast_injective (pow_succ t i.val).symm (congrArg Prod.fst hp)
  have hpair := finProdFinEquiv.injective hc
  have hg : g = h := congrArg Prod.fst hpair
  have hr1 : (finProdFinEquiv.symm r).1 = (finProdFinEquiv.symm s).1 := congrArg (fun p : Fin (t^i.val) × Fin t => p.2) hpair
  have hr2 : (finProdFinEquiv.symm r).2 = (finProdFinEquiv.symm s).2 := congrArg (fun p : Fin (t^(i.val+1)) × Fin m => p.2) hp
  have hr : r = s := finProdFinEquiv.symm.injective (Prod.ext hr1 hr2)
  subst h
  subst s
  rfl

GraphChoices.LowerBound.graph_isSimple.source:
theorem graph_isSimple (b t m : ℕ) : (graph b t m).IsSimple := by
  constructor
  · intro e he
    have hh := congrArg (fun v => v.1.val) he
    change e.1.1.val = e.1.1.val+1 at hh
    omega
  · intro e f hef
    rcases hef with ⟨hl,hr⟩ | ⟨hl,hr⟩
    · have hleft := leftVertex_injective b t m hl
      have hright := rightVertex_injective b t m hr
      have hc : e.1 = f.1 := congrArg (fun p : Blocks b t × Fin m => p.1) hleft
      have ha : e.2.1 = f.2.1 := congrArg (fun p : Blocks b t × Fin m => p.2) hleft
      have hr : e.2.2 = f.2.2 := congrArg (fun p : Blocks b t × Fin (t*m) => p.2) hright
      exact Prod.ext hc (Prod.ext ha hr)
    · have h1 := congrArg (fun v => v.1.val) hl
      have h2 := congrArg (fun v => v.1.val) hr
      change e.1.1.val = f.1.1.val+1 at h1
      change e.1.1.val+1 = f.1.1.val at h2
      omega

GraphChoices.LowerBound.layerSum.source: def layerSum (t b : ℕ) : ℕ := ∑ i ∈ range b, t^i

GraphChoices.LowerBound.card_blocks.source:
theorem card_blocks (b t : ℕ) : Fintype.card (Blocks b t) = layerSum t b := by
  simp only [Blocks, Fintype.card_sigma, Fintype.card_fin, layerSum, Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range]

GraphChoices.LowerBound.card_vertices.source:
theorem card_vertices (b t m : ℕ) : Fintype.card (Vertices b t m) = m*layerSum t (b+1) := by
  simp only [Vertices, Fintype.card_sigma, Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fin,
    ← sum_mul, Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range, layerSum]
  ring

GraphChoices.LowerBound.card_edges.source:
theorem card_edges (b t m : ℕ) : Fintype.card (Edges b t m) = m^2*t*layerSum t b := by
  simp only [Edges, Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fin, card_blocks]
  ring

GraphChoices.LowerBound.layerSum_succ.source: theorem layerSum_succ (t b : ℕ) : layerSum t (b+1) = layerSum t b+t^b := sum_range_succ _ _

GraphChoices.LowerBound.layerSum_shift.source:
theorem layerSum_shift (t b : ℕ) : layerSum t (b+1) = 1+t*layerSum t b := by
  simp only [layerSum, sum_range_succ', pow_succ, ← sum_mul, pow_zero]
  ring

GraphChoices.LowerBound.layerSum_pos.source:
theorem layerSum_pos (t b : ℕ) (hb : 0 < b) : 0 < layerSum t b := by
  have hh : (1:ℕ) ≤ layerSum t b := by
    simpa only [pow_zero] using (single_le_sum (f := fun i => t^i) (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) (mem_range.mpr hb))
  omega

GraphChoices.LowerBound.layerSum_upper.source:
theorem layerSum_upper (t b : ℕ) (ht : 1 ≤ t) : layerSum t (b+1) ≤ (b+1)*t^b := by
  apply le_trans (sum_le_card_nsmul _ _ (t^b) ?_) (by simp)
  intro i hi
  exact Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by have := mem_range.mp hi; omega)

end GraphChoices.LowerBound

GraphChoices.Peeling.leftBucket.source: def leftBucket (G : Graph L R) (u : L) : Finset G := univ.filter fun e => e.val.1 = u

GraphChoices.Peeling.leftBucket_card.source:
theorem leftBucket_card (G : Graph L R) (u : L) : (leftBucket G u).card = leftDegree G u := by
  classical
  apply card_bij (fun e _ => e.val.2)
  · intro e he
    have hh := (mem_filter.mp he).2
    simp only [leftNeighbors, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
    simpa only [← hh] using e.property
  · intro e he f hf h
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact Prod.ext (((mem_filter.mp he).2).trans ((mem_filter.mp hf).2).symm) h
  · intro v hv
    have hh : (u,v) ∈ G := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
    exact ⟨⟨(u,v),hh⟩, mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _,rfl⟩, rfl⟩

GraphChoices.Peeling.allLeft_maxLoad.source:
theorem allLeft_maxLoad (G : Graph L R) {T : ℕ} (ω : Fin T → G) :
    maxLoad ((graphBase G).sample ω) (fun _ => true) =
      univ.sup (fun u : L => hitCount (leftBucket G u) ω) := by
  have hl (u : L) : load ((graphBase G).sample ω) (fun _ => true) (Sum.inl u) =
      hitCount (leftBucket G u) ω := by simp [load, destination, graphBase, BaseGraph.sample, hitCount, leftBucket]
  have hr (v : R) : load ((graphBase G).sample ω) (fun _ => true) (Sum.inr v) = 0 := by
    simp [load, destination, graphBase, BaseGraph.sample]
  apply Nat.le_antisymm
  · apply (maxLoad_le_iff _ _ _).mpr
    intro v
    cases v with
    | inl u => rw [hl]; exact Finset.le_sup (f := fun u : L => hitCount (leftBucket G u) ω) (mem_univ u)
    | inr v => rw [hr]; omega
  · apply Finset.sup_le
    intro u _
    rw [← hl]
    exact load_le_maxLoad _ _ _

GraphChoices.Peeling.allLeft_expectedCos.source:
theorem allLeft_expectedCost (G : Graph L R) [Nonempty G] (T N : ℕ)
    (hvertices : Fintype.card (L ⊕ R) ≤ N) :
    expectedCost (graphBase G) (onlineOrientation (T := T) (fun _ _ => true)) ≤
      2*Real.log (N:ℝ)+2*(maxLeftDegree G:ℝ)*((T:ℝ)/G.card) := by
  classical
  let e : G := Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty G)
  letI : Nonempty L := ⟨e.val.1⟩
  have hc : (0:ℝ) < Fintype.card L := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
  have hLN : Fintype.card L ≤ N := by simp only [Fintype.card_sum] at hvertices; omega
  have hh := expected_max_hits (leftBucket G) T ((maxLeftDegree G:ℝ)*((T:ℝ)/G.card)) (fun u => by
    rw [leftBucket_card, Fintype.card_coe]
    have hd : (leftDegree G u:ℝ) ≤ maxLeftDegree G := by exact_mod_cast leftDegree_le_max G u
    have he := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hd (show 0 ≤ (T:ℝ)/G.card by positivity)
    convert he using 1 <;> ring)
  have heq : expectedCost (graphBase G) (onlineOrientation (T := T) (fun _ _ => true)) =
      average (fun ω : Fin T → G => ((univ.sup fun u => hitCount (leftBucket G u) ω:ℕ):ℝ)) := by
    unfold expectedCost
    congr 1
    funext ω
    exact_mod_cast allLeft_maxLoad G ω
  rw [heq]
  have hlog := Real.log_le_log hc (show (Fintype.card L:ℝ) ≤ N by exact_mod_cast hLN)
  linarith

GraphChoices.Peeling.allLeft_reference_b.source:
theorem allLeft_reference_bound (G : Graph L R) [Nonempty G] (T N : ℕ)
    (hvertices : Fintype.card (L ⊕ R) ≤ N)
    (hD : ∀ u, leftDegree G u ≤ 4*(graphBase G).referenceCap) :
    expectedCost (graphBase G) (onlineOrientation (T := T) (fun _ _ => true)) ≤
      24*expectedOpt (graphBase G) T+2*Real.log (N:ℝ) := by
  have hd : (maxLeftDegree G:ℝ) ≤ 4*(graphBase G).referenceCap := by
    exact_mod_cast maxLeftDegree_le G _ hD
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hd (show 0 ≤ (T:ℝ)/G.card by positivity)
  have hc := expected_reference_cap_bound (graphBase G) T
  rw [Fintype.card_coe] at hc
  apply (allLeft_expectedCost G T N hvertices).trans
  nlinarith

end GraphChoices.Peeling

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.isLeft.source: def isLeft : L ⊕ R → Bool := Sum.elim (fun _ => true) (fun _ => false)

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.mem_listLef.source:
theorem mem_listLeftNeighbors (es : List (Arrival L R C)) (u : L) (v : R) :
    v ∈ listLeftNeighbors es u ↔ ∃ e ∈ es, e.left = u ∧ e.right = v := by
  simp only [listLeftNeighbors, List.mem_toFinset, List.mem_map, List.mem_filter,
    decide_eq_true_eq]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨e, ⟨he, hl⟩, hr⟩
    exact ⟨e, he, hl, hr⟩
  · rintro ⟨e, he, hl, hr⟩
    exact ⟨e, ⟨he, hl⟩, hr⟩

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.replay_adj_.source:
theorem replay_adj_iff (es : List (Arrival L R C)) (x y : L ⊕ R) :
    (arrivalGraph (replayInstance es)).Adj x y ↔
      x ≠ y ∧ ∃ e ∈ es,
        (Sum.inl e.left = x ∧ Sum.inr e.right = y) ∨
        (Sum.inl e.left = y ∧ Sum.inr e.right = x) := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hne, t, ht⟩
    exact ⟨hne, es.get t, List.get_mem _ _, ht⟩
  · rintro ⟨hne, e, he, hxy⟩
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := List.mem_iff_get.mp he
    refine ⟨hne, t, ?_⟩
    simpa only [replayInstance, ht] using hxy

theorem replay_adj_sides (es : List (Arrival L R C)) (x y : L ⊕ R)
    (hxy : (arrivalGraph (replayInstance es)).Adj x y) : isLeft x ≠ isLeft y := by
  obtain ⟨_, e, _, h | h⟩ := (replay_adj_iff es x y).mp hxy
  · rcases h with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    simp [isLeft]
  · rcases h with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    simp [isLeft]

theorem replay_adj_inl_inr (es : List (Arrival L R C)) (u : L) (v : R) :
    (arrivalGraph (replayInstance es)).Adj (Sum.inl u) (Sum.inr v) ↔
      v ∈ listLeftNeighbors es u := by
  rw [replay_adj_iff, mem_listLeftNeighbors]
  simp

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.replay_left.source:
theorem replay_left_degree (es : List (Arrival L R C)) (u : L) :
    let G := arrivalGraph (replayInstance es)
    letI : DecidableRel G.Adj := Classical.decRel _
    G.degree (Sum.inl u) = (listLeftNeighbors es u).card := by
  classical
  dsimp only
  have heq : (arrivalGraph (replayInstance es)).neighborFinset (Sum.inl u) =
      (listLeftNeighbors es u).image Sum.inr := by
    ext w
    cases w with
    | inl a =>
      simp only [SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset, mem_image, Sum.inr_ne_inl, and_false, exists_false]
      constructor
      · intro h
        exact (replay_adj_sides es _ _ h) rfl
      · exact False.elim
    | inr v => simp [replay_adj_inl_inr]
  rw [← SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree, heq, card_image_of_injective _ Sum.inr_injective]

end GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy

GraphChoices.LowerBound.branching_log.source:
theorem branching_log (b : ℕ) : Real.log (branching b:ℝ) = 3*Real.log (16*(b:ℝ)) := by
  simp only [branching, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_mul, Real.log_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat]

GraphChoices.LowerBound.family_elementar.source:
theorem family_elementary_logs (b : ℕ) (hb : 16 ≤ b) :
    1 ≤ Real.log ((b:ℝ)+1) ∧ 15 ≤ Real.log (branching b:ℝ) ∧
      Real.log (branching b:ℝ) ≤ 12*Real.log ((b:ℝ)+1) := by
  have hbr : (16:ℝ) ≤ b := by exact_mod_cast hb
  have hlog2 := Real.log_two_gt_d9
  have hlog2' := Real.log_two_lt_d9
  have h16 : Real.log (16:ℝ) = 4*Real.log 2 := by convert Real.log_pow (2:ℝ) 4 using 1 <;> norm_num
  have h256 : Real.log (256:ℝ) = 8*Real.log 2 := by convert Real.log_pow (2:ℝ) 8 using 1 <;> norm_num
  have hbp := Real.log_le_log (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<16) (show (16:ℝ) ≤ (b:ℝ)+1 by linarith)
  rw [h16] at hbp
  have h15 := Real.log_le_log (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<256) (show (256:ℝ) ≤ 16*(b:ℝ) by linarith)
  rw [h256] at h15
  have hblog := Real.log_le_log (show (0:ℝ)<b by linarith) (show (b:ℝ) ≤ (b:ℝ)+1 by linarith)
  have ht := branching_log b
  rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num) (by positivity),h16] at ht
  refine ⟨by linarith,?_,?_⟩
  · rw [branching_log]; linarith
  · linarith

GraphChoices.LowerBound.family_log_bound.source:
theorem family_log_bounds (b : ℕ) (hb : 16 ≤ b) :
    (b:ℝ)+1 ≤ Real.log (size b:ℝ) ∧
      Real.log (size b:ℝ) ≤ 26*(b:ℝ)*Real.log ((b:ℝ)+1) := by
  have hp := family_parameter_bounds b hb
  obtain ⟨hlogbp,hlogt,hlogt_up⟩ := family_elementary_logs b hb
  have hbr : (16:ℝ) ≤ b := by exact_mod_cast hb
  have htp : 0 < branching b := by have := hp.1; omega
  have hN : 0 < size b := by have := hp.2.2.2.2.1; omega
  have hpowm : (branching b)^b ≤ width b := by unfold width; omega
  have hmN : width b ≤ size b := by
    unfold size
    have hs : 1 ≤ layerSum (branching b) (b+1) := layerSum_pos _ _ (by omega)
    nlinarith
  have hlogpow := Real.log_le_log (show (0:ℝ) < (branching b:ℝ)^b by positivity)
    (show (branching b:ℝ)^b ≤ size b by exact_mod_cast hpowm.trans hmN)
  rw [Real.log_pow] at hlogpow
  constructor
  · nlinarith
  · have hupper : size b ≤ 2*(b+1)*(branching b)^(2*b) := by
      unfold size
      have hs := layerSum_upper (branching b) b (by have := hp.1; omega)
      have hh := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (width b) hs
      unfold width at hh
      convert hh using 1 <;> rw [show 2*b = b+b by omega,pow_add] <;> ring
    have hu := Real.log_le_log (show (0:ℝ) < size b by exact_mod_cast hN)
      (show (size b:ℝ) ≤ 2*((b:ℝ)+1)*(branching b:ℝ)^(2*b) by exact_mod_cast hupper)
    rw [Real.log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity),Real.log_mul (by norm_num) (by positivity),Real.log_pow] at hu
    push_cast at hu
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlogt_up (show 0 ≤ 2*(b:ℝ) by positivity)
    have hlog2 : Real.log 2 ≤ 1 := by linarith [Real.log_two_lt_d9]
    nlinarith

GraphChoices.LowerBound.family_log_large.source:
theorem family_log_large (b : ℕ) (hb : 16 ≤ b) : 30*(b:ℝ) ≤ Real.log (size b:ℝ) := by
  have hp := family_parameter_bounds b hb
  have htp : 0 < branching b := by have := hp.1; omega
  have hS : (branching b)^b ≤ layerSum (branching b) (b+1) := by rw [layerSum_succ]; omega
  have hN : 2*(branching b)^(2*b) ≤ size b := by
    unfold size width
    rw [show 2*b = b+b by omega,pow_add]
    have hh := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (2*(branching b)^b) hS
    nlinarith
  have hh := Real.log_le_log (show (0:ℝ) < 2*(branching b:ℝ)^(2*b) by positivity)
    (show 2*(branching b:ℝ)^(2*b) ≤ size b by exact_mod_cast hN)
  rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num) (by positivity),Real.log_pow] at hh
  push_cast at hh
  have ht := (family_elementary_logs b hb).2.1
  have hlog2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num : (1:ℝ)<2)
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ht (show 0 ≤ 2*(b:ℝ) by positivity)
  nlinarith

GraphChoices.LowerBound.branching_large.source:
theorem branching_large (b : ℕ) (hb : 16 ≤ b) : 1024*b^3 ≤ branching b := by
  unfold branching
  rw [show (16*b)^3 = 4096*b^3 by ring]
  omega

GraphChoices.LowerBound.family_propagati.source:
theorem family_propagation_error (b : ℕ) (hb : 16 ≤ b) :
    (b:ℝ)*(Fintype.card (Blocks b (branching b)):ℝ)*width b*
      Real.exp ((b:ℝ)*Real.log 2-(batchLength b:ℝ)*(branching b*width b)/
        (4*(Fintype.card (Edges b (branching b) (width b)):ℝ))) ≤ 1/(size b:ℝ)^2 := by
  have hp := family_parameter_bounds b hb
  letI := family_edges_nonempty b hb
  have hbr : (16:ℝ) ≤ b := by exact_mod_cast hb
  have hm : (0:ℝ) < width b := by have hh := hp.2.1; exact_mod_cast (show 0 < width b by omega)
  have hN : (0:ℝ) < size b := by have hh := hp.2.2.2.2.1; exact_mod_cast (show 0 < size b by omega)
  have hE : (0:ℝ) < Fintype.card (Edges b (branching b) (width b)) := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
  have hQ : (0:ℝ) < Fintype.card (Blocks b (branching b)) := by rw [card_blocks]; exact_mod_cast layerSum_pos (branching b) b (by omega)
  let M : ℝ := Fintype.card (Edges b (branching b) (width b))
  let μ : ℝ := (batchLength b:ℝ)*(branching b*width b)/(4*M)
  let C : ℝ := (b:ℝ)*(Fintype.card (Blocks b (branching b)):ℝ)*width b
  have hC : 0 < C := by dsimp [C]; positivity
  have hμ : 256*(b:ℝ)^2 ≤ μ := by
    have hr := (family_rate_bounds b hb).1
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hr (Nat.cast_nonneg (branching b): (0:ℝ) ≤ branching b)
    have hsize : (size b:ℝ) = (b:ℝ)*batchLength b := by exact_mod_cast size_eq_batches b (by omega)
    have hlow : (branching b:ℝ)/(4*(b:ℝ)) ≤ μ := by
      apply (div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < 4*(b:ℝ)) (by dsimp [M]; positivity : (0:ℝ)<4*M)).mpr
      dsimp [μ]
      rw [hsize] at hmul
      push_cast
      nlinarith
    have ht : 1024*(b:ℝ)^3 ≤ branching b := by exact_mod_cast branching_large b hb
    apply le_trans _ hlow
    apply (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : (0:ℝ)<4*(b:ℝ))).mpr
    nlinarith
  have hCbound : C ≤ (b:ℝ)*size b := by
    have hQle : layerSum (branching b) b ≤ layerSum (branching b) (b+1) := by rw [layerSum_succ]; omega
    have hmul := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (b*width b) hQle
    dsimp only [C]
    rw [card_blocks,size_eq_vertices,card_vertices]
    exact_mod_cast (by nlinarith : b*layerSum (branching b) b*width b ≤ b*(width b*layerSum (branching b) (b+1)))
  have hlogC := Real.log_le_log hC hCbound
  rw [Real.log_mul (by positivity) hN.ne'] at hlogC
  have hlogN := (family_log_bounds b hb).2
  have hlogbp := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (show (0:ℝ)<(b:ℝ)+1 by positivity)
  have hlogb := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (show (0:ℝ)<b by positivity)
  have hlog2 : Real.log 2 ≤ 1 := by linarith [Real.log_two_lt_d9]
  have hlogN' : Real.log (size b:ℝ) ≤ 26*(b:ℝ)^2 := by
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlogbp (show 0 ≤ 26*(b:ℝ) by positivity)
    nlinarith
  have hexp : Real.log C+((b:ℝ)*Real.log 2-μ) ≤ -(2*Real.log (size b:ℝ)) := by
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog2 (Nat.cast_nonneg b : (0:ℝ) ≤ b)
    nlinarith
  change C*Real.exp ((b:ℝ)*Real.log 2-μ) ≤ _
  calc
    _ = Real.exp (Real.log C+((b:ℝ)*Real.log 2-μ)) := by rw [Real.exp_add,Real.exp_log hC]
    _ ≤ Real.exp (-(2*Real.log (size b:ℝ))) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hexp
    _ = _ := by rw [Real.exp_neg,show (2:ℝ)*Real.log (size b:ℝ) = (2:ℕ)*Real.log (size b:ℝ) by norm_num,
      Real.exp_nat_mul,Real.exp_log hN]; simp

end GraphChoices.LowerBound

GraphChoices.LowerBound.batchLength.source: def batchLength (b : ℕ) : ℕ := (width b/b)*layerSum (branching b) (b+1)

GraphChoices.LowerBound.size.source: def size (b : ℕ) : ℕ := width b*layerSum (branching b) (b+1)

GraphChoices.LowerBound.size_eq_vertices.source:
theorem size_eq_vertices (b : ℕ) : size b = Fintype.card (Vertices b (branching b) (width b)) := by
  rw [card_vertices]
  rfl

GraphChoices.LowerBound.size_eq_batches.source:
theorem size_eq_batches (b : ℕ) (hb : 0 < b) : size b = b*batchLength b := by
  have ht : b ∣ branching b := dvd_pow (Nat.dvd_mul_left b 16) (by decide : 3 ≠ 0)
  have hm : b ∣ width b := dvd_mul_of_dvd_right (dvd_pow ht (by omega : b ≠ 0)) 2
  unfold size batchLength
  rw [← mul_assoc,Nat.mul_div_cancel' hm]

GraphChoices.LowerBound.layerSum_geometr.source:
theorem layerSum_geometric_upper (t b : ℕ) (ht : 2 ≤ t) : layerSum t (b+1) ≤ 2*t^b := by
  induction b with
  | zero => simp [layerSum]
  | succ b ih =>
    rw [layerSum_succ]
    have hp : t^(b+1) = t^b*t := pow_succ _ _
    nlinarith

GraphChoices.LowerBound.layerSum_le_widt.source:
theorem layerSum_le_width (b t : ℕ) (ht : 1 ≤ t) : layerSum t b ≤ b*t^b := by
  apply le_trans (sum_le_card_nsmul _ _ (t^b) ?_) (by simp)
  intro i hi
  exact Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by have := mem_range.mp hi; omega)

GraphChoices.LowerBound.densityThreshold.source:
theorem densityThreshold_scale (t : ℕ) (ht : 4 ≤ t) :
    16 ≤ densityThreshold t ∧
      Real.exp 1*(t:ℝ)*(2*Real.exp 1/(densityThreshold t:ℝ))^(densityThreshold t) ≤ 1/256 := by
  let k := densityThreshold t
  have hk : 16 ≤ k := by dsimp [k,densityThreshold]; omega
  have hkr : (16:ℝ) ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast hk
  have htp : (0:ℝ) < t := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < t by omega)
  have hl : 2*Real.log 2 ≤ Real.log (t:ℝ) := by
    have hh := Real.log_le_log (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<4) (show (4:ℝ) ≤ t by exact_mod_cast ht)
    have he : Real.log (4:ℝ) = 2*Real.log 2 := by convert Real.log_pow (2:ℝ) 2 using 1 <;> norm_num
    rwa [he] at hh
  have hlog : 0 ≤ Real.log (t:ℝ) := Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ t by omega))
  have hkl : 16*Real.log (t:ℝ) ≤ (k:ℝ) := by
    have hh := Nat.le_ceil (16*Real.log (t:ℝ))
    dsimp only [k,densityThreshold]
    push_cast
    linarith
  have hbase : 2*Real.exp 1/(k:ℝ) ≤ 1/2 := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ (by linarith : (0:ℝ)<k)).mpr
    linarith [Real.exp_one_lt_d9]
  have hpow : (2*Real.exp 1/(k:ℝ))^k ≤ (1/2:ℝ)^k := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hbase k
  have heq : Real.exp 1*(t:ℝ)*(1/2:ℝ)^k =
      Real.exp (1+Real.log (t:ℝ)-(k:ℝ)*Real.log 2) := by
    rw [Real.exp_sub, Real.exp_add, Real.exp_nat_mul, Real.exp_log htp, Real.exp_log (by norm_num)]
    rw [div_pow]
    ring
  have hsmall : 1+Real.log (t:ℝ)-(k:ℝ)*Real.log 2 ≤ -(8*Real.log 2) := by
    have hh : (1:ℝ)/2 ≤ Real.log 2 := by linarith [Real.log_two_gt_d9]
    have hp := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hkl (by linarith : 0 ≤ Real.log 2)
    nlinarith
  refine ⟨hk,?_⟩
  calc
    _ ≤ Real.exp 1*(t:ℝ)*(1/2:ℝ)^k := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpow (by positivity)
    _ ≤ Real.exp (-(8*Real.log 2)) := by rw [heq]; exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hsmall
    _ = _ := by rw [Real.exp_neg, show (8:ℝ)*Real.log 2 = (8:ℕ)*Real.log 2 by norm_num,
      Real.exp_nat_mul, Real.exp_log (by norm_num)]; norm_num

theorem densityThreshold_upper (t : ℕ) (ht : 1 ≤ t) :
    (densityThreshold t:ℝ) ≤ 16*Real.log (t:ℝ)+17 := by
  have hh := Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (mul_nonneg (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 16)
    (Real.log_nonneg (show (1:ℝ) ≤ t by exact_mod_cast ht)))
  unfold densityThreshold
  push_cast
  linarith

GraphChoices.LowerBound.family_parameter.source:
theorem family_parameter_bounds (b : ℕ) (hb : 16 ≤ b) :
    4 ≤ branching b ∧ 2 ≤ width b ∧ branching b ≤ width b ∧
      layerSum (branching b) b ≤ width b ∧ b ≤ size b ∧ size b ≤ (width b)^2 := by
  let t := branching b
  have ht : 4 ≤ t := by
    change 4 ≤ (16*b)^3
    exact (show 4 ≤ 16*b by omega).trans (Nat.le_pow (by decide : 0 < 3))
  have hbt : b ≤ t := by
    change b ≤ (16*b)^3
    exact (show b ≤ 16*b by omega).trans (Nat.le_pow (by decide : 0 < 3))
  have hpow : 1 ≤ t^b := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by omega)
  have hpowt : t ≤ t^b := Nat.le_pow (by omega)
  have hm : b ≤ width b := by change b ≤ 2*t^b; omega
  have htm : t ≤ width b := by change t ≤ 2*t^b; omega
  have hQ : layerSum t b ≤ width b := by
    have hh := layerSum_geometric_upper t b (by omega)
    have hh' : layerSum t b ≤ layerSum t (b+1) := by rw [layerSum_succ]; omega
    exact hh'.trans hh
  have hS := layerSum_geometric_upper t b (by omega)
  have hSpos : 1 ≤ layerSum t (b+1) := layerSum_pos t (b+1) (by omega)
  have hN : b ≤ size b := by unfold size; change b ≤ width b*layerSum t (b+1); nlinarith
  have hNupper : size b ≤ (width b)^2 := by
    have hmdef : width b = 2*t^b := rfl
    unfold size
    change width b*layerSum t (b+1) ≤ (width b)^2
    nlinarith
  exact ⟨ht,by change 2 ≤ 2*t^b; omega,htm,hQ,hN,hNupper⟩

GraphChoices.LowerBound.family_edges_non.source:
theorem family_edges_nonempty (b : ℕ) (hb : 16 ≤ b) : Nonempty (Edges b (branching b) (width b)) := by
  have hp := family_parameter_bounds b hb
  apply Fintype.card_pos_iff.mp
  rw [card_edges]
  have hh := layerSum_pos (branching b) b (by omega)
  have ht := hp.1
  have hm := hp.2.1
  positivity

GraphChoices.LowerBound.family_rate_boun.source:
theorem family_rate_bounds (b : ℕ) (hb : 16 ≤ b) :
    (Fintype.card (Edges b (branching b) (width b)):ℝ) ≤ (size b:ℝ)*width b ∧
      (size b:ℝ)*width b ≤ 2*(Fintype.card (Edges b (branching b) (width b)):ℝ) := by
  have hp := family_parameter_bounds b hb
  have hQ : 0 < layerSum (branching b) b := layerSum_pos _ _ (by omega)
  rw [size_eq_vertices,card_vertices,card_edges]
  have hshift := layerSum_shift (branching b) b
  rw [hshift]
  have hprod : 1 ≤ branching b*layerSum (branching b) b := by nlinarith [hp.1]
  have hh := Nat.mul_le_mul_left ((width b)^2) hprod
  constructor
  · exact_mod_cast (by nlinarith : (width b)^2*branching b*layerSum (branching b) b ≤
      width b*(1+branching b*layerSum (branching b) b)*width b)
  · exact_mod_cast (by nlinarith : width b*(1+branching b*layerSum (branching b) b)*width b ≤
      2*((width b)^2*branching b*layerSum (branching b) b))

end GraphChoices.LowerBound

GraphChoices.LowerBound.baseDegree.source:
def baseDegree {V E : Type*} [Fintype E] [DecidableEq V] (G : BaseGraph V E) (v : V) : ℕ :=
  (univ.filter fun e => G.left e = v ∨ G.right e = v).card

GraphChoices.LowerBound.block_degree_upp.source:
theorem block_degree_upper {V C : Type*} [Fintype C] [DecidableEq C] [DecidableEq V] {m r : ℕ}
    (left : C × Fin m → V) (right : C × Fin r → V)
    (hl : Function.Injective left) (hr : Function.Injective right) (v : V) :
    baseDegree (blockBase left right) v ≤ m+r := by
  have hL : (univ.filter fun e : C × (Fin m × Fin r) => left (e.1,e.2.1) = v).card ≤ r := by
    let A := univ.filter fun e : C × (Fin m × Fin r) => left (e.1,e.2.1) = v
    let f : A → Fin r := fun e => e.val.2.2
    have hf : Function.Injective f := by
      intro e f h
      have hh := hl (((mem_filter.mp e.property).2).trans ((mem_filter.mp f.property).2).symm)
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact Prod.ext (congrArg (fun p : C × Fin m => p.1) hh)
        (Prod.ext (congrArg (fun p : C × Fin m => p.2) hh) h)
    simpa only [Fintype.card_coe,Fintype.card_fin] using Fintype.card_le_of_injective f hf
  have hR : (univ.filter fun e : C × (Fin m × Fin r) => right (e.1,e.2.2) = v).card ≤ m := by
    let A := univ.filter fun e : C × (Fin m × Fin r) => right (e.1,e.2.2) = v
    let f : A → Fin m := fun e => e.val.2.1
    have hf : Function.Injective f := by
      intro e f h
      have hh := hr (((mem_filter.mp e.property).2).trans ((mem_filter.mp f.property).2).symm)
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact Prod.ext (congrArg (fun p : C × Fin r => p.1) hh)
        (Prod.ext h (congrArg (fun p : C × Fin r => p.2) hh))
    simpa only [Fintype.card_coe,Fintype.card_fin] using Fintype.card_le_of_injective f hf
  have heq : (univ.filter fun e : C × (Fin m × Fin r) => left (e.1,e.2.1) = v ∨ right (e.1,e.2.2) = v) =
      (univ.filter fun e => left (e.1,e.2.1) = v) ∪ (univ.filter fun e => right (e.1,e.2.2) = v) := by ext e; simp
  unfold baseDegree
  change (univ.filter fun e : C × (Fin m × Fin r) => left (e.1,e.2.1) = v ∨ right (e.1,e.2.2) = v).card ≤ m+r
  rw [heq]
  exact (card_union_le _ _).trans (by omega)

GraphChoices.LowerBound.rightVertex_cove.source:
theorem rightVertex_covers_positive (b t m : ℕ) (v : Vertices b t m) (hv : v.1 ≠ 0) :
    ∃ p : Blocks b t × Fin (t*m), rightVertex p = v := by
  rcases v with ⟨i,g,a⟩
  obtain ⟨j,rfl⟩ := Fin.eq_succ_of_ne_zero hv
  let p := finProdFinEquiv.symm (Fin.cast (pow_succ t j.val) g)
  refine ⟨(⟨j,p.1⟩,finProdFinEquiv (p.2,a)),?_⟩
  apply Sigma.mk.inj_iff.mpr
  refine ⟨rfl,heq_of_eq ?_⟩
  simp only [rightVertex,childGroup,Equiv.symm_apply_apply,Prod.fst,Prod.snd]
  apply Prod.ext
  · change Fin.cast (pow_succ t j.val).symm (finProdFinEquiv p) = g
    change Fin.cast (pow_succ t j.val).symm
      (finProdFinEquiv (finProdFinEquiv.symm (Fin.cast (pow_succ t j.val) g))) = g
    rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    exact Fin.ext rfl
  · rfl

GraphChoices.LowerBound.vertex_block_cov.source:
theorem vertex_block_cover (b t m : ℕ) (hb : 0 < b) (v : Vertices b t m) :
    (∃ p : Blocks b t × Fin m, leftVertex p = v) ∨
      ∃ p : Blocks b t × Fin (t*m), rightVertex p = v := by
  by_cases hv : v.1.val < b
  · left
    exact ⟨(⟨⟨v.1.val,hv⟩,v.2.1⟩,v.2.2),rfl⟩
  · right
    apply rightVertex_covers_positive
    intro hz
    have hval := congrArg Fin.val hz
    simp only [Fin.val_zero] at hval
    omega

GraphChoices.LowerBound.graph_degree_low.source:
theorem graph_degree_lower (b t m : ℕ) (hb : 0 < b) (ht : 1 ≤ t) (v : Vertices b t m) :
    m ≤ baseDegree (graph b t m) v := by
  rcases vertex_block_cover b t m hb v with ⟨⟨c,a⟩,hv⟩ | ⟨⟨c,r⟩,hv⟩
  · have hh : t*m ≤ baseDegree (graph b t m) v := by
      let f : Fin (t*m) → {e : Edges b t m // (graph b t m).left e = v ∨ (graph b t m).right e = v} :=
        fun r => ⟨(c,a,r),Or.inl hv⟩
      have hf : Function.Injective f := by intro r s h; exact congrArg (fun e => e.val.2.2) h
      simpa only [Fintype.card_fin,Fintype.card_subtype,baseDegree] using Fintype.card_le_of_injective f hf
    exact (by nlinarith : m ≤ t*m).trans hh
  · let f : Fin m → {e : Edges b t m // (graph b t m).left e = v ∨ (graph b t m).right e = v} :=
      fun a => ⟨(c,a,r),Or.inr hv⟩
    have hf : Function.Injective f := by intro a a' h; exact congrArg (fun e => e.val.2.1) h
    simpa only [Fintype.card_fin,Fintype.card_subtype,baseDegree] using Fintype.card_le_of_injective f hf

/-- The literal degree interval in Theorem 1.2, with the actual vertex
count N rather than an auxiliary asymptotic size parameter. -/

GraphChoices.LowerBound.family_degree_ra.source:
theorem family_degree_range (b : ℕ) (hb : 16 ≤ b) (v : Vertices b (branching b) (width b)) :
    Real.sqrt (size b:ℝ) ≤ (baseDegree (graph b (branching b) (width b)) v:ℝ) ∧
      (baseDegree (graph b (branching b) (width b)) v:ℝ) ≤
        Real.sqrt (size b:ℝ)*(Real.log (size b:ℝ))^3 := by
  have hp := family_parameter_bounds b hb
  have hm : (0:ℝ) ≤ width b := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  have hN : (0:ℝ) ≤ size b := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  have hmin := graph_degree_lower b (branching b) (width b) (by omega) (by have := hp.1; omega) v
  have hmax := block_degree_upper (@leftVertex b (branching b) (width b)) (@rightVertex b (branching b) (width b))
    (leftVertex_injective _ _ _) (rightVertex_injective _ _ _) v
  have hminr : (width b:ℝ) ≤ baseDegree (graph b (branching b) (width b)) v := by exact_mod_cast hmin
  have hmaxr : (baseDegree (graph b (branching b) (width b)) v:ℝ) ≤ (width b:ℝ)*(branching b+1) := by
    have hh : baseDegree (graph b (branching b) (width b)) v ≤ width b+branching b*width b := hmax
    exact_mod_cast (by nlinarith : baseDegree (graph b (branching b) (width b)) v ≤ width b*(branching b+1))
  have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (size b:ℝ) ≤ width b := Real.sqrt_le_iff.mpr ⟨hm,by exact_mod_cast hp.2.2.2.2.2⟩
  have hS : (branching b)^b ≤ layerSum (branching b) (b+1) := by rw [layerSum_succ]; omega
  have hm2N : (width b:ℝ)^2 ≤ 2*(size b:ℝ) := by
    have hh := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (4*(branching b)^b) hS
    unfold width size at *
    exact_mod_cast (by nlinarith : (2*(branching b)^b)^2 ≤ 2*(2*(branching b)^b*layerSum (branching b) (b+1)))
  have hs0 := Real.sqrt_nonneg (size b:ℝ)
  have hs2 := Real.sq_sqrt hN
  have hmupper : (width b:ℝ) ≤ 2*Real.sqrt (size b:ℝ) := by nlinarith
  have hlog := family_log_large b hb
  have hpow := pow_le_pow_left₀ (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 30*(b:ℝ) by positivity) hlog 3
  have htdef : (branching b:ℝ) = 4096*(b:ℝ)^3 := by unfold branching; push_cast; ring
  have hb16 : (16:ℝ) ≤ b := by exact_mod_cast hb
  have hb3 : (1:ℝ) ≤ (b:ℝ)^3 := one_le_pow₀ (by linarith : (1:ℝ) ≤ b)
  have htlog : 2*((branching b:ℝ)+1) ≤ (Real.log (size b:ℝ))^3 := by rw [htdef]; nlinarith
  refine ⟨hsqrt.trans hminr,?_⟩
  have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hmupper (show 0 ≤ (branching b:ℝ)+1 by positivity)
  have hh' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htlog hs0
  push_cast at hmaxr
  nlinarith

end GraphChoices.LowerBound

GraphChoices.LowerBound.expectedOpt_comp.source:
theorem expectedOpt_complete_blocks (m t T k : ℕ) (left : C × Fin m → V) (right : C × Fin (t*m) → V)
    (hl : Function.Injective left) (hr : Function.Injective right)
    (hm : 0 < m) (ht : 1 ≤ t) (hk : 16 ≤ k)
    (hrate : (T:ℝ)*(m:ℝ) ≤ 2*(Fintype.card (C × (Fin m × Fin (t*m))):ℝ))
    (hscale : Real.exp 1*(t:ℝ)*(2*Real.exp 1/(k:ℝ))^k ≤ 1/256) :
    letI : Nonempty (Fin m) := ⟨⟨0,hm⟩⟩
    letI : Nonempty (Fin (t*m)) := ⟨⟨0,by positivity⟩⟩
    expectedOpt (blockBase left right) T ≤
      2*(k:ℝ)+(T:ℝ)*((Fintype.card C:ℝ)*m*(t*m)/(m:ℝ)^8) := by
  letI : Nonempty (Fin m) := ⟨⟨0,hm⟩⟩
  letI : Nonempty (Fin (t*m)) := ⟨⟨0,by positivity⟩⟩
  have hh := average_le_good_add_bad
    (fun ω : Fin T → C × (Fin m × Fin (t*m)) => (opt ((blockBase left right).sample ω):ℝ))
    (fun _ => 2*(k:ℝ)) (badBlockDensity m (t*m) T k) (T:ℝ)
    (fun ω hω => by
      change (opt ((blockBase left right).sample ω):ℝ) ≤ 2*(k:ℝ)
      exact_mod_cast opt_le_of_block_density left right hl hr ω k (not_badBlockDensity _ _ _ _ ω hω))
    (fun ω _ => by
      change (opt ((blockBase left right).sample ω):ℝ) ≤ 2*(k:ℝ)+(T:ℝ)
      have hp := opt_le_length ((blockBase left right).sample ω)
      exact_mod_cast (show opt ((blockBase left right).sample ω) ≤ 2*k+T by omega))
  rw [average_const] at hh
  apply hh.trans
  have hb := badBlockDensity_probability (C := C) m t T k hm ht hk hrate hscale
  nlinarith

GraphChoices.LowerBound.family_offline_b.source:
theorem family_offline_bound (b : ℕ) (hb : 16 ≤ b) :
    letI := family_edges_nonempty b hb
    expectedOpt (graph b (branching b) (width b)) (size b) ≤
      2*(densityThreshold (branching b):ℝ)+1 := by
  letI := family_edges_nonempty b hb
  have hp := family_parameter_bounds b hb
  letI : Nonempty (Blocks b (branching b)) := ⟨⟨⟨0,by omega⟩,⟨0,by simp⟩⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨hk,hscale⟩ := densityThreshold_scale (branching b) hp.1
  have hh := expectedOpt_complete_blocks (width b) (branching b) (size b) (densityThreshold (branching b))
    (@leftVertex b (branching b) (width b)) (@rightVertex b (branching b) (width b))
    (leftVertex_injective _ _ _) (rightVertex_injective _ _ _) (by omega) (by omega)
    hk (family_rate_bounds b hb).2 hscale
  change expectedOpt (graph b (branching b) (width b)) (size b) ≤ _ at hh
  have hmr : (2:ℝ) ≤ width b := by exact_mod_cast hp.2.1
  have hQ : (Fintype.card (Blocks b (branching b)):ℝ) ≤ width b := by
    rw [card_blocks]
    exact_mod_cast hp.2.2.2.1
  have ht : (branching b:ℝ) ≤ width b := by exact_mod_cast hp.2.2.1
  have hN : (size b:ℝ) ≤ 2*(width b:ℝ)^2 := by
    have hh : (size b:ℝ) ≤ (width b:ℝ)^2 := by exact_mod_cast hp.2.2.2.2.2
    nlinarith
  have hnum : (Fintype.card (Blocks b (branching b)):ℝ)*width b*(branching b*width b) ≤ (width b:ℝ)^4 := by
    push_cast
    have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hQ (show 0 ≤ (width b:ℝ)*(branching b:ℝ)*width b by positivity)
    have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ht (show 0 ≤ (width b:ℝ)^3 by positivity)
    nlinarith
  have herr : (size b:ℝ)*((Fintype.card (Blocks b (branching b)):ℝ)*width b*(branching b*width b)/(width b:ℝ)^8) ≤ 1 := by
    calc
      _ ≤ (size b:ℝ)*((width b:ℝ)^4/(width b:ℝ)^8) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hnum (by positivity)) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
      _ ≤ (2*(width b:ℝ)^2)*((width b:ℝ)^4/(width b:ℝ)^8) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hN (by positivity)
      _ = 2/(width b:ℝ)^2 := by field_simp
      _ ≤ 1 := (div_le_one (by positivity)).mpr (by nlinarith)
  exact hh.trans (by linarith)

end GraphChoices.LowerBound

GraphChoices.exists_competitive_policy.source:
theorem exists_competitive_policy (G : BaseGraph V E) (hsimple : G.IsSimple) (T : ℕ) :
    ∃ p : OnlinePolicy E, expectedCost G (onlineOrientation (T := T) p) ≤
      120000*loglogFactor (Fintype.card V)*expectedOpt G T := by
  classical
  let x : E := Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty E)
  have hV : 2 ≤ Fintype.card V := by
    have hh := card_le_univ ({G.left x, G.right x}:Finset V)
    simpa [hsimple.1 x] using hh
  obtain ⟨b,hD⟩ := exists_preprocessed_split G hsimple
  let H := splitGraph G b
  let e := splitEdgeEquiv G hsimple b
  letI : Nonempty H := ⟨e x⟩
  have hvertices : Fintype.card (V ⊕ V) ≤ 2*Fintype.card V := by simp only [Fintype.card_sum]; omega
  obtain ⟨p,hp⟩ := Peeling.exists_bipartite_policy_all_horizons H (2*Fintype.card V) T hvertices hD
  let q := pullbackPolicy e p
  have hq : expectedCost (G.split b) (onlineOrientation (T := T) q) ≤
      (30000*loglogFactor (2*Fintype.card V))*expectedOpt (G.split b) T := by
    rw [relabel_expectedCost (G.split b) (Peeling.graphBase H) e
      (splitEdgeEquiv_left G hsimple b) (splitEdgeEquiv_right G hsimple b) T p,
      relabel_expectedOpt (G.split b) (Peeling.graphBase H) e
        (splitEdgeEquiv_left G hsimple b) (splitEdgeEquiv_right G hsimple b) T]
    exact hp
  have hfactor := loglogFactor_ge_one (2*Fintype.card V)
  have hc : 0 ≤ 30000*loglogFactor (2*Fintype.card V) := by positivity
  refine ⟨collapsePolicy b q, (online_expected_transfer G b q _ hc hq).trans ?_⟩
  have hlog := loglogFactor_square_bound (Fintype.card V) (2*Fintype.card V) hV (by nlinarith)
  have ho := expectedOpt_nonneg G T
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hlog (show 0 ≤ 60000*expectedOpt G T by positivity)
  nlinarith

/-- The exact proposition stated in Targets.lean, now proved. -/

GraphChoices.mainTheorem.source:
theorem mainTheorem : MainTheorem := by
  refine ⟨120000, by norm_num, ?_⟩
  intro n m G hsimple T
  simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using exists_competitive_policy G hsimple T

end GraphChoices

GraphChoices.Instance.source:
structure Instance (V : Type*) (T : ℕ) where
  left : Fin T → V
  right : Fin T → V

GraphChoices.Instance.ext.source:
theorem Instance.ext {V : Type*} {T : ℕ} {I J : Instance V T}
    (hl : I.left = J.left) (hr : I.right = J.right) : I = J := by
  cases I
  cases J
  cases hl
  cases hr
  rfl

variable {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {T : ℕ}

GraphChoices.Orientation.source: abbrev Orientation (T : ℕ) := Fin T → Bool

GraphChoices.destination.source:
def destination (I : Instance V T) (a : Orientation T) (t : Fin T) : V :=
  if a t then I.left t else I.right t

GraphChoices.load.source:
def load (I : Instance V T) (a : Orientation T) (v : V) : ℕ :=
  (univ.filter fun t => destination I a t = v).card

GraphChoices.maxLoad.source:
def maxLoad (I : Instance V T) (a : Orientation T) : ℕ :=
  univ.sup (load I a)

GraphChoices.internalCount.source:
def internalCount (I : Instance V T) (S : Finset V) : ℕ :=
  (univ.filter fun t => I.left t ∈ S ∧ I.right t ∈ S).card

GraphChoices.destination_endpoint.source:
theorem destination_endpoint (I : Instance V T) (a : Orientation T) (t : Fin T) :
    destination I a t = I.left t ∨ destination I a t = I.right t := by
  simp only [destination]; split <;> simp_all

GraphChoices.load_le_maxLoad.source:
theorem load_le_maxLoad (I : Instance V T) (a : Orientation T) (v : V) :
    load I a v ≤ maxLoad I a := by
  exact le_sup (f := load I a) (mem_univ v)

GraphChoices.maxLoad_le_iff.source:
theorem maxLoad_le_iff (I : Instance V T) (a : Orientation T) (c : ℕ) :
    maxLoad I a ≤ c ↔ ∀ v, load I a v ≤ c := by
  simp [maxLoad]

omit [Fintype V] in

GraphChoices.load_le_length.source:
theorem load_le_length (I : Instance V T) (a : Orientation T) (v : V) :
    load I a v ≤ T := by
  simpa [load] using card_filter_le (univ : Finset (Fin T))
