    (fun t => destination I a t = v)

GraphChoices.maxLoad_le_length.source:
theorem maxLoad_le_length (I : Instance V T) (a : Orientation T) :
    maxLoad I a ≤ T :=
  (maxLoad_le_iff I a T).2 (load_le_length I a)

omit [Fintype V] in

GraphChoices.assignedCount_eq_sum.source:
theorem assignedCount_eq_sum (I : Instance V T) (a : Orientation T) (S : Finset V) :
    assignedCount I a S = ∑ v ∈ S, load I a v := by
  classical
  simp only [assignedCount, load, card_eq_sum_ones, sum_filter]
  rw [sum_comm]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro t ht
  simp

GraphChoices.total_load.source:
theorem total_load (I : Instance V T) (a : Orientation T) :
    ∑ v, load I a v = T := by
  rw [← assignedCount_eq_sum I a univ]
  simp [assignedCount]

omit [Fintype V] in

GraphChoices.internalCount_le_assignedCo.source:
theorem internalCount_le_assignedCount (I : Instance V T) (a : Orientation T)
    (S : Finset V) : internalCount I S ≤ assignedCount I a S := by
  apply card_le_card
  intro t ht
  simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and] at ht ⊢
  rcases destination_endpoint I a t with h | h <;> simp [h, ht.1, ht.2]

/-- The exact, ceiling-sensitive density obstruction used in Section 2.2. -/

GraphChoices.density_obstruction.source:
theorem density_obstruction (I : Instance V T) (a : Orientation T) (S : Finset V) :
    internalCount I S ≤ S.card * maxLoad I a := by
  calc
    internalCount I S ≤ assignedCount I a S := internalCount_le_assignedCount I a S
    _ = ∑ v ∈ S, load I a v := assignedCount_eq_sum I a S
    _ ≤ ∑ _v ∈ S, maxLoad I a := sum_le_sum fun v _ => load_le_maxLoad I a v
    _ = S.card * maxLoad I a := by simp

/-- Existence is constructive at the level of a finite search space. -/

GraphChoices.exists_opt_orientation.source:
theorem exists_opt_orientation (I : Instance V T) :
    ∃ a : Orientation T, maxLoad I a ≤ opt I := by
  unfold opt
  exact Nat.find_spec (p := fun c => ∃ a : Orientation T, maxLoad I a ≤ c) _

GraphChoices.opt_le_maxLoad.source:
theorem opt_le_maxLoad (I : Instance V T) (a : Orientation T) :
    opt I ≤ maxLoad I a := Nat.find_min' _ ⟨a, le_rfl⟩

GraphChoices.exists_exact_opt.source:
theorem exists_exact_opt (I : Instance V T) :
    ∃ a : Orientation T, maxLoad I a = opt I := by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_opt_orientation I
  exact ⟨a, Nat.le_antisymm ha (opt_le_maxLoad I a)⟩

GraphChoices.opt_le_length.source:
theorem opt_le_length (I : Instance V T) : opt I ≤ T :=
  (opt_le_maxLoad I (fun _ => false)).trans (maxLoad_le_length I _)

GraphChoices.density_le_opt.source:
theorem density_le_opt (I : Instance V T) (S : Finset V) :
    internalCount I S ≤ S.card * opt I := by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_exact_opt I
  simpa [ha] using density_obstruction I a S

GraphChoices.total_le_card_mul_opt.source:
theorem total_le_card_mul_opt (I : Instance V T) : T ≤ Fintype.card V * opt I := by
  simpa [internalCount] using density_le_opt I univ

GraphChoices.opt_pos.source:
theorem opt_pos (I : Instance V T) (hT : 0 < T) : 0 < opt I := by
  have h := total_le_card_mul_opt I
  by_contra hn
  have : opt I = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hn
  simp [this] at h
  omega

/-- Every occurrence of a fixed pair must be assigned to one of two vertices. -/

GraphChoices.multiplicity_le_two_opt.source:
theorem multiplicity_le_two_opt (I : Instance V T) (u v : V) :
    (univ.filter fun t => I.left t = u ∧ I.right t = v).card ≤ 2 * opt I := by
  calc
    _ ≤ internalCount I {u, v} := by
      apply card_le_card
      intro t ht
      simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and] at ht ⊢
      simp [ht.1, ht.2]
    _ ≤ ({u, v} : Finset V).card * opt I := density_le_opt I _
    _ ≤ 2 * opt I := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (card_insert_le _ _ |>.trans (by simp))

end GraphChoices

GraphChoices.average_sub.source:
theorem average_sub {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] (f g : Ω → ℝ) :
    average (fun ω => f ω - g ω) = average f - average g := by
  simp [average, sum_sub_distrib, sub_div]

GraphChoices.average_div.source:
theorem average_div {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] (f : Ω → ℝ) (a : ℝ) :
    average (fun ω => f ω / a) = average f / a := by
  simp only [average, div_eq_mul_inv, ← sum_mul]
  ring

GraphChoices.successNumber.source:
noncomputable def successNumber {I Ω : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq Ω]
    (events : I → Finset Ω) (ω : Ω) : ℝ := ∑ i, if ω ∈ events i then 1 else 0

GraphChoices.successNumber_nonneg.source:
theorem successNumber_nonneg {I Ω : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq Ω]
    (events : I → Finset Ω) (ω : Ω) : 0 ≤ successNumber events ω := by
  exact sum_nonneg fun _ _ => by split <;> norm_num

GraphChoices.average_successNumber.source:
theorem average_successNumber {I Ω : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq Ω]
    (events : I → Finset Ω) :
    average (successNumber events) = ∑ i, eventProbability (events i) := by
  unfold successNumber
  rw [average_sum]
  simp_rw [average_unit_indicator]

GraphChoices.average_indicator_product.source:
theorem average_indicator_product {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq Ω]
    (A B : Finset Ω) :
    average (fun ω => (if ω ∈ A then (1 : ℝ) else 0) *
      (if ω ∈ B then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) = eventProbability (A ∩ B) := by
  rw [← average_unit_indicator]
  congr 1
  funext ω
  by_cases hA : ω ∈ A <;> by_cases hB : ω ∈ B <;> simp [hA, hB]

GraphChoices.successNumber_second_moment.source:
theorem successNumber_second_moment {I Ω : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype Ω]
    [DecidableEq Ω] (events : I → Finset Ω)
    (hcov : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → eventProbability (events i ∩ events j) ≤
      eventProbability (events i) * eventProbability (events j)) :
    average (fun ω => (successNumber events ω)^2) ≤
      (∑ i, eventProbability (events i))^2 + ∑ i, eventProbability (events i) := by
  classical
  have heq (ω : Ω) : (successNumber events ω)^2 =
      ∑ i, ∑ j, (if ω ∈ events i then (1 : ℝ) else 0) *
        (if ω ∈ events j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) := by
    simp only [successNumber, pow_two, sum_mul, mul_sum]
    rw [sum_comm]
  simp_rw [heq, average_sum, average_indicator_product]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ i, ∑ j, (eventProbability (events i) * eventProbability (events j) +
        if i = j then eventProbability (events i) else 0) := by
      apply sum_le_sum
      intro i _
      apply sum_le_sum
      intro j _
      by_cases hij : i = j
      · subst j
        simp only [inter_self, if_true]
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (eventProbability (events i))]
      · simpa only [if_neg hij, add_zero] using hcov i j hij
    _ = _ := by simp [sum_add_distrib, ← mul_sum, ← sum_mul, pow_two]

GraphChoices.density_quadratic_lower.source:
theorem density_quadratic_lower {z r f k a : ℝ}
    (hz : 0 ≤ z) (hr : 0 < r) (hk : 0 ≤ k) (ha : 0 < a)
    (hdensity : k*z ≤ (z+r)*f) :
    k*(2*z/a - (z^2+r*z)/a^2) ≤ f := by
  have hzr : 0 < z+r := by linarith
  have hf : k*z/(z+r) ≤ f := (div_le_iff₀ hzr).mpr (by simpa only [mul_comm f] using hdensity)
  apply le_trans _ hf
  apply (le_div_iff₀ hzr).mpr
  have ha2 : 0 < a^2 := sq_pos_of_pos ha
  apply (le_of_mul_le_mul_right (a := a^2) ?_ ha2)
  have heq : (k*(2*z/a - (z^2+r*z)/a^2)*(z+r)) * a^2 =
      k*(2*z*a - (z^2+r*z))*(z+r) := by field_simp <;> ring
  rw [heq]
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hk hz) (sq_nonneg (a-(z+r)))]

/-- If E[Z²] ≤ E[Z]²+E[Z] and E[Z] ≥ r ≥ 1, any sampled
graph with density at least k Z/(Z+r) has expected optimum at least k/3. -/

GraphChoices.expected_density_of_second_.source:
theorem expected_density_of_second_moment {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [Nonempty Ω]
    (Z f : Ω → ℝ) (k r : ℝ) (hz : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ Z ω) (hk : 0 ≤ k)
    (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hmean : r ≤ average Z)
    (hsecond : average (fun ω => (Z ω)^2) ≤ (average Z)^2 + average Z)
    (hdensity : ∀ ω, k*Z ω ≤ (Z ω+r)*f ω) :
    k/3 ≤ average f := by
  let m := average Z
  let a := m+r+1
  have hm : 1 ≤ m := hr.trans hmean
  have ha : 0 < a := by dsimp [a]; linarith
  have hminor := average_mono fun ω => density_quadratic_lower (hz ω)
    (by linarith : 0 < r) hk ha (hdensity ω)
  rw [average_mul, average_sub, average_div, average_mul, average_div,
    average_add, average_mul] at hminor
  change k*(2*m/a - (average (fun ω => (Z ω)^2)+r*m)/a^2) ≤ average f at hminor
  have hbound : k*m/a ≤ average f := by
    apply le_trans _ hminor
    have ha2 : 0 < a^2 := sq_pos_of_pos ha
    apply (le_of_mul_le_mul_right (a := a^2) ?_ ha2)
    have heq : k*m/a*a^2 = k*m*a := by field_simp <;> ring
    have heq2 : (k*(2*m/a - (average (fun ω => (Z ω)^2)+r*m)/a^2))*a^2 =
        k*(2*m*a - (average (fun ω => (Z ω)^2)+r*m)) := by field_simp <;> ring
    rw [heq, heq2]
    have hh : average (fun ω => (Z ω)^2) ≤ m^2+m := hsecond
    dsimp [a]
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hk (sub_nonneg.mpr hh)]
  apply le_trans _ hbound
  apply (le_div_iff₀ ha).mpr
  have hma : a ≤ 3*m := by dsimp [a]; linarith
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg hk (sub_nonneg.mpr hma)]

end GraphChoices

GraphChoices.orientedPair.source:
def orientedPair (G : BaseGraph V E) (b : E → Bool) (x : E) : V × V :=
  (if b x then G.left x else G.right x, if b x then G.right x else G.left x)

GraphChoices.splitGraph.source:
def splitGraph (G : BaseGraph V E) (b : E → Bool) : Peeling.Graph V V :=
  univ.image (orientedPair G b)

GraphChoices.orientedPair_injective.source:
theorem orientedPair_injective (G : BaseGraph V E) (hsimple : G.IsSimple) (b : E → Bool) :
    Function.Injective (orientedPair G b) := by
  intro x y hxy
  have h1 := congrArg Prod.fst hxy
  have h2 := congrArg Prod.snd hxy
  cases hx : b x <;> cases hy : b y <;>
    simp only [orientedPair, hx, hy, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] at h1 h2
  · exact hsimple.2 x y (Or.inl ⟨h2,h1⟩)
  · exact hsimple.2 x y (Or.inr ⟨h2,h1⟩)
  · exact hsimple.2 x y (Or.inr ⟨h1,h2⟩)
  · exact hsimple.2 x y (Or.inl ⟨h1,h2⟩)

GraphChoices.splitEdgeEquiv.source:
noncomputable def splitEdgeEquiv (G : BaseGraph V E) (hsimple : G.IsSimple) (b : E → Bool) :
    E ≃ splitGraph G b := Equiv.ofBijective
      (fun x => ⟨orientedPair G b x, mem_image.mpr ⟨x,mem_univ _,rfl⟩⟩)
      ⟨fun _ _ h => orientedPair_injective G hsimple b (congrArg Subtype.val h), by
        intro y
        obtain ⟨x,_,hx⟩ := mem_image.mp y.property
        exact ⟨x,Subtype.ext hx⟩⟩

GraphChoices.splitEdgeEquiv_left.source:
theorem splitEdgeEquiv_left (G : BaseGraph V E) (hsimple : G.IsSimple) (b : E → Bool) (x : E) :
    (Peeling.graphBase (splitGraph G b)).left (splitEdgeEquiv G hsimple b x) = (G.split b).left x := rfl

GraphChoices.splitEdgeEquiv_right.source:
theorem splitEdgeEquiv_right (G : BaseGraph V E) (hsimple : G.IsSimple) (b : E → Bool) (x : E) :
    (Peeling.graphBase (splitGraph G b)).right (splitEdgeEquiv G hsimple b x) = (G.split b).right x := rfl

GraphChoices.exists_preprocessed_split.source:
theorem exists_preprocessed_split (G : BaseGraph V E) (hsimple : G.IsSimple) :
    ∃ b : E → Bool, ∀ u,
      Peeling.leftDegree (splitGraph G b) u ≤
        4*(Peeling.graphBase (splitGraph G b)).referenceCap := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := exists_reference_source_orientation G
  refine ⟨b, fun u => ?_⟩
  let H := splitGraph G b
  let e := splitEdgeEquiv G hsimple b
  letI : Nonempty H := ⟨e (Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty E))⟩
  have hc : (univ.filter fun x : E => (if b x then G.left x else G.right x) = u).card =
      (Peeling.leftBucket H u).card := by
    apply card_equiv e
    intro x
    simp only [Peeling.leftBucket, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
    rfl
  have hleft : Peeling.leftDegree H u ≤ G.referenceCap := by
    rw [← Peeling.leftBucket_card, ← hc]
    exact hb u
  have hcap : (G.split b).referenceCap = (Peeling.graphBase H).referenceCap :=
    relabel_referenceCap (G.split b) (Peeling.graphBase H) e
      (splitEdgeEquiv_left G hsimple b) (splitEdgeEquiv_right G hsimple b)
  have hs := source_split_reference G b
  rw [hcap] at hs
  change Peeling.leftDegree H u ≤ 4*(Peeling.graphBase H).referenceCap
  omega

end GraphChoices

GraphChoices.menuValid_of_pointwise.source:
theorem menuValid_of_pointwise {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (menu : (k : ℕ) → (Fin k → V) → Finset V) (n : ℕ) (f : Fin n → V)
    (h : ∀ i : Fin n, f i ∈ menu i.val (fun j => f ⟨j.val, by omega⟩)) :
    MenuValid menu n f := by
  induction n with
  | zero => trivial
  | succ n ih =>
    constructor
    · apply ih (Fin.init f)
      intro i
      exact h i.castSucc
    · exact h (Fin.last n)

end GraphChoices

namespace GraphChoices.Patterns
open Finset
open ThresholdGreedy
variable {E L R C : Type*} [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E] [Nonempty E]
  [Fintype L] [Fintype R] [DecidableEq L] [DecidableEq R] [DecidableEq C]
  {T m : ℕ}

GraphChoices.Patterns.edgeData_labels_in.source:
theorem edgeData_labels_injective (p : ParentPattern C m) (encode : E → Arrival L R C)
    (f : Fin (m+1) → L ⊕ R) (g : Fin m → E)
    (hf : Function.Injective f) (he : EdgeData p encode f g) : Function.Injective g := by
  intro i j hij
  have hi := (he i).2
  have hj := (he j).2
  rw [hij] at hi
  have hpi := (p.parent i).isLt
  have hpj := (p.parent j).isLt
  cases hsi : p.childLeft i <;> cases hsj : p.childLeft j <;>
    simp only [hsi, hsj, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, if_true] at hi hj
  · have hidx := congrArg Fin.val (hf (hi.2.trans hj.2.symm))
    apply Fin.ext
    simpa only [childIndex] using Nat.add_right_cancel hidx
  · have hidx1 := congrArg Fin.val (hf (hi.1.trans hj.1.symm))
    have hidx2 := congrArg Fin.val (hf (hi.2.trans hj.2.symm))
    simp only [childIndex, parentIndex] at hidx1 hidx2
    omega
  · have hidx1 := congrArg Fin.val (hf (hi.1.trans hj.1.symm))
    have hidx2 := congrArg Fin.val (hf (hi.2.trans hj.2.symm))
    simp only [childIndex, parentIndex] at hidx1 hidx2
    omega
  · have hidx := congrArg Fin.val (hf (hi.1.trans hj.1.symm))
    apply Fin.ext
    simpa only [childIndex] using Nat.add_right_cancel hidx

GraphChoices.Patterns.edgeData_mem_assig.source:
theorem edgeData_mem_assignments (p : ParentPattern C m) (H : C → Peeling.Graph L R)
    (encode : E → Arrival L R C)
    (hsource : ∀ e, ((encode e).left, (encode e).right) ∈ H (encode e).cls)
    (f : Fin (m+1) → L ⊕ R) (g : Fin m → E)
    (hroot : ∃ v, f ⟨0, by omega⟩ = Sum.inr v) (he : EdgeData p encode f g) :
    f ∈ patternAssignments p H := by
  classical
  apply (mem_menuAssignments_iff _ _ _).mpr
  apply menuValid_of_pointwise
  intro k
  cases k with
  | mk k hk =>
    cases k with
    | zero =>
      obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hroot
      simp only [patternMenu, hv]
      exact mem_image.mpr ⟨v, mem_univ _, rfl⟩
    | succ k =>
      have hkm : k < m := by omega
      let i : Fin m := ⟨k, hkm⟩
      have hs : ((encode (g i)).left, (encode (g i)).right) ∈ H (p.cls i) := by
        rw [← (he i).1]
        exact hsource _
      have hed := (he i).2
      cases hi : p.childLeft i
      · simp only [hi, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false] at hed
        change f (childIndex i) ∈ patternMenu p H (k+1) _
        simp only [patternMenu, dif_pos hkm]
        change f (childIndex i) ∈ if p.childLeft i then _ else _
        rw [hi]
        simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
        change f (childIndex i) ∈ match f (parentIndex p i) with
          | Sum.inl u => (Peeling.leftNeighbors (H (p.cls i)) u).image Sum.inr
          | Sum.inr _ => ∅
        rw [hed.1, hed.2]
        exact mem_image.mpr ⟨_, by simpa [Peeling.leftNeighbors] using hs, rfl⟩
      · simp only [hi, if_true] at hed
        change f (childIndex i) ∈ patternMenu p H (k+1) _
        simp only [patternMenu, dif_pos hkm]
        change f (childIndex i) ∈ if p.childLeft i then _ else _
        rw [hi]
        simp only [if_true]
        change f (childIndex i) ∈ match f (parentIndex p i) with
          | Sum.inl _ => ∅
          | Sum.inr v => (Peeling.rightNeighbors (H (p.cls i)) v).image Sum.inl
        rw [hed.2, hed.1]
        exact mem_image.mpr ⟨_, by simpa [Peeling.rightNeighbors] using hs, rfl⟩

/-- Geometric vertex data and actual residual occurrences imply membership
in the exact pattern event whose probability was already bounded. -/

GraphChoices.Patterns.mem_residualPatter.source:
theorem mem_residualPatternEvent_of_data (p : ParentPattern C m) (H : C → Peeling.Graph L R)
    (encode : E → Arrival L R C) (α : C → ℕ)
    (hsource : ∀ e, ((encode e).left, (encode e).right) ∈ H (encode e).cls)
    (ω : Fin T → E) (f : Fin (m+1) → L ⊕ R) (g : Fin m → E)
    (hf : Function.Injective f) (hroot : ∃ v, f ⟨0, by omega⟩ = Sum.inr v)
    (he : EdgeData p encode f g)
    (hres : ∀ i, ∃ t : Fin T, ω t = g i ∧ residualTime α encode ω t) :
    ω ∈ residualPatternEvent p H encode α T := by
  classical
  apply mem_biUnion.mpr
  refine ⟨(f,g), mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, ?_, hf, he⟩, ?_⟩
  · exact edgeData_mem_assignments p H encode hsource f g hroot he
  · exact (mem_fixedResidualEvent_iff α encode g (edgeData_labels_injective p encode f g hf he) ω).mpr hres

end GraphChoices.Patterns

GraphChoices.Patterns.weighted_branch_id.source:
theorem weighted_branch_identity (p : ParentPattern C m) (D z : ℝ) (DR γ : C → ℝ) :
    (∏ i : Fin m, if p.childLeft i then DR (p.cls i) else D) *
      (z^m * ∏ j : LeftChildren p, γ (p.cls j.val)) =
    ∏ i : Fin m, if p.childLeft i then DR (p.cls i)*z*γ (p.cls i) else D*z := by
  classical
  rw [GraphChoices.subtype_product_as_ite (fun i : Fin m => p.childLeft i = true) (fun i => γ (p.cls i))]
  have hz : z^m = ∏ _i : Fin m, z := by simp
  rw [hz, ← prod_mul_distrib, ← prod_mul_distrib]
  apply prod_congr rfl
  intro i _
  cases h : p.childLeft i <;> simp [h, mul_assoc]

GraphChoices.Patterns.bucketDecay.source:
noncomputable def bucketDecay (α : C → ℕ) (DL : C → ℕ) (T : ℕ) (c : C) : ℝ :=
  (Real.exp 1 * T * (DL c : ℝ) / Fintype.card E / α c)^(α c)

/-- A fixed left-heavy pattern has geometric probability decay when the local
threshold tails beat their right branching factors. This combines actual
execution witnesses and the concrete graph-embedding count. -/

GraphChoices.Patterns.residualPattern_pr.source:
theorem residualPattern_probability_decay (p : ParentPattern C m) (H : C → Peeling.Graph L R)
    (encode : E → Arrival L R C) (α : C → ℕ) (DL DR : C → ℕ) (D : ℕ)
    (hsimple : Function.Injective fun e => ((encode e).left,(encode e).right))
    (hDL : ∀ u c, (sourceBucket encode u c).card ≤ DL c)
    (hL : ∀ c u, Peeling.leftDegree (H c) u ≤ D)
    (hR : ∀ c v, Peeling.rightDegree (H c) v ≤ DR c)
    (b r : ℝ) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hbr : b ≤ r)
    (hpair : (D : ℝ)*((T:ℝ)/Fintype.card E)*b ≤ r^2)
    (hlocal : ∀ c, (DR c : ℝ)*((T:ℝ)/Fintype.card E)*bucketDecay (E := E) α DL T c ≤ b)
    (hheavy : m ≤ 2*(univ.filter fun i : Fin m => p.childLeft i = true).card) :
    eventProbability (residualPatternEvent p H encode α T) ≤ (Fintype.card R : ℝ)*r^m := by
  classical
  have hp := residualPattern_probability_le (T := T) p H encode α DL DR D hsimple hDL hL hR
  have heq :
      ((Fintype.card R * (∏ i : Fin m, if p.childLeft i then DR (p.cls i) else D) : ℕ) : ℝ) *
        patternProbabilityFactor (E := E) p α DL T =
      (Fintype.card R : ℝ) * (∏ i : Fin m, if p.childLeft i then
        (DR (p.cls i) : ℝ)*((T:ℝ)/Fintype.card E)*bucketDecay (E := E) α DL T (p.cls i)
        else (D:ℝ)*((T:ℝ)/Fintype.card E)) := by
    simp only [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_prod, Nat.cast_ite, patternProbabilityFactor]
    rw [mul_assoc]
    exact congrArg (fun x : ℝ => (Fintype.card R : ℝ)*x)
      (weighted_branch_identity p (D:ℝ) ((T:ℝ)/Fintype.card E)
        (fun c => (DR c : ℝ)) (bucketDecay (E := E) α DL T))
  rw [heq] at hp
  calc
    _ ≤ _ := hp
    _ ≤ (Fintype.card R : ℝ) * (∏ i : Fin m, if p.childLeft i then b else (D:ℝ)*((T:ℝ)/Fintype.card E)) := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
      apply prod_le_prod
      · intro i _
        split_ifs <;> (try dsimp only [bucketDecay]) <;> positivity
      · intro i _
        split_ifs
        · exact hlocal _
        · exact le_rfl
    _ ≤ (Fintype.card R : ℝ) * r^m := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
      simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using GraphChoices.two_class_product_bound (fun i : Fin m => p.childLeft i = true)
        _ b r (by positivity) hb hr hpair hbr (by simpa using hheavy)

end GraphChoices.Patterns

GraphChoices.Patterns.ParentPattern.source:
structure ParentPattern (C : Type*) (m : ℕ) where
  parent : (i : Fin m) → Fin (i.val+1)
  cls : Fin m → C
  childLeft : Fin m → Bool

GraphChoices.Patterns.patternMenu.source:
noncomputable def patternMenu {m : ℕ} (p : ParentPattern C m)
    (H : C → Peeling.Graph L R) : (k : ℕ) → (Fin k → L ⊕ R) → Finset (L ⊕ R)
  | 0, _ => univ.image Sum.inr
  | k+1, f => if hk : k < m then
      let i : Fin m := ⟨k,hk⟩
      if p.childLeft i then
        match f (p.parent i) with
        | Sum.inl _ => ∅
        | Sum.inr v => (Peeling.rightNeighbors (H (p.cls i)) v).image Sum.inl
      else
        match f (p.parent i) with
        | Sum.inl u => (Peeling.leftNeighbors (H (p.cls i)) u).image Sum.inr
        | Sum.inr _ => ∅
    else ∅

GraphChoices.Patterns.branchBound.source:
def branchBound {m : ℕ} (p : ParentPattern C m) (D : ℕ) (DR : C → ℕ) : ℕ → ℕ
  | 0 => Fintype.card R
  | k+1 => if hk : k < m then if p.childLeft ⟨k,hk⟩ then DR (p.cls ⟨k,hk⟩) else D else 0

GraphChoices.Patterns.patternMenu_card_l.source:
theorem patternMenu_card_le {m : ℕ} (p : ParentPattern C m) (H : C → Peeling.Graph L R)
    (D : ℕ) (DR : C → ℕ)
    (hL : ∀ c u, Peeling.leftDegree (H c) u ≤ D)
    (hR : ∀ c v, Peeling.rightDegree (H c) v ≤ DR c)
    (k : ℕ) (f : Fin k → L ⊕ R) :
    (patternMenu p H k f).card ≤ branchBound (R := R) p D DR k := by
  cases k with
  | zero =>
    simpa only [patternMenu, branchBound, card_univ] using
      (card_image_le (s := (univ : Finset R)) (f := (Sum.inr : R → L ⊕ R)))
  | succ k =>
    by_cases hk : k < m
    · cases hs : p.childLeft ⟨k,hk⟩
      · cases hv : f (p.parent ⟨k,hk⟩) with
        | inl u =>
          simp only [patternMenu, branchBound, dif_pos hk, hs, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, hv]
          exact card_image_le.trans (hL _ _)
        | inr v => simp [patternMenu, branchBound, hk, hs, hv]
      · cases hv : f (p.parent ⟨k,hk⟩) with
        | inl u => simp [patternMenu, branchBound, hk, hs, hv]
        | inr v =>
          simp only [patternMenu, branchBound, dif_pos hk, hs, if_true, hv]
          exact card_image_le.trans (hR _ _)
    · simp [patternMenu, branchBound, hk]

GraphChoices.Patterns.patternAssignments.source:
noncomputable def patternAssignments {m : ℕ} (p : ParentPattern C m) (H : C → Peeling.Graph L R) :
    Finset (Fin (m+1) → L ⊕ R) := GraphChoices.menuAssignments (patternMenu p H) (m+1)

/-- The fixed-pattern embedding count underlying Equation (8), before grouping
left vertices with equal edge classes. The right root has at most |R| choices. -/

theorem patternAssignments_card_le {m : ℕ} (p : ParentPattern C m) (H : C → Peeling.Graph L R)
    (D : ℕ) (DR : C → ℕ)
    (hL : ∀ c u, Peeling.leftDegree (H c) u ≤ D)
    (hR : ∀ c v, Peeling.rightDegree (H c) v ≤ DR c) :
    (patternAssignments p H).card ≤ Fintype.card R *
      ∏ i : Fin m, if p.childLeft i then DR (p.cls i) else D := by
  have hh := GraphChoices.menuAssignments_card_le (patternMenu p H)
    (branchBound (R := R) p D DR) (m+1) (fun k _ f => patternMenu_card_le p H D DR hL hR k f)
  unfold patternAssignments
  apply hh.trans_eq
  rw [prod_range_succ']
  rw [← Fin.prod_univ_eq_prod_range (fun k => branchBound (R := R) p D DR (k+1)) m]
  simp only [branchBound, Fin.isLt, dif_pos]
  rw [mul_comm]

end GraphChoices.Patterns

GraphChoices.Patterns.childIndex.source: def childIndex (i : Fin m) : Fin (m+1) := ⟨i.val+1,by omega⟩

GraphChoices.Patterns.parentIndex.source:
def parentIndex (p : ParentPattern C m) (i : Fin m) : Fin (m+1) :=
  ⟨(p.parent i).val,by have := (p.parent i).isLt; have := i.isLt; omega⟩

GraphChoices.Patterns.EdgeData.source:
def EdgeData (p : ParentPattern C m) (encode : E → Arrival L R C)
    (f : Fin (m+1) → L ⊕ R) (g : Fin m → E) : Prop :=
  ∀ i, (encode (g i)).cls = p.cls i ∧
    if p.childLeft i then
      f (childIndex i) = Sum.inl (encode (g i)).left ∧
      f (parentIndex p i) = Sum.inr (encode (g i)).right
    else
      f (parentIndex p i) = Sum.inl (encode (g i)).left ∧
      f (childIndex i) = Sum.inr (encode (g i)).right

GraphChoices.Patterns.embeddingSet.source:
noncomputable def embeddingSet (p : ParentPattern C m) (H : C → Peeling.Graph L R)
    (encode : E → Arrival L R C) :
    Finset ((Fin (m+1) → L ⊕ R) × (Fin m → E)) := by
  classical
  exact univ.filter fun fg => fg.1 ∈ patternAssignments p H ∧ Function.Injective fg.1 ∧ EdgeData p encode fg.1 fg.2

GraphChoices.Patterns.embedding_projecti.source:
theorem embedding_projection_inj (p : ParentPattern C m) (H : C → Peeling.Graph L R)
    (encode : E → Arrival L R C)
    (hsimple : Function.Injective fun e => ((encode e).left,(encode e).right)) :
    Set.InjOn (fun fg : ((Fin (m+1) → L ⊕ R) × (Fin m → E)) => fg.1)
      (↑(embeddingSet p H encode) : Set _) := by
  classical
  intro a ha b hb hab
  change a.1 = b.1 at hab
  have hA := (mem_filter.mp ha).2.2.2
  have hB := (mem_filter.mp hb).2.2.2
  apply Prod.ext hab
  funext i
  apply hsimple
  have hx := (hA i).2
  have hy := (hB i).2
  rw [hab] at hx
  cases hs : p.childLeft i <;> simp only [hs, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, if_true] at hx hy
  · exact Prod.ext (Sum.inl.inj (hx.1.symm.trans hy.1)) (Sum.inr.inj (hx.2.symm.trans hy.2))
  · exact Prod.ext (Sum.inl.inj (hx.1.symm.trans hy.1)) (Sum.inr.inj (hx.2.symm.trans hy.2))

GraphChoices.Patterns.embeddingSet_card_.source:
theorem embeddingSet_card_le (p : ParentPattern C m) (H : C → Peeling.Graph L R)
    (encode : E → Arrival L R C)
    (hsimple : Function.Injective fun e => ((encode e).left,(encode e).right)) :
    (embeddingSet p H encode).card ≤ (patternAssignments p H).card := by
  classical
  exact card_le_card_of_injOn Prod.fst
    (fun fg hfg => (mem_filter.mp hfg).2.1) (embedding_projection_inj p H encode hsimple)

GraphChoices.Patterns.LeftChildren.source: abbrev LeftChildren (p : ParentPattern C m) := {i : Fin m // p.childLeft i = true}

GraphChoices.Patterns.embedding_left_buc.source:
theorem embedding_left_buckets_distinct (p : ParentPattern C m) (encode : E → Arrival L R C)
    (f : Fin (m+1) → L ⊕ R) (g : Fin m → E) (hf : Function.Injective f) (he : EdgeData p encode f g) :
    Function.Injective (fun j : LeftChildren p => ((encode (g j.val)).left,p.cls j.val)) := by
  intro j k hjk
  have hj := (he j.val).2
  have hk := (he k.val).2
  simp only [j.property, k.property, if_true] at hj hk
  have hl := congrArg Prod.fst hjk
  have hc : childIndex j.val = childIndex k.val := hf (hj.1.trans ((congrArg Sum.inl hl).trans hk.1.symm))
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Fin.ext
  have hv := congrArg Fin.val hc
  simp only [childIndex] at hv
  omega

GraphChoices.Patterns.patternProbability.source:
noncomputable def patternProbabilityFactor (p : ParentPattern C m) (α : C → ℕ)
    (DL : C → ℕ) (T : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ((T:ℝ) / Fintype.card E)^m * ∏ j : LeftChildren p,
    (Real.exp 1 * T * (DL (p.cls j.val) : ℝ) / Fintype.card E / α (p.cls j.val))^(α (p.cls j.val))

GraphChoices.Patterns.embedding_probabil.source:
theorem embedding_probability_le (p : ParentPattern C m) (H : C → Peeling.Graph L R)
    (encode : E → Arrival L R C) (α : C → ℕ) (DL : C → ℕ)
    (hDL : ∀ u c, (sourceBucket encode u c).card ≤ DL c)
    (fg : (Fin (m+1) → L ⊕ R) × (Fin m → E)) (hfg : fg ∈ embeddingSet p H encode) :
    eventProbability (fixedResidualEvent α encode T m fg.2) ≤ patternProbabilityFactor (E := E) p α DL T := by
  classical
  have hf := (mem_filter.mp hfg).2.2.1
  have he := (mem_filter.mp hfg).2.2.2
  have hp := fixedResidual_probability_le (T := T) (J := LeftChildren p) α encode fg.2
    (fun j => (encode (fg.2 j.val)).left) (fun j => p.cls j.val) (fun j => j.val)
    (fun j => ⟨rfl,(he j.val).1⟩) (embedding_left_buckets_distinct p encode fg.1 fg.2 hf he)
  apply hp.trans
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity)
  apply prod_le_prod
  · intro j _; positivity
  · intro j _
    apply pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) _
    apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity)
    exact_mod_cast hDL (encode (fg.2 j.val)).left (p.cls j.val)

GraphChoices.Patterns.residualPatternEve.source:
noncomputable def residualPatternEvent (p : ParentPattern C m) (H : C → Peeling.Graph L R)
    (encode : E → Arrival L R C) (α : C → ℕ) (T : ℕ) : Finset (Fin T → E) :=
  (embeddingSet p H encode).biUnion fun fg => fixedResidualEvent α encode T m fg.2

/-- Fixed-pattern union bound combining the concrete embedding count and raw
residual-tree probability. Threshold parameter simplification is still separate. -/

GraphChoices.Patterns.residualPattern_pr.source:
theorem residualPattern_probability_le (p : ParentPattern C m) (H : C → Peeling.Graph L R)
    (encode : E → Arrival L R C) (α : C → ℕ) (DL DR : C → ℕ) (D : ℕ)
    (hsimple : Function.Injective fun e => ((encode e).left,(encode e).right))
    (hDL : ∀ u c, (sourceBucket encode u c).card ≤ DL c)
    (hL : ∀ c u, Peeling.leftDegree (H c) u ≤ D)
    (hR : ∀ c v, Peeling.rightDegree (H c) v ≤ DR c) :
    eventProbability (residualPatternEvent p H encode α T) ≤
      (Fintype.card R * (∏ i : Fin m, if p.childLeft i then DR (p.cls i) else D) : ℕ) *
        patternProbabilityFactor (E := E) p α DL T := by
  classical
  have hP : 0 ≤ patternProbabilityFactor (E := E) p α DL T := by unfold patternProbabilityFactor; positivity
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ fg ∈ embeddingSet p H encode, eventProbability (fixedResidualEvent α encode T m fg.2) := witness_union_bound _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ _fg ∈ embeddingSet p H encode, patternProbabilityFactor (E := E) p α DL T :=
      sum_le_sum fun fg hfg => embedding_probability_le p H encode α DL hDL fg hfg
    _ = (embeddingSet p H encode).card * patternProbabilityFactor (E := E) p α DL T := by simp
    _ ≤ (Fintype.card R * (∏ i : Fin m, if p.childLeft i then DR (p.cls i) else D) : ℕ) *
        patternProbabilityFactor (E := E) p α DL T := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ hP
      exact_mod_cast (embeddingSet_card_le p H encode hsimple).trans (patternAssignments_card_le p H D DR hL hR)

end GraphChoices.Patterns

GraphChoices.TimeChoice.source:
abbrev TimeChoice (T k : ℕ) :=
  {K : Finset (Fin T) // K ∈ (univ : Finset (Fin T)).powersetCard k}

GraphChoices.TimeWitness.source:
abbrev TimeWitness (J : Type*) (T m : ℕ) (α : J → ℕ) :=
  (Fin m → Fin T) × ((j : J) → TimeChoice T (α j))

GraphChoices.WitnessSlot.source:
abbrev WitnessSlot (J : Type*) (m : ℕ) (α : J → ℕ) :=
  Fin m ⊕ ((j : J) × Fin (α j))

GraphChoices.witnessTime.source:
noncomputable def witnessTime {T m : ℕ} {α : J → ℕ} (w : TimeWitness J T m α) :
    WitnessSlot J m α → Fin T
  | Sum.inl i => w.1 i
  | Sum.inr ⟨j,i⟩ => (w.2 j).val.orderEmbOfFin ((mem_powersetCard.mp (w.2 j).property).2) i

GraphChoices.timeChoice_card.source:
theorem timeChoice_card (T k : ℕ) : Fintype.card (TimeChoice T k) = T.choose k := by
  simp [TimeChoice, Fintype.card_coe, card_powersetCard]

GraphChoices.timeWitness_card.source:
theorem timeWitness_card (T m : ℕ) (α : J → ℕ) :
    Fintype.card (TimeWitness J T m α) = T^m * ∏ j, T.choose (α j) := by
  simp [TimeWitness, Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_pi, timeChoice_card]

GraphChoices.slot_probability_product.source:
theorem slot_probability_product {m : ℕ} (α : J → ℕ) (tree : Fin m → E) (bucket : J → Finset E) :
    (∏ s : WitnessSlot J m α, ((slotAllowed tree bucket s).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card E) =
      ((1:ℝ) / Fintype.card E)^m * ∏ j, (((bucket j).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card E)^(α j) := by
  rw [Fintype.prod_sum_type, Fintype.prod_sigma]
  simp [slotAllowed, div_pow, prod_div_distrib]

GraphChoices.patternWitnessEvent.source:
noncomputable def patternWitnessEvent (T m : ℕ) (α : J → ℕ)
    (tree : Fin m → E) (bucket : J → Finset E) : Finset (Fin T → E) := by
  classical
  exact univ.biUnion fun w : TimeWitness J T m α =>
    if Function.Injective (witnessTime w) then requirementsEvent (witnessTime w) (slotAllowed tree bucket) else ∅

/-- Joint counting and probability bound with exact binomial coefficients. -/

GraphChoices.patternWitness_probability_.source:
theorem patternWitness_probability_le (T m : ℕ) (α : J → ℕ)
    (tree : Fin m → E) (bucket : J → Finset E) :
    eventProbability (patternWitnessEvent T m α tree bucket) ≤
      ((T:ℝ) / Fintype.card E)^m *
        ∏ j, (T.choose (α j) : ℝ) * (((bucket j).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card E)^(α j) := by
  classical
  have hh := injected_witness_union_bound
    (W := TimeWitness J T m α) (J := WitnessSlot J m α) witnessTime (slotAllowed tree bucket)
  change eventProbability (patternWitnessEvent T m α tree bucket) ≤ _ at hh
  calc
    _ ≤ (Fintype.card (TimeWitness J T m α) : ℝ) *
        (∏ s : WitnessSlot J m α, ((slotAllowed tree bucket s).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card E) := hh
    _ = _ := by
      rw [timeWitness_card, slot_probability_product]
      simp only [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_prod, prod_mul_distrib, div_pow]
      ring

/-- The exponential version corresponding to the raw pattern bound in (12).
All time-step collisions have been discarded before applying independence. -/

theorem patternWitness_probability_le_exp (T m : ℕ) (α : J → ℕ)
    (tree : Fin m → E) (bucket : J → Finset E) :
    eventProbability (patternWitnessEvent T m α tree bucket) ≤
      ((T:ℝ) / Fintype.card E)^m *
        ∏ j, (Real.exp 1 * T * (((bucket j).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card E) / α j)^(α j) := by
  apply (patternWitness_probability_le T m α tree bucket).trans
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity)
  apply prod_le_prod
  · intro j _; positivity
  · intro j _
    calc
      (T.choose (α j) : ℝ) * (((bucket j).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card E)^(α j) ≤
          (Real.exp 1 * T / α j)^(α j) * (((bucket j).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card E)^(α j) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (choose_le_exp_div_pow T (α j)) (by positivity)
      _ = _ := by rw [← mul_pow]; congr 1; ring

end GraphChoices

GraphChoices.Peeling.Graph.source: abbrev Graph (L R : Type*) := Finset (L × R)

GraphChoices.Peeling.leftNeighbors.source:
def leftNeighbors (H : Graph L R) (u : L) : Finset R :=
  univ.filter fun v => (u,v) ∈ H

GraphChoices.Peeling.rightNeighbors.source:
def rightNeighbors (H : Graph L R) (v : R) : Finset L :=
  univ.filter fun u => (u,v) ∈ H

GraphChoices.Peeling.leftDegree.source: def leftDegree (H : Graph L R) (u : L) : ℕ := (leftNeighbors H u).card

GraphChoices.Peeling.rightDegree.source: def rightDegree (H : Graph L R) (v : R) : ℕ := (rightNeighbors H v).card

GraphChoices.Peeling.leftNeighbors_mono.source:
theorem leftNeighbors_mono {F H : Graph L R} (h : F ⊆ H) (u : L) :
    leftNeighbors F u ⊆ leftNeighbors H u := by
  intro v hv
  simp only [leftNeighbors, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and] at hv ⊢
  exact h hv

GraphChoices.Peeling.leftDegree_mono.source:
theorem leftDegree_mono {F H : Graph L R} (h : F ⊆ H) (u : L) :
    leftDegree F u ≤ leftDegree H u := card_le_card (leftNeighbors_mono h u)

GraphChoices.Peeling.leftDegree_sdiff.source:
theorem leftDegree_sdiff {F H : Graph L R} (h : F ⊆ H) (u : L) :
    leftDegree (H \ F) u = leftDegree H u - leftDegree F u := by
  have heq : leftNeighbors (H \ F) u = leftNeighbors H u \ leftNeighbors F u := by
    ext v; simp [leftNeighbors]
  rw [leftDegree, heq, card_sdiff_of_subset (leftNeighbors_mono h u)]
  rfl

GraphChoices.Peeling.rightDegree_union_l.source:
theorem rightDegree_union_le (F H : Graph L R) (v : R) :
    rightDegree (F ∪ H) v ≤ rightDegree F v + rightDegree H v := by
  have heq : rightNeighbors (F ∪ H) v = rightNeighbors F v ∪ rightNeighbors H v := by
    ext u; simp [rightNeighbors]
  exact (congrArg card heq).le.trans (card_union_le _ _)

/-- Every sufficiently high-degree left set expands, in every residual graph. -/

GraphChoices.Peeling.PeelingExpansion.source:
def PeelingExpansion (H : Graph L R) (k b : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ F : Graph L R, F ⊆ H → ∀ A : Finset L,
    (∀ u ∈ A, k < leftDegree F u) →
      A.card ≤ b * (GraphChoices.neighbors (fun u v => (u,v) ∈ F) A).card

GraphChoices.Peeling.PeelingExpansion.mo.source:
theorem PeelingExpansion.mono {F H : Graph L R} {k b : ℕ}
    (h : PeelingExpansion H k b) (hF : F ⊆ H) : PeelingExpansion F k b := by
  intro J hJ A hA
  exact h J (hJ.trans hF) A hA

/-- A matching covers exactly a specified active set, with right capacity b. -/

GraphChoices.Peeling.exists_active_match.source:
theorem exists_active_matching (H : Graph L R) (A : Finset L) (b : ℕ)
    (hexpand : ∀ B : Finset L, B ⊆ A →
      B.card ≤ b * (GraphChoices.neighbors (fun u v => (u,v) ∈ H) B).card) :
    ∃ M : Graph L R, M ⊆ H ∧
      (∀ u, leftDegree M u = if u ∈ A then 1 else 0) ∧
      (∀ v, rightDegree M v ≤ b) := by
  classical
  let U := {u : L // u ∈ A}
  let r (u : U) (v : R) := (u.val,v) ∈ H
  have hcap (B : Finset U) : B.card ≤ b * (GraphChoices.neighbors r B).card := by
    have hb := hexpand (B.image Subtype.val) (by
      intro u hu
      obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hu
      exact w.property)
    have hi : (B.image Subtype.val).card = B.card := card_image_of_injective _ Subtype.val_injective
    have heq : GraphChoices.neighbors (fun u v => (u,v) ∈ H) (B.image Subtype.val) =
        GraphChoices.neighbors r B := by
      ext v
      simp only [GraphChoices.neighbors, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, mem_image]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨u, ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩, h⟩; exact ⟨w, hw, h⟩
      · rintro ⟨w, hw, h⟩; exact ⟨w.val, ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩, h⟩
    simpa [hi, heq] using hb
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hfb⟩ := GraphChoices.exists_capacity_matching r b hcap
  let M : Graph L R := univ.image fun u : U => (u.val, f u)
  refine ⟨M, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro p hp
    obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hp
    exact hf u
  · intro u
    by_cases hu : u ∈ A
    · have heq : leftNeighbors M u = {f ⟨u,hu⟩} := by
        ext v
        simp only [leftNeighbors, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, M, mem_image, mem_singleton]
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨w, hw⟩
          have hwval : w.val = u := congrArg Prod.fst hw
          have hwsub : w = ⟨u,hu⟩ := Subtype.ext hwval
          have := congrArg Prod.snd hw
          simpa [hwsub] using this.symm
        · intro hv
          exact ⟨⟨u,hu⟩, by simp [hv]⟩
      simp [leftDegree, heq, hu]
    · have heq : leftNeighbors M u = ∅ := by
        ext v
        simp only [leftNeighbors, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, M, mem_image, notMem_empty, iff_false]
        rintro ⟨w, hw⟩
        have hwval : w.val = u := congrArg Prod.fst hw
        exact hu (hwval ▸ w.property)
      simp [leftDegree, heq, hu]
  · intro v
    have heq : rightNeighbors M v = (univ.filter fun u : U => f u = v).image Subtype.val := by
      ext u
      simp only [rightNeighbors, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, M, mem_image]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨w, hw⟩
        exact ⟨w, congrArg Prod.snd hw, congrArg Prod.fst hw⟩
      · rintro ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨w, by simp [hw]⟩
    calc
      rightDegree M v = ((univ.filter fun u : U => f u = v).image Subtype.val).card := congrArg card heq
      _ ≤ (univ.filter fun u : U => f u = v).card := card_image_le
      _ ≤ b := hfb v

/-- Extraction terminates after at most D matching rounds. The removed piece
has right degree at most D b, and the residual has left degree at most k. -/

GraphChoices.Peeling.exists_peeling_piec.source:
theorem exists_peeling_piece (H : Graph L R) (k b D : ℕ)
    (hD : ∀ u, leftDegree H u ≤ D) (hexpand : PeelingExpansion H k b) :
    ∃ P : Graph L R, P ⊆ H ∧
      (∀ u, leftDegree (H \ P) u ≤ k) ∧
      (∀ v, rightDegree P v ≤ D*b) := by
  induction D generalizing H with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨∅, empty_subset _, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro u; simpa using (hD u).trans (Nat.zero_le k)
    · intro v; simp [rightDegree, rightNeighbors]
  | succ D ih =>
    by_cases hk : D+1 ≤ k
    · refine ⟨∅, empty_subset _, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro u; simpa using (hD u).trans hk
      · intro v; simp [rightDegree, rightNeighbors]
    · let A : Finset L := univ.filter fun u => k < leftDegree H u
      obtain ⟨M, hMH, hML, hMR⟩ := exists_active_matching H A b (by
        intro B hBA
        apply hexpand H (subset_refl _) B
        intro u hu
        exact (mem_filter.mp (hBA hu)).2)
      have hnext (u : L) : leftDegree (H \ M) u ≤ D := by
        rw [leftDegree_sdiff hMH, hML]
        by_cases hu : u ∈ A
        · rw [if_pos hu]
          have := hD u
          omega
        · rw [if_neg hu]
          have hlow : leftDegree H u ≤ k := by
            simpa only [A, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, not_lt] using hu
          omega
      obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hQleft, hQright⟩ := ih (H \ M) hnext
        (hexpand.mono sdiff_subset)
      have hQH : Q ⊆ H := hQ.trans sdiff_subset
      refine ⟨M ∪ Q, union_subset hMH hQH, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro u
        have heq : H \ (M ∪ Q) = (H \ M) \ Q := by ext p; simp; tauto
        rw [heq]
        exact hQleft u
      · intro v
        have hdeg := rightDegree_union_le M Q v
        have hm := hMR v
        have hq := hQright v
        nlinarith

end GraphChoices.Peeling

GraphChoices.Peeling.mem_unionPieces_iff.source:
theorem mem_unionPieces_iff (Ps : List (Graph L R)) (e : L × R) :
    e ∈ unionPieces Ps ↔ ∃ P ∈ Ps, e ∈ P := by
  induction Ps with
  | nil => simp [unionPieces]
  | cons P Ps ih => simp [unionPieces, ih, or_and_right, exists_or]

GraphChoices.Peeling.exists_piece_index.source:
theorem exists_piece_index (G : Graph L R) (Ps : List (Graph L R))
    (hcover : unionPieces Ps = G) (e : G) : ∃ i : Fin Ps.length, e.val ∈ Ps.get i := by
  have he : e.val ∈ unionPieces Ps := by rw [hcover]; exact e.property
  obtain ⟨P, hP, heP⟩ := (mem_unionPieces_iff Ps e.val).mp he
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := List.mem_iff_get.mp hP
  exact ⟨i, by rw [hi]; exact heP⟩

GraphChoices.Peeling.pieceClass.source:
noncomputable def pieceClass (G : Graph L R) (Ps : List (Graph L R))
    (hcover : unionPieces Ps = G) (e : G) : Fin Ps.length :=
  Classical.choose (exists_piece_index G Ps hcover e)

GraphChoices.Peeling.pieceClass_mem.source:
theorem pieceClass_mem (G : Graph L R) (Ps : List (Graph L R))
    (hcover : unionPieces Ps = G) (e : G) : e.val ∈ Ps.get (pieceClass G Ps hcover e) :=
  Classical.choose_spec (exists_piece_index G Ps hcover e)

GraphChoices.Peeling.pieceEncode.source:
noncomputable def pieceEncode (G : Graph L R) (Ps : List (Graph L R))
    (hcover : unionPieces Ps = G) (e : G) : Arrival L R (Fin Ps.length) :=
  ⟨e.val.1, e.val.2, pieceClass G Ps hcover e⟩

GraphChoices.Peeling.pieceEncode_simple.source:
theorem pieceEncode_simple (G : Graph L R) (Ps : List (Graph L R)) (hcover : unionPieces Ps = G) :
    Function.Injective fun e => ((pieceEncode G Ps hcover e).left, (pieceEncode G Ps hcover e).right) := by
  intro e f h
  exact Subtype.ext h

GraphChoices.Peeling.pieceEncode_source.source:
theorem pieceEncode_source (G : Graph L R) (Ps : List (Graph L R)) (hcover : unionPieces Ps = G) :
    ∀ e, ((pieceEncode G Ps hcover e).left, (pieceEncode G Ps hcover e).right) ∈
      Ps.get (pieceEncode G Ps hcover e).cls := pieceClass_mem G Ps hcover

GraphChoices.Peeling.piece_sourceBucket_.source:
theorem piece_sourceBucket_card_le (G : Graph L R) (Ps : List (Graph L R))
    (hcover : unionPieces Ps = G) (u : L) (i : Fin Ps.length) :
    (sourceBucket (pieceEncode G Ps hcover) u i).card ≤ leftDegree (Ps.get i) u := by
  classical
  apply card_le_card_of_injOn (fun e : G => e.val.2)
  · intro e he
    obtain ⟨hu, hc⟩ := (mem_filter.mp he).2
    have hsrc := pieceEncode_source G Ps hcover e
    rw [hc] at hsrc
    change e.val.1 = u at hu
    change (e.val.1, e.val.2) ∈ Ps.get i at hsrc
    change e.val.2 ∈ leftNeighbors (Ps.get i) u
    simp only [leftNeighbors, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
    rw [← hu]
    exact hsrc
  · intro e he f hf hright
    have heleft := (mem_filter.mp he).2.1
    have hfleft := (mem_filter.mp hf).2.1
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact Prod.ext (heleft.trans hfleft.symm) hright

GraphChoices.Peeling.piece_leftSourceBuc.source:
theorem piece_leftSourceBucket_card_le (G : Graph L R) (Ps : List (Graph L R))
    (hcover : unionPieces Ps = G) (u : L) :
    (leftSourceBucket (pieceEncode G Ps hcover) u).card ≤ leftDegree G u := by
  classical
  apply card_le_card_of_injOn (fun e : G => e.val.2)
  · intro e he
    have hu := (mem_filter.mp he).2
    change e.val.1 = u at hu
    change e.val.2 ∈ leftNeighbors G u
    simp only [leftNeighbors, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
    rw [← hu]
    exact e.property
  · intro e he f hf hright
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact Prod.ext ((mem_filter.mp he).2.trans (mem_filter.mp hf).2.symm) hright

GraphChoices.Peeling.maxLeftDegree.source: def maxLeftDegree (G : Graph L R) : ℕ := univ.sup (leftDegree G)

GraphChoices.Peeling.maxRightDegree.source: def maxRightDegree (G : Graph L R) : ℕ := univ.sup (rightDegree G)

GraphChoices.Peeling.leftDegree_le_max.source:
theorem leftDegree_le_max (G : Graph L R) (u : L) : leftDegree G u ≤ maxLeftDegree G :=
  Finset.le_sup (mem_univ u)

GraphChoices.Peeling.rightDegree_le_max.source:
theorem rightDegree_le_max (G : Graph L R) (v : R) : rightDegree G v ≤ maxRightDegree G :=
  Finset.le_sup (mem_univ v)

GraphChoices.Peeling.maxLeftDegree_le.source:
theorem maxLeftDegree_le (G : Graph L R) (D : ℕ) (h : ∀ u, leftDegree G u ≤ D) :
    maxLeftDegree G ≤ D := Finset.sup_le (fun u _ => h u)

GraphChoices.Peeling.nat_sup_cast_le.source:
theorem nat_sup_cast_le {U : Type*} (s : Finset U) (f : U → ℕ) (K : ℝ)
    (hK : 0 ≤ K) (h : ∀ u ∈ s, (f u : ℝ) ≤ K) : ((s.sup f : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ K := by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simpa using hK
  | @insert u s hu ih =>
    rw [Finset.sup_insert]
    change ((max (f u) (s.sup f) : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ K
    rw [Nat.cast_max]
    exact max_le (h u (mem_insert_self _ _)) (ih (fun v hv => h v (mem_insert_of_mem hv)))

GraphChoices.Peeling.maxLeftDegree_real_.source:
theorem maxLeftDegree_real_le (G : Graph L R) (K : ℝ)
    (hK : 0 ≤ K) (h : ∀ u, (leftDegree G u : ℝ) ≤ K) : (maxLeftDegree G : ℝ) ≤ K :=
  nat_sup_cast_le _ _ _ hK (fun u _ => h u)

GraphChoices.Peeling.maxRightDegree_real.source:
theorem maxRightDegree_real_le (G : Graph L R) (K : ℝ)
    (hK : 0 ≤ K) (h : ∀ v, (rightDegree G v : ℝ) ≤ K) : (maxRightDegree G : ℝ) ≤ K :=
  nat_sup_cast_le _ _ _ hK (fun v _ => h v)

GraphChoices.Peeling.piece_maxLeftDegree.source:
theorem piece_maxLeftDegree_le (G : Graph L R) (Ps : List (Graph L R))
    (hcover : unionPieces Ps = G) (i : Fin Ps.length) :
    maxLeftDegree (Ps.get i) ≤ maxLeftDegree G := by
  apply maxLeftDegree_le
  intro u
  have hsub : Ps.get i ⊆ G := by
    rw [← hcover]
    exact mem_subset_unionPieces (List.get_mem _ _)
  exact (leftDegree_mono hsub u).trans (leftDegree_le_max G u)

end GraphChoices.Peeling

GraphChoices.polynomialCutoff.source: def polynomialCutoff (N c : ℕ) : ℕ := (c+1)*(Nat.log 2 N+1)

GraphChoices.polynomialCutoff_pos.source:
theorem polynomialCutoff_pos (N c : ℕ) : 0 < polynomialCutoff N c := by
  unfold polynomialCutoff
  positivity

GraphChoices.polynomialCutoff_power.source:
theorem polynomialCutoff_power (N c : ℕ) : N^(c+1) ≤ 2^polynomialCutoff N c := by
  have hN := (Nat.lt_pow_succ_log_self (by decide : 1 < 2) N).le
  calc
    _ ≤ (2^(Nat.log 2 N+1))^(c+1) := Nat.pow_le_pow_left hN _
    _ = _ := by rw [← pow_mul]; congr 1; unfold polynomialCutoff; ring

GraphChoices.geometric_tail_le_polynomia.source:
theorem geometric_tail_le_polynomial (N c k A : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (hA : A ≤ N)
    (hk : polynomialCutoff N c ≤ k) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hrsmall : r ≤ 1/2) :
    (A:ℝ)*r^k ≤ 1/(N:ℝ)^c := by
  have hNr : (0:ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN
  have hexp : (N:ℝ)^(c+1) ≤ (2:ℝ)^k := by
    exact_mod_cast (polynomialCutoff_power N c).trans (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide : 0 < 2) hk)
  calc
    _ ≤ (A:ℝ)*((1:ℝ)/2)^k := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_pow_left₀ hr hrsmall k) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    _ = (A:ℝ)/(2:ℝ)^k := by rw [div_pow]; ring
    _ ≤ (N:ℝ)/(2:ℝ)^k := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast hA) (by positivity)
    _ ≤ (N:ℝ)/(N:ℝ)^(c+1) := div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hNr.le (by positivity) hexp
    _ = _ := by rw [pow_succ]; field_simp

end GraphChoices

namespace GraphChoices.Patterns
open ThresholdGreedy
variable {E L R C : Type*} [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E] [Nonempty E]
  [Fintype L] [Fintype R] [Fintype C]
  [DecidableEq L] [DecidableEq R] [DecidableEq C]

/-- Conditional component shattering with exact cutoff and failure constant.
The source of the remaining coverage assumption is stated in the module header. -/

GraphChoices.Patterns.largeComponent_pol.source:
theorem largeComponent_polynomial_tail_of_coverage (H : C → Peeling.Graph L R)
    (encode : E → Arrival L R C) (α : C → ℕ) (T D k B N c : ℕ)
    (hN : 0 < N) (hL : Fintype.card L ≤ N) (hR : Fintype.card R ≤ N)
    (hD : polynomialCutoff N c ≤ D+1) (hk : polynomialCutoff N c ≤ k)
    (hmean : ∀ u, Real.exp 1*T*(((leftSourceBucket encode u).card : ℝ)/Fintype.card E)/(D+1) ≤ 1/2)
    (hcoverage : largeHeavyTreeEvent encode α T k ⊆ largeShapeEvent H encode α T k B)
    (hshape : ∀ j ≤ B, eventProbability (heavyShapeEvent H encode α T (k+j)) ≤
      (Fintype.card R : ℝ)/2^(k+j)) :
    eventProbability (largeComponentEvent encode α T ((D+1)*(k+1))) ≤ 3/(N:ℝ)^c := by
  have h := largeComponent_tail_of_canonical_coverage H encode α T D k B (1/2) hmean hcoverage hshape
  have hd := geometric_tail_le_polynomial N c (D+1) (Fintype.card L) hN hL hD (1/2) (by norm_num) le_rfl
  have hr := geometric_tail_le_polynomial N c k (Fintype.card R) hN hR hk (1/2) (by norm_num) le_rfl
  have heq : (Fintype.card R : ℝ)*((1:ℝ)/2)^k = (Fintype.card R : ℝ)/2^k := by
    rw [div_pow]; ring
  rw [heq] at hr
  calc
    _ ≤ _ := h
    _ = (Fintype.card L : ℝ)*((1:ℝ)/2)^(D+1) + 2*((Fintype.card R : ℝ)/2^k) := by ring
    _ ≤ 1/(N:ℝ)^c + 2*(1/(N:ℝ)^c) := add_le_add hd (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hr (by norm_num))
    _ = _ := by ring

/-- The fully explicit expectation reduction from a canonical-coverage proof.
No main competitive result is claimed while that premise remains open. -/

GraphChoices.Patterns.expected_load_poly.source:
theorem expected_load_polynomial_of_coverage (H : C → Peeling.Graph L R)
    (encode : E → Arrival L R C) (α : C → ℕ) (T D k B N c : ℕ)
    (hN : 0 < N) (hL : Fintype.card L ≤ N) (hR : Fintype.card R ≤ N)
    (hD : polynomialCutoff N c ≤ D+1) (hk : polynomialCutoff N c ≤ k)
    (hmean : ∀ u, Real.exp 1*T*(((leftSourceBucket encode u).card : ℝ)/Fintype.card E)/(D+1) ≤ 1/2)
    (hcoverage : largeHeavyTreeEvent encode α T k ⊆ largeShapeEvent H encode α T k B)
    (hshape : ∀ j ≤ B, eventProbability (heavyShapeEvent H encode α T (k+j)) ≤
      (Fintype.card R : ℝ)/2^(k+j)) :
    expectedTotalMaxLoad encode α T ≤ (∑ c, (α c : ℝ)) +
      (2*(Nat.log 2 ((D+1)*(k+1))+1) : ℕ)*expectedReplayOpt encode T +
      3*T/(N:ℝ)^c := by
  have ht := largeComponent_polynomial_tail_of_coverage H encode α T D k B N c hN hL hR hD hk
    hmean hcoverage hshape
  have h := expected_load_of_component_tail encode α T _ _ ht
  convert h using 1 <;> ring

end GraphChoices.Patterns

GraphChoices.Peeling.PreparedDecompositi.source:
structure PreparedDecomposition (G : Graph L R) (B N : ℕ) (d : ℝ) where
  pieces : List (Graph L R)
  count : pieces.length = numberRounds B
  disjoint : pieces.Pairwise Disjoint
  cover : unionPieces pieces = G
  positive_average : 0 < d
  large_log : 1 < Real.log (N:ℝ)
  average_cap : d ≤ 16*B
  global_cap : ∀ u, leftDegree G u ≤ 4*B
  preprocessing : ∀ u, (leftDegree G u : ℝ) ≤ d*Real.log (N:ℝ)
  left_bound : ∀ i : Fin pieces.length,
    (maxLeftDegree (pieces.get i) : ℝ) ≤ 16*B/(scaleNat i.val : ℝ)
  right_bound : ∀ i : Fin pieces.length,
    (maxRightDegree (pieces.get i) : ℝ) ≤
      16*B*((scaleNat i.val : ℝ)*Real.log (N:ℝ))^(2*graphLogSkewness G d (N:ℝ))

GraphChoices.Peeling.exists_preparedDeco.source:
theorem exists_preparedDecomposition (G : Graph L R) (B N : ℕ) (d : ℝ)
    (hd : 0 < d) (hN : 1 < Real.log (N:ℝ))
    (hleft : ∀ u, (leftDegree G u : ℝ) ≤ d*Real.log (N:ℝ))
    (hB : d ≤ 16*B) (hD : ∀ u, leftDegree G u ≤ 4*B) :
    Nonempty (PreparedDecomposition G B N d) := by
  obtain ⟨Ps, hlen, hdisj, hcover, hbounds⟩ := exists_skew_biregular_partition G B d (N:ℝ) hd hN hleft hB hD
  refine ⟨⟨Ps, hlen, hdisj, hcover, hd, hN, hB, hD, hleft, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · intro i
    exact maxLeftDegree_real_le _ _ (by positivity) (hbounds i).1
  · intro i
    exact maxRightDegree_real_le _ _ (by positivity) (hbounds i).2

variable {G : Graph L R} {B N : ℕ} {d : ℝ}

GraphChoices.Peeling.PreparedDecompositi.source:
noncomputable def PreparedDecomposition.encode (P : PreparedDecomposition G B N d) :
    G → Arrival L R (Fin P.pieces.length) := pieceEncode G P.pieces P.cover

def PreparedDecomposition.DL (P : PreparedDecomposition G B N d) (i : Fin P.pieces.length) : ℕ :=
  maxLeftDegree (P.pieces.get i)

def PreparedDecomposition.DR (P : PreparedDecomposition G B N d) (i : Fin P.pieces.length) : ℕ :=
  maxRightDegree (P.pieces.get i)

noncomputable def PreparedDecomposition.thresholds (P : PreparedDecomposition G B N d) (T : ℕ) :
    Fin P.pieces.length → ℕ :=
  automaticThresholds (E := G) P.DL P.DR (4*B) T (fun i => scaleNat i.val)

GraphChoices.Peeling.graphBase.source:
def graphBase (G : Graph L R) : BaseGraph (L ⊕ R) G where
  left e := Sum.inl e.val.1
  right e := Sum.inr e.val.2

GraphChoices.Peeling.PreparedDecompositi.source:
noncomputable def PreparedDecomposition.policy (P : PreparedDecomposition G B N d) (T : ℕ) : OnlinePolicy G :=
  thresholdPolicy P.encode (P.thresholds T)

noncomputable def PreparedDecomposition.budget (P : PreparedDecomposition G B N d) (T : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  P.pieces.length*(16*Real.exp 1*B*((T:ℝ)/Fintype.card G)+2*graphLogSkewness G d (N:ℝ)+2) +
    (Real.log (16*B*((T:ℝ)/Fintype.card G)/branchTarget (4*B) P.pieces.length ((T:ℝ)/Fintype.card G)) +
      2*graphLogSkewness G d (N:ℝ)*Real.log (Real.log (N:ℝ)))/Real.log 2

theorem PreparedDecomposition.source (P : PreparedDecomposition G B N d) :
    ∀ e, ((P.encode e).left, (P.encode e).right) ∈ P.pieces.get (P.encode e).cls :=
  pieceEncode_source G P.pieces P.cover

theorem PreparedDecomposition.simple (P : PreparedDecomposition G B N d) :
    Function.Injective fun e => ((P.encode e).left, (P.encode e).right) :=
  pieceEncode_simple G P.pieces P.cover

theorem PreparedDecomposition.bucket_bound (P : PreparedDecomposition G B N d) (u : L) (i : Fin P.pieces.length) :
    (sourceBucket P.encode u i).card ≤ P.DL i :=
  (piece_sourceBucket_card_le G P.pieces P.cover u i).trans (leftDegree_le_max _ _)

theorem PreparedDecomposition.global_bucket_bound (P : PreparedDecomposition G B N d) (u : L) :
    (leftSourceBucket P.encode u).card ≤ maxLeftDegree G :=
  (piece_leftSourceBucket_card_le G P.pieces P.cover u).trans (leftDegree_le_max _ _)

theorem PreparedDecomposition.piece_left_cap (P : PreparedDecomposition G B N d) (i : Fin P.pieces.length) (u : L) :
    leftDegree (P.pieces.get i) u ≤ 4*B :=
  (leftDegree_le_max _ _).trans ((piece_maxLeftDegree_le G P.pieces P.cover i).trans (maxLeftDegree_le G _ P.global_cap))

theorem PreparedDecomposition.piece_right_cap (P : PreparedDecomposition G B N d) (i : Fin P.pieces.length) (v : R) :
    rightDegree (P.pieces.get i) v ≤ P.DR i := rightDegree_le_max _ _

theorem PreparedDecomposition.max_degree_preprocessing (P : PreparedDecomposition G B N d) :
    (maxLeftDegree G : ℝ) ≤ d*Real.log (N:ℝ) :=
  maxLeftDegree_real_le G _ (mul_nonneg P.positive_average.le (by linarith [P.large_log])) P.preprocessing

theorem PreparedDecomposition.vertex_count_pos (P : PreparedDecomposition G B N d) : 0 < N := by
  have h := P.large_log
  by_contra hn
  have hz : N = 0 := by omega
  norm_num [hz] at h

theorem PreparedDecomposition.scale_gt_one (P : PreparedDecomposition G B N d) (i : Fin P.pieces.length) :
    (1:ℝ) < scaleNat i.val := by
  have hh := scaleNat_ge_two i.val
  exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1 < scaleNat i.val)

variable [Nonempty G]

theorem PreparedDecomposition.class_count_pos (P : PreparedDecomposition G B N d) : 0 < P.pieces.length := by
  simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using class_card_pos P.encode

theorem PreparedDecomposition.reference_cap_pos (P : PreparedDecomposition G B N d) : 0 < B := by
  classical
  let e : G := Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty G)
  have hmem : e.val.2 ∈ leftNeighbors G e.val.1 := by simpa [leftNeighbors] using e.property
  have hp : 0 < leftDegree G e.val.1 := card_pos.mpr ⟨e.val.2, hmem⟩
  have hc := P.global_cap e.val.1
  omega

theorem PreparedDecomposition.threshold_budget (P : PreparedDecomposition G B N d) (T : ℕ)
    (hmass : 1 ≤ 16*(B:ℝ)*((T:ℝ)/Fintype.card G)) :
    (∑ i, (P.thresholds T i : ℝ)) ≤ P.budget T := by
  exact automaticThresholds_budget P.pieces.length (4*B) T P.DL P.DR (B:ℝ)
    (Real.log (N:ℝ)) (graphLogSkewness G d (N:ℝ)) P.class_count_pos
    (by exact_mod_cast P.reference_cap_pos) P.large_log.le (graphLogSkewness_nonneg G d (N:ℝ))
    hmass P.left_bound P.right_bound

theorem PreparedDecomposition.mass_at_vertex_horizon (P : PreparedDecomposition G B N d)
    (haverage : 2*(G.card : ℝ) = (N:ℝ)*d) :
    1 ≤ 16*(B:ℝ)*((N:ℝ)/Fintype.card G) := by
  have hE : (0:ℝ) < Fintype.card G := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
  rw [← mul_div_assoc]
  apply (le_div_iff₀ hE).mpr
  have hp := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left P.average_cap (Nat.cast_nonneg N : (0:ℝ) ≤ N)
  have heq : (Fintype.card G : ℝ) = G.card := by rw [Fintype.card_coe]
  rw [heq]
  nlinarith

end GraphChoices.Peeling

GraphChoices.Peeling.graph_card_le_squar.source:
theorem graph_card_le_square (G : Graph L R) (N : ℕ)
    (hvertices : Fintype.card (L ⊕ R) ≤ N) : G.card ≤ N^2 := by
  have hsum : Fintype.card L + Fintype.card R ≤ N := by simpa only [Fintype.card_sum] using hvertices
  have hL : Fintype.card L ≤ N := by omega
  have hR : Fintype.card R ≤ N := by omega
  calc
    _ ≤ Fintype.card (L × R) := card_le_card (subset_univ _)
    _ = Fintype.card L*Fintype.card R := Fintype.card_prod _ _
    _ ≤ N*N := Nat.mul_le_mul hL hR
    _ = _ := by ring

GraphChoices.Peeling.average_le_two_refe.source:
theorem average_le_two_referenceCap (G : Graph L R) [Nonempty G] (N : ℕ) (d : ℝ)
    (hN : 0 < N) (hvertices : Fintype.card (L ⊕ R) ≤ N)
    (haverage : 2*(G.card : ℝ) = (N:ℝ)*d) : d ≤ 2*(graphBase G).referenceCap := by
  have hNr : (0:ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN
  have hcard : (Fintype.card (L ⊕ R) : ℝ) ≤ N := by exact_mod_cast hvertices
  have he := (graphBase G).total_edges_le_card_mul_referenceCap
  rw [Fintype.card_coe] at he
  have hcap : (0:ℝ) ≤ (graphBase G).referenceCap := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  have hbound := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcard hcap
  apply (mul_le_mul_left hNr).mp
  nlinarith

variable {G : Graph L R} {B N : ℕ} {d : ℝ} [Nonempty G]

GraphChoices.Peeling.PreparedDecompositi.source:
theorem PreparedDecomposition.reference_cap_le_square (P : PreparedDecomposition G B N d)
    (hB : B = (graphBase G).referenceCap) (hvertices : Fintype.card (L ⊕ R) ≤ N) : B ≤ N^2 := by
  have he : B ≤ G.card := by
    rw [hB]
    simpa only [Fintype.card_coe] using (graphBase G).referenceCap_le_edges
  exact he.trans (graph_card_le_square G N hvertices)

theorem PreparedDecomposition.reference_density_bound (P : PreparedDecomposition G B N d)
    (hB : B = (graphBase G).referenceCap) :
    (B:ℝ)*((N:ℝ)/Fintype.card G) ≤ 3*expectedOpt (graphBase G) N := by
  rw [hB]
  exact expected_reference_cap_bound (graphBase G) N

/-- A fully quantified preprocessed guarantee with explicit universal constant.
No lower bound on log-skewness is assumed: it remains visibly additive to
the expected optimum on the right-hand side. -/

theorem PreparedDecomposition.expected_cost_density_skew (P : PreparedDecomposition G B N d)
    (hB : B = (graphBase G).referenceCap) (hvertices : Fintype.card (L ⊕ R) ≤ N)
    (haverage : 2*(G.card : ℝ) = (N:ℝ)*d) :
    expectedCost (graphBase G) (onlineOrientation (T := N) (P.policy N)) ≤
      1400*(iteratedLog N : ℝ)*(expectedOpt (graphBase G) N+graphLogSkewness G d (N:ℝ)) := by
  let q : ℝ := iteratedLog N
  let optE : ℝ := expectedOpt (graphBase G) N
  let σ : ℝ := graphLogSkewness G d (N:ℝ)
  have hq : 1 ≤ q := by
    change (1:ℝ) ≤ (iteratedLog N : ℝ)
    exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ iteratedLog N by have := iteratedLog_pos N; omega)
  have hopt : 1 ≤ optE := expectedOpt_ge_one _ _ P.vertex_count_pos
  have hs : 0 ≤ σ := graphLogSkewness_nonneg G d (N:ℝ)
  have hM := P.reference_density_bound hB
  have hbudget := P.budget_loglog (P.reference_cap_le_square hB hvertices) haverage
  have hbudget' : P.budget N ≤ 320*(4*optE+σ)*q := by
    apply hbudget.trans
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (by linarith)
    dsimp only [optE, σ]
    nlinarith
  have hcoeff : ((2*(Nat.log 2 (3*(polynomialCutoff N 5+1)^2)+1) : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ 20*q := by
    change ((2*(Nat.log 2 (3*(polynomialCutoff N 5+1)^2)+1) : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ 20*(iteratedLog N : ℝ)
    exact_mod_cast greedy_multiplier_le_iteratedLog N
  have hgreedy := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcoeff (show 0 ≤ optE by linarith)
  have hprod : 1 ≤ q*optE := by nlinarith
  have herror : 3*(N:ℝ)/(N:ℝ)^5 ≤ 3*q*optE := by
    apply (exceptional_error_le_three N P.vertex_count_pos).trans
    nlinarith
  have hcost := P.expected_cost_at_vertex_horizon 5 (by decide) hvertices haverage
  calc
    _ ≤ _ := hcost
    _ ≤ 320*(4*optE+σ)*q + (20*q)*optE + 3*q*optE :=
      add_le_add (add_le_add hbudget' hgreedy) herror
    _ ≤ _ := by nlinarith [mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ q by linarith) hs,
      mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ q by linarith) (show 0 ≤ optE by linarith)]

/-- Explicitly conditional corollary: the log-skewness benchmark comparison
is still an input here, rather than a postulated or claimed proved lemma. -/

theorem PreparedDecomposition.competitive_of_skew_lower_bound (P : PreparedDecomposition G B N d)
    (hB : B = (graphBase G).referenceCap) (hvertices : Fintype.card (L ⊕ R) ≤ N)
    (haverage : 2*(G.card : ℝ) = (N:ℝ)*d) (K : ℝ)
    (hskew : graphLogSkewness G d (N:ℝ) ≤ K*expectedOpt (graphBase G) N) :
    expectedCost (graphBase G) (onlineOrientation (T := N) (P.policy N)) ≤
      1400*(1+K)*(iteratedLog N : ℝ)*expectedOpt (graphBase G) N := by
  apply (P.expected_cost_density_skew hB hvertices haverage).trans
  calc
    _ ≤ 1400*(iteratedLog N : ℝ)*(expectedOpt (graphBase G) N+K*expectedOpt (graphBase G) N) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (add_le_add_left hskew _) (by positivity)
    _ = _ := by ring

GraphChoices.Peeling.exists_preprocessed.source:
theorem exists_preprocessed_density_skew_policy (G : Graph L R) [Nonempty G] (N : ℕ) (d : ℝ)
    (hd : 0 < d) (hlog : 1 < Real.log (N:ℝ))
    (hleft : ∀ u, (leftDegree G u : ℝ) ≤ d*Real.log (N:ℝ))
    (hD : ∀ u, leftDegree G u ≤ 4*(graphBase G).referenceCap)
    (hvertices : Fintype.card (L ⊕ R) ≤ N)
    (haverage : 2*(G.card : ℝ) = (N:ℝ)*d) :
    ∃ p : OnlinePolicy G, expectedCost (graphBase G) (onlineOrientation (T := N) p) ≤
      1400*(iteratedLog N : ℝ)*(expectedOpt (graphBase G) N+graphLogSkewness G d (N:ℝ)) := by
  have hN : 0 < N := by
    by_contra hn
    have hz : N = 0 := by omega
    norm_num [hz] at hlog
  have hcap := average_le_two_referenceCap G N d hN hvertices haverage
  have hB : d ≤ 16*(graphBase G).referenceCap := by
    have hp : (0:ℝ) ≤ (graphBase G).referenceCap := Nat.cast_nonneg _
    linarith
  obtain ⟨P⟩ := exists_preparedDecomposition G (graphBase G).referenceCap N d hd hlog hleft hB hD
  exact ⟨P.policy N, P.expected_cost_density_skew rfl hvertices haverage⟩

end GraphChoices.Peeling

GraphChoices.loglogFactor_ge_one.source:
theorem loglogFactor_ge_one (N : ℕ) : 1 ≤ loglogFactor N := by
  unfold loglogFactor
  have hh : 0 ≤ Real.log (max 2 (N:ℝ)) := Real.log_nonneg (by have := le_max_left (2:ℝ) (N:ℝ); linarith)
  have hh' : 0 ≤ Real.log (1+Real.log (max 2 (N:ℝ))) := Real.log_nonneg (by linarith)
  linarith

GraphChoices.small_log_vertex_bound.source:
theorem small_log_vertex_bound (N : ℕ) (hlog : Real.log (N:ℝ) < 2) : N ≤ 8 := by
  by_cases hN : N = 0
  · omega
  have hNr : (0:ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hN
  have hh := Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr hlog
  rw [Real.exp_log hNr] at hh
  have he : Real.exp 2 = (Real.exp 1)^2 := by simpa using Real.exp_nat_mul 1 2
  have he3 : Real.exp 1 < 3 := by linarith [Real.exp_one_lt_d9]
  have hepos := Real.exp_pos 1
  have he9 : (Real.exp 1)^2 < 9 := by nlinarith
  have hn9 : (N:ℝ) < 9 := by rw [he] at hh; linarith
  have hn : N < 9 := by exact_mod_cast hn9
  omega

GraphChoices.expectedCost_le_horizon.source:
theorem expectedCost_le_horizon {V E : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    [Fintype E] [Nonempty E] (G : BaseGraph V E) (T : ℕ)
    (a : (Fin T → E) → Orientation T) : expectedCost G a ≤ T := by
  rw [← average_const (Ω := Fin T → E) (T:ℝ)]
  apply average_mono
  intro ω
  exact_mod_cast maxLoad_le_length (G.sample ω) (a ω)

end GraphChoices

namespace GraphChoices.Peeling
variable {L R : Type*} [Fintype L] [Fintype R] [DecidableEq L] [DecidableEq R]
  {G : Graph L R} {B N : ℕ} {d : ℝ} [Nonempty G]

/-- The constructed Threshold-Greedy policy is O(log log N)-competitive
under the graph preprocessing conditions, with no unproved skewness premise. -/

GraphChoices.Peeling.PreparedDecompositi.source:
theorem PreparedDecomposition.expected_cost_competitive (P : PreparedDecomposition G B N d)
    (hB : B = (graphBase G).referenceCap) (hvertices : Fintype.card (L ⊕ R) ≤ N)
    (haverage : 2*(G.card:ℝ) = (N:ℝ)*d) :
    expectedCost (graphBase G) (onlineOrientation (T := N) (P.policy N)) ≤
      37800*loglogFactor N*expectedOpt (graphBase G) N := by
  have hfactor := loglogFactor_ge_one N
  by_cases hlog : 2 ≤ Real.log (N:ℝ)
  · have hs := graphLogSkewness_le_eight_expectedOpt G N d P.positive_average hlog
      P.preprocessing hvertices haverage
    have hh := P.real_competitive_of_skew_lower_bound hB hvertices haverage 8 hs
    norm_num at hh
    exact hh
  · have hN8 := small_log_vertex_bound N (lt_of_not_ge hlog)
    have hopt := expectedOpt_ge_one (graphBase G) N P.vertex_count_pos
    apply (expectedCost_le_horizon (graphBase G) N _).trans
    have hNr : (N:ℝ) ≤ 8 := by exact_mod_cast hN8
    have hh : 1 ≤ loglogFactor N*expectedOpt (graphBase G) N := by nlinarith
    nlinarith

/-- A graph-level competitive theorem at T=N. The remaining assumptions
are solely concrete preprocessing, vertex-count and average-degree facts. -/

GraphChoices.Peeling.exists_preprocessed.source:
theorem exists_preprocessed_competitive_policy (G : Graph L R) [Nonempty G]
    (N : ℕ) (d : ℝ) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hleft : ∀ u, (leftDegree G u:ℝ) ≤ d*Real.log (N:ℝ))
    (hD : ∀ u, leftDegree G u ≤ 4*(graphBase G).referenceCap)
    (hvertices : Fintype.card (L ⊕ R) ≤ N)
    (haverage : 2*(G.card:ℝ) = (N:ℝ)*d) :
    ∃ p : OnlinePolicy G, expectedCost (graphBase G) (onlineOrientation (T := N) p) ≤
      37800*loglogFactor N*expectedOpt (graphBase G) N := by
  have hN : 0 < N := by
    have hm : (0:ℝ) < G.card := by
      have hh : 0 < G.card := by simpa only [← Fintype.card_coe] using Fintype.card_pos (α := G)
      exact_mod_cast hh
    by_contra h
    have hz : N = 0 := by omega
    simp only [hz, Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul] at haverage
    linarith
  by_cases hlog : 2 ≤ Real.log (N:ℝ)
  · have hlog1 : 1 < Real.log (N:ℝ) := by linarith
    have hcap := average_le_two_referenceCap G N d hN hvertices haverage
    have hB : d ≤ 16*(graphBase G).referenceCap := by
      have hh : (0:ℝ) ≤ (graphBase G).referenceCap := Nat.cast_nonneg _
      linarith
    obtain ⟨P⟩ := exists_preparedDecomposition G (graphBase G).referenceCap N d hd hlog1 hleft hB hD
    exact ⟨P.policy N, P.expected_cost_competitive rfl hvertices haverage⟩
  · refine ⟨fun _ _ => false, (expectedCost_le_horizon (graphBase G) N _).trans ?_⟩
    have hN8 : (N:ℝ) ≤ 8 := by exact_mod_cast small_log_vertex_bound N (lt_of_not_ge hlog)
    have hopt := expectedOpt_ge_one (graphBase G) N hN
    have hfactor := loglogFactor_ge_one N
    have hh : 1 ≤ loglogFactor N*expectedOpt (graphBase G) N := by nlinarith
    nlinarith

end GraphChoices.Peeling

GraphChoices.Patterns.real_log_le_nat_lo.source:
theorem real_log_le_nat_log_shift (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) :
    Real.log (N:ℝ) ≤ (Nat.log 2 N+1 : ℕ) := by
  have hNr : (0:ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN
  have hp : (N:ℝ) ≤ (2:ℝ)^(Nat.log 2 N+1) := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.lt_pow_succ_log_self (by decide : 1 < 2) N).le
  have hlog := Real.log_le_log hNr hp
  rw [Real.log_pow] at hlog
  have htwo : Real.log 2 ≤ 1 := by
    have hh := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 2)
    linarith
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htwo (Nat.cast_nonneg (Nat.log 2 N+1) : (0:ℝ) ≤ (Nat.log 2 N+1 : ℕ))
  exact hlog.trans (by simpa using hmul)

GraphChoices.Patterns.preprocessing_mean.source:
theorem preprocessing_mean_bound (M T N E : ℕ) (d : ℝ)
    (hE : 0 < E) (hT : T ≤ N)
    (hdegree : (M:ℝ) ≤ d*Real.log (N:ℝ))
    (haverage : 2*(E:ℝ) = (N:ℝ)*d) :
    (T:ℝ)*M/E ≤ 2*Real.log (N:ℝ) := by
  have hEr : (0:ℝ) < E := by exact_mod_cast hE
  apply (div_le_iff₀ hEr).mpr
  calc
    (T:ℝ)*M ≤ (N:ℝ)*M := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast hT) (Nat.cast_nonneg M)
    _ ≤ (N:ℝ)*(d*Real.log (N:ℝ)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdegree (Nat.cast_nonneg N)
    _ = (2*(E:ℝ))*Real.log (N:ℝ) := by rw [haverage]; ring
    _ = _ := by ring

GraphChoices.Patterns.preprocessed_mean_.source:
theorem preprocessed_mean_below_cutoff (N c : ℕ) (μ : ℝ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (hc : 5 ≤ c) (hμ : 0 ≤ μ) (hmean : μ ≤ 2*Real.log (N:ℝ)) :
    Real.exp 1*μ ≤ (polynomialCutoff N c : ℝ) := by
  have he : Real.exp 1 ≤ 3 := by linarith [Real.exp_one_lt_d9]
  have hlog := real_log_le_nat_log_shift N hN
  have hc' : (6:ℝ) ≤ (c:ℝ)+1 := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 6 ≤ c+1)
  calc
    _ ≤ 3*μ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right he hμ
    _ ≤ 3*(2*Real.log (N:ℝ)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmean (by norm_num)
    _ ≤ 6*(Nat.log 2 N+1 : ℕ) := by linarith
    _ ≤ ((c:ℝ)+1)*(Nat.log 2 N+1 : ℕ) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc' (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    _ = _ := by simp only [polynomialCutoff, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]

open ThresholdGreedy
variable {E L R C : Type*} [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E] [Nonempty E]
  [Fintype L] [Fintype R] [Fintype C]
  [DecidableEq L] [DecidableEq R] [DecidableEq C]

/-- Finite form of the component-shattering lemma in the preprocessed regime.
All coverage and sampling-tail premises are proved, including the source mean. -/

GraphChoices.Patterns.preprocessed_log_s.source:
theorem preprocessed_log_squared_component_tail (H : C → Peeling.Graph L R)
    (encode : E → Arrival L R C) (DL DR : C → ℕ) (D M T N c : ℕ) (f : C → ℝ) (d : ℝ)
    (hsimple : Function.Injective fun e => ((encode e).left,(encode e).right))
    (hsource : ∀ e, ((encode e).left, (encode e).right) ∈ H (encode e).cls)
    (hDL : ∀ u a, (sourceBucket encode u a).card ≤ DL a)
    (hL : ∀ a u, Peeling.leftDegree (H a) u ≤ D)
    (hR : ∀ a v, Peeling.rightDegree (H a) v ≤ DR a)
    (hM : ∀ u, (leftSourceBucket encode u).card ≤ M)
    (hT : 0 < T) (hTN : T ≤ N) (hf : ∀ a, 1 < f a)
    (hN : 0 < N) (hLN : Fintype.card L ≤ N) (hRN : Fintype.card R ≤ N)
    (hc : 5 ≤ c) (hdegree : (M:ℝ) ≤ d*Real.log (N:ℝ))
    (haverage : 2*(Fintype.card E : ℝ) = (N:ℝ)*d) :
    eventProbability (largeComponentEvent encode (automaticThresholds (E := E) DL DR D T f)
      T (3*(polynomialCutoff N c+1)^2)) ≤ 3/(N:ℝ)^c := by
  apply log_squared_component_tail H encode DL DR D M T N c f hsimple hsource hDL hL hR hM hT hf hN hLN hRN
  have hmean := preprocessing_mean_bound M T N (Fintype.card E) d Fintype.card_pos hTN hdegree haverage
  have hbound := preprocessed_mean_below_cutoff N c ((T:ℝ)*M/Fintype.card E) hN hc (by positivity) hmean
  convert hbound using 1 <;> ring

end GraphChoices.Patterns

GraphChoices.BaseGraph.split.source:
def BaseGraph.split (G : BaseGraph V E) (b : E → Bool) : BaseGraph (V ⊕ V) E where
  left e := Sum.inl (if b e then G.left e else G.right e)
  right e := Sum.inr (if b e then G.right e else G.left e)

omit [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E] [Nonempty E] in

GraphChoices.split_sample.source:
theorem split_sample (G : BaseGraph V E) (b : E → Bool) (ω : Fin T → E) :
    (G.split b).sample ω = splitInstance (G.sample ω) (fun t => b (ω t)) := by
  apply Instance.ext <;> funext t
  · rfl
  · cases h : b (ω t) <;>
      simp [BaseGraph.split, BaseGraph.sample, splitInstance, destination, flip, h]

omit [DecidableEq E] [Nonempty E] in

GraphChoices.split_expectedOpt_le.source:
theorem split_expectedOpt_le (G : BaseGraph V E) (b : E → Bool) (T : ℕ) :
    expectedOpt (G.split b) T ≤ expectedOpt G T := by
  apply average_mono
  intro ω
  rw [split_sample]
  exact_mod_cast split_opt_le (G.sample ω) (fun t => b (ω t))

omit [DecidableEq E] [Nonempty E] in

GraphChoices.expectedOpt_le_two_split.source:
theorem expectedOpt_le_two_split (G : BaseGraph V E) (b : E → Bool) (T : ℕ) :
    expectedOpt G T ≤ 2 * expectedOpt (G.split b) T := by
  unfold expectedOpt
  rw [← average_mul]
  apply average_mono
  intro ω
  rw [split_sample]
  exact_mod_cast opt_le_two_split_opt (G.sample ω) (fun t => b (ω t))

/-- Expected maximum load of a policy. This definition also permits policies
that see the future; applications must separately establish nonanticipation. -/

GraphChoices.expectedCost.source:
noncomputable def expectedCost (G : BaseGraph V E) (a : (Fin T → E) → Orientation T) : ℝ :=
  average (fun ω => (maxLoad (G.sample ω) (a ω) : ℝ))

GraphChoices.expected_competitive_transf.source:
theorem expected_competitive_transfer (G : BaseGraph V E) (b : E → Bool)
    (a : (Fin T → E) → Orientation T) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hcost : expectedCost (G.split b) a ≤ c * expectedOpt (G.split b) T) :
    expectedCost G (fun ω => transport (fun t => b (ω t)) (a ω)) ≤
      (2*c) * expectedOpt G T := by
  have hcollapse : expectedCost G (fun ω => transport (fun t => b (ω t)) (a ω)) ≤
      2 * expectedCost (G.split b) a := by
    unfold expectedCost
    rw [← average_mul]
    apply average_mono
    intro ω
    rw [split_sample]
    exact_mod_cast collapse_maxLoad_le (G.sample ω) (fun t => b (ω t)) (a ω)
  calc
    _ ≤ 2 * expectedCost (G.split b) a := hcollapse
    _ ≤ 2 * (c * expectedOpt (G.split b) T) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcost (by norm_num)
    _ ≤ 2 * (c * expectedOpt G T) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (split_expectedOpt_le G b T) hc) (by norm_num)
    _ = _ := by ring

/-- An actual reference orientation with maximum left degree ceil(rho*).
The index set here is an arbitrary finite sequence of base-edge occurrences. -/

GraphChoices.exists_left_degree_bounded_.source:
theorem exists_left_degree_bounded_split (I : Instance V T) :
    ∃ b : Orientation T, ∀ u : V,
      (univ.filter fun t => (splitInstance I b).left t = Sum.inl u).card ≤ ⌈maxDensity I⌉₊ := by
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := exists_exact_opt I
  refine ⟨b, ?_⟩
  intro u
  have h := load_le_maxLoad I b u
  rw [hb, opt_eq_ceil_maxDensity] at h
  simpa [splitInstance, load] using h

end GraphChoices

GraphChoices.RandomGreedy.target.source:
def target (G : BaseGraph V E) (s : V → ℕ) (x : E × Bool) : V :=
  if choice G s x then G.left x.1 else G.right x.1

GraphChoices.RandomGreedy.step.source:
def step (G : BaseGraph V E) (s : V → ℕ) (x : E × Bool) : V → ℕ :=
  fun v => s v + if target G s x = v then 1 else 0

GraphChoices.RandomGreedy.run.source:
def run (G : BaseGraph V E) (xs : List (E × Bool)) : V → ℕ :=
  xs.foldl (step G) (fun _ => 0)

GraphChoices.RandomGreedy.policy.source: def policy (G : BaseGraph V E) : OnlinePolicy (E × Bool) := fun history x => choice G (run G history) x

GraphChoices.RandomGreedy.coinGraph.source:
def coinGraph (G : BaseGraph V E) : BaseGraph V (E × Bool) where
  left x := G.left x.1
  right x := G.right x.1

GraphChoices.RandomGreedy.state.source:
def state (G : BaseGraph V E) {T : ℕ} (ω : Fin T → E × Bool) (k : ℕ) : V → ℕ :=
  run G ((List.ofFn ω).take k)

GraphChoices.RandomGreedy.run_append.source:
theorem run_append (G : BaseGraph V E) (xs : List (E × Bool)) (x : E × Bool) :
    run G (xs ++ [x]) = step G (run G xs) x := by simp only [run, List.foldl_append, List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_nil]

GraphChoices.RandomGreedy.state_zero.source:
theorem state_zero (G : BaseGraph V E) {T : ℕ} (ω : Fin T → E × Bool) (v : V) : state G ω 0 v = 0 := by
  simp only [state, List.take_zero, run, List.foldl_nil]

GraphChoices.RandomGreedy.state_step.source:
theorem state_step (G : BaseGraph V E) {T : ℕ} (ω : Fin T → E × Bool) (t : Fin T) (v : V) :
    state G ω (t.val+1) v = state G ω t.val v +
      if destination ((coinGraph G).sample ω) (onlineOrientation (policy G) ω) t = v then 1 else 0 := by
  have ht : t.val < (List.ofFn ω).length := by simpa using t.isLt
  simp only [state, List.take_succ_eq_append_getElem ht, run_append, step,
    List.getElem_ofFn, destination, BaseGraph.sample, coinGraph, onlineOrientation, policy, target]

GraphChoices.RandomGreedy.state_eq_prefi.source:
theorem state_eq_prefixLoad (G : BaseGraph V E) {T : ℕ} (ω : Fin T → E × Bool)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ T) (v : V) :
    state G ω k v = prefixLoad ((coinGraph G).sample ω) (onlineOrientation (policy G) ω) k v :=
  execution_counts_prefix _ _ _ (state_zero G ω) (state_step G ω) k hk v

GraphChoices.RandomGreedy.state_mono.source:
theorem state_mono (G : BaseGraph V E) {T : ℕ} (ω : Fin T → E × Bool)
    {a b : ℕ} (hab : a ≤ b) (hb : b ≤ T) (v : V) : state G ω a v ≤ state G ω b v := by
  rw [state_eq_prefixLoad G ω a (hab.trans hb), state_eq_prefixLoad G ω b hb]
  apply card_le_card
  intro t ht
  simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and] at ht ⊢
  exact ⟨by omega,ht.2⟩

GraphChoices.RandomGreedy.choice_favours.source:
theorem choice_favours_left (G : BaseGraph V E) (s : V → ℕ) (x : E × Bool)
    (hcoin : x.2 = true) (hload : s (G.left x.1) ≤ s (G.right x.1)) : choice G s x = true := by
  unfold choice
  split_ifs with h1 h2
  · rfl
  · omega
  · exact hcoin

GraphChoices.RandomGreedy.policy_isGreed.source:
theorem policy_isGreedy (G : BaseGraph V E) {T : ℕ} (ω : Fin T → E × Bool) :
    IsGreedy ((coinGraph G).sample ω) (onlineOrientation (policy G) ω) := by
  apply isGreedy_of_execution _ _ _ (state_zero G ω) (state_step G ω)
  intro t v hv
  change v = G.left (ω t).1 ∨ v = G.right (ω t).1 at hv
  change state G ω t.val (target G (state G ω t.val) (ω t)) ≤ state G ω t.val v
  by_cases h1 : state G ω t.val (G.left (ω t).1) < state G ω t.val (G.right (ω t).1)
  · simp only [target, choice, if_pos h1, ↓reduceIte]
    rcases hv with rfl | rfl <;> omega
  · by_cases h2 : state G ω t.val (G.right (ω t).1) < state G ω t.val (G.left (ω t).1)
    · simp only [target, choice, if_neg h1, if_pos h2, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
      rcases hv with rfl | rfl <;> omega
    · simp only [target, choice, if_neg h1, if_neg h2]
      split <;> rcases hv with rfl | rfl <;> omega

variable [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E] [Nonempty E]

GraphChoices.RandomGreedy.expectedLoad.source:
noncomputable def expectedLoad (G : BaseGraph V E) (T : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  expectedCost (coinGraph G) (onlineOrientation (T := T) (policy G))

end GraphChoices.RandomGreedy

GraphChoices.Peeling.rateReference.source:
noncomputable def rateReference (G : Graph L R) (d : ℝ) : ℕ :=
  (graphBase G).referenceCap+⌈d/16⌉₊

GraphChoices.Peeling.rateReference_bound.source:
theorem rateReference_bounds (G : Graph L R) [Nonempty G] (N T : ℕ) (d : ℝ)
    (hT : 0 < T) (hd : 0 < d) (hvertices : Fintype.card (L ⊕ R) ≤ N)
    (haverage : 2*(G.card:ℝ) = (T:ℝ)*d) :
    d ≤ 16*(rateReference G d:ℝ) ∧ rateReference G d ≤ N^2 ∧
      (rateReference G d:ℝ)*((T:ℝ)/G.card) ≤ 6*expectedOpt (graphBase G) T := by
  have hTr : (1:ℝ) ≤ T := by exact_mod_cast hT
  have hM : (0:ℝ) < G.card := by
    exact_mod_cast (show 0 < G.card by simpa only [← Fintype.card_coe] using Fintype.card_pos (α := G))
  have hdM : d ≤ 2*(G.card:ℝ) := by nlinarith
  have hceilM : ⌈d/16⌉₊ ≤ G.card := Nat.ceil_le.mpr (by linarith)
