  have hbaseM : (graphBase G).referenceCap ≤ G.card := by simpa only [Fintype.card_coe] using (graphBase G).referenceCap_le_edges
  have hBM : rateReference G d ≤ 2*G.card := by unfold rateReference; omega
  have hMprod : G.card ≤ Fintype.card L*Fintype.card R := by simpa only [Fintype.card_prod] using card_le_univ G
  have hsum : Fintype.card L+Fintype.card R ≤ N := by simpa only [Fintype.card_sum] using hvertices
  have hM2 : 2*G.card ≤ N^2 := by nlinarith [Nat.mul_self_le_mul_self hsum]
  have hc := Nat.le_ceil (d/16)
  have hcap : d ≤ 16*(rateReference G d:ℝ) := by
    unfold rateReference
    push_cast
    have hbase : (0:ℝ) ≤ (graphBase G).referenceCap := Nat.cast_nonneg _
    linarith
  refine ⟨hcap, hBM.trans hM2, ?_⟩
  have hceil : (⌈d/16⌉₊:ℝ) ≤ d/16+1 := (Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (by linarith : 0 ≤ d/16)).le
  have hz : 0 ≤ (T:ℝ)/G.card := by positivity
  have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hceil hz
  have heq : (d/16)*((T:ℝ)/G.card) = 1/8 := by
    apply (eq_div_iff (by norm_num : (8:ℝ) ≠ 0)).mpr
    field_simp
    nlinarith
  have hb := expected_reference_cap_bound (graphBase G) T
  have he := expected_edge_rate_le_two_opt (graphBase G) T
  rw [Fintype.card_coe] at hb he
  have ho := expectedOpt_ge_one (graphBase G) T hT
  unfold rateReference
  push_cast
  rw [add_mul]
  nlinarith

GraphChoices.Peeling.exists_rate_competi.source:
theorem exists_rate_competitive_policy (G : Graph L R) [Nonempty G] (N T : ℕ) (d : ℝ)
    (hT : 0 < T) (hd : 0 < d) (hlog : 2 ≤ Real.log (N:ℝ))
    (hlogT : Real.log (N:ℝ) ≤ T) (hTN : T ≤ N)
    (hleft : ∀ u, (leftDegree G u:ℝ) ≤ d*Real.log (N:ℝ))
    (hD : ∀ u, leftDegree G u ≤ 4*(graphBase G).referenceCap)
    (hvertices : Fintype.card (L ⊕ R) ≤ N)
    (haverage : 2*(G.card:ℝ) = (T:ℝ)*d) :
    ∃ p : OnlinePolicy G, expectedCost (graphBase G) (onlineOrientation (T := T) p) ≤
      15000*loglogFactor N*expectedOpt (graphBase G) T := by
  obtain ⟨hcap,hBsquare,hBmean⟩ := rateReference_bounds G N T d hT hd hvertices haverage
  have hBbase : (graphBase G).referenceCap ≤ rateReference G d := by unfold rateReference; omega
  obtain ⟨P⟩ := exists_preparedDecomposition G (rateReference G d) N d hd (by linarith) hleft hcap
    (fun u => (hD u).trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 4 hBbase))
  refine ⟨P.policy T, ?_⟩
  have hh := P.expected_cost_horizon T hT hTN hvertices haverage hBsquare
  have hs := graphLogSkewness_le_eight_expectedOpt_horizon G N T d hd hlog hlogT hleft hvertices haverage
  have ho := expectedOpt_ge_one (graphBase G) T hT
  have hQ : (1:ℝ) ≤ iteratedLog N := by exact_mod_cast iteratedLog_pos N
  have hsum : (rateReference G d:ℝ)*((T:ℝ)/G.card)+graphLogSkewness G d (N:ℝ)+1 ≤
      15*expectedOpt (graphBase G) T := by linarith
  have hcost : expectedCost (graphBase G) (onlineOrientation (T := T) (P.policy T)) ≤
      5000*(iteratedLog N:ℝ)*expectedOpt (graphBase G) T := by
    have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsum (by positivity : 0 ≤ 320*(iteratedLog N:ℝ))
    have hqe : 1 ≤ (iteratedLog N:ℝ)*expectedOpt (graphBase G) T := by nlinarith
    nlinarith
  apply hcost.trans
  have hcomp := iteratedLog_le_real_factor N (by linarith)
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcomp (show 0 ≤ 5000*expectedOpt (graphBase G) T by positivity)
  nlinarith

end GraphChoices.Peeling

GraphChoices.nat_log_le_twice_real_log.source:
theorem nat_log_le_twice_real_log (a : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    (Nat.log 2 a : ℝ) ≤ 2*Real.log (a:ℝ) := by
  have hp : (2:ℝ)^(Nat.log 2 a) ≤ (a:ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.pow_log_le_self 2 ha.ne'
  have hlog := Real.log_le_log (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < (2:ℝ)^(Nat.log 2 a)) hp
  rw [Real.log_pow] at hlog
  have htwo : (1:ℝ)/2 ≤ Real.log 2 := by linarith [Real.log_two_gt_d9]
  have hn : (0:ℝ) ≤ Nat.log 2 a := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  nlinarith

GraphChoices.iteratedLog_le_real_factor.source:
theorem iteratedLog_le_real_factor (N : ℕ) (hlog : 1 < Real.log (N:ℝ)) :
    (iteratedLog N : ℝ) ≤ 3*loglogFactor N := by
  have hN : 2 ≤ N := by
    by_contra hn
    have hc : N = 0 ∨ N = 1 := by omega
    rcases hc with rfl | rfl <;> norm_num at hlog
  have hNr : (2:ℝ) ≤ N := by exact_mod_cast hN
  let a := Nat.log 2 N+1
  have ha : 0 < a := by dsimp [a]; omega
  have hinner := nat_log_le_twice_real_log N (by omega)
  have houter := nat_log_le_twice_real_log a ha
  have hap : (0:ℝ) < a := by exact_mod_cast ha
  have haBound : (a:ℝ) ≤ 2*(1+Real.log (N:ℝ)) := by
    dsimp [a]
    push_cast
    linarith
  have hla := Real.log_le_log hap haBound
  rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num) (ne_of_gt (by linarith : 0 < 1+Real.log (N:ℝ)))] at hla
  have hln : 0 ≤ Real.log (1+Real.log (N:ℝ)) := Real.log_nonneg (by linarith)
  have htwo : Real.log 2 ≤ 1 := by linarith [Real.log_two_lt_d9]
  unfold loglogFactor
  rw [max_eq_right hNr]
  have heq : (iteratedLog N : ℝ) = (Nat.log 2 a : ℝ)+1 := by
    simp only [iteratedLog, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, a]
  rw [heq]
  linarith

end GraphChoices

namespace GraphChoices.Peeling
variable {L R : Type*} [Fintype L] [Fintype R] [DecidableEq L] [DecidableEq R]
  {G : Graph L R} {B N : ℕ} {d : ℝ} [Nonempty G]

/-- The real log-log bound for the constructed preprocessed online policy.
The actual graph skewness remains additive; no skewness lower bound is assumed. -/

GraphChoices.Peeling.PreparedDecompositi.source:
theorem PreparedDecomposition.expected_cost_real_loglog (P : PreparedDecomposition G B N d)
    (hB : B = (graphBase G).referenceCap) (hvertices : Fintype.card (L ⊕ R) ≤ N)
    (haverage : 2*(G.card : ℝ) = (N:ℝ)*d) :
    expectedCost (graphBase G) (onlineOrientation (T := N) (P.policy N)) ≤
      4200*loglogFactor N*(expectedOpt (graphBase G) N+graphLogSkewness G d (N:ℝ)) := by
  apply (P.expected_cost_density_skew hB hvertices haverage).trans
  have hs : 0 ≤ expectedOpt (graphBase G) N+graphLogSkewness G d (N:ℝ) :=
    add_nonneg (expectedOpt_nonneg _ _) (graphLogSkewness_nonneg G d (N:ℝ))
  calc
    _ ≤ (1400*(3*loglogFactor N))*(expectedOpt (graphBase G) N+graphLogSkewness G d (N:ℝ)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (iteratedLog_le_real_factor N P.large_log) (by norm_num)) hs
    _ = _ := by ring

/-- Conditional competitive guarantee: the only additional benchmark premise
is an explicitly stated parameterized log-skewness bound. The following
PreprocessedCompetitive module supplies a proved constant bound. -/

theorem PreparedDecomposition.real_competitive_of_skew_lower_bound (P : PreparedDecomposition G B N d)
    (hB : B = (graphBase G).referenceCap) (hvertices : Fintype.card (L ⊕ R) ≤ N)
    (haverage : 2*(G.card : ℝ) = (N:ℝ)*d) (K : ℝ)
    (hskew : graphLogSkewness G d (N:ℝ) ≤ K*expectedOpt (graphBase G) N) :
    expectedCost (graphBase G) (onlineOrientation (T := N) (P.policy N)) ≤
      4200*(1+K)*loglogFactor N*expectedOpt (graphBase G) N := by
  have hfactor : 0 ≤ loglogFactor N := by
    have hq : (0:ℝ) ≤ iteratedLog N := Nat.cast_nonneg _
    have hh := iteratedLog_le_real_factor N P.large_log
    linarith
  apply (P.expected_cost_real_loglog hB hvertices haverage).trans
  calc
    _ ≤ 4200*loglogFactor N*(expectedOpt (graphBase G) N+K*expectedOpt (graphBase G) N) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (add_le_add_left hskew _) (by positivity)
    _ = _ := by ring

/-- Graph-level existence theorem in the real log-log scale of the main target.
The reference capacity is the rounded maximum source density, and its
average-degree comparison is proved internally. The skewness term remains. -/

GraphChoices.Peeling.exists_preprocessed.source:
theorem exists_preprocessed_real_loglog_policy (G : Graph L R) [Nonempty G] (N : ℕ) (d : ℝ)
    (hd : 0 < d) (hlog : 1 < Real.log (N:ℝ))
    (hleft : ∀ u, (leftDegree G u : ℝ) ≤ d*Real.log (N:ℝ))
    (hD : ∀ u, leftDegree G u ≤ 4*(graphBase G).referenceCap)
    (hvertices : Fintype.card (L ⊕ R) ≤ N)
    (haverage : 2*(G.card : ℝ) = (N:ℝ)*d) :
    ∃ p : OnlinePolicy G, expectedCost (graphBase G) (onlineOrientation (T := N) p) ≤
      4200*loglogFactor N*(expectedOpt (graphBase G) N+graphLogSkewness G d (N:ℝ)) := by
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := exists_preprocessed_density_skew_policy G N d hd hlog hleft hD hvertices haverage
  refine ⟨p, hp.trans ?_⟩
  have hs : 0 ≤ expectedOpt (graphBase G) N+graphLogSkewness G d (N:ℝ) :=
    add_nonneg (expectedOpt_nonneg _ _) (graphLogSkewness_nonneg G d (N:ℝ))
  calc
    _ ≤ (1400*(3*loglogFactor N))*(expectedOpt (graphBase G) N+graphLogSkewness G d (N:ℝ)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (iteratedLog_le_real_factor N hlog) (by norm_num)) hs
    _ = _ := by ring

end GraphChoices.Peeling

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.greedyVerte.source: def greedyVertexLoad (s : GreedyLoads L R) : L ⊕ R → ℕ := Sum.elim s.left s.right

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.greedyTarge.source:
def greedyTarget (s : GreedyLoads L R) (e : Arrival L R C) : L ⊕ R :=
  if s.left e.left < s.right e.right then Sum.inl e.left else Sum.inr e.right

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.greedyVerte.source:
theorem greedyVertexLoad_step (s : GreedyLoads L R) (e : Arrival L R C) (v : L ⊕ R) :
    greedyVertexLoad (greedyStep s e) v = greedyVertexLoad s v + if greedyTarget s e = v then 1 else 0 := by
  by_cases hs : s.left e.left < s.right e.right <;> cases v <;>
    simp [greedyVertexLoad, greedyStep, greedyTarget, hs, eq_comm]

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.greedyTarge.source:
theorem greedyTarget_min (s : GreedyLoads L R) (e : Arrival L R C) :
    greedyVertexLoad s (greedyTarget s e) ≤ s.left e.left ∧
    greedyVertexLoad s (greedyTarget s e) ≤ s.right e.right := by
  by_cases hs : s.left e.left < s.right e.right
  · simp [greedyVertexLoad, greedyTarget, hs, Nat.le_of_lt hs]
  · simp [greedyVertexLoad, greedyTarget, hs, Nat.le_of_not_gt hs]

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.greedyRun_a.source:
theorem greedyRun_append (s : GreedyLoads L R) (xs ys : List (Arrival L R C)) :
    greedyRun s (xs ++ ys) = greedyRun (greedyRun s xs) ys := by
  induction xs generalizing s with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons e es ih => exact ih (greedyStep s e)

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.greedyRun_t.source:
theorem greedyRun_take_succ (es : List (Arrival L R C)) (t : Fin es.length) :
    greedyRun (zeroGreedy : GreedyLoads L R) (es.take (t.val+1)) =
      greedyStep (greedyRun zeroGreedy (es.take t.val)) (es.get t) := by
  rw [List.take_succ_eq_append_getElem t.isLt, greedyRun_append]
  rfl

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.replayInsta.source:
def replayInstance (es : List (Arrival L R C)) : Instance (L ⊕ R) es.length where
  left t := Sum.inl (es.get t).left
  right t := Sum.inr (es.get t).right

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.replayState.source:
def replayState (es : List (Arrival L R C)) (k : ℕ) : L ⊕ R → ℕ :=
  greedyVertexLoad (greedyRun (zeroGreedy : GreedyLoads L R) (es.take k))

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.replay_dest.source:
theorem replay_destination (es : List (Arrival L R C)) (t : Fin es.length) :
    destination (replayInstance es) (replayOrientation es) t =
      greedyTarget (greedyRun zeroGreedy (es.take t.val)) (es.get t) := by
  simp [destination, replayInstance, replayOrientation, greedyTarget]

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.replay_zero.source:
theorem replay_zero (es : List (Arrival L R C)) (v : L ⊕ R) : replayState es 0 v = 0 := by
  cases v <;> rfl

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.replay_incr.source:
theorem replay_increment (es : List (Arrival L R C)) (t : Fin es.length) (v : L ⊕ R) :
    replayState es (t.val+1) v = replayState es t.val v +
      if destination (replayInstance es) (replayOrientation es) t = v then 1 else 0 := by
  unfold replayState
  rw [greedyRun_take_succ, greedyVertexLoad_step, replay_destination]

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.replay_isGr.source:
theorem replay_isGreedy (es : List (Arrival L R C)) :
    IsGreedy (replayInstance es) (replayOrientation es) := by
  apply isGreedy_of_execution (replayInstance es) (replayOrientation es) (replayState es)
    (replay_zero es) (replay_increment es)
  intro t v hv
  have hmin := greedyTarget_min (greedyRun zeroGreedy (es.take t.val)) (es.get t)
  rw [replay_destination]
  rcases hv with rfl | rfl
  · exact hmin.1
  · exact hmin.2

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.replay_fina.source:
theorem replay_final_load (es : List (Arrival L R C)) (v : L ⊕ R) :
    greedyVertexLoad (greedyRun (zeroGreedy : GreedyLoads L R) es) v =
      load (replayInstance es) (replayOrientation es) v := by
  simpa [replayState] using execution_final_load (replayInstance es) (replayOrientation es)
    (replayState es) (replay_zero es) (replay_increment es) v

/-- The actual residual left load obeys the proved deterministic Greedy bound.
The optimum here is the samplewise optimum of the residual arrival instance. -/

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.residual_le.source:
theorem residual_left_competitive (α : C → ℕ) (es : List (Arrival L R C))
    (u : L) (hres : 0 < (residualArrivals (trace α es)).length) :
    (run α es).greedyLeft u <
      2 * opt (replayInstance (residualArrivals (trace α es))) *
        (Nat.log 2 (Fintype.card (L ⊕ R)) + 1) := by
  let rs := residualArrivals (trace α es)
  have hr := residual_replay α es
  have hl : (run α es).greedyLeft u =
      greedyVertexLoad (greedyRun (zeroGreedy : GreedyLoads L R) rs) (Sum.inl u) := by
    exact congrArg (fun s : GreedyLoads L R => s.left u) hr
  rw [hl, replay_final_load]
  exact (load_le_maxLoad (replayInstance rs) (replayOrientation rs) (Sum.inl u)).trans_lt
    (greedy_competitive (replayInstance rs) (replayOrientation rs) (replay_isGreedy rs) hres)

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.residual_ri.source:
theorem residual_right_competitive (α : C → ℕ) (es : List (Arrival L R C))
    (v : R) (hres : 0 < (residualArrivals (trace α es)).length) :
    (run α es).greedyRight v <
      2 * opt (replayInstance (residualArrivals (trace α es))) *
        (Nat.log 2 (Fintype.card (L ⊕ R)) + 1) := by
  let rs := residualArrivals (trace α es)
  have hr := residual_replay α es
  have hl : (run α es).greedyRight v =
      greedyVertexLoad (greedyRun (zeroGreedy : GreedyLoads L R) rs) (Sum.inr v) := by
    exact congrArg (fun s : GreedyLoads L R => s.right v) hr
  rw [hl, replay_final_load]
  exact (load_le_maxLoad (replayInstance rs) (replayOrientation rs) (Sum.inr v)).trans_lt
    (greedy_competitive (replayInstance rs) (replayOrientation rs) (replay_isGreedy rs) hres)

end GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.mem_residua.source:
theorem mem_residual_sample_iff (encode : E → Arrival L R C) (α : C → ℕ)
    (ω : Fin T → E) (e : Arrival L R C) :
    e ∈ residualArrivals (trace α (sampleArrivals encode ω)) ↔
      ∃ t : Fin T, encode (ω t) = e ∧ residualTime α encode ω t := by
  constructor
  · intro he
    obtain ⟨ev, hev, ha⟩ := List.mem_map.mp he
    obtain ⟨htrace, hres⟩ := List.mem_filter.mp hev
    have hfalse : ev.threshold = false := by simpa using hres
    obtain ⟨i, htime, _⟩ := trace_mem_arrival α (sampleArrivals encode ω) ev htrace
    let t : Fin T := ⟨ev.time, by
      have hi := i.isLt
      have hlen := sampleArrivals_length encode ω
      omega⟩
    have hs := sample_event_arrival α encode ω ev htrace t rfl
    exact ⟨t, hs.symm.trans ha, ev, htrace, rfl, hfalse⟩
  · rintro ⟨t, he, ev, hev, ht, hres⟩
    apply List.mem_map.mpr
    refine ⟨ev, List.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hev, by simpa [hres]⟩, ?_⟩
    exact (sample_event_arrival α encode ω ev hev t ht).trans he

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.residual_ad.source:
theorem residual_adj_iff_time (encode : E → Arrival L R C) (α : C → ℕ)
    (ω : Fin T → E) (x y : L ⊕ R) :
    (arrivalGraph (residualInstance α (sampleArrivals encode ω))).Adj x y ↔
      x ≠ y ∧ ∃ t : Fin T, residualTime α encode ω t ∧
        ((Sum.inl (encode (ω t)).left = x ∧ Sum.inr (encode (ω t)).right = y) ∨
         (Sum.inl (encode (ω t)).left = y ∧ Sum.inr (encode (ω t)).right = x)) := by
  rw [residualInstance, replay_adj_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hne, e, he, hxy⟩
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hres⟩ := (mem_residual_sample_iff encode α ω e).mp he
    exact ⟨hne, t, hres, by simpa only [ht] using hxy⟩
  · rintro ⟨hne, t, hres, hxy⟩
    exact ⟨hne, encode (ω t), (mem_residual_sample_iff encode α ω _).mpr ⟨t, rfl, hres⟩, hxy⟩

theorem residual_adj_inl_inr_iff_time (encode : E → Arrival L R C) (α : C → ℕ)
    (ω : Fin T → E) (u : L) (v : R) :
    (arrivalGraph (residualInstance α (sampleArrivals encode ω))).Adj (Sum.inl u) (Sum.inr v) ↔
      ∃ t : Fin T, residualTime α encode ω t ∧
        (encode (ω t)).left = u ∧ (encode (ω t)).right = v := by
  rw [residual_adj_iff_time]
  simp

end GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.residualVer.source:
def residualVertexLoad (α : C → ℕ) (es : List (Arrival L R C)) : L ⊕ R → ℕ :=
  Sum.elim (run α es).greedyLeft (run α es).greedyRight

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.residualIns.source:
def residualInstance (α : C → ℕ) (es : List (Arrival L R C)) :=
  replayInstance (residualArrivals (trace α es))

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.residual_ve.source:
theorem residual_vertex_load_eq (α : C → ℕ) (es : List (Arrival L R C)) (v : L ⊕ R) :
    residualVertexLoad α es v =
      load (residualInstance α es) (replayOrientation (residualArrivals (trace α es))) v := by
  have hr := residual_replay α es
  have hh := congrArg (fun s : GreedyLoads L R => greedyVertexLoad s v) hr
  exact hh.trans (replay_final_load _ v)

theorem residual_vertex_load_le_length (α : C → ℕ) (es : List (Arrival L R C)) (v : L ⊕ R) :
    residualVertexLoad α es v ≤ es.length := by
  rw [residual_vertex_load_eq]
  exact (load_le_length _ _ _).trans (residual_sublist α es).length_le

/-- This bound also covers an empty residual sequence, without a positivity premise. -/

theorem residual_vertex_component_bound (α : C → ℕ) (es : List (Arrival L R C)) (v : L ⊕ R) :
    residualVertexLoad α es v ≤ 2 * opt (replayInstance es) *
      (Nat.log 2 (componentVertices (residualInstance α es) v).card + 1) := by
  rw [residual_vertex_load_eq]
  by_cases hres : 0 < (residualArrivals (trace α es)).length
  · apply (greedy_component_competitive _ _ (replay_isGreedy _) hres v).le.trans
    exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 (residual_opt_le_full α es))
  · have hz : (residualArrivals (trace α es)).length = 0 := by omega
    have hh := load_le_length (residualInstance α es)
      (replayOrientation (residualArrivals (trace α es))) v
    change _ ≤ (residualArrivals (trace α es)).length at hh
    exact (hh.trans hz.le).trans (Nat.zero_le _)

theorem residual_vertex_bound_of_small_components (α : C → ℕ) (es : List (Arrival L R C))
    (s : ℕ) (hsmall : ∀ v, (componentVertices (residualInstance α es) v).card ≤ s)
    (v : L ⊕ R) :
    residualVertexLoad α es v ≤ 2 * opt (replayInstance es) * (Nat.log 2 s + 1) := by
  apply (residual_vertex_component_bound α es v).trans
  exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.add_le_add_right (Nat.log_mono_right (hsmall v)) 1)

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.total_verte.source:
theorem total_vertex_le_threshold_add_residual [Fintype C] (α : C → ℕ)
    (es : List (Arrival L R C)) (v : L ⊕ R) :
    totalVertexLoad α es v ≤ (∑ c, α c) + residualVertexLoad α es v := by
  cases v with
  | inl u => exact Nat.add_le_add_right (threshold_budget α es u) _
  | inr v => exact Nat.le_add_left _ _

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.totalMaxLoa.source:
theorem totalMaxLoad_le_budget_add_length [Fintype C] (α : C → ℕ)
    (es : List (Arrival L R C)) : totalMaxLoad α es ≤ (∑ c, α c) + es.length := by
  apply Finset.sup_le
  intro v _
  exact (total_vertex_le_threshold_add_residual α es v).trans
    (Nat.add_le_add_left (residual_vertex_load_le_length α es v) _)

/-- The deterministic consequence of component shattering needed by Theorem 4.1. -/

theorem totalMaxLoad_of_small_components [Fintype C] (α : C → ℕ)
    (es : List (Arrival L R C)) (s : ℕ)
    (hsmall : ∀ v, (componentVertices (residualInstance α es) v).card ≤ s) :
    totalMaxLoad α es ≤ (∑ c, α c) + 2 * opt (replayInstance es) * (Nat.log 2 s + 1) := by
  apply Finset.sup_le
  intro v _
  exact (total_vertex_le_threshold_add_residual α es v).trans
    (Nat.add_le_add_left (residual_vertex_bound_of_small_components α es s hsmall v) _)

/-- For components of at most ell squared vertices, the Greedy multiplier is
at most 4(log_2 ell + 1), with exact integer constants. -/

theorem totalMaxLoad_of_square_components [Fintype C] (α : C → ℕ)
    (es : List (Arrival L R C)) (ell : ℕ)
    (hsmall : ∀ v, (componentVertices (residualInstance α es) v).card ≤ ell^2) :
    totalMaxLoad α es ≤ (∑ c, α c) + 4 * opt (replayInstance es) * (Nat.log 2 ell + 1) := by
  have hlog : Nat.log 2 (ell^2) + 1 ≤ 2*(Nat.log 2 ell + 1) := by
    by_cases hz : ell = 0
    · simp [hz]
    have hpow := Nat.lt_pow_succ_log_self (by decide : 1 < 2) ell
    have hsquare : ell^2 < 2^(2*(Nat.log 2 ell + 1)) := by
      calc
        ell^2 < (2^(Nat.log 2 ell+1))^2 := Nat.pow_lt_pow_left hpow (by decide)
        _ = _ := by rw [← pow_mul]; congr 1; omega
    have hh := Nat.log_lt_of_lt_pow (pow_ne_zero 2 hz) hsquare
    omega
  apply (totalMaxLoad_of_small_components α es (ell^2) hsmall).trans
  apply Nat.add_le_add_left
  calc
    _ ≤ 2 * opt (replayInstance es) * (2*(Nat.log 2 ell + 1)) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hlog
    _ = _ := by ring

end GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.listLeftNei.source:
theorem listLeftNeighbors_card_le (es : List (Arrival L R C)) (u : L) :
    (listLeftNeighbors es u).card ≤ es.countP (fun e => decide (e.left = u)) := by
  exact (List.toFinset_card_le _).trans_eq (by simp [List.countP_eq_length_filter])

omit [Fintype L] [Fintype R] [DecidableEq C] in

theorem listLeftNeighbors_mono {xs ys : List (Arrival L R C)} (h : xs.Sublist ys) (u : L) :
    listLeftNeighbors xs u ⊆ listLeftNeighbors ys u := by
  intro v hv
  exact List.mem_toFinset.mpr (((h.filter _).map Arrival.right).subset (List.mem_toFinset.mp hv))

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.residual_le.source:
theorem residual_left_neighbors_subset (α : C → ℕ) (es : List (Arrival L R C)) (u : L) :
    listLeftNeighbors (residualArrivals (trace α es)) u ⊆ listLeftNeighbors es u :=
  listLeftNeighbors_mono (residual_sublist α es) u

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.sample_left.source:
theorem sample_left_count_eq_hits (encode : E → Arrival L R C) {T : ℕ}
    (ω : Fin T → E) (u : L) :
    (sampleArrivals encode ω).countP (fun e => decide (e.left = u)) =
      hitCount (leftSourceBucket encode u) ω := by
  unfold sampleArrivals
  rw [countP_ofFn_eq_sum]
  simp only [hitCount, leftSourceBucket, card_eq_sum_ones, sum_filter,
    mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, decide_eq_true_eq]

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.residual_le.source:
theorem residual_left_degree_le_hits (encode : E → Arrival L R C) (α : C → ℕ) {T : ℕ}
    (ω : Fin T → E) (u : L) :
    (listLeftNeighbors (residualArrivals (trace α (sampleArrivals encode ω))) u).card ≤
      hitCount (leftSourceBucket encode u) ω := by
  calc
    _ ≤ (listLeftNeighbors (sampleArrivals encode ω) u).card :=
      card_le_card (residual_left_neighbors_subset α _ u)
    _ ≤ _ := (listLeftNeighbors_card_le _ u).trans_eq (sample_left_count_eq_hits encode ω u)

/-- Left-degree tail for the actual residual graph, counting distinct neighbors. -/

theorem residual_left_degree_tail (encode : E → Arrival L R C) (α : C → ℕ)
    (T k : ℕ) (r : ℝ)
    (hmean : ∀ u, Real.exp 1*T*(((leftSourceBucket encode u).card : ℝ)/Fintype.card E)/k ≤ r) :
    eventProbability (univ.filter fun ω : Fin T → E => ∃ u,
      k ≤ (listLeftNeighbors (residualArrivals (trace α (sampleArrivals encode ω))) u).card) ≤
      Fintype.card L * r^k := by
  apply (eventProbability_mono (B := univ.filter fun ω : Fin T → E =>
    ∃ u, k ≤ hitCount (leftSourceBucket encode u) ω) ?_).trans
  · exact some_bucket_tail_bound (leftSourceBucket encode) T k r hmean
  · intro ω hω
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := (mem_filter.mp hω).2
    exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, u, hu.trans (residual_left_degree_le_hits encode α ω u)⟩

end GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy

GraphChoices.countP_ofFn_eq_sum.source:
theorem countP_ofFn_eq_sum {A : Type*} {n : ℕ} (f : Fin n → A) (P : A → Bool) :
    (List.ofFn f).countP P = ∑ i, if P (f i) then 1 else 0 := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [List.ofFn_succ, List.countP_cons, ih, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
    simp only [Nat.add_comm]

GraphChoices.card_filter_list_indices.source:
theorem card_filter_list_indices {A : Type*} (es : List A) (P : A → Bool) :
    (univ.filter fun i : Fin es.length => P (es.get i) = true).card = es.countP P := by
  have hh := countP_ofFn_eq_sum es.get P
  rw [List.ofFn_get] at hh
  simp only [card_eq_sum_ones, sum_filter]
  exact hh.symm

GraphChoices.opt_le_of_internalCount_le.source:
theorem opt_le_of_internalCount_le {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {S T : ℕ} (J : Instance V S) (I : Instance V T)
    (h : ∀ A, internalCount J A ≤ internalCount I A) : opt J ≤ opt I := by
  apply (opt_le_iff_density J _).2
  intro A
  exact (h A).trans (density_le_opt I A)

end GraphChoices

namespace GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy
open Finset
variable {L R C : Type*} [Fintype L] [Fintype R]
  [DecidableEq L] [DecidableEq R] [DecidableEq C]

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.replay_inte.source:
theorem replay_internalCount (es : List (Arrival L R C)) (A : Finset (L ⊕ R)) :
    internalCount (replayInstance es) A =
      es.countP (fun e => decide (Sum.inl e.left ∈ A ∧ Sum.inr e.right ∈ A)) := by
  simpa only [internalCount, replayInstance, decide_eq_true_eq] using
    GraphChoices.card_filter_list_indices es
      (fun e => decide (Sum.inl e.left ∈ A ∧ Sum.inr e.right ∈ A))

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.replay_opt_.source:
theorem replay_opt_mono_sublist (xs ys : List (Arrival L R C)) (h : xs.Sublist ys) :
    opt (replayInstance xs) ≤ opt (replayInstance ys) := by
  apply GraphChoices.opt_le_of_internalCount_le
  intro A
  rw [replay_internalCount, replay_internalCount]
  have hh := (h.filter (fun e => decide (Sum.inl e.left ∈ A ∧ Sum.inr e.right ∈ A))).length_le
  simpa only [List.countP_eq_length_filter] using hh

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.residual_su.source:
theorem residual_sublist (α : C → ℕ) (es : List (Arrival L R C)) :
    (residualArrivals (trace α es)).Sublist es := by
  have hh := List.Sublist.map Event.arrival (List.filter_sublist
    (l := trace α es) (p := fun ev => !ev.threshold))
  simpa only [residualArrivals, trace, traceFrom_arrivals] using hh

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.residual_op.source:
theorem residual_opt_le_full (α : C → ℕ) (es : List (Arrival L R C)) :
    opt (replayInstance (residualArrivals (trace α es))) ≤ opt (replayInstance es) :=
  replay_opt_mono_sublist _ _ (residual_sublist α es)

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.residual_le.source:
theorem residual_left_competitive_full (α : C → ℕ) (es : List (Arrival L R C))
    (u : L) (hres : 0 < (residualArrivals (trace α es)).length) :
    (run α es).greedyLeft u <
      2 * opt (replayInstance es) * (Nat.log 2 (Fintype.card (L ⊕ R)) + 1) := by
  apply (residual_left_competitive α es u hres).trans_le
  exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 (residual_opt_le_full α es))

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.residual_ri.source:
theorem residual_right_competitive_full (α : C → ℕ) (es : List (Arrival L R C))
    (v : R) (hres : 0 < (residualArrivals (trace α es)).length) :
    (run α es).greedyRight v <
      2 * opt (replayInstance es) * (Nat.log 2 (Fintype.card (L ⊕ R)) + 1) := by
  apply (residual_right_competitive α es v hres).trans_le
  exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 (residual_opt_le_full α es))

end GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.Event.source:
structure Event (L R C : Type*) where
  time : ℕ
  arrival : Arrival L R C
  threshold : Bool

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.traceFrom.source:
def traceFrom (α : C → ℕ) : State L R C → ℕ → List (Arrival L R C) → List (Event L R C)
  | _, _, [] => []
  | s, k, e :: es =>
    ⟨k,e,isThreshold α s e⟩ :: traceFrom α (step α s e) (k+1) es

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.trace.source:
def trace (α : C → ℕ) (es : List (Arrival L R C)) : List (Event L R C) :=
  traceFrom α initial 0 es

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.thresholdAr.source:
def thresholdArrivals (log : List (Event L R C)) : List (Arrival L R C) :=
  (log.filter fun e => e.threshold).map Event.arrival

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.residualArr.source:
def residualArrivals (log : List (Event L R C)) : List (Arrival L R C) :=
  (log.filter fun e => !e.threshold).map Event.arrival

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.GreedyLoads.source:
structure GreedyLoads (L R : Type*) where
  left : L → ℕ
  right : R → ℕ

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.project.source: def project (s : State L R C) : GreedyLoads L R := ⟨s.greedyLeft, s.greedyRight⟩

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.greedyRun.source:
def greedyRun : GreedyLoads L R → List (Arrival L R C) → GreedyLoads L R
  | s, [] => s
  | s, e::es => greedyRun (greedyStep s e) es

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.project_thr.source:
theorem project_threshold_step (α : C → ℕ) (s : State L R C) (e : Arrival L R C)
    (h : isThreshold α s e = true) : project (step α s e) = project s := by
  have ht : s.threshold e.left e.cls < α e.cls := by simpa [isThreshold] using h
  simp [step, ht, project]

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.project_res.source:
theorem project_residual_step (α : C → ℕ) (s : State L R C) (e : Arrival L R C)
    (h : isThreshold α s e = false) : project (step α s e) = greedyStep (project s) e := by
  have ht : ¬ s.threshold e.left e.cls < α e.cls := by simpa [isThreshold] using h
  simp only [step, if_neg ht, greedyStep, project]
  split_ifs <;> rfl

/-- The implemented residual process is exactly ordinary Greedy replay on the
extracted residual list, with all classes combined. -/

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.residual_re.source:
theorem residual_replay_from (α : C → ℕ) (s : State L R C) (k : ℕ)
    (es : List (Arrival L R C)) :
    project (runFrom α s es) = greedyRun (project s)
      (residualArrivals (traceFrom α s k es)) := by
  induction es generalizing s k with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons e es ih =>
    cases h : isThreshold α s e with
    | false =>
      simp only [traceFrom, residualArrivals, h, Bool.not_false, List.filter_cons_of_pos,
        List.map_cons, greedyRun]
      rw [← project_residual_step α s e h]
      exact ih _ _
    | true =>
      simp only [traceFrom, residualArrivals, h, Bool.not_true, List.filter_cons_of_neg]
      rw [← project_threshold_step α s e h]
      exact ih _ _

theorem residual_replay (α : C → ℕ) (es : List (Arrival L R C)) :
    project (run α es) = greedyRun (project (initial : State L R C))
      (residualArrivals (trace α es)) := residual_replay_from α initial 0 es

/-- Counters count actual threshold occurrences, rather than all arrivals in
the corresponding bucket. -/

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.threshold_c.source:
theorem threshold_counter_exact_from (α : C → ℕ) (s : State L R C) (k : ℕ)
    (es : List (Arrival L R C)) (u : L) (i : C) :
    (runFrom α s es).threshold u i = s.threshold u i +
      incidentCount (thresholdArrivals (traceFrom α s k es)) u i := by
  induction es generalizing s k with
  | nil => simp [runFrom, traceFrom, thresholdArrivals, incidentCount]
  | cons e es ih =>
    cases h : isThreshold α s e with
    | false =>
      have ht : ¬s.threshold e.left e.cls < α e.cls := by simpa [isThreshold] using h
      simp only [runFrom, traceFrom, thresholdArrivals, h, List.filter_cons_of_neg]
      rw [ih (step α s e) (k+1)]
      simp only [step, if_neg ht]
      split_ifs <;> rfl
    | true =>
      have ht : s.threshold e.left e.cls < α e.cls := by simpa [isThreshold] using h
      simp only [runFrom, traceFrom, thresholdArrivals, h, List.filter_cons_of_pos, List.map_cons]
      rw [ih (step α s e) (k+1)]
      simp only [thresholdArrivals, step, if_pos ht, incidentCount, List.filter_cons]
      by_cases he : e.left = u ∧ e.cls = i
      · obtain ⟨rfl,rfl⟩ := he
        simp
        omega
      · have he' : ¬(u = e.left ∧ i = e.cls) := by aesop
        simp [he, he']

theorem threshold_counter_exact (α : C → ℕ) (es : List (Arrival L R C)) (u : L) (i : C) :
    (run α es).threshold u i = incidentCount (thresholdArrivals (trace α es)) u i := by
  simpa [run, trace, initial] using threshold_counter_exact_from α initial 0 es u i

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.residual_ha.source:
theorem residual_has_threshold_witnesses (α : C → ℕ) (es : List (Arrival L R C))
    (e : Arrival L R C) (he : isThreshold α (run α es) e = false) :
    incidentCount (thresholdArrivals (trace α es)) e.left e.cls = α e.cls := by
  rw [← threshold_counter_exact]
  exact residual_counter_saturated α es e he

/-- The log records every occurrence in its original position. -/

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.traceFrom_a.source:
theorem traceFrom_arrivals (α : C → ℕ) (s : State L R C) (k : ℕ)
    (es : List (Arrival L R C)) : (traceFrom α s k es).map Event.arrival = es := by
  induction es generalizing s k with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons e es ih => simp [traceFrom, ih]

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.traceFrom_t.source:
theorem traceFrom_times (α : C → ℕ) (s : State L R C) (k : ℕ)
    (es : List (Arrival L R C)) :
    (traceFrom α s k es).map Event.time = List.range' k es.length := by
  induction es generalizing s k with
  | nil => simp [traceFrom]
  | cons e es ih => simp [traceFrom, ih, List.range'_succ]

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.traceFrom_u.source:
theorem traceFrom_unique_times (α : C → ℕ) (s : State L R C) (k : ℕ)
    (es : List (Arrival L R C)) : ((traceFrom α s k es).map Event.time).Nodup := by
  rw [traceFrom_times]
  exact List.nodup_range'

/-- Threshold and residual logs partition the occurrence log up to permutation.
Their internal order is retained by the filter operations. -/

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.trace_parti.source:
theorem trace_partition (α : C → ℕ) (es : List (Arrival L R C)) :
    (thresholdArrivals (trace α es) ++ residualArrivals (trace α es)).Perm es := by
  have h := List.filter_append_perm (fun e : Event L R C => e.threshold) (trace α es)
  have hh := h.map Event.arrival
  simpa [thresholdArrivals, residualArrivals, List.map_append, trace, traceFrom_arrivals] using hh

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.traceFrom_a.source:
theorem traceFrom_append (α : C → ℕ) (s : State L R C) (k : ℕ)
    (xs ys : List (Arrival L R C)) :
    traceFrom α s k (xs ++ ys) = traceFrom α s k xs ++
      traceFrom α (runFrom α s xs) (k + xs.length) ys := by
  induction xs generalizing s k with
  | nil => simp [traceFrom, runFrom]
  | cons e es ih =>
    simp [traceFrom, runFrom, ih, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm]

/-- Distinct time labels make threshold witnesses disjoint from all residual
occurrences, even when their base-edge labels are identical. -/

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.threshold_r.source:
theorem threshold_residual_times_disjoint (log : List (Event L R C))
    (hunique : (log.map Event.time).Nodup) :
    List.Disjoint ((log.filter fun e => e.threshold).map Event.time)
      ((log.filter fun e => !e.threshold).map Event.time) := by
  apply List.disjoint_left.mpr
  intro t ht hr
  obtain ⟨e,he,het⟩ := List.mem_map.mp ht
  obtain ⟨f,hf,hft⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hr
  have hmemE := (List.mem_filter.mp he).1
  have hmemF := (List.mem_filter.mp hf).1
  have hef : e = f := List.inj_on_of_nodup_map hunique hmemE hmemF (het.trans hft.symm)
  have hetrue := (List.mem_filter.mp he).2
  have hffalse := (List.mem_filter.mp hf).2
  simp_all

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.trace_thres.source:
theorem trace_threshold_residual_disjoint (α : C → ℕ) (es : List (Arrival L R C)) :
    List.Disjoint (((trace α es).filter fun e => e.threshold).map Event.time)
      (((trace α es).filter fun e => !e.threshold).map Event.time) :=
  threshold_residual_times_disjoint _ (traceFrom_unique_times α initial 0 es)

end GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.sampleArriv.source:
def sampleArrivals (encode : E → Arrival L R C) (ω : Fin T → E) : List (Arrival L R C) :=
  List.ofFn fun t => encode (ω t)

theorem sampleArrivals_length (encode : E → Arrival L R C) (ω : Fin T → E) :
    (sampleArrivals encode ω).length = T := by simp [sampleArrivals]

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.residualTim.source:
def residualTime (α : C → ℕ) (encode : E → Arrival L R C) (ω : Fin T → E) (t : Fin T) : Prop :=
  ∃ ev ∈ trace α (sampleArrivals encode ω), ev.time = t.val ∧ ev.threshold = false

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.sample_even.source:
theorem sample_event_arrival (α : C → ℕ) (encode : E → Arrival L R C) (ω : Fin T → E)
    (ev : Event L R C) (hev : ev ∈ trace α (sampleArrivals encode ω))
    (t : Fin T) (ht : ev.time = t.val) : ev.arrival = encode (ω t) := by
  obtain ⟨i,hi,ha⟩ := trace_mem_arrival α (sampleArrivals encode ω) ev hev
  have hval : i.val = t.val := hi.symm.trans ht
  simpa only [sampleArrivals, List.get_eq_getElem, List.getElem_ofFn, hval] using ha

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.fixedResidu.source:
noncomputable def fixedResidualEvent (α : C → ℕ) (encode : E → Arrival L R C)
    (T m : ℕ) (tree : Fin m → E) : Finset (Fin T → E) := by
  classical
  exact univ.filter fun ω => ∃ τ : Fin m → Fin T, Function.Injective τ ∧
    ∀ i, ω (τ i) = tree i ∧ residualTime α encode ω (τ i)

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.sourceBucke.source:
def sourceBucket (encode : E → Arrival L R C) (u : L) (c : C) : Finset E :=
  univ.filter fun e => (encode e).left = u ∧ (encode e).cls = c

/-- For distinct fixed edge labels, occurrence of every label in the residual
process is equivalent to the injectively time-labelled event definition. -/

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.mem_fixedRe.source:
theorem mem_fixedResidualEvent_iff (α : C → ℕ) (encode : E → Arrival L R C)
    (tree : Fin m → E) (htree : Function.Injective tree) (ω : Fin T → E) :
    ω ∈ fixedResidualEvent α encode T m tree ↔
      ∀ i, ∃ t : Fin T, ω t = tree i ∧ residualTime α encode ω t := by
  classical
  simp only [fixedResidualEvent, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨τ,hτ,hh⟩ i
    exact ⟨τ i,hh i⟩
  · intro hh
    choose τ hτ using hh
    refine ⟨τ,?_,hτ⟩
    intro i j hij
    apply htree
    exact (hτ i).1.symm.trans ((congrArg ω hij).trans (hτ j).1)

/-- Every fixed residual-edge event forces the exact witnesses counted in the
joint probability bound. There is one representative residual edge per bucket. -/

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.fixedResidu.source:
theorem fixedResidualEvent_subset_witness (α : C → ℕ) (encode : E → Arrival L R C)
    (tree : Fin m → E) (vertex : J → L) (cls : J → C) (representative : J → Fin m)
    (hrepresentative : ∀ j, (encode (tree (representative j))).left = vertex j ∧
      (encode (tree (representative j))).cls = cls j)
    (hdistinct : Function.Injective (fun j => (vertex j,cls j))) :
    fixedResidualEvent α encode T m tree ⊆
      GraphChoices.patternWitnessEvent T m (fun j => α (cls j)) tree
        (fun j => sourceBucket encode (vertex j) (cls j)) := by
  classical
  intro ω hω
  obtain ⟨τ,hτ,hocc⟩ := (mem_filter.mp hω).2
  let es := sampleArrivals encode ω
  have hlen : es.length = T := sampleArrivals_length encode ω
  let K (j : J) := finiteThresholdTimes α es T hlen (vertex j) (cls j)
  apply GraphChoices.mem_patternWitnessEvent_of_times ω tree
    (fun j => sourceBucket encode (vertex j) (cls j)) τ K
  · intro j
    rw [finiteThresholdTimes_card]
    obtain ⟨ev,hev,htime,hr⟩ := (hocc (representative j)).2
    have ha : ev.arrival = encode (tree (representative j)) :=
      (sample_event_arrival α encode ω ev hev _ htime).trans (congrArg encode (hocc _).1)
    have hs := residual_event_final_saturated α es ev hev hr
    simpa [ha, (hrepresentative j).1, (hrepresentative j).2] using hs
  · exact hτ
  · exact fun i => (hocc i).1
  · intro i j ht
    obtain ⟨ev,hev,htime,hth,_,_⟩ := thresholdWitnessTimes_spec α es (vertex j) (cls j) (τ i).val
      ((mem_finiteThresholdTimes α es T hlen _ _ _).mp ht)
    obtain ⟨ev',hev',htime',hr⟩ := (hocc i).2
    have heq := trace_event_eq_of_time α es ev ev' hev hev' (htime.trans htime'.symm)
    have : true = false := hth.symm.trans ((congrArg Event.threshold heq).trans hr)
    cases this
  · intro j j' hj
    exact finiteThresholdTimes_buckets_disjoint α es T hlen _ _ _ _ (fun h => hj (hdistinct h))
  · intro j t ht
    obtain ⟨ev,hev,htime,_,hu,hc⟩ := thresholdWitnessTimes_spec α es (vertex j) (cls j) t.val
      ((mem_finiteThresholdTimes α es T hlen _ _ _).mp ht)
    have ha := sample_event_arrival α encode ω ev hev t htime
    simp only [sourceBucket, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
    exact ⟨(congrArg Arrival.left ha).symm.trans hu,(congrArg Arrival.cls ha).symm.trans hc⟩

/-- The raw exponential fixed-tree probability bound (Equation (12)), now
proved for the actual residual execution. -/

theorem fixedResidual_probability_le (α : C → ℕ) (encode : E → Arrival L R C)
    (tree : Fin m → E) (vertex : J → L) (cls : J → C) (representative : J → Fin m)
    (hrepresentative : ∀ j, (encode (tree (representative j))).left = vertex j ∧
      (encode (tree (representative j))).cls = cls j)
    (hdistinct : Function.Injective (fun j => (vertex j,cls j))) :
    GraphChoices.eventProbability (fixedResidualEvent α encode T m tree) ≤
      ((T:ℝ) / Fintype.card E)^m *
        ∏ j, (Real.exp 1 * T * ((sourceBucket encode (vertex j) (cls j)).card : ℝ) /
          Fintype.card E / α (cls j))^(α (cls j)) := by
  have hs := GraphChoices.eventProbability_mono
    (fixedResidualEvent_subset_witness (T := T) α encode tree vertex cls representative hrepresentative hdistinct)
  have hp := GraphChoices.patternWitness_probability_le_exp T m (fun j => α (cls j)) tree
    (fun j => sourceBucket encode (vertex j) (cls j))
  apply hs.trans
  simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm] using hp

end GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy

GraphChoices.Instance.restrict.source:
def Instance.restrict {V : Type*} {M N : ℕ} (I : Instance V N) (f : Fin M ↪ Fin N) :
    Instance V M where
  left t := I.left (f t)
  right t := I.right (f t)

GraphChoices.opt_restrict_le.source:
theorem opt_restrict_le {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {M N : ℕ}
    (I : Instance V N) (f : Fin M ↪ Fin N) : opt (I.restrict f) ≤ opt I := by
  obtain ⟨a,ha⟩ := exists_exact_opt I
  apply (opt_le_maxLoad (I.restrict f) (fun t => a (f t))).trans
  rw [← ha]
  apply (maxLoad_le_iff _ _ _).mpr
  intro v
  apply le_trans _ (load_le_maxLoad I a v)
  apply card_le_card_of_injOn f
  · intro t ht
    change t ∈ univ.filter (fun t => destination (I.restrict f) (fun t => a (f t)) t = v) at ht
    change f t ∈ univ.filter (fun t => destination I a t = v)
    simpa only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, destination, Instance.restrict] using ht
  · exact fun _ _ _ _ h => f.injective h

GraphChoices.average_product_fst.source:
theorem average_product_fst {Ω Ω' : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [Fintype Ω'] [Nonempty Ω']
    (f : Ω → ℝ) : average (fun p : Ω × Ω' => f p.1) = average f := by
  simp only [average, Fintype.sum_prod_type, sum_const, card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul,
    ← mul_sum, Fintype.card_prod, Nat.cast_mul]
  have h : (Fintype.card Ω' : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero
  by_cases hΩ : Fintype.card Ω = 0
  · simp [hΩ]
  · have hΩ' : (Fintype.card Ω : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hΩ
    field_simp

GraphChoices.appendSamples.source:
def appendSamples {E : Type*} (M Q : ℕ) :
    (Fin M → E) × (Fin Q → E) ≃ (Fin (M+Q) → E) :=
  (Equiv.sumArrowEquivProdArrow (Fin M) (Fin Q) E).symm.trans
    (Equiv.arrowCongr finSumFinEquiv (Equiv.refl E))

GraphChoices.appendSamples_left.source:
theorem appendSamples_left {E : Type*} (M Q : ℕ)
    (p : (Fin M → E) × (Fin Q → E)) (t : Fin M) :
    appendSamples M Q p (Fin.castAdd Q t) = p.1 t := by
  change appendSamples M Q p (finSumFinEquiv (Sum.inl t)) = p.1 t
  simp only [appendSamples, Equiv.trans_apply, Equiv.arrowCongr_apply, Function.comp_apply, Equiv.refl_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  rcases p with ⟨p,q⟩
  rfl

GraphChoices.average_prefix.source:
theorem average_prefix {E : Type*} [Fintype E] [Nonempty E] (M Q : ℕ)
    (f : (Fin M → E) → ℝ) :
    average (fun ω : Fin (M+Q) → E => f (fun t => ω (Fin.castAdd Q t))) = average f := by
  rw [← average_equiv (appendSamples M Q)]
  simp_rw [appendSamples_left]
  exact average_product_fst f

GraphChoices.expectedOpt_mono_horizon.source:
theorem expectedOpt_mono_horizon {V E : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    [Fintype E] [Nonempty E] (G : BaseGraph V E) {M N : ℕ} (hMN : M ≤ N) :
    expectedOpt G M ≤ expectedOpt G N := by
  obtain ⟨Q,rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hMN
  unfold expectedOpt
  rw [← average_prefix M Q (fun ω => (opt (G.sample ω):ℝ))]
  apply average_mono
  intro ω
  have hh := opt_restrict_le (G.sample ω) ⟨Fin.castAdd Q, Fin.castAdd_injective M Q⟩
  exact_mod_cast hh

end GraphChoices

GraphChoices.hitCount.source:
def hitCount (A : Finset E) (ω : Fin T → E) : ℕ :=
  (univ.filter fun t => ω t ∈ A).card

GraphChoices.hitTailEvent.source:
def hitTailEvent (A : Finset E) (T k : ℕ) : Finset (Fin T → E) :=
  univ.filter fun ω => k ≤ hitCount A ω

GraphChoices.requiredHitsEvent.source:
noncomputable def requiredHitsEvent (A : Finset E) (K : Finset (Fin T)) : Finset (Fin T → E) :=
  Fintype.piFinset fun t => if t ∈ K then A else univ

GraphChoices.requiredHits_probability.source:
theorem requiredHits_probability (A : Finset E) (K : Finset (Fin T)) :
    eventProbability (requiredHitsEvent A K) = ((A.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card E)^K.card := by
  classical
  rw [requiredHitsEvent, probability_coordinate_constraints]
  have hm : (Fintype.card E : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero
  have hfactor (t : Fin T) :
      (((if t ∈ K then A else univ : Finset E).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card E) =
      if t ∈ K then (A.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card E else 1 := by
    by_cases ht : t ∈ K <;> simp [ht,hm]
  simp_rw [hfactor]
  simp [div_pow]

GraphChoices.hitTail_subset_witness_unio.source:
theorem hitTail_subset_witness_union (A : Finset E) (T k : ℕ) :
    hitTailEvent A T k ⊆
      (univ.powersetCard k).biUnion (fun K : Finset (Fin T) => requiredHitsEvent A K) := by
  classical
  intro ω hω
  have hk := (mem_filter.mp hω).2
  obtain ⟨K,hK,hcard⟩ := exists_subset_card_eq hk
  apply mem_biUnion.mpr
  refine ⟨K, mem_powersetCard.mpr ⟨subset_univ _,hcard⟩, ?_⟩
  simp only [requiredHitsEvent, Fintype.mem_piFinset]
  intro t
  by_cases ht : t ∈ K
  · simp only [if_pos ht]
    exact (mem_filter.mp (hK ht)).2
  · simp [ht]

/-- P[Bin(T,p) >= k] <= choose(T,k) p^k, with p = |A|/|E|.
This is an upper bound for every k, including k=0 and k>T. -/

GraphChoices.hitTail_probability_le.source:
theorem hitTail_probability_le (A : Finset E) (T k : ℕ) :
    eventProbability (hitTailEvent A T k) ≤
      (T.choose k : ℝ) * ((A.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card E)^k := by
  calc
    _ ≤ eventProbability ((univ.powersetCard k).biUnion
        (fun K : Finset (Fin T) => requiredHitsEvent A K)) :=
      eventProbability_mono (hitTail_subset_witness_union A T k)
    _ ≤ ∑ K ∈ univ.powersetCard k, eventProbability (requiredHitsEvent A K) :=
      witness_union_bound _ _
    _ = ∑ _K ∈ (univ : Finset (Fin T)).powersetCard k,
        ((A.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card E)^k := by
      apply sum_congr rfl
      intro K hK
      rw [requiredHits_probability, (mem_powersetCard.mp hK).2]
    _ = _ := by simp [card_powersetCard]

/-- The standard exponential estimate for binomial coefficients, including
k=0. It is derived from the exponential series and the factorial bound. -/

GraphChoices.choose_le_exp_div_pow.source:
theorem choose_le_exp_div_pow (T k : ℕ) :
    (T.choose k : ℝ) ≤ (Real.exp 1 * T / k)^k := by
  by_cases hk : k = 0
  · simp [hk]
  have hkpos : (0:ℝ) < k := by exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hk
  have hkne : (k:ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hkpos
  have he : Real.exp (k : ℝ) = (Real.exp 1)^k := by simpa using Real.exp_nat_mul 1 k
  have hp := Real.pow_div_factorial_le_exp (k : ℝ) (Nat.cast_nonneg k : (0:ℝ) ≤ k) k
  rw [he] at hp
  have hscale := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ ((T:ℝ)/k)^k)
  calc
    (T.choose k : ℝ) ≤ (T:ℝ)^k / k.factorial := Nat.choose_le_pow_div k T
    _ = ((T:ℝ)/k)^k * ((k:ℝ)^k / k.factorial) := by
      rw [div_pow]
      field_simp
    _ ≤ ((T:ℝ)/k)^k * (Real.exp 1)^k := hscale
    _ = _ := by rw [← mul_pow]; congr 1; ring

/-- A Chernoff-style upper tail in the paper's exact sampling space. -/

GraphChoices.hitTail_probability_le_exp.source:
theorem hitTail_probability_le_exp (A : Finset E) (T k : ℕ) :
    eventProbability (hitTailEvent A T k) ≤
      (Real.exp 1 * T * ((A.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card E) / k)^k := by
  calc
    _ ≤ (T.choose k : ℝ) * ((A.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card E)^k := hitTail_probability_le A T k
    _ ≤ (Real.exp 1 * T / k)^k * ((A.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card E)^k :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (choose_le_exp_div_pow T k) (by positivity)
    _ = _ := by rw [← mul_pow]; congr 1; ring

/-- A useful geometric form once the threshold dominates the bucket's mean. -/

GraphChoices.hitTail_probability_le_geom.source:
theorem hitTail_probability_le_geometric (A : Finset E) (T k : ℕ) (r : ℝ)
    (h : Real.exp 1 * T * ((A.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card E) / k ≤ r) :
    eventProbability (hitTailEvent A T k) ≤ r^k := by
  apply (hitTail_probability_le_exp A T k).trans
  exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) h k

/-- Union bound for large sampled degrees across any finite family of buckets. -/

GraphChoices.some_bucket_tail_bound.source:
theorem some_bucket_tail_bound {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (A : V → Finset E) (T k : ℕ) (r : ℝ)
    (h : ∀ v, Real.exp 1 * T * (((A v).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card E) / k ≤ r) :
    eventProbability (univ.filter fun ω : Fin T → E => ∃ v, k ≤ hitCount (A v) ω) ≤
      Fintype.card V * r^k := by
  have hsub : (univ.filter fun ω : Fin T → E => ∃ v, k ≤ hitCount (A v) ω) ⊆
      univ.biUnion (fun v : V => hitTailEvent (A v) T k) := by
    intro ω hω
    obtain ⟨v,hv⟩ := (mem_filter.mp hω).2
    exact mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨v,mem_univ _,mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _,hv⟩⟩
  calc
    _ ≤ eventProbability (univ.biUnion fun v : V => hitTailEvent (A v) T k) := eventProbability_mono hsub
    _ ≤ ∑ v, eventProbability (hitTailEvent (A v) T k) := witness_union_bound _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ _v : V, r^k := sum_le_sum fun v _ => hitTail_probability_le_geometric (A v) T k r (h v)
    _ = _ := by simp

end GraphChoices

GraphChoices.Patterns.UnlabelledShape.source: abbrev UnlabelledShape (m : ℕ) := {t : Tree Unit // t ∈ Tree.treesOfNumNodesEq m}

GraphChoices.Patterns.skeletonPattern.source:
def skeletonPattern {m : ℕ} (s : UnlabelledShape m) : ParentPattern Unit m :=
  shapePattern (s, fun _ => ())

variable {E L R C : Type*} [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E] [Nonempty E]
  [Fintype L] [Fintype R] [Fintype C]
  [DecidableEq L] [DecidableEq R] [DecidableEq C] {T m : ℕ}

/-- The only input is an unlabelled geometric embedding. Classes, edge labels
and globally distinct occurrence witnesses follow from actual adjacency. -/

GraphChoices.Patterns.mem_heavyShapeEven.source:
theorem mem_heavyShapeEvent_of_geometric_embedding (H : C → Peeling.Graph L R)
    (encode : E → Arrival L R C) (α : C → ℕ)
    (hsource : ∀ e, ((encode e).left, (encode e).right) ∈ H (encode e).cls)
    (ω : Fin T → E) (s : UnlabelledShape m) (f : Fin (m+1) → L ⊕ R)
    (hf : Function.Injective f) (hroot : ∃ v, f ⟨0, by omega⟩ = Sum.inr v)
    (hside : ∀ i, isLeft (f (childIndex i)) = (skeletonPattern s).childLeft i)
    (hadj : ∀ i, (arrivalGraph (residualInstance α (sampleArrivals encode ω))).Adj
      (f (childIndex i)) (f (parentIndex (skeletonPattern s) i)))
    (hheavy : m ≤ 2*(univ.filter fun i : Fin m => isLeft (f (childIndex i)) = true).card) :
    ω ∈ heavyShapeEvent H encode α T m := by
  classical
  have ht : ∀ i : Fin m, ∃ t : Fin T, residualTime α encode ω t ∧
      if (skeletonPattern s).childLeft i then
        f (childIndex i) = Sum.inl (encode (ω t)).left ∧
        f (parentIndex (skeletonPattern s) i) = Sum.inr (encode (ω t)).right
      else
        f (parentIndex (skeletonPattern s) i) = Sum.inl (encode (ω t)).left ∧
        f (childIndex i) = Sum.inr (encode (ω t)).right := by
    intro i
    obtain ⟨_, t, hres, hxy⟩ := (residual_adj_iff_time encode α ω _ _).mp (hadj i)
    refine ⟨t, hres, ?_⟩
    have hsi := hside i
    cases hs : (skeletonPattern s).childLeft i <;> simp only [hs, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, if_true]
    · rcases hxy with hxy | hxy
      · rw [← hxy.1, hs] at hsi
        simp [isLeft] at hsi
      · exact ⟨hxy.1.symm, hxy.2.symm⟩
    · rcases hxy with hxy | hxy
      · exact ⟨hxy.1.symm, hxy.2.symm⟩
      · rw [← hxy.2, hs] at hsi
        simp [isLeft] at hsi
  choose τ hτ using ht
  let g : Fin m → E := fun i => ω (τ i)
  let labelled : ShapeCode C m := (s, fun i => (encode (g i)).cls)
  have he : EdgeData (shapePattern labelled) encode f g := by
    intro i
    exact ⟨rfl, (hτ i).2⟩
  have hp := mem_residualPatternEvent_of_data (shapePattern labelled) H encode α hsource
    ω f g hf hroot he (fun i => ⟨τ i, rfl, (hτ i).1⟩)
  have hheavy' : m ≤ 2*(univ.filter fun i : Fin m => (shapePattern labelled).childLeft i = true).card := by
    simpa only [hside] using hheavy
  apply mem_biUnion.mpr
  refine ⟨labelled, mem_univ _, ?_⟩
  simpa only [if_pos hheavy'] using hp

end GraphChoices.Patterns

GraphChoices.Patterns.forestParent.source:
def forestParent : (t : Tree Unit) → (p start : ℕ) → p ≤ start →
    (i : Fin t.numNodes) → Fin (start+i.val+1)
  | .nil, _, _, _, i => Fin.elim0 i
  | .node _ l r, p, start, hp, i =>
    if hz : i.val = 0 then ⟨p,by omega⟩
    else if hl : i.val ≤ l.numNodes then
      let j : Fin l.numNodes := ⟨i.val-1,by omega⟩
      let q := forestParent l (start+1) (start+1) le_rfl j
      ⟨q.val,by have := q.isLt; dsimp [j] at this; omega⟩
    else
      let j : Fin r.numNodes := ⟨i.val-1-l.numNodes,by
        have hi := i.isLt
        simp only [Tree.numNodes] at hi
        omega⟩
      let q := forestParent r p (start+1+l.numNodes) (by omega) j
      ⟨q.val,by have := q.isLt; dsimp [j] at this; omega⟩

GraphChoices.Patterns.forestSide.source:
def forestSide : (t : Tree Unit) → Bool → Fin t.numNodes → Bool
  | .nil, _, i => Fin.elim0 i
  | .node _ l r, side, i =>
    if hz : i.val = 0 then side
    else if hl : i.val ≤ l.numNodes then
      forestSide l (!side) ⟨i.val-1,by omega⟩
    else
      forestSide r side ⟨i.val-1-l.numNodes,by
        have hi := i.isLt
        simp only [Tree.numNodes] at hi
        omega⟩

GraphChoices.Patterns.ShapeCode.source:
abbrev ShapeCode (C : Type*) (m : ℕ) :=
  {t : Tree Unit // t ∈ Tree.treesOfNumNodesEq m} × (Fin m → C)

GraphChoices.Patterns.shapePattern.source:
def shapePattern {C : Type*} {m : ℕ} (s : ShapeCode C m) : ParentPattern C m where
  parent i :=
    let j : Fin s.1.val.numNodes := Fin.cast (Tree.mem_treesOfNumNodesEq.mp s.1.property).symm i
    let q := forestParent s.1.val 0 0 le_rfl j
    ⟨q.val,by simpa [j] using q.isLt⟩
  cls := s.2
  childLeft i := forestSide s.1.val true (Fin.cast (Tree.mem_treesOfNumNodesEq.mp s.1.property).symm i)

GraphChoices.Patterns.shapes_card_le.source:
theorem shapes_card_le (m : ℕ) : (Tree.treesOfNumNodesEq m).card ≤ 4^m := by
  rw [Tree.treesOfNumNodesEq_card_eq_catalan, catalan_eq_centralBinom_div]
  calc
    _ ≤ Nat.centralBinom m := Nat.div_le_self _ _
    _ ≤ 2^(2*m) := Nat.choose_le_two_pow _ _
    _ = _ := by rw [pow_mul]; norm_num

GraphChoices.Patterns.shapeCode_card_le.source:
theorem shapeCode_card_le {C : Type*} [Fintype C] [DecidableEq C] (m : ℕ) :
    Fintype.card (ShapeCode C m) ≤ 4^m * (Fintype.card C)^m := by
  simp only [ShapeCode, Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_coe, Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_fin]
  exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (shapes_card_le m)

variable {E L R C : Type*} [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E] [Nonempty E]
  [Fintype L] [Fintype R] [Fintype C] [DecidableEq L] [DecidableEq R] [DecidableEq C]

/-- Union-bound over canonical plane-tree shapes and class labels. Only the
left-heavy patterns are retained; the per-pattern bound is a stated premise. -/

GraphChoices.Patterns.heavyShapeEvent.source:
noncomputable def heavyShapeEvent (H : C → Peeling.Graph L R) (encode : E → ThresholdGreedy.Arrival L R C)
    (α : C → ℕ) (T m : ℕ) : Finset (Fin T → E) := by
  classical
  exact univ.biUnion fun s : ShapeCode C m =>
    if m ≤ 2*(univ.filter fun i : Fin m => (shapePattern s).childLeft i = true).card
    then residualPatternEvent (shapePattern s) H encode α T else ∅

GraphChoices.Patterns.heavyShape_probabi.source:
theorem heavyShape_probability_le (H : C → Peeling.Graph L R) (encode : E → ThresholdGreedy.Arrival L R C)
    (α : C → ℕ) (T m : ℕ) (N r : ℝ) (hN : 0 ≤ N) (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hpattern : ∀ s : ShapeCode C m,
      m ≤ 2*(univ.filter fun i : Fin m => (shapePattern s).childLeft i = true).card →
      eventProbability (residualPatternEvent (shapePattern s) H encode α T) ≤ N*r^m) :
    eventProbability (heavyShapeEvent H encode α T m) ≤ N*(4*(Fintype.card C : ℝ)*r)^m := by
  classical
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ s : ShapeCode C m, eventProbability
      (if m ≤ 2*(univ.filter fun i : Fin m => (shapePattern s).childLeft i = true).card
      then residualPatternEvent (shapePattern s) H encode α T else ∅) := witness_union_bound _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ _s : ShapeCode C m, N*r^m := by
      apply sum_le_sum
      intro s _
      split_ifs with h
      · exact hpattern s h
      · simpa [eventProbability] using mul_nonneg hN (pow_nonneg hr m)
    _ = (Fintype.card (ShapeCode C m) : ℝ)*(N*r^m) := by simp
    _ ≤ (4^m*(Fintype.card C)^m : ℕ)*(N*r^m) := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (mul_nonneg hN (pow_nonneg hr m))
      exact_mod_cast shapeCode_card_le (C := C) m
    _ = _ := by push_cast; rw [mul_pow, mul_pow]; ring

end GraphChoices.Patterns

GraphChoices.Patterns.heavyShape_decay_o.source:
theorem heavyShape_decay_of_thresholds (H : C → Peeling.Graph L R)
    (encode : E → Arrival L R C) (α : C → ℕ) (DL DR : C → ℕ) (D : ℕ) (f : C → ℝ)
    (hsimple : Function.Injective fun e => ((encode e).left,(encode e).right))
    (hDL : ∀ u c, (sourceBucket encode u c).card ≤ DL c)
    (hL : ∀ c u, Peeling.leftDegree (H c) u ≤ D)
    (hR : ∀ c v, Peeling.rightDegree (H c) v ≤ DR c)
    (b r : ℝ) (hT : 0 < T) (hb : 0 < b) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hbr : b ≤ r)
    (hpair : (D : ℝ)*((T:ℝ)/Fintype.card E)*b ≤ r^2)
    (hf : ∀ c, 1 < f c)
    (hbase : ∀ c, Real.exp 1*T*(DL c : ℝ)/Fintype.card E/α c ≤ 1/f c)
    (hthreshold : ∀ c, 0 < DR c →
      Real.log (((DR c : ℝ)*((T:ℝ)/Fintype.card E))/b) / Real.log (f c) ≤ (α c : ℝ)) :
    eventProbability (heavyShapeEvent H encode α T m) ≤
      (Fintype.card R : ℝ)*(4*(Fintype.card C : ℝ)*r)^m := by
  apply heavyShape_probability_le H encode α T m _ r (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hr
  intro s hs
  exact residualPattern_decay_of_thresholds (shapePattern s) H encode α DL DR D f
    hsimple hDL hL hR b r hT hb hr hbr hpair hf hbase hthreshold hs

GraphChoices.Patterns.heavyShape_geometr.source:
theorem heavyShape_geometric_tail (H : C → Peeling.Graph L R)
    (encode : E → Arrival L R C) (α : C → ℕ) (T m : ℕ) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hdecay : eventProbability (heavyShapeEvent H encode α T m) ≤
      (Fintype.card R : ℝ)*(4*(Fintype.card C : ℝ)*r)^m)
    (hsmall : 4*(Fintype.card C : ℝ)*r ≤ 1/2) :
    eventProbability (heavyShapeEvent H encode α T m) ≤ (Fintype.card R : ℝ)/2^m := by
  calc
    _ ≤ (Fintype.card R : ℝ)*(4*(Fintype.card C : ℝ)*r)^m := hdecay
    _ ≤ (Fintype.card R : ℝ)*((1:ℝ)/2)^m :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hsmall m) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    _ = _ := by rw [div_pow]; ring

/-- An explicit inverse-polynomial failure probability for the canonical
heavy-tree event. The exponent condition is exact and uses no asymptotic O. -/

GraphChoices.Patterns.heavyShape_polynom.source:
theorem heavyShape_polynomial_tail (H : C → Peeling.Graph L R)
    (encode : E → Arrival L R C) (α : C → ℕ) (T m N c : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (hR : Fintype.card R ≤ N)
    (hprob : eventProbability (heavyShapeEvent H encode α T m) ≤ (Fintype.card R : ℝ)/2^m)
    (hexponent : N^(c+1) ≤ 2^m) :
    eventProbability (heavyShapeEvent H encode α T m) ≤ 1/(N:ℝ)^c := by
  have hNr : (0:ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN
  have hexp : (N:ℝ)^(c+1) ≤ (2:ℝ)^m := by exact_mod_cast hexponent
  calc
    _ ≤ (Fintype.card R : ℝ)/2^m := hprob
    _ ≤ (N:ℝ)/2^m := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast hR) (by positivity)
    _ ≤ (N:ℝ)/(N:ℝ)^(c+1) := div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hNr.le (by positivity) hexp
    _ = _ := by rw [pow_succ]; field_simp

end GraphChoices.Patterns

GraphChoices.greedy_bound_by_arrivals.source:
theorem greedy_bound_by_arrivals {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {T : ℕ}
    (I : Instance V T) (a : Orientation T) (hg : IsGreedy I a) (hT : 0 < T) :
    maxLoad I a ≤ 2*opt I*(Nat.log 2 (2*T)+1) := by
  let S := univ.image I.left ∪ univ.image I.right
  have hl (t : Fin T) : I.left t ∈ S := mem_union_left _ (mem_image.mpr ⟨t,mem_univ _,rfl⟩)
  have hr (t : Fin T) : I.right t ∈ S := mem_union_right _ (mem_image.mpr ⟨t,mem_univ _,rfl⟩)
  have hc : S.card ≤ 2*T := by
    have h1 := card_image_le (f := I.left) (s := univ)
    have h2 := card_image_le (f := I.right) (s := univ)
    have h3 := card_union_le (univ.image I.left) (univ.image I.right)
    simp only [card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] at h1 h2
    dsimp only [S]
    omega
  apply (maxLoad_le_iff _ _ _).mpr
  intro v
  by_cases hv : v ∈ S
  · exact (greedy_load_lt_of_closed I a hg S (fun t => ⟨fun _ => hr t,fun _ => hl t⟩)
      hT (Nat.log 2 (2*T)+1) (hc.trans_lt (Nat.lt_pow_succ_log_self (by decide) _)) v hv).le
  · have hz : load I a v = 0 := by
      apply card_eq_zero.mpr
      apply Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem.mpr
      intro t ht
      have hd := (mem_filter.mp ht).2
      have hm : destination I a t ∈ S := by
        rcases destination_endpoint I a t with he | he
        · rw [he]; exact hl t
        · rw [he]; exact hr t
      exact hv (hd ▸ hm)
    rw [hz]
    omega

end GraphChoices

namespace GraphChoices.Peeling
open Finset ThresholdGreedy
variable {L R : Type*} [Fintype L] [Fintype R] [DecidableEq L] [DecidableEq R]

GraphChoices.Peeling.simpleEncode.source: def simpleEncode (G : Graph L R) (e : G) : Arrival L R Unit := ⟨e.val.1,e.val.2,()⟩

GraphChoices.Peeling.simpleGreedyPolicy.source: def simpleGreedyPolicy (G : Graph L R) : OnlinePolicy G := thresholdPolicy (simpleEncode G) (fun _ => 0)

GraphChoices.Peeling.simpleGreedyPolicy_.source:
theorem simpleGreedyPolicy_isGreedy (G : Graph L R) [Nonempty G] {T : ℕ} (ω : Fin T → G) :
    IsGreedy ((graphBase G).sample ω) (onlineOrientation (simpleGreedyPolicy G) ω) := by
  apply isGreedy_of_execution _ _ (policyPrefixLoad (simpleEncode G) (fun _ => 0) ω)
    (policyPrefixLoad_zero _ _ ω) (policyPrefixLoad_step _ _ ω)
  intro t v hv
  let es := (((List.ofFn ω).take t.val).map (simpleEncode G))
  let s := run (fun _ : Unit => 0) es
  have hzero (u : L) : ∑ i : Unit, s.threshold u i = 0 := by
    have hh := threshold_budget (fun _ : Unit => 0) es u
    simpa only [sum_const_zero, Nat.le_zero] using hh
  have hload (u : L) : stateLoad s (Sum.inl u) = s.greedyLeft u := by simp only [stateLoad, Sum.elim_inl, hzero, zero_add]
  change stateLoad s (if stepChoice (fun _ : Unit => 0) s (simpleEncode G (ω t)) then
    Sum.inl (ω t).val.1 else Sum.inr (ω t).val.2) ≤ stateLoad s v
  change v = Sum.inl (ω t).val.1 ∨ v = Sum.inr (ω t).val.2 at hv
  simp only [stepChoice, Nat.not_lt_zero, ↓reduceIte, simpleEncode, decide_eq_true_eq]
  by_cases hh : s.greedyLeft (ω t).val.1 < s.greedyRight (ω t).val.2
  · rw [if_pos hh, hload]
    rcases hv with rfl | rfl
    · rw [hload]
    · exact hh.le
  · rw [if_neg hh]
    rcases hv with rfl | rfl
    · rw [hload]
      exact le_of_not_gt hh
    · exact le_rfl

GraphChoices.Peeling.short_horizon_polic.source:
theorem short_horizon_policy (G : Graph L R) [Nonempty G] (N T : ℕ)
    (hT : 0 < T) (hlog : 2 ≤ Real.log (N:ℝ)) (hshort : (T:ℝ) ≤ Real.log (N:ℝ)) :
    expectedCost (graphBase G) (onlineOrientation (T := T) (simpleGreedyPolicy G)) ≤
      12*loglogFactor N*expectedOpt (graphBase G) T := by
  have hgreedy : expectedCost (graphBase G) (onlineOrientation (T := T) (simpleGreedyPolicy G)) ≤
      (2*(Nat.log 2 (2*T)+1):ℕ)*expectedOpt (graphBase G) T := by
    unfold expectedCost expectedOpt
    rw [← average_mul]
    apply average_mono
    intro ω
    have hh := greedy_bound_by_arrivals ((graphBase G).sample ω) _ (simpleGreedyPolicy_isGreedy G ω) hT
    exact_mod_cast (by nlinarith : maxLoad ((graphBase G).sample ω) (onlineOrientation (simpleGreedyPolicy G) ω) ≤
      (2*(Nat.log 2 (2*T)+1))*opt ((graphBase G).sample ω))
  have hln := nat_log_le_twice_real_log (2*T) (by omega)
  have hTp : (0:ℝ) < T := by exact_mod_cast hT
  have hlogT := Real.log_le_log hTp hshort
  have hloglog := Real.log_le_log (by linarith : 0 < Real.log (N:ℝ)) (by linarith : Real.log (N:ℝ) ≤ 1+Real.log (N:ℝ))
  have hN2 : (2:ℝ) ≤ N := by
    by_contra hn
    have hnat : N < 2 := by exact_mod_cast lt_of_not_ge hn
    have hz : N = 0 ∨ N = 1 := by omega
    rcases hz with rfl | rfl <;> norm_num at hlog
  have hfactor : loglogFactor N = 1+Real.log (1+Real.log (N:ℝ)) := by unfold loglogFactor; rw [max_eq_right hN2]
  have hlog2 : Real.log 2 ≤ 1 := by linarith [Real.log_two_lt_d9]
  rw [Nat.cast_mul, Real.log_mul (by norm_num) hTp.ne'] at hln
  norm_num only [Nat.cast_ofNat] at hln
  have hcoeff : (((2*(Nat.log 2 (2*T)+1):ℕ):ℝ)) ≤ 12*loglogFactor N := by
    push_cast
    rw [hfactor]
    have hh := Real.log_nonneg (show 1 ≤ 1+Real.log (N:ℝ) by linarith)
    linarith
  exact hgreedy.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcoeff (expectedOpt_nonneg _ _))

end GraphChoices.Peeling

GraphChoices.skew_denominator_ge_log.source:
theorem skew_denominator_ge_log {δ d n : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hn : 2 ≤ Real.log n) (hdeg : δ ≤ d*Real.log n) :
    Real.log n ≤ d*(Real.log n)^2/δ := by
  apply (le_div_iff₀ hδ).mpr
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hdeg (by linarith : 0 ≤ Real.log n)]

GraphChoices.skew_threshold_le_log.source:
theorem skew_threshold_le_log {a b δ d n : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 1 ≤ b)
    (han : a ≤ n) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hd : 0 < d) (hn : 2 ≤ Real.log n)
    (hdeg : δ ≤ d*Real.log n) (k : ℕ)
    (hk : 2*(k:ℝ) ≤ localLogSkewness a b δ d n) : (k:ℝ) ≤ Real.log n := by
  let q := d*(Real.log n)^2/δ
  have hq : Real.log n ≤ q := skew_denominator_ge_log hδ hd hn hdeg
  have hq2 : 2 ≤ q := hn.trans hq
  have hlogq : 1/2 ≤ Real.log q := by
    have hh := Real.log_le_log (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<2) hq2
    linarith [Real.log_two_gt_d9]
  have hratio : a/b ≤ n := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ (by linarith : 0 < b)).mpr
    nlinarith
  have hlogratio := Real.log_le_log (div_pos ha (by linarith : 0 < b)) hratio
  have hk' : 2*(k:ℝ)*Real.log q ≤ Real.log (a/b) :=
    (le_div_iff₀ (by linarith : 0 < Real.log q)).mp hk
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlogq (Nat.cast_nonneg k)]

GraphChoices.skew_block_population.source:
theorem skew_block_population {a b δ d n : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (han : a ≤ n) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hn : 2 ≤ Real.log n) (hdeg : δ ≤ d*Real.log n)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) (hks : 2*(k:ℝ) ≤ localLogSkewness a b δ d n) :
    b ≤ a*((min 1 (δ/d)/(k:ℝ))/2)^k := by
  let q := d*(Real.log n)^2/δ
  let rate := min 1 (δ/d)
  have hkpos : (0:ℝ) < k := by exact_mod_cast hk
  have hrate : 0 < rate := lt_min (by norm_num) (div_pos hδ hd)
  have hqlog : Real.log n ≤ q := skew_denominator_ge_log hδ hd hn hdeg
  have hq2 : 2 ≤ q := hn.trans hqlog
  have hqpos : 0 < q := by linarith
  have hklog : (k:ℝ) ≤ Real.log n := skew_threshold_le_log ha hb han hδ hd hn hdeg k hks
  have hscale : 2*(k:ℝ)/rate ≤ q^2 := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hrate).mpr
    by_cases hδd : 1 ≤ δ/d
    · have hl : rate = 1 := min_eq_left hδd
      rw [hl]
      nlinarith
    · have hl : rate = δ/d := min_eq_right (le_of_not_ge hδd)
      have heq : q*rate = (Real.log n)^2 := by dsimp [q]; rw [hl]; field_simp
      have hh : q*rate ≤ q^2*rate := by nlinarith [mul_nonneg hrate.le (by nlinarith : 0 ≤ q^2-q)]
      nlinarith
  have hpow : (2*(k:ℝ)/rate)^k ≤ a/b := by
    apply (Real.log_le_log_iff (pow_pos (div_pos (by positivity) hrate) _) (div_pos ha (by linarith))).mp
    rw [Real.log_pow]
    have hlogscale := Real.log_le_log (div_pos (by positivity : 0 < 2*(k:ℝ)) hrate) hscale
    rw [Real.log_pow] at hlogscale
    have hk' : 2*(k:ℝ)*Real.log q ≤ Real.log (a/b) :=
      (le_div_iff₀ (Real.log_pos (by linarith : 1 < q))).mp hks
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlogscale hkpos.le]
  have hpowerpos : 0 < (2*(k:ℝ)/rate)^k := pow_pos (div_pos (by positivity) hrate) _
  have hprod : ((rate/(k:ℝ))/2)^k * (2*(k:ℝ)/rate)^k = 1 := by
    rw [← mul_pow]
    have heq : ((rate/(k:ℝ))/2) * (2*(k:ℝ)/rate) = 1 := by field_simp
    rw [heq, one_pow]
  change b ≤ a*((rate/(k:ℝ))/2)^k
  apply (mul_le_mul_right hpowerpos).mp
  rw [mul_assoc, hprod, mul_one]
  have hh := (le_div_iff₀ (by linarith : 0 < b)).mp hpow
  nlinarith

GraphChoices.block_length_mean.source:
theorem block_length_mean (N k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) (hkN : k ≤ N)
    (δ d m : ℝ) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hd : 0 < d) (hm : 0 < m)
    (haverage : 2*m = (N:ℝ)*d) :
    min 1 (δ/d)/(k:ℝ) ≤ ((N/k : ℕ):ℝ)*(δ/m) := by
  have hs : 1 ≤ N/k := Nat.div_pos hkN hk
  have hN : N < (N/k)*k+k := Nat.lt_div_mul_add hk
  have hnk : k ≤ (N/k)*k := by nlinarith
  have hfloor : (N:ℝ) ≤ 2*((N/k : ℕ):ℝ)*(k:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (by nlinarith : N ≤ 2*(N/k)*k)
  have hkpos : (0:ℝ) < k := by exact_mod_cast hk
  apply le_trans (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (min_le_right _ _) hkpos.le)
  apply (div_le_iff₀ hkpos).mpr
  apply (div_le_iff₀ hd).mpr
  have hh : (N:ℝ)*δ ≤ 2*((N/k : ℕ):ℝ)*(k:ℝ)*δ :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hfloor hδ
  apply (le_of_mul_le_mul_right (a := m) ?_ hm)
  field_simp
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg hδ (sub_nonneg.mpr hfloor)]

end GraphChoices

GraphChoices.Peeling.roundBudget.source: def roundBudget (B i : ℕ) : ℕ := 16*B / scaleNat i

GraphChoices.Peeling.scaleNat_pos.source: theorem scaleNat_pos (i : ℕ) : 0 < scaleNat i := by unfold scaleNat; positivity

GraphChoices.Peeling.scaleNat_succ.source:
theorem scaleNat_succ (i : ℕ) : scaleNat (i+1) = (scaleNat i)^2 := by
  unfold scaleNat
  rw [← pow_mul, pow_succ]

GraphChoices.Peeling.roundBudget_zero.source:
theorem roundBudget_zero (B : ℕ) : roundBudget B 0 = 4*B := by
  simp only [roundBudget, scaleNat]
  norm_num
  omega

/-- Floor rounding leaves enough slack for the minimum active integer degree. -/

GraphChoices.Peeling.active_cutoff_at_sc.source:
theorem active_cutoff_at_scale (B i : ℕ) (d : ℝ) (hd : d ≤ 16*B) :
    d / (scaleNat i : ℝ)^2 ≤ (roundBudget B (i+1) + 1 : ℕ) := by
  have hpos := scaleNat_pos (i+1)
  have hdiv : 16*B < (16*B / scaleNat (i+1) + 1) * scaleNat (i+1) := by
    have hm := Nat.mod_lt (16*B) hpos
    have he := Nat.mod_add_div (16*B) (scaleNat (i+1))
    nlinarith
  have hcast : (16*B : ℝ) ≤ ((roundBudget B (i+1) + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (scaleNat i : ℝ)^2 := by
    have he : scaleNat (i+1) = scaleNat i ^ 2 := scaleNat_succ i
    have hr : ((16*B : ℕ) : ℝ) < ((16*B / scaleNat (i+1) + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (scaleNat (i+1) : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast hdiv
    simpa [roundBudget, he] using hr.le
  have hscale : (0:ℝ) < (scaleNat i : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast scaleNat_pos i
  apply (div_le_iff₀ (sq_pos_of_pos hscale)).mpr
  exact hd.trans hcast

GraphChoices.Peeling.skewSchedule.source:
noncomputable def skewSchedule (G : Graph L R) (B h : ℕ) (d n : ℝ) : List (ℕ × ℕ) :=
  List.ofFn fun i : Fin h =>
    (roundBudget B (i.val+1), scaleCapacity G d n (scaleNat i.val))

GraphChoices.Peeling.skewSchedule_length.source:
theorem skewSchedule_length (G : Graph L R) (B h : ℕ) (d n : ℝ) :
    (skewSchedule G B h d n).length = h := by simp [skewSchedule]

GraphChoices.Peeling.skewSchedule_expand.source:
theorem skewSchedule_expands (G : Graph L R) (B h : ℕ) (d n : ℝ)
    (hd : 0 < d) (hn : 1 < Real.log n)
    (hleft : ∀ u, (leftDegree G u : ℝ) ≤ d * Real.log n) (hB : d ≤ 16*B) :
    ∀ kb ∈ skewSchedule G B h d n, PeelingExpansion G kb.1 kb.2 := by
  intro kb hkb
  obtain ⟨i,rfl⟩ := List.mem_ofFn.mp hkb
  apply peelingExpansion_of_graphLogSkewness G _ d n (scaleNat i.val) hd _ hn hleft
    (active_cutoff_at_scale B i.val d hB)
  exact_mod_cast (scaleNat_pos i.val)

/-- A zero cutoff in the last round makes the schedule end at zero. -/

GraphChoices.Peeling.finalBudget_append.source:
theorem finalBudget_append (D : ℕ) (ss : List (ℕ × ℕ)) (kb : ℕ × ℕ) :
    finalBudget D (ss ++ [kb]) = kb.1 := by
  induction ss generalizing D with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a ss ih => exact ih a.1

GraphChoices.Peeling.skewSchedule_finalB.source:
theorem skewSchedule_finalBudget (G : Graph L R) (B h : ℕ) (d n : ℝ) :
    finalBudget (roundBudget B 0) (skewSchedule G B h d n) = roundBudget B h := by
  induction h with
  | zero => simp [skewSchedule, finalBudget]
  | succ h ih =>
    unfold skewSchedule
    rw [List.ofFn_succ']
    simp only [List.concat_eq_append]
    rw [finalBudget_append]
    rfl

/-- Concrete doubly exponential decomposition. There is one piece for each
scale 2^(2^(i+1)); their exact integer degree caps are recorded by pieceBudgets.
The condition 16 B < scaleNat h certifies that all edges have been extracted. -/

GraphChoices.Peeling.exists_doubly_expon.source:
theorem exists_doubly_exponential_decomposition (G : Graph L R) (B h : ℕ) (d n : ℝ)
    (hd : 0 < d) (hn : 1 < Real.log n)
    (hleft : ∀ u, (leftDegree G u : ℝ) ≤ d * Real.log n)
    (hB : d ≤ 16*B) (hD : ∀ u, leftDegree G u ≤ 4*B)
    (hstop : 16*B < scaleNat h) :
    ∃ Ps : List (Graph L R), Ps.length = h ∧ Ps.Pairwise Disjoint ∧
      unionPieces Ps = G ∧
      List.Forall₂ (fun P kb => (∀ u, leftDegree P u ≤ kb.1) ∧
        (∀ v, rightDegree P v ≤ kb.2)) Ps
        (pieceBudgets (4*B) (skewSchedule G B h d n)) := by
  have hfinal : finalBudget (4*B) (skewSchedule G B h d n) = 0 := by
    rw [← roundBudget_zero B, skewSchedule_finalBudget]
    exact Nat.div_eq_of_lt hstop
  obtain ⟨Ps,hlen,hdisj,hcover,hbounds⟩ := exists_edge_partition G (4*B) hD
    (skewSchedule G B h d n) (skewSchedule_expands G B h d n hd hn hleft hB) hfinal
  exact ⟨Ps,hlen.trans (skewSchedule_length G B h d n),hdisj,hcover,hbounds⟩

GraphChoices.Peeling.pieceBudgets_append.source:
theorem pieceBudgets_append (D : ℕ) (ss : List (ℕ × ℕ)) (kb : ℕ × ℕ) :
    pieceBudgets D (ss ++ [kb]) = pieceBudgets D ss ++
      [(finalBudget D ss, finalBudget D ss * kb.2)] := by
  induction ss generalizing D with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a ss ih => simpa [pieceBudgets, finalBudget] using congrArg (List.cons (D,D*a.2)) (ih a.1)

/-- The generic iteration certificate has exactly the intended scale-by-scale
integer degree caps. -/

GraphChoices.Peeling.pieceBudgets_skewSc.source:
theorem pieceBudgets_skewSchedule (G : Graph L R) (B h : ℕ) (d n : ℝ) :
    pieceBudgets (4*B) (skewSchedule G B h d n) =
      List.ofFn (fun i : Fin h => (roundBudget B i.val,
        roundBudget B i.val * scaleCapacity G d n (scaleNat i.val))) := by
  induction h with
  | zero => simp [skewSchedule, pieceBudgets]
  | succ h ih =>
    have heq : skewSchedule G B (h+1) d n = skewSchedule G B h d n ++
        [(roundBudget B (h+1), scaleCapacity G d n (scaleNat h))] := by
      unfold skewSchedule
      rw [List.ofFn_succ']
      simp only [List.concat_eq_append]
      rfl
    rw [heq, pieceBudgets_append, ih]
    have hfinal : finalBudget (4*B) (skewSchedule G B h d n) = roundBudget B h := by
      rw [← roundBudget_zero B, skewSchedule_finalBudget]
    rw [hfinal, List.ofFn_succ']
    simp only [List.concat_eq_append]
    rfl

GraphChoices.Peeling.scaleNat_ge_two.source:
theorem scaleNat_ge_two (i : ℕ) : 2 ≤ scaleNat i := by
  have hp : 1 ≤ 2^(i+1) := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (pow_ne_zero _ (by decide))
  simpa [scaleNat] using Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide : 0 < 2) hp

GraphChoices.Peeling.roundBudget_mul_sca.source:
theorem roundBudget_mul_scale (B i : ℕ) : roundBudget B i * scaleNat i ≤ 16*B :=
  Nat.div_mul_le_self _ _

GraphChoices.Peeling.roundBudget_real_le.source:
theorem roundBudget_real_le (B i : ℕ) :
    (roundBudget B i : ℝ) ≤ (16*B : ℝ) / scaleNat i := by
  have hp : (0:ℝ) < scaleNat i := by exact_mod_cast scaleNat_pos i
  apply (le_div_iff₀ hp).mpr
  exact_mod_cast roundBudget_mul_scale B i

/-- Integer rounding of the right capacity costs no extra constant, since each
scale is at least two and the unrounded right-capacity factor is at least one. -/

GraphChoices.Peeling.rounded_capacity_pr.source:
theorem rounded_capacity_product (B i : ℕ) (Q : ℝ) (hQ : 1 ≤ Q) :
    ((roundBudget B i * ⌈Q⌉₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ 16*B*Q := by
  have hscale : (2:ℝ) ≤ scaleNat i := by exact_mod_cast scaleNat_ge_two i
  have hmul : (roundBudget B i : ℝ) * scaleNat i ≤ 16*B := by
    exact_mod_cast roundBudget_mul_scale B i
  have hnonneg : (0:ℝ) ≤ roundBudget B i := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  have hsmall : (roundBudget B i : ℝ)*2 ≤ 16*B := by nlinarith
  have hceil : (⌈Q⌉₊ : ℝ) ≤ 2*Q := by
    have hh := Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (by linarith : 0 ≤ Q)
    linarith
  calc
    _ = (roundBudget B i : ℝ) * (⌈Q⌉₊ : ℝ) := by norm_cast
    _ ≤ (roundBudget B i : ℝ) * (2*Q) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hceil hnonneg
    _ = ((roundBudget B i : ℝ)*2)*Q := by ring
    _ ≤ 16*B*Q := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsmall (by linarith)

/-- An explicit log-log number of matching-extraction rounds. -/

GraphChoices.Peeling.numberRounds_suffic.source:
theorem numberRounds_suffices (B : ℕ) : 16*B < scaleNat (numberRounds B) := by
  have houter := Nat.lt_pow_succ_log_self (by decide : 1 < 2) (16*B)
  have hinner := Nat.lt_pow_succ_log_self (by decide : 1 < 2) (Nat.log 2 (16*B) + 1)
  exact houter.trans_le (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide : 0 < 2) (Nat.le_of_lt hinner))

/-- A bounded-left-degree graph admits an exact partition with the explicit
log-log piece count; no termination or expansion conclusion is assumed. -/

GraphChoices.Peeling.exists_loglog_skew_.source:
theorem exists_loglog_skew_decomposition (G : Graph L R) (B : ℕ) (d n : ℝ)
    (hd : 0 < d) (hn : 1 < Real.log n)
    (hleft : ∀ u, (leftDegree G u : ℝ) ≤ d * Real.log n)
    (hB : d ≤ 16*B) (hD : ∀ u, leftDegree G u ≤ 4*B) :
    ∃ Ps : List (Graph L R), Ps.length = numberRounds B ∧ Ps.Pairwise Disjoint ∧
      unionPieces Ps = G ∧
      List.Forall₂ (fun P kb => (∀ u, leftDegree P u ≤ kb.1) ∧
        (∀ v, rightDegree P v ≤ kb.2)) Ps
        (pieceBudgets (4*B) (skewSchedule G B (numberRounds B) d n)) :=
  exists_doubly_exponential_decomposition G B _ d n hd hn hleft hB hD (numberRounds_suffices B)

/-- Structural existence part of the skew-biregular decomposition, stated with
explicit real degree bounds and an exact log-log piece count. -/

GraphChoices.Peeling.exists_skew_biregul.source:
theorem exists_skew_biregular_partition (G : Graph L R) (B : ℕ) (d n : ℝ)
    (hd : 0 < d) (hn : 1 < Real.log n)
    (hleft : ∀ u, (leftDegree G u : ℝ) ≤ d * Real.log n)
    (hB : d ≤ 16*B) (hD : ∀ u, leftDegree G u ≤ 4*B) :
    ∃ Ps : List (Graph L R), Ps.length = numberRounds B ∧ Ps.Pairwise Disjoint ∧
      unionPieces Ps = G ∧ ∀ i : Fin Ps.length,
        (∀ u, (leftDegree (Ps.get i) u : ℝ) ≤ 16*B/(scaleNat i.val)) ∧
        (∀ v, (rightDegree (Ps.get i) v : ℝ) ≤
          16*B*((scaleNat i.val : ℝ)*Real.log n)^(2*graphLogSkewness G d n)) := by
  obtain ⟨Ps,hlen,hdisj,hcover,hbounds⟩ := exists_loglog_skew_decomposition G B d n hd hn hleft hB hD
  rw [pieceBudgets_skewSchedule] at hbounds
  refine ⟨Ps,hlen,hdisj,hcover,?_⟩
  intro i
  have hi : i.val < numberRounds B := by rw [← hlen]; exact i.isLt
  have hh := hbounds.get i.isLt (by simp [hi])
  simp only [List.get_eq_getElem, List.getElem_ofFn] at hh
  constructor
  · intro u
    exact (by exact_mod_cast hh.1 u : (leftDegree (Ps.get i) u : ℝ) ≤ roundBudget B i.val).trans
      (roundBudget_real_le B i.val)
  · intro v
    have hQ : (1:ℝ) ≤ ((scaleNat i.val : ℝ)*Real.log n)^(2*graphLogSkewness G d n) := by
      have hs : (2:ℝ) ≤ scaleNat i.val := by exact_mod_cast scaleNat_ge_two i.val
      apply Real.one_le_rpow
      · nlinarith
      · exact mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (graphLogSkewness_nonneg G d n)
    have hright : (rightDegree (Ps.get i) v : ℝ) ≤
