        ((roundBudget B i.val * scaleCapacity G d n (scaleNat i.val) : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast hh.2 v
    exact hright.trans (rounded_capacity_product B i.val _ hQ)

end GraphChoices.Peeling

GraphChoices.localLogSkewness.source:
noncomputable def localLogSkewness (a b d D n : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.log (a/b) / Real.log (D * (Real.log n)^2 / d)

GraphChoices.log_ratio_bound_iff.source:
theorem log_ratio_bound_iff {a b q σ : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hq : 1 < q) :
    Real.log (a/b) / Real.log q ≤ σ ↔ a ≤ b * q^σ := by
  rw [div_le_iff₀ (Real.log_pos hq)]
  rw [mul_comm σ, Real.log_le_iff_le_exp (div_pos ha hb)]
  rw [← Real.rpow_def_of_pos (lt_trans zero_lt_one hq)]
  rw [div_le_iff₀ hb, mul_comm]

/-- A local skewness bound implies the neighborhood expansion inequality.
The parameter q is the denominator's argument in Definition 3.2. -/

GraphChoices.expansion_of_log_skew.source:
theorem expansion_of_log_skew {a b q Q σ : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hq : 1 < q) (hQ : q ≤ Q) (hσ : 0 ≤ σ)
    (hskew : Real.log (a/b) / Real.log q ≤ σ) :
    a ≤ b * Q^σ := by
  exact ((log_ratio_bound_iff ha hb hq).mp hskew).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.rpow_le_rpow (by linarith) hQ hσ) (le_of_lt hb))

/-- The exact scale substitution used for b_i in Lemma 3.7. -/

GraphChoices.expansion_at_scale.source:
theorem expansion_at_scale {a b d D n f σ : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hf : 0 < f) (hn : 0 < Real.log n) (hσ : 0 ≤ σ)
    (hdegree : D / f^2 ≤ d)
    (hdenom : 1 < D * (Real.log n)^2 / d)
    (hskew : localLogSkewness a b d D n ≤ σ) :
    a ≤ b * (f * Real.log n)^(2*σ) := by
  have hf2 : 0 < f^2 := sq_pos_of_pos hf
  have hDle : D ≤ d * f^2 := (div_le_iff₀ hf2).mp hdegree
  have hq : D * (Real.log n)^2 / d ≤ (f * Real.log n)^2 := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hd).mpr
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hDle (sq_nonneg (Real.log n))]
  have hh := expansion_of_log_skew ha hb hdenom hq hσ hskew
  have hp : 0 ≤ f * Real.log n := le_of_lt (mul_pos hf hn)
  have heq : ((f * Real.log n)^2 : ℝ)^σ = (f * Real.log n)^(2*σ) := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hp]
    norm_num
  simpa [heq] using hh

end GraphChoices

GraphChoices.Peeling.skewValue_le_eight_.source:
theorem skewValue_le_eight_expectedOpt_horizon (G F : Graph L R) [Nonempty G]
    (hF : F ⊆ G) (A : Finset L) (N T : ℕ) (d : ℝ)
    (hd : 0 < d) (hlog : 2 ≤ Real.log (N:ℝ)) (hlogT : Real.log (N:ℝ) ≤ T)
    (hleft : ∀ u, (leftDegree G u:ℝ) ≤ d*Real.log (N:ℝ))
    (hvertices : Fintype.card (L ⊕ R) ≤ N)
    (haverage : 2*(G.card:ℝ) = (T:ℝ)*d)
    (hadm : SkewAdmissible F A d (N:ℝ)) :
    skewValue F A d (N:ℝ) ≤ 8*expectedOpt (graphBase G) T := by
  let a : ℝ := A.card
  let b : ℝ := (neighborSet F A).card
  let δ : ℝ := minLeftDegree F A
  let σ := skewValue F A d (N:ℝ)
  let k : ℕ := ⌊σ/2⌋₊
  have ha : 0 < a := by dsimp only [a]; exact_mod_cast hadm.1.card_pos
  have hb : 1 ≤ b := by
    dsimp only [b]
    exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ (neighborSet F A).card from hadm.2.1.card_pos)
  have hδ : 0 < δ := by dsimp only [δ]; exact_mod_cast hadm.2.2.2.1
  have han : a ≤ N := by
    have hh : A.card ≤ N := (card_le_univ A).trans
      ((by simp only [Fintype.card_sum]; omega : Fintype.card L ≤ Fintype.card (L ⊕ R)).trans hvertices)
    dsimp only [a]
    exact_mod_cast hh
  obtain ⟨u,hu⟩ := hadm.1
  have hdeg : δ ≤ d*Real.log (N:ℝ) := by
    apply le_trans _ (hleft u)
    dsimp only [δ]
    exact_mod_cast (minLeftDegree_le F hu).trans (leftDegree_mono hF u)
  have hσ : 0 ≤ σ := by
    apply div_nonneg
    · apply Real.log_nonneg
      apply (one_le_div (by linarith : 0 < b)).mpr
      dsimp only [b]
      exact_mod_cast hadm.2.2.1
    · exact (Real.log_pos hadm.2.2.2.2).le
  have hkfloor : 2*(k:ℝ) ≤ σ := by
    have hh := Nat.floor_le (by linarith : 0 ≤ σ/2)
    change (⌊σ/2⌋₊:ℝ) ≤ σ/2 at hh
    dsimp only [k]
    linarith
  have hσk : σ < 2*((k:ℝ)+1) := by
    have hh := Nat.lt_floor_add_one (σ/2)
    change σ/2 < (k:ℝ)+1 at hh
    linarith
  have hN : 0 < N := by
    by_contra h
    have hh : N = 0 := by omega
    norm_num [hh] at hlog
  have hT : 0 < T := by
    have hh : (0:ℝ) < T := by linarith
    exact_mod_cast hh
  have hopt := expectedOpt_ge_one (graphBase G) T hT
  by_cases hk : k = 0
  · have hh : (k:ℝ) = 0 := by simp [hk]
    change σ ≤ _
    linarith
  have hkpos : 0 < k := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hk
  have hkr : (0:ℝ) < k := by exact_mod_cast hkpos
  have hklog : (k:ℝ) ≤ Real.log (N:ℝ) :=
    skew_threshold_le_log ha hb han hδ hd hlog hdeg k hkfloor
  have hkT : k ≤ T := by exact_mod_cast hklog.trans hlogT
  let x := min 1 (δ/d)/(k:ℝ)
  have hx : 0 ≤ x := div_nonneg (le_min (by norm_num) (div_nonneg hδ.le hd.le)) hkr.le
  have hx1 : x ≤ 1 := by
    apply (div_le_one hkr).mpr
    have hh : (1:ℝ) ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast hkpos
    exact (min_le_left _ _).trans hh
  have hmean : x ≤ ((T/k : ℕ):ℝ)*(δ/G.card) :=
    block_length_mean T k hkpos hkT δ d G.card hδ.le hd
      (by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < G.card by simpa only [← Fintype.card_coe] using Fintype.card_pos (α := G))) haverage
  have hpop : b ≤ a*(x/2)^k :=
    skew_block_population ha hb han hδ hd hlog hdeg k hkpos hkfloor
  have hlower := expectedOpt_subgraph_blocks G F hF A hadm.2.1 k (T/k) x hx hx1 hmean hpop
  have hmon := expectedOpt_mono_horizon (graphBase G) (by simpa only [Nat.mul_comm] using Nat.div_mul_le_self T k)
  have hlow : (k:ℝ)/3 ≤ expectedOpt (graphBase G) T := hlower.trans hmon
  change σ ≤ _
  linarith

/-- Concrete graph log-skewness is absorbed into the actual expected
offline optimum; no skewness-lower-bound premise remains. -/

GraphChoices.Peeling.graphLogSkewness_le.source:
theorem graphLogSkewness_le_eight_expectedOpt_horizon (G : Graph L R) [Nonempty G]
    (N T : ℕ) (d : ℝ) (hd : 0 < d) (hlog : 2 ≤ Real.log (N:ℝ)) (hlogT : Real.log (N:ℝ) ≤ T)
    (hleft : ∀ u, (leftDegree G u:ℝ) ≤ d*Real.log (N:ℝ))
    (hvertices : Fintype.card (L ⊕ R) ≤ N)
    (haverage : 2*(G.card:ℝ) = (T:ℝ)*d) :
    graphLogSkewness G d (N:ℝ) ≤ 8*expectedOpt (graphBase G) T := by
  classical
  unfold graphLogSkewness
  apply (sup'_le_iff _ _).mpr
  intro y hy
  rcases mem_insert.mp hy with rfl | hy
  · have hh := expectedOpt_nonneg (graphBase G) T
    dsimp only [id]
    linarith
  · obtain ⟨⟨F,A⟩,hFA,rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hy
    have hh := mem_filter.mp hFA
    have hF : F ⊆ G := mem_powerset.mp (mem_product.mp hh.1).1
    exact skewValue_le_eight_expectedOpt_horizon G F hF A N T d hd hlog hlogT hleft hvertices haverage hh.2

end GraphChoices.Peeling

GraphChoices.Peeling.skewValue_le_eight_.source:
theorem skewValue_le_eight_expectedOpt (G F : Graph L R) [Nonempty G]
    (hF : F ⊆ G) (A : Finset L) (N : ℕ) (d : ℝ)
    (hd : 0 < d) (hlog : 2 ≤ Real.log (N:ℝ))
    (hleft : ∀ u, (leftDegree G u:ℝ) ≤ d*Real.log (N:ℝ))
    (hvertices : Fintype.card (L ⊕ R) ≤ N)
    (haverage : 2*(G.card:ℝ) = (N:ℝ)*d)
    (hadm : SkewAdmissible F A d (N:ℝ)) :
    skewValue F A d (N:ℝ) ≤ 8*expectedOpt (graphBase G) N := by
  let a : ℝ := A.card
  let b : ℝ := (neighborSet F A).card
  let δ : ℝ := minLeftDegree F A
  let σ := skewValue F A d (N:ℝ)
  let k : ℕ := ⌊σ/2⌋₊
  have ha : 0 < a := by dsimp only [a]; exact_mod_cast hadm.1.card_pos
  have hb : 1 ≤ b := by
    dsimp only [b]
    exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ (neighborSet F A).card from hadm.2.1.card_pos)
  have hδ : 0 < δ := by dsimp only [δ]; exact_mod_cast hadm.2.2.2.1
  have han : a ≤ N := by
    have hh : A.card ≤ N := (card_le_univ A).trans
      ((by simp only [Fintype.card_sum]; omega : Fintype.card L ≤ Fintype.card (L ⊕ R)).trans hvertices)
    dsimp only [a]
    exact_mod_cast hh
  obtain ⟨u,hu⟩ := hadm.1
  have hdeg : δ ≤ d*Real.log (N:ℝ) := by
    apply le_trans _ (hleft u)
    dsimp only [δ]
    exact_mod_cast (minLeftDegree_le F hu).trans (leftDegree_mono hF u)
  have hσ : 0 ≤ σ := by
    apply div_nonneg
    · apply Real.log_nonneg
      apply (one_le_div (by linarith : 0 < b)).mpr
      dsimp only [b]
      exact_mod_cast hadm.2.2.1
    · exact (Real.log_pos hadm.2.2.2.2).le
  have hkfloor : 2*(k:ℝ) ≤ σ := by
    have hh := Nat.floor_le (by linarith : 0 ≤ σ/2)
    change (⌊σ/2⌋₊:ℝ) ≤ σ/2 at hh
    dsimp only [k]
    linarith
  have hσk : σ < 2*((k:ℝ)+1) := by
    have hh := Nat.lt_floor_add_one (σ/2)
    change σ/2 < (k:ℝ)+1 at hh
    linarith
  have hN : 0 < N := by
    by_contra h
    have hh : N = 0 := by omega
    norm_num [hh] at hlog
  have hopt := expectedOpt_ge_one (graphBase G) N hN
  by_cases hk : k = 0
  · have hh : (k:ℝ) = 0 := by simp [hk]
    change σ ≤ _
    linarith
  have hkpos : 0 < k := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hk
  have hkr : (0:ℝ) < k := by exact_mod_cast hkpos
  have hklog : (k:ℝ) ≤ Real.log (N:ℝ) :=
    skew_threshold_le_log ha hb han hδ hd hlog hdeg k hkfloor
  have hkN : k ≤ N := by
    have hh := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (show (0:ℝ)<N by exact_mod_cast hN)
    exact_mod_cast (show (k:ℝ) ≤ N by linarith)
  let x := min 1 (δ/d)/(k:ℝ)
  have hx : 0 ≤ x := div_nonneg (le_min (by norm_num) (div_nonneg hδ.le hd.le)) hkr.le
  have hx1 : x ≤ 1 := by
    apply (div_le_one hkr).mpr
    have hh : (1:ℝ) ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast hkpos
    exact (min_le_left _ _).trans hh
  have hmean : x ≤ ((N/k : ℕ):ℝ)*(δ/G.card) :=
    block_length_mean N k hkpos hkN δ d G.card hδ.le hd
      (by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < G.card by simpa only [← Fintype.card_coe] using Fintype.card_pos (α := G))) haverage
  have hpop : b ≤ a*(x/2)^k :=
    skew_block_population ha hb han hδ hd hlog hdeg k hkpos hkfloor
  have hlower := expectedOpt_subgraph_blocks G F hF A hadm.2.1 k (N/k) x hx hx1 hmean hpop
  have hmon := expectedOpt_mono_horizon (graphBase G) (by simpa only [Nat.mul_comm] using Nat.div_mul_le_self N k)
  have hlow : (k:ℝ)/3 ≤ expectedOpt (graphBase G) N := hlower.trans hmon
  change σ ≤ _
  linarith

/-- Concrete graph log-skewness is absorbed into the actual expected
offline optimum; no skewness-lower-bound premise remains. -/

GraphChoices.Peeling.graphLogSkewness_le.source:
theorem graphLogSkewness_le_eight_expectedOpt (G : Graph L R) [Nonempty G]
    (N : ℕ) (d : ℝ) (hd : 0 < d) (hlog : 2 ≤ Real.log (N:ℝ))
    (hleft : ∀ u, (leftDegree G u:ℝ) ≤ d*Real.log (N:ℝ))
    (hvertices : Fintype.card (L ⊕ R) ≤ N)
    (haverage : 2*(G.card:ℝ) = (N:ℝ)*d) :
    graphLogSkewness G d (N:ℝ) ≤ 8*expectedOpt (graphBase G) N := by
  classical
  unfold graphLogSkewness
  apply (sup'_le_iff _ _).mpr
  intro y hy
  rcases mem_insert.mp hy with rfl | hy
  · have hh := expectedOpt_nonneg (graphBase G) N
    dsimp only [id]
    linarith
  · obtain ⟨⟨F,A⟩,hFA,rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hy
    have hh := mem_filter.mp hFA
    have hF : F ⊆ G := mem_powerset.mp (mem_product.mp hh.1).1
    exact skewValue_le_eight_expectedOpt G F hF A N d hd hlog hleft hvertices haverage hh.2

GraphChoices.relabel_sample.source:
theorem relabel_sample (G : BaseGraph V E) (H : BaseGraph V F) (e : E ≃ F)
    (hl : ∀ x, H.left (e x) = G.left x) (hr : ∀ x, H.right (e x) = G.right x)
    {T : ℕ} (ω : Fin T → E) : H.sample (fun t => e (ω t)) = G.sample ω := by
  apply Instance.ext <;> funext t
  · exact hl (ω t)
  · exact hr (ω t)

GraphChoices.relabel_expectedOpt.source:
theorem relabel_expectedOpt (G : BaseGraph V E) (H : BaseGraph V F) (e : E ≃ F)
    (hl : ∀ x, H.left (e x) = G.left x) (hr : ∀ x, H.right (e x) = G.right x) (T : ℕ) :
    expectedOpt G T = expectedOpt H T := by
  unfold expectedOpt
  rw [← average_equiv (Equiv.arrowCongr (Equiv.refl (Fin T)) e)]
  congr 1
  funext ω
  congr 1
  change opt (G.sample ω) = opt (H.sample (fun t => e (ω t)))
  rw [relabel_sample G H e hl hr ω]

GraphChoices.pullbackPolicy.source:
def pullbackPolicy (e : E ≃ F) (p : OnlinePolicy F) : OnlinePolicy E :=
  fun history x => p (history.map e) (e x)

GraphChoices.pullback_orientation.source:
theorem pullback_orientation (e : E ≃ F) (p : OnlinePolicy F) {T : ℕ} (ω : Fin T → E) :
    onlineOrientation (pullbackPolicy e p) ω = onlineOrientation p (fun t => e (ω t)) := by
  funext t
  simp only [onlineOrientation, pullbackPolicy, List.map_take, List.map_ofFn, Function.comp_def]

GraphChoices.relabel_expectedCost.source:
theorem relabel_expectedCost (G : BaseGraph V E) (H : BaseGraph V F) (e : E ≃ F)
    (hl : ∀ x, H.left (e x) = G.left x) (hr : ∀ x, H.right (e x) = G.right x)
    (T : ℕ) (p : OnlinePolicy F) :
    expectedCost G (onlineOrientation (T := T) (pullbackPolicy e p)) =
      expectedCost H (onlineOrientation (T := T) p) := by
  unfold expectedCost
  rw [← average_equiv (Equiv.arrowCongr (Equiv.refl (Fin T)) e)]
  congr 1
  funext ω
  rw [pullback_orientation]
  congr 1
  change maxLoad (G.sample ω) (onlineOrientation p (fun t => e (ω t))) =
    maxLoad (H.sample (fun t => e (ω t))) (onlineOrientation p (fun t => e (ω t)))
  rw [relabel_sample G H e hl hr ω]

GraphChoices.relabel_referenceCap.source:
theorem relabel_referenceCap (G : BaseGraph V E) (H : BaseGraph V F) (e : E ≃ F)
    (hl : ∀ x, H.left (e x) = G.left x) (hr : ∀ x, H.right (e x) = G.right x) :
    G.referenceCap = H.referenceCap := by
  have hcount (S : Finset V) : (G.internalEdges S).card = (H.internalEdges S).card := by
    apply card_equiv e
    intro x
    simp only [BaseGraph.internalEdges, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, hl, hr]
  have hd : G.maxBaseDensity = H.maxBaseDensity := by
    unfold BaseGraph.maxBaseDensity
    apply sup'_congr _ rfl
    intro S _
    simp only [BaseGraph.baseDensity, hcount]
  simp only [BaseGraph.referenceCap, hd]

GraphChoices.sourceInstance.source:
noncomputable def sourceInstance (G : BaseGraph V E) : Instance V (Fintype.card E) :=
  G.sample (Fintype.equivFin E).symm

GraphChoices.sourceInstance_internalCoun.source:
theorem sourceInstance_internalCount (G : BaseGraph V E) (S : Finset V) :
    internalCount (sourceInstance G) S = (G.internalEdges S).card := by
  apply card_equiv (Fintype.equivFin E).symm
  intro t
  simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, sourceInstance, BaseGraph.sample, BaseGraph.internalEdges]

GraphChoices.sourceInstance_opt.source:
theorem sourceInstance_opt (G : BaseGraph V E) : opt (sourceInstance G) = G.referenceCap := by
  rw [opt_eq_ceil_maxDensity]
  have hd : maxDensity (sourceInstance G) = G.maxBaseDensity := by
    unfold maxDensity BaseGraph.maxBaseDensity
    apply sup'_congr _ rfl
    intro S _
    simp only [density, BaseGraph.baseDensity, sourceInstance_internalCount]
  rw [hd]
  rfl

GraphChoices.sourceInstance_split.source:
theorem sourceInstance_split (G : BaseGraph V E) (b : E → Bool) :
    sourceInstance (G.split b) = splitInstance (sourceInstance G)
      (fun t => b ((Fintype.equivFin E).symm t)) := split_sample G b _

GraphChoices.source_split_reference.source:
theorem source_split_reference (G : BaseGraph V E) (b : E → Bool) :
    G.referenceCap ≤ 2*(G.split b).referenceCap := by
  rw [← sourceInstance_opt G, ← sourceInstance_opt (G.split b), sourceInstance_split]
  exact opt_le_two_split_opt _ _

GraphChoices.exists_reference_source_ori.source:
theorem exists_reference_source_orientation (G : BaseGraph V E) :
    ∃ b : E → Bool, ∀ v,
      (univ.filter fun x => (if b x then G.left x else G.right x) = v).card ≤ G.referenceCap := by
  obtain ⟨a,ha⟩ := exists_exact_opt (sourceInstance G)
  let b := fun x : E => a (Fintype.equivFin E x)
  refine ⟨b, fun v => ?_⟩
  have hc : (univ.filter fun x : E => (if b x then G.left x else G.right x) = v).card =
      load (sourceInstance G) a v := by
    apply card_equiv (Fintype.equivFin E)
    intro x
    simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, destination, load, sourceInstance,
      BaseGraph.sample, b, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  rw [hc]
  have hh := load_le_maxLoad (sourceInstance G) a v
  rw [ha, sourceInstance_opt] at hh
  exact hh

end GraphChoices

GraphChoices.Peeling.subgraphBucket.source:
def subgraphBucket (G F : Graph L R) (u : L) : Finset G :=
  univ.filter fun e => e.val ∈ F ∧ e.val.1 = u

GraphChoices.Peeling.subgraphBucket_degr.source:
theorem subgraphBucket_degree_lower {G F : Graph L R} (hF : F ⊆ G) (u : L) :
    leftDegree F u ≤ (subgraphBucket G F u).card := by
  classical
  have hedge (v : leftNeighbors F u) : (u,v.val) ∈ F := by
    simpa only [leftNeighbors, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and] using v.property
  let f : leftNeighbors F u → subgraphBucket G F u := fun v =>
    ⟨⟨(u,v.val), hF (hedge v)⟩, mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, hedge v, rfl⟩⟩
  have hf : Function.Injective f := by
    intro v w h
    exact Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun x => x.val.val.2) h)
  have hh := Fintype.card_le_of_injective f hf
  simpa only [Fintype.card_coe, leftDegree] using hh

GraphChoices.Peeling.subgraphBucket_sour.source:
theorem subgraphBucket_source (G F : Graph L R) (A : Finset L) :
    ∀ u ∈ A, ∀ e ∈ subgraphBucket G F u,
      e.val.1 = u ∧ e.val.2 ∈ neighborSet F A := by
  intro u hu e he
  have hs := (mem_filter.mp he).2
  refine ⟨hs.2, ?_⟩
  simp only [neighborSet, GraphChoices.neighbors, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
  exact ⟨u, hu, by simpa only [← hs.2] using hs.1⟩

/-- If the block-hit lower bound predicts at least |B| successful left
vertices, the actual sampled optimum is at least k/3 in expectation. -/

GraphChoices.Peeling.expectedOpt_subgrap.source:
theorem expectedOpt_subgraph_blocks (G F : Graph L R) [Nonempty G]
    (hF : F ⊆ G) (A : Finset L) (hB : (neighborSet F A).Nonempty)
    (k s : ℕ) (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hx1 : x ≤ 1)
    (hmean : x ≤ (s:ℝ)*((minLeftDegree F A : ℝ)/G.card))
    (hpop : ((neighborSet F A).card : ℝ) ≤ (A.card:ℝ)*(x/2)^k) :
    (k:ℝ)/3 ≤ expectedOpt (graphBase G) (k*s) := by
  have hprob (u : A) : (x/2)^k ≤ eventProbability (allBlocksEvent (subgraphBucket G F u.val) k s) := by
    rw [allBlocks_probability]
    apply pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity)
    apply blockHit_probability_lower_of_mean _ _ x hx hx1
    apply hmean.trans
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (Nat.cast_nonneg s)
    rw [Fintype.card_coe]
    apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ (Nat.cast_nonneg G.card)
    exact_mod_cast (minLeftDegree_le F u.property).trans (subgraphBucket_degree_lower hF u.val)
  have hh := expectedOpt_block_lower (fun e : G => e.val.1) (fun e : G => e.val.2)
    A (neighborSet F A) (subgraphBucket G F) (subgraphBucket_source G F A) k s hB
    (hpop.trans (by simpa only [sum_const, card_univ, Fintype.card_coe, nsmul_eq_mul] using
      (sum_le_sum fun u (_ : u ∈ (univ : Finset A)) => hprob u)))
  exact hh

end GraphChoices.Peeling

GraphChoices.BaseGraph.IsSimple.source:
def BaseGraph.IsSimple (G : BaseGraph V E) : Prop :=
  (∀ e, G.left e ≠ G.right e) ∧
    ∀ e f, ((G.left e = G.left f ∧ G.right e = G.right f) ∨
      (G.left e = G.right f ∧ G.right e = G.left f)) → e = f

GraphChoices.OnlinePolicy.source: abbrev OnlinePolicy (E : Type*) := List E → E → Bool

GraphChoices.onlineOrientation.source:
def onlineOrientation (p : OnlinePolicy E) (ω : Fin T → E) : Orientation T :=
  fun t => p ((List.ofFn ω).take t.val) (ω t)

GraphChoices.collapsePolicy_orientation.source:
theorem collapsePolicy_orientation (b : E → Bool) (p : OnlinePolicy E) (ω : Fin T → E) :
    onlineOrientation (collapsePolicy b p) ω =
      transport (fun t => b (ω t)) (onlineOrientation p ω) := rfl

/-- The expected transfer also preserves the explicit online-policy type. -/

GraphChoices.online_expected_transfer.source:
theorem online_expected_transfer (G : BaseGraph V E) (b : E → Bool)
    (p : OnlinePolicy E) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hcost : expectedCost (T := T) (G.split b) (onlineOrientation p) ≤
      c * expectedOpt (G.split b) T) :
    expectedCost (T := T) G (onlineOrientation (collapsePolicy b p)) ≤
      (2*c) * expectedOpt G T := by
  exact expected_competitive_transfer G b (onlineOrientation p) c hc hcost

/-- Positive for small n and asymptotically Theta(log log n). -/

GraphChoices.loglogFactor.source:
noncomputable def loglogFactor (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  1 + Real.log (1 + Real.log (max 2 (n : ℝ)))

/-- Theorem 1.1 specification, proved by GraphChoices.mainTheorem, with a
horizon-aware deterministic online policy and
an explicit bounded-at-small-n interpretation of O(log log n).
Edge labels use Fin(m+1) to ensure that the sampling space is nonempty. -/

GraphChoices.MainTheorem.source:
def MainTheorem : Prop :=
  ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
    ∀ (n m : ℕ) (G : BaseGraph (Fin n) (Fin (m+1))), G.IsSimple →
      ∀ T : ℕ, ∃ p : OnlinePolicy (Fin (m+1)),
        expectedCost G (onlineOrientation (T := T) p) ≤
          C * loglogFactor n * expectedOpt G T

end GraphChoices

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.finite_half.source:
theorem finite_half_geometric (h : ℕ) :
    ∑ i ∈ range h, ((1:ℝ)/2)^i = 2 * (1 - ((1:ℝ)/2)^h) := by
  induction h with
  | zero => simp
  | succ h ih => rw [sum_range_succ, ih, pow_succ]; ring

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.inverse_pow.source:
theorem inverse_powers_sum_le_two (h : ℕ) :
    ∑ i ∈ range h, (1:ℝ)/2^i ≤ 2 := by
  simp_rw [← one_div_pow]
  rw [finite_half_geometric]
  have : (0:ℝ) ≤ (1/2)^h := by positivity
  linarith

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.roundedThre.source:
noncomputable def roundedThreshold (K L : ℝ) (i : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ⌈K * (L / 2^i + 1)⌉₊

/-- An explicit version of sum alpha_i = O(K (L+h)), including ceil errors. -/

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.rounded_thr.source:
theorem rounded_threshold_budget (K L : ℝ) (h : ℕ) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hL : 0 ≤ L) :
    (∑ i ∈ range h, (roundedThreshold K L i : ℝ)) ≤ K * (2*L+h) + h := by
  have hround (i : ℕ) : (roundedThreshold K L i : ℝ) ≤ K * (L / 2^i + 1) + 1 := by
    exact (Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (mul_nonneg hK (by positivity))).le
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ range h, (K * (L / 2^i + 1) + 1) := sum_le_sum fun i _ => hround i
    _ = K * (L * (∑ i ∈ range h, (1:ℝ)/2^i) + h) + h := by
      have heq (i : ℕ) : K * (L / 2^i + 1) + 1 = K*L*((1:ℝ)/2^i) + (K+1) := by ring
      simp_rw [heq]
      rw [sum_add_distrib, ← mul_sum]
      simp only [sum_const, card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]
      ring
    _ ≤ K * (2*L+h) + h := by
      have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (inverse_powers_sum_le_two h) hL
      nlinarith

end GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy

GraphChoices.inverse_power_le_target.source:
theorem inverse_power_le_target (f target : ℝ) (k : ℕ)
    (hf : 1 < f) (ht : 0 < target)
    (hk : Real.log (1/target) / Real.log f ≤ (k:ℝ)) :
    ((1:ℝ)/f)^k ≤ target := by
  have hfpos : 0 < f := by linarith
  apply (Real.log_le_log_iff (pow_pos (div_pos zero_lt_one hfpos) _) ht).mp
  rw [Real.log_pow, Real.log_div (by norm_num) (ne_of_gt hfpos), Real.log_one]
  have hh := (div_le_iff₀ (Real.log_pos hf)).mp hk
  rw [Real.log_div (by norm_num) (ne_of_gt ht), Real.log_one] at hh
  linarith

GraphChoices.power_le_target_of_threshol.source:
theorem power_le_target_of_threshold (x f target : ℝ) (k : ℕ)
    (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hf : 1 < f) (ht : 0 < target)
    (hbase : x ≤ 1/f) (hk : Real.log (1/target) / Real.log f ≤ (k:ℝ)) :
    x^k ≤ target :=
  (pow_le_pow_left₀ hx hbase k).trans (inverse_power_le_target f target k hf ht hk)

end GraphChoices

namespace GraphChoices.Patterns
open Finset
open ThresholdGreedy
variable {E L R C : Type*} [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E] [Nonempty E]
  [Fintype L] [Fintype R] [DecidableEq L] [DecidableEq R] [DecidableEq C]
  {T m : ℕ}

GraphChoices.Patterns.bucketDecay_small_.source:
theorem bucketDecay_small_of_threshold (α DL DR : C → ℕ) (f : C → ℝ) (T : ℕ)
    (b : ℝ) (hT : 0 < T) (hb : 0 < b) (hf : ∀ c, 1 < f c)
    (hbase : ∀ c, Real.exp 1*T*(DL c : ℝ)/Fintype.card E/α c ≤ 1/f c)
    (hthreshold : ∀ c, 0 < DR c →
      Real.log (((DR c : ℝ)*((T:ℝ)/Fintype.card E))/b) / Real.log (f c) ≤ (α c : ℝ)) :
    ∀ c, (DR c : ℝ)*((T:ℝ)/Fintype.card E)*bucketDecay (E := E) α DL T c ≤ b := by
  intro c
  by_cases hDR : DR c = 0
  · simp [hDR, le_of_lt hb]
  have hp : (0:ℝ) < (DR c : ℝ)*((T:ℝ)/Fintype.card E) := by
    have hd : (0:ℝ) < DR c := by exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hDR
    have ht : (0:ℝ) < T := by exact_mod_cast hT
    exact mul_pos hd (div_pos ht (by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos))
  have htarget : 0 < b / ((DR c : ℝ)*((T:ℝ)/Fintype.card E)) := div_pos hb hp
  have hlog : Real.log (1 / (b / ((DR c : ℝ)*((T:ℝ)/Fintype.card E)))) /
      Real.log (f c) ≤ (α c : ℝ) := by
    simpa [one_div_div] using hthreshold c (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hDR)
  have hdecay : bucketDecay (E := E) α DL T c ≤ b / ((DR c : ℝ)*((T:ℝ)/Fintype.card E)) :=
    GraphChoices.power_le_target_of_threshold _ _ _ _ (by positivity) (hf c) htarget (hbase c) hlog
  calc
    _ ≤ ((DR c : ℝ)*((T:ℝ)/Fintype.card E)) * (b / ((DR c : ℝ)*((T:ℝ)/Fintype.card E))) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdecay hp.le
    _ = b := by field_simp

/-- Conditional fixed-pattern decay with explicit base and logarithmic
threshold inequalities. Instantiation by the paper's alpha_i remains separate. -/

GraphChoices.Patterns.residualPattern_de.source:
theorem residualPattern_decay_of_thresholds (p : ParentPattern C m) (H : C → Peeling.Graph L R)
    (encode : E → Arrival L R C) (α : C → ℕ) (DL DR : C → ℕ) (D : ℕ) (f : C → ℝ)
    (hsimple : Function.Injective fun e => ((encode e).left,(encode e).right))
    (hDL : ∀ u c, (sourceBucket encode u c).card ≤ DL c)
    (hL : ∀ c u, Peeling.leftDegree (H c) u ≤ D)
    (hR : ∀ c v, Peeling.rightDegree (H c) v ≤ DR c)
    (b r : ℝ) (hT : 0 < T) (hb : 0 < b) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hbr : b ≤ r)
    (hpair : (D : ℝ)*((T:ℝ)/Fintype.card E)*b ≤ r^2)
    (hf : ∀ c, 1 < f c)
    (hbase : ∀ c, Real.exp 1*T*(DL c : ℝ)/Fintype.card E/α c ≤ 1/f c)
    (hthreshold : ∀ c, 0 < DR c →
      Real.log (((DR c : ℝ)*((T:ℝ)/Fintype.card E))/b) / Real.log (f c) ≤ (α c : ℝ))
    (hheavy : m ≤ 2*(univ.filter fun i : Fin m => p.childLeft i = true).card) :
    eventProbability (residualPatternEvent p H encode α T) ≤ (Fintype.card R : ℝ)*r^m :=
  residualPattern_probability_decay p H encode α DL DR D hsimple hDL hL hR b r hb.le hr hbr hpair
    (bucketDecay_small_of_threshold α DL DR f T b hT hb hf hbase hthreshold) hheavy

end GraphChoices.Patterns

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.Arrival.source:
structure Arrival (L R C : Type*) where
  left : L
  right : R
  cls : C

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.State.source:
structure State (L R C : Type*) where
  threshold : L → C → ℕ
  greedyLeft : L → ℕ
  greedyRight : R → ℕ

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.initial.source: def initial : State L R C := ⟨fun _ _ => 0, fun _ => 0, fun _ => 0⟩

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.isThreshold.source:
def isThreshold (α : C → ℕ) (s : State L R C) (e : Arrival L R C) : Bool :=
  decide (s.threshold e.left e.cls < α e.cls)

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.runFrom.source:
def runFrom (α : C → ℕ) : State L R C → List (Arrival L R C) → State L R C
  | s, [] => s
  | s, e :: es => runFrom α (step α s e) es

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.run.source:
def run (α : C → ℕ) (es : List (Arrival L R C)) : State L R C :=
  runFrom α initial es

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.runFrom_app.source:
theorem runFrom_append (α : C → ℕ) (s : State L R C) (xs ys : List (Arrival L R C)) :
    runFrom α s (xs ++ ys) = runFrom α (runFrom α s xs) ys := by
  induction xs generalizing s with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons e es ih => exact ih (step α s e)

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.run_append_.source:
theorem run_append_singleton (α : C → ℕ) (xs : List (Arrival L R C)) (e : Arrival L R C) :
    run α (xs ++ [e]) = step α (run α xs) e := by
  exact runFrom_append α initial xs [e]

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.step_preser.source:
theorem step_preserves_caps (α : C → ℕ) (s : State L R C) (e : Arrival L R C)
    (hs : ∀ u i, s.threshold u i ≤ α i) :
    ∀ u i, (step α s e).threshold u i ≤ α i := by
  intro u i
  unfold step
  split_ifs with ht hg
  · dsimp
    by_cases h : u = e.left ∧ i = e.cls
    · rcases h with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      simp
      omega
    · simpa [h] using hs u i
  · exact hs u i
  · exact hs u i

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.runFrom_pre.source:
theorem runFrom_preserves_caps (α : C → ℕ) (s : State L R C)
    (es : List (Arrival L R C)) (hs : ∀ u i, s.threshold u i ≤ α i) :
    ∀ u i, (runFrom α s es).threshold u i ≤ α i := by
  induction es generalizing s with
  | nil => exact hs
  | cons e es ih => exact ih _ (step_preserves_caps α s e hs)

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.threshold_c.source:
theorem threshold_cap (α : C → ℕ) (es : List (Arrival L R C)) (u : L) (i : C) :
    (run α es).threshold u i ≤ α i :=
  runFrom_preserves_caps α initial es (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) u i

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.threshold_b.source:
theorem threshold_budget [Fintype C] (α : C → ℕ) (es : List (Arrival L R C)) (u : L) :
    ∑ i, (run α es).threshold u i ≤ ∑ i, α i :=
  sum_le_sum fun i _ => threshold_cap α es u i

/-- A residual edge can occur only once its class counter is saturated. -/

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.residual_co.source:
theorem residual_counter_saturated (α : C → ℕ) (es : List (Arrival L R C))
    (e : Arrival L R C) (he : isThreshold α (run α es) e = false) :
    (run α es).threshold e.left e.cls = α e.cls := by
  have hlo : α e.cls ≤ (run α es).threshold e.left e.cls := by
    simpa [isThreshold] using he
  exact Nat.le_antisymm (threshold_cap α es _ _) hlo

/-- The number of previous arrivals in a left-vertex/class bucket. -/

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.incidentCou.source:
def incidentCount (es : List (Arrival L R C)) (u : L) (i : C) : ℕ :=
  (es.filter fun e => decide (e.left = u ∧ e.cls = i)).length

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.step_counte.source:
theorem step_counter_le (α : C → ℕ) (s : State L R C) (e : Arrival L R C) (u : L) (i : C) :
    (step α s e).threshold u i ≤ s.threshold u i + if e.left = u ∧ e.cls = i then 1 else 0 := by
  unfold step
  split_ifs <;> simp_all [eq_comm]

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.counter_le_.source:
theorem counter_le_incident (α : C → ℕ) (es : List (Arrival L R C)) (u : L) (i : C) :
    (run α es).threshold u i ≤ incidentCount es u i := by
  induction es using List.reverseRecOn with
  | nil => simp [run, runFrom, initial, incidentCount]
  | append_singleton es e ih =>
    rw [run_append_singleton]
    have hstep := step_counter_le α (run α es) e u i
    have hc : incidentCount (es ++ [e]) u i =
        incidentCount es u i + if e.left = u ∧ e.cls = i then 1 else 0 := by
      by_cases he : e.left = u ∧ e.cls = i <;> simp [incidentCount, List.filter_append, he]
    rw [hc]
    omega

/-- The necessary incidence condition behind the pattern probability bound. -/

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.residual_re.source:
theorem residual_requires_previous_arrivals (α : C → ℕ) (es : List (Arrival L R C))
    (e : Arrival L R C) (he : isThreshold α (run α es) e = false) :
    α e.cls ≤ incidentCount es e.left e.cls := by
  rw [← residual_counter_saturated α es e he]
  exact counter_le_incident α es _ _

/-- On a residual arrival the counter is unchanged and the selected endpoint
has minimum residual load. Ties go right, as in Algorithm 1. -/

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.residual_st.source:
theorem residual_step (α : C → ℕ) (s : State L R C) (e : Arrival L R C)
    (he : isThreshold α s e = false) :
    (step α s e).threshold = s.threshold ∧
    ((s.greedyLeft e.left < s.greedyRight e.right ∧
        (step α s e).greedyLeft e.left = s.greedyLeft e.left + 1 ∧
        (step α s e).greedyRight = s.greedyRight) ∨
      (s.greedyRight e.right ≤ s.greedyLeft e.left ∧
        (step α s e).greedyRight e.right = s.greedyRight e.right + 1 ∧
        (step α s e).greedyLeft = s.greedyLeft)) := by
  have ht : ¬s.threshold e.left e.cls < α e.cls := by simpa [isThreshold] using he
  unfold step
  rw [if_neg ht]
  split_ifs with hg
  · simp [hg]
  · simp [hg, Nat.le_of_not_gt hg]

end GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.encodedBase.source:
def encodedBaseGraph (encode : E → Arrival L R C) : BaseGraph (L ⊕ R) E where
  left e := Sum.inl (encode e).left
  right e := Sum.inr (encode e).right

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.encoded_int.source:
theorem encoded_internalCount (encode : E → Arrival L R C) {T : ℕ} (ω : Fin T → E)
    (A : Finset (L ⊕ R)) :
    internalCount (replayInstance (sampleArrivals encode ω)) A =
      internalCount ((encodedBaseGraph encode).sample ω) A := by
  rw [replay_internalCount]
  unfold sampleArrivals
  rw [countP_ofFn_eq_sum]
  simp only [internalCount, BaseGraph.sample, encodedBaseGraph, card_eq_sum_ones, sum_filter,
    decide_eq_true_eq]

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.encoded_opt.source:
theorem encoded_opt (encode : E → Arrival L R C) {T : ℕ} (ω : Fin T → E) :
    opt (replayInstance (sampleArrivals encode ω)) = opt ((encodedBaseGraph encode).sample ω) := by
  apply Nat.le_antisymm
  · apply opt_le_of_internalCount_le
    intro A
    exact (encoded_internalCount encode ω A).le
  · apply opt_le_of_internalCount_le
    intro A
    exact (encoded_internalCount encode ω A).symm.le

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.expectedRep.source:
theorem expectedReplayOpt_eq_expectedOpt (encode : E → Arrival L R C) (T : ℕ) :
    expectedReplayOpt encode T = expectedOpt (encodedBaseGraph encode) T := by
  unfold expectedReplayOpt expectedOpt
  congr 1
  funext ω
  rw [encoded_opt]

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.stateLoad.source:
def stateLoad (s : State L R C) : L ⊕ R → ℕ :=
  Sum.elim (fun u => (∑ c, s.threshold u c) + s.greedyLeft u) s.greedyRight

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.step_stateL.source:
theorem step_stateLoad (α : C → ℕ) (s : State L R C) (e : Arrival L R C) (v : L ⊕ R) :
    stateLoad (step α s e) v = stateLoad s v +
      if (if stepChoice α s e then Sum.inl e.left else Sum.inr e.right) = v then 1 else 0 := by
  by_cases ht : s.threshold e.left e.cls < α e.cls
  · cases v with
    | inl u =>
      by_cases hu : u = e.left <;>
        simp [stateLoad, step, stepChoice, ht, hu, sum_add_distrib, eq_comm, Nat.add_assoc,
          Nat.add_comm, Finset.filter_eq']
    | inr w => simp [stateLoad, step, stepChoice, ht]
  · by_cases hg : s.greedyLeft e.left < s.greedyRight e.right <;> cases v <;>
      simp [stateLoad, step, stepChoice, ht, hg, eq_comm, Nat.add_assoc]

/-- Only the preceding source labels and current label are inputs. -/

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.thresholdPo.source:
def thresholdPolicy (encode : E → Arrival L R C) (α : C → ℕ) : OnlinePolicy E :=
  fun history e => stepChoice α (run α (history.map encode)) (encode e)

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.policyPrefi.source:
theorem policyPrefixLoad_step (encode : E → Arrival L R C) (α : C → ℕ) {T : ℕ}
    (ω : Fin T → E) (t : Fin T) (v : L ⊕ R) :
    policyPrefixLoad encode α ω (t.val+1) v = policyPrefixLoad encode α ω t.val v +
      if destination ((encodedBaseGraph encode).sample ω) (onlineOrientation (thresholdPolicy encode α) ω) t = v
      then 1 else 0 := by
  have hi : t.val < (List.ofFn ω).length := by simpa using t.isLt
  unfold policyPrefixLoad
  rw [List.take_succ_eq_append_getElem hi, List.map_append, List.map_singleton, run_append_singleton]
  rw [step_stateLoad]
  simp [List.getElem_ofFn, destination, encodedBaseGraph, BaseGraph.sample,
    onlineOrientation, thresholdPolicy]

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.policy_fina.source:
theorem policy_final_load (encode : E → Arrival L R C) (α : C → ℕ) {T : ℕ}
    (ω : Fin T → E) (v : L ⊕ R) :
    totalVertexLoad α (sampleArrivals encode ω) v =
      load ((encodedBaseGraph encode).sample ω) (onlineOrientation (thresholdPolicy encode α) ω) v := by
  have h := execution_final_load ((encodedBaseGraph encode).sample ω)
    (onlineOrientation (thresholdPolicy encode α) ω) (policyPrefixLoad encode α ω)
    (policyPrefixLoad_zero encode α ω) (policyPrefixLoad_step encode α ω) v
  have htake : (List.ofFn ω).take T = List.ofFn ω := List.take_of_length_le (by simp)
  simpa only [policyPrefixLoad, htake, sampleArrivals, List.map_ofFn, stateLoad, totalVertexLoad] using h

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.policy_maxL.source:
theorem policy_maxLoad (encode : E → Arrival L R C) (α : C → ℕ) {T : ℕ} (ω : Fin T → E) :
    totalMaxLoad α (sampleArrivals encode ω) =
      maxLoad ((encodedBaseGraph encode).sample ω) (onlineOrientation (thresholdPolicy encode α) ω) := by
  unfold totalMaxLoad maxLoad
  apply Finset.sup_congr rfl
  intro v _
  exact policy_final_load encode α ω v

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.expectedTot.source:
theorem expectedTotalMaxLoad_eq_expectedCost (encode : E → Arrival L R C) (α : C → ℕ) (T : ℕ) :
    expectedTotalMaxLoad encode α T =
      expectedCost (encodedBaseGraph encode) (onlineOrientation (T := T) (thresholdPolicy encode α)) := by
  unfold expectedTotalMaxLoad expectedCost
  congr 1
  funext ω
  rw [policy_maxLoad]

end GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.thresholdBu.source:
def thresholdBucket (log : List (Event L R C)) (u : L) (i : C) : List (Event L R C) :=
  log.filter fun ev => ev.threshold && decide (ev.arrival.left = u ∧ ev.arrival.cls = i)

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.thresholdWi.source:
def thresholdWitnessTimes (α : C → ℕ) (es : List (Arrival L R C)) (u : L) (i : C) : List ℕ :=
  (thresholdBucket (trace α es) u i).map Event.time

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.thresholdBu.source:
theorem thresholdBucket_length (log : List (Event L R C)) (u : L) (i : C) :
    (thresholdBucket log u i).length = incidentCount (thresholdArrivals log) u i := by
  simp [thresholdBucket, incidentCount, thresholdArrivals, List.filter_map, List.filter_filter, Bool.and_comm]

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.thresholdWi.source:
theorem thresholdWitnessTimes_length (α : C → ℕ) (es : List (Arrival L R C)) (u : L) (i : C) :
    (thresholdWitnessTimes α es u i).length = (run α es).threshold u i := by
  simp only [thresholdWitnessTimes, List.length_map, thresholdBucket_length, threshold_counter_exact]

theorem thresholdWitnessTimes_nodup (α : C → ℕ) (es : List (Arrival L R C)) (u : L) (i : C) :
    (thresholdWitnessTimes α es u i).Nodup := by
  apply List.Nodup.sublist (List.Sublist.map Event.time (List.filter_sublist))
  exact traceFrom_unique_times α initial 0 es

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.trace_prefi.source:
theorem trace_prefix_mem (α : C → ℕ) (xs ys : List (Arrival L R C))
    (ev : Event L R C) (hev : ev ∈ trace α xs) : ev ∈ trace α (xs ++ ys) := by
  unfold trace
  rw [traceFrom_append]
  exact List.mem_append_left _ hev

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.thresholdWi.source:
theorem thresholdWitnessTimes_spec (α : C → ℕ) (es : List (Arrival L R C)) (u : L) (i : C)
    (t : ℕ) (ht : t ∈ thresholdWitnessTimes α es u i) :
    ∃ ev ∈ trace α es, ev.time = t ∧ ev.threshold = true ∧ ev.arrival.left = u ∧ ev.arrival.cls = i := by
  obtain ⟨ev,hev,hetime⟩ := List.mem_map.mp ht
  have h := List.mem_filter.mp hev
  have hh : ev.threshold = true ∧ (ev.arrival.left = u ∧ ev.arrival.cls = i) := by
    simpa using h.2
  exact ⟨ev,h.1,hetime,hh.1,hh.2⟩

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.traceFrom_t.source:
theorem traceFrom_time_lt (α : C → ℕ) (s : State L R C) (k : ℕ)
    (es : List (Arrival L R C)) (ev : Event L R C) (hev : ev ∈ traceFrom α s k es) :
    ev.time < k + es.length := by
  induction es generalizing s k with
  | nil => simp [traceFrom] at hev
  | cons e es ih =>
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hev with rfl | hev
    · simp
    · have ht := ih (step α s e) (k+1) hev
      simp only [List.length_cons]
      omega

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.thresholdWi.source:
theorem thresholdWitnessTimes_earlier (α : C → ℕ) (es : List (Arrival L R C)) (u : L) (i : C)
    (t : ℕ) (ht : t ∈ thresholdWitnessTimes α es u i) : t < es.length := by
  obtain ⟨ev,hev,hetime,_⟩ := thresholdWitnessTimes_spec α es u i t ht
  have h := traceFrom_time_lt α initial 0 es ev hev
  simpa [hetime] using h

theorem thresholdWitnessTimes_disjoint_residual (α : C → ℕ) (xs ys : List (Arrival L R C))
    (u : L) (i : C) :
    List.Disjoint (thresholdWitnessTimes α xs u i)
      (((trace α (xs ++ ys)).filter fun ev => !ev.threshold).map Event.time) := by
  apply List.disjoint_left.mpr
  intro t ht hr
  obtain ⟨ev,hev,hetime,heth,_,_⟩ := thresholdWitnessTimes_spec α xs u i t ht
  have hfull := trace_prefix_mem α xs ys ev hev
  have htfull : t ∈ (((trace α (xs ++ ys)).filter fun ev => ev.threshold).map Event.time) :=
    List.mem_map.mpr ⟨ev,List.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hfull,heth⟩,hetime⟩
  exact List.disjoint_left.mp (trace_threshold_residual_disjoint α (xs ++ ys)) htfull hr

/-- A residual class-i arrival forces alpha_i distinct earlier threshold
occurrences in its bucket, disjoint from every residual occurrence in the full
execution. The suffix is arbitrary and can include the current arrival. -/

GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.residual_di.source:
theorem residual_distinct_threshold_witnesses (α : C → ℕ) (xs ys : List (Arrival L R C))
    (e : Arrival L R C) (he : isThreshold α (run α xs) e = false) :
    ∃ W : List ℕ, W.Nodup ∧ W.length = α e.cls ∧
      (∀ t ∈ W, t < xs.length) ∧
      List.Disjoint W (((trace α (xs ++ ys)).filter fun ev => !ev.threshold).map Event.time) ∧
      ∀ t ∈ W, ∃ ev ∈ trace α xs,
        ev.time = t ∧ ev.threshold = true ∧ ev.arrival.left = e.left ∧ ev.arrival.cls = e.cls := by
  refine ⟨thresholdWitnessTimes α xs e.left e.cls,
    thresholdWitnessTimes_nodup α xs _ _, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [thresholdWitnessTimes_length]
    exact residual_counter_saturated α xs e he
  · exact thresholdWitnessTimes_earlier α xs _ _
  · exact thresholdWitnessTimes_disjoint_residual α xs ys _ _
  · exact thresholdWitnessTimes_spec α xs _ _

end GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy

GraphChoices.path_internal_degree.source:
theorem path_internal_degree {u v : V} (p : G.Walk u v) (hp : p.IsPath)
    (w : V) (hw : w ∈ p.support) (hwu : w ≠ u) (hwv : w ≠ v) :
    2 ≤ G.degree w := by
  induction p generalizing w with
  | nil => simp only [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_nil, List.mem_singleton] at hw; exact (hwu hw).elim
  | @cons u x v h p ih =>
    have hps := (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons_isPath_iff h p).mp hp
    simp only [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_cons, List.mem_cons] at hw
    rcases hw with hw | hw
    · exact (hwu hw).elim
    by_cases hx : w = x
    · subst w
      cases p with
      | nil => exact (hwv rfl).elim
      | @cons x y v hxy q =>
        have huy : u ≠ y := by
          intro heq
          apply hps.2
          simp [heq]
        have hpair : ({u,y} : Finset V) ⊆ G.neighborFinset x := by
          intro z hz
          rcases mem_insert.mp hz with rfl | hz
          · exact (G.mem_neighborFinset _ _).mpr h.symm
          · have hz' := mem_singleton.mp hz
            subst z
            exact (G.mem_neighborFinset _ _).mpr hxy
        have hc := card_le_card hpair
        simpa only [card_pair huy, SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree] using hc
    · exact ih hps.1 w hw hx hwv

omit [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj] in

GraphChoices.reachable_induce_of_walk.source:
theorem reachable_induce_of_walk {s : Set V} {u v : V} (p : G.Walk u v)
    (hu : u ∈ s) (hv : v ∈ s) (hs : ∀ w ∈ p.support, w ∈ s) :
    (G.induce s).Reachable ⟨u,hu⟩ ⟨v,hv⟩ := by
  induction p with
  | nil => exact SimpleGraph.Reachable.rfl
  | @cons u w v h p ih =>
    have hw : w ∈ s := hs w (by simp)
    have hp : ∀ z ∈ p.support, z ∈ s := fun z hz => hs z (by simp [hz])
    exact (SimpleGraph.Adj.reachable (show (G.induce s).Adj ⟨u,hu⟩ ⟨w,hw⟩ from h)).trans
      (ih hw hv hp)

GraphChoices.pruned_induce_connected.source:
theorem pruned_induce_connected (left : V → Bool) (hc : G.Connected)
    (root : V) (hroot : left root = true) :
    (G.induce (prunedVertices G left)).Connected := by
  apply (SimpleGraph.connected_iff_exists_forall_reachable _).mpr
  refine ⟨⟨root, Or.inl hroot⟩, ?_⟩
  intro v
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := (hc root v.val).exists_isPath
  apply reachable_induce_of_walk G p (Or.inl hroot) v.property
  intro w hw
  by_cases hwu : w = root
  · subst w; exact Or.inl hroot
  by_cases hwv : w = v.val
  · subst w; exact v.property
  exact Or.inr (path_internal_degree G p hp w hw hwu hwv)

GraphChoices.pruned_induce_isTree.source:
theorem pruned_induce_isTree (left : V → Bool) (ht : G.IsTree)
    (root : V) (hroot : left root = true) :
    (G.induce (prunedVertices G left)).IsTree :=
  ⟨pruned_induce_connected G left ht.isConnected root hroot,
    ht.IsAcyclic.induce _⟩

omit [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj] in

GraphChoices.bool_bipartite.source:
theorem bool_bipartite (left : V → Bool)
    (hcolor : ∀ x y, G.Adj x y → left x ≠ left y) :
    G.IsBipartiteWith {v | left v = true} {v | left v = false} := by
  constructor
  · simp [Set.disjoint_left]
  · intro x y hxy
    have h := hcolor x y hxy
    cases hx : left x <;> cases hy : left y <;> simp_all

omit [DecidableEq V] in

GraphChoices.bool_partition_card.source:
theorem bool_partition_card (left : V → Bool) :
    (univ.filter fun v => left v = true).card +
      (univ.filter fun v => left v = false).card = Fintype.card V := by
  simpa using filter_card_add_filter_neg_card_eq_card (s := (univ : Finset V)) (fun v => left v = true)

omit [DecidableEq V] in

GraphChoices.right_degree_preserved_by_p.source:
theorem right_degree_preserved_by_pruning (left : V → Bool)
    (hcolor : ∀ x y, G.Adj x y → left x ≠ left y)
    (v : prunedVertices G left) (hv : left v.val = false) :
    (G.induce (prunedVertices G left)).degree v = G.degree v.val := by
  apply SimpleGraph.degree_induce_of_neighborSet_subset
  intro w hw
  apply Or.inl
  have h := hcolor v.val w hw
  cases hh : left w <;> simp_all

omit [DecidableEq V] in
/-- A tree without right leaves has strictly more left vertices than right
vertices. This is the degree-sum argument with the exact tree edge count. -/

GraphChoices.tree_left_heavy_of_right_mi.source:
theorem tree_left_heavy_of_right_min_degree (left : V → Bool) (ht : G.IsTree)
    (hcolor : ∀ x y, G.Adj x y → left x ≠ left y)
    (hdeg : ∀ v, left v = false → 2 ≤ G.degree v) :
    (univ.filter fun v => left v = false).card + 1 ≤
      (univ.filter fun v => left v = true).card := by
  classical
  have hbi : G.IsBipartiteWith
      (↑(univ.filter fun v => left v = true)) (↑(univ.filter fun v => left v = false)) := by
    simpa using bool_bipartite G left hcolor
  have hsum := SimpleGraph.isBipartiteWith_sum_degrees_eq_card_edges' hbi
  have hbound : 2 * (univ.filter fun v => left v = false).card ≤ G.edgeFinset.card := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ v ∈ univ.filter (fun v => left v = false), 2 := by simp [mul_comm]
      _ ≤ ∑ v ∈ univ.filter (fun v => left v = false), G.degree v := by
        apply sum_le_sum
        intro v hv
        exact hdeg v (mem_filter.mp hv).2
      _ = _ := hsum
  have hc := ht.card_edgeFinset
  have hp := bool_partition_card left
  omega

GraphChoices.pruned_tree_left_heavy.source:
theorem pruned_tree_left_heavy (left : V → Bool) (ht : G.IsTree)
    (hcolor : ∀ x y, G.Adj x y → left x ≠ left y)
    (root : V) (hroot : left root = true) :
    let U := prunedVertices G left
    (univ.filter fun v : U => left v.val = false).card + 1 ≤
      (univ.filter fun v : U => left v.val = true).card := by
  apply tree_left_heavy_of_right_min_degree (G.induce (prunedVertices G left))
    (fun v => left v.val) (pruned_induce_isTree G left ht root hroot)
  · intro x y hxy
    exact hcolor x.val y.val hxy
  · intro v hv
    rw [right_degree_preserved_by_pruning G left hcolor v hv]
    rcases v.property with hleft | hdeg
    · simp [hv] at hleft
    · exact hdeg

omit [DecidableEq V] in

GraphChoices.left_card_le_pruned_card.source:
theorem left_card_le_pruned_card (left : V → Bool) :
    (univ.filter fun v => left v = true).card ≤ Fintype.card (prunedVertices G left) := by
  rw [Fintype.card_subtype]
  apply card_le_card
  intro v hv
  exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, Or.inl (mem_filter.mp hv).2⟩

/-- Deleting right leaves loses at most a factor D+1 in tree size, when all
left degrees are at most D. This also covers a singleton left tree. -/

GraphChoices.pruning_size_bound.source:
theorem pruning_size_bound (left : V → Bool) (hc : G.Connected)
    (hcolor : ∀ x y, G.Adj x y → left x ≠ left y)
    (root : V) (hroot : left root = true) (D : ℕ)
    (hD : ∀ v, left v = true → G.degree v ≤ D) :
    Fintype.card V ≤ (D+1) * Fintype.card (prunedVertices G left) := by
  classical
  have hbi : G.IsBipartiteWith
      (↑(univ.filter fun v => left v = true)) (↑(univ.filter fun v => left v = false)) := by
    simpa using bool_bipartite G left hcolor
  have hright : (univ.filter fun v => left v = false).card ≤ G.edgeFinset.card := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ v ∈ univ.filter (fun v => left v = false), 1 := by simp
      _ ≤ ∑ v ∈ univ.filter (fun v => left v = false), G.degree v := by
        apply sum_le_sum
        intro v hv
        have hvfalse := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
        have hne : v ≠ root := by intro heq; subst v; simp [hroot] at hvfalse
        letI : Nontrivial V := ⟨⟨v, root, hne⟩⟩
        exact hc.preconnected.degree_pos_of_nontrivial v
      _ = _ := SimpleGraph.isBipartiteWith_sum_degrees_eq_card_edges' hbi
  have hleft : G.edgeFinset.card ≤ D * (univ.filter fun v => left v = true).card := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ v ∈ univ.filter (fun v => left v = true), G.degree v :=
        (SimpleGraph.isBipartiteWith_sum_degrees_eq_card_edges hbi).symm
      _ ≤ ∑ v ∈ univ.filter (fun v => left v = true), D := by
        apply sum_le_sum
        intro v hv
        exact hD v (mem_filter.mp hv).2
      _ = _ := by simp [mul_comm]
  have hpart := bool_partition_card left
  calc
    Fintype.card V ≤ (D+1)*(univ.filter fun v => left v = true).card := by nlinarith
    _ ≤ _ := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (left_card_le_pruned_card G left)

/-- Deterministic large-component reduction: any connected bipartite graph
with left degrees at most D contains a left-heavy tree with at least a
1/(D+1) fraction of its vertices. All original left vertices are retained. -/

GraphChoices.exists_large_left_heavy_tre.source:
theorem exists_large_left_heavy_tree (left : V → Bool) (hc : G.Connected)
    (hcolor : ∀ x y, G.Adj x y → left x ≠ left y)
    (root : V) (hroot : left root = true) (D : ℕ)
    (hD : ∀ v, left v = true → G.degree v ≤ D) :
    ∃ s : Set V, ∃ H : SimpleGraph s,
      H.IsTree ∧ H ≤ G.induce s ∧
      (∀ v, left v = true → v ∈ s) ∧
      Fintype.card V ≤ (D+1) * Nat.card s ∧
      Nat.card {v : s // left v.val = false} + 1 ≤ Nat.card {v : s // left v.val = true} := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨F, hFG, htree⟩ := hc.exists_isTree_le
  let s := prunedVertices F left
  refine ⟨s, F.induce s, pruned_induce_isTree F left htree root hroot, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x y hxy
    exact hFG hxy
  · intro v hv
    exact Or.inl hv
  · have hFD : ∀ v, left v = true → F.degree v ≤ D := by
      intro v hv
      exact (F.degree_le_of_le hFG).trans (hD v hv)
    simpa only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using
      pruning_size_bound F left htree.isConnected (fun x y h => hcolor x y (hFG h)) root hroot D hFD
  · simpa only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_subtype] using
      pruned_tree_left_heavy F left htree (fun x y h => hcolor x y (hFG h)) root hroot

end GraphChoices

GraphChoices.average.source:
noncomputable def average {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] (f : Ω → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (∑ ω, f ω) / Fintype.card Ω

GraphChoices.average_mono.source:
theorem average_mono {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] {f g : Ω → ℝ} (h : ∀ ω, f ω ≤ g ω) :
    average f ≤ average g := by
  unfold average
  exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (sum_le_sum fun ω _ => h ω) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)

GraphChoices.average_sum.source:
theorem average_sum {Ω K : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [Fintype K] (f : K → Ω → ℝ) :
    average (fun ω => ∑ k, f k ω) = ∑ k, average (f k) := by
  unfold average
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, sum_mul]
  rw [sum_comm]

GraphChoices.average_mul.source:
theorem average_mul {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] (c : ℝ) (f : Ω → ℝ) :
    average (fun ω => c * f ω) = c * average f := by
  simp only [average, ← mul_sum]
  ring

GraphChoices.average_const.source:
theorem average_const {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [Nonempty Ω] (c : ℝ) :
    average (fun _ : Ω => c) = c := by
  simp [average, Fintype.card_ne_zero]

variable {E : Type*} [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E] [Nonempty E] {T : ℕ}

omit [Nonempty E] in

GraphChoices.sample_fiber_card.source:
theorem sample_fiber_card (t : Fin T) (e : E) :
    (univ.filter fun ω : Fin T → E => ω t = e).card = Fintype.card E ^ (T-1) := by
  simpa using Fintype.card_filter_piFinset_const_eq_of_mem
    (ι := Fin T) (univ : Finset E) t (mem_univ e)

omit [Nonempty E] in

GraphChoices.sum_coordinate.source:
theorem sum_coordinate (t : Fin T) (f : E → ℝ) :
    (∑ ω : Fin T → E, f (ω t)) =
      (Fintype.card E : ℝ)^(T-1) * ∑ e, f e := by
  calc
    _ = ∑ e : E, ∑ ω ∈ (univ.filter fun ω : Fin T → E => ω t = e), f (ω t) :=
      (sum_fiberwise univ (fun ω : Fin T → E => ω t) (fun ω => f (ω t))).symm
    _ = ∑ e : E, (Fintype.card E : ℝ)^(T-1) * f e := by
      apply sum_congr rfl
      intro e _
      calc
        _ = ∑ _ω ∈ (univ.filter fun ω : Fin T → E => ω t = e), f e := by
          apply sum_congr rfl
          intro ω hω
          rw [(mem_filter.mp hω).2]
        _ = _ := by simp [sample_fiber_card, nsmul_eq_mul]
    _ = _ := by rw [mul_sum]

/-- Each coordinate of the product space is exactly uniform. -/

GraphChoices.average_coordinate.source:
theorem average_coordinate (t : Fin T) (f : E → ℝ) :
    average (fun ω : Fin T → E => f (ω t)) = average f := by
  unfold average
  rw [sum_coordinate]
  have hT : T = (T-1)+1 := by have := t.isLt; omega
  have hm : (Fintype.card E : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero
  simp only [Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_fin, Nat.cast_pow]
  have heq : (Fintype.card E : ℝ)^T = (Fintype.card E : ℝ)^(T-1) * Fintype.card E := by
    nth_rw 1 [hT]
    rw [pow_succ]
  rw [heq]
  field_simp

/-- A base graph is represented by a finite, nonempty set of edge labels.
Taking E to be the edges of a simple graph gives exactly the paper's model. -/

GraphChoices.BaseGraph.source:
structure BaseGraph (V E : Type*) where
  left : E → V
  right : E → V

variable {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]

GraphChoices.BaseGraph.sample.source:
def BaseGraph.sample (G : BaseGraph V E) (ω : Fin T → E) : Instance V T where
  left t := G.left (ω t)
  right t := G.right (ω t)

GraphChoices.BaseGraph.internalEdges.source:
def BaseGraph.internalEdges (G : BaseGraph V E) (S : Finset V) : Finset E :=
  univ.filter fun e => G.left e ∈ S ∧ G.right e ∈ S

GraphChoices.expectedOpt.source:
noncomputable def expectedOpt (G : BaseGraph V E) (T : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  average (fun ω : Fin T → E => (opt (G.sample ω) : ℝ))

omit [Fintype V] in

GraphChoices.average_internalCount.source:
theorem average_internalCount (G : BaseGraph V E) (S : Finset V) (T : ℕ) :
    average (fun ω : Fin T → E => (internalCount (G.sample ω) S : ℝ)) =
      T * ((G.internalEdges S).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card E := by
  have hsum (ω : Fin T → E) : (internalCount (G.sample ω) S : ℝ) =
      ∑ t : Fin T, if G.left (ω t) ∈ S ∧ G.right (ω t) ∈ S then (1:ℝ) else 0 := by
    simp only [internalCount, BaseGraph.sample, card_eq_sum_ones, sum_filter, Nat.cast_sum, Nat.cast_ite, Nat.cast_one, Nat.cast_zero]
  simp_rw [hsum]
  rw [average_sum]
  have hk (k : Fin T) :
      average (fun ω : Fin T → E => if G.left (ω k) ∈ S ∧ G.right (ω k) ∈ S then (1:ℝ) else 0) =
      average (fun e : E => if G.left e ∈ S ∧ G.right e ∈ S then (1:ℝ) else 0) :=
    average_coordinate k (fun e : E => if G.left e ∈ S ∧ G.right e ∈ S then (1:ℝ) else 0)
  simp_rw [hk]
  simp [average, BaseGraph.internalEdges, sum_boole, mul_div_assoc]

/-- Density lower bound for every subset and every number of arrivals.
Equivalent to (16) after substituting d_av = 2|E|/n and maximizing over S. -/

GraphChoices.expected_density_lower_boun.source:
theorem expected_density_lower_bound (G : BaseGraph V E) (S : Finset V) (T : ℕ) :
    T * ((G.internalEdges S).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card E ≤
      S.card * expectedOpt G T := by
  rw [← average_internalCount]
  unfold expectedOpt
  rw [← average_mul]
  apply average_mono
  intro ω
  exact_mod_cast density_le_opt (G.sample ω) S

omit [DecidableEq E] in

GraphChoices.expectedOpt_ge_one.source:
theorem expectedOpt_ge_one (G : BaseGraph V E) (T : ℕ) (hT : 0 < T) :
    1 ≤ expectedOpt G T := by
  rw [← average_const (Ω := Fin T → E) (1:ℝ)]
  exact average_mono fun ω => by exact_mod_cast opt_pos (G.sample ω) hT

end GraphChoices

GraphChoices.witnessTime_injective.source:
theorem witnessTime_injective (w : TimeWitness J T m α)
    (htree : Function.Injective w.1)
    (hsep : ∀ i j, w.1 i ∉ (w.2 j).val)
    (hdisj : ∀ j j', j ≠ j' → Disjoint (w.2 j).val (w.2 j').val) :
    Function.Injective (witnessTime w) := by
  intro a b hab
  cases a with
  | inl i =>
    cases b with
    | inl i' => exact congrArg Sum.inl (htree hab)
    | inr p =>
      obtain ⟨j,k⟩ := p
      have hk := (w.2 j).val.orderEmbOfFin_mem ((mem_powersetCard.mp (w.2 j).property).2) k
      simp only [witnessTime] at hab
      exact False.elim (hsep i j (hab.symm ▸ hk))
  | inr p =>
    obtain ⟨j,k⟩ := p
    cases b with
    | inl i =>
      have hk := (w.2 j).val.orderEmbOfFin_mem ((mem_powersetCard.mp (w.2 j).property).2) k
      simp only [witnessTime] at hab
      exact False.elim (hsep i j (hab ▸ hk))
    | inr p' =>
      obtain ⟨j',k'⟩ := p'
      by_cases hj : j = j'
      · subst j'
        have hk : k = k' := ((w.2 j).val.orderEmbOfFin ((mem_powersetCard.mp (w.2 j).property).2)).injective hab
        subst k'
        rfl
      · have hk := (w.2 j).val.orderEmbOfFin_mem ((mem_powersetCard.mp (w.2 j).property).2) k
        have hk' := (w.2 j').val.orderEmbOfFin_mem ((mem_powersetCard.mp (w.2 j').property).2) k'
        simp only [witnessTime] at hab
        exact False.elim (Finset.disjoint_left.mp (hdisj j j' hj) hk (hab.symm ▸ hk'))

/-- Exhibiting actual, globally disjoint occurrence times is sufficient for
membership in the abstract pattern witness event. -/

GraphChoices.mem_patternWitnessEvent_of_.source:
theorem mem_patternWitnessEvent_of_times (ω : Fin T → E) (tree : Fin m → E)
    (bucket : J → Finset E) (τ : Fin m → Fin T) (K : J → Finset (Fin T))
    (hcard : ∀ j, (K j).card = α j)
    (htree : Function.Injective τ) (hlabel : ∀ i, ω (τ i) = tree i)
    (hsep : ∀ i j, τ i ∉ K j)
    (hdisj : ∀ j j', j ≠ j' → Disjoint (K j) (K j'))
    (hbucket : ∀ j t, t ∈ K j → ω t ∈ bucket j) :
    ω ∈ patternWitnessEvent T m α tree bucket := by
  classical
  let w : TimeWitness J T m α := (τ, fun j => ⟨K j,mem_powersetCard.mpr ⟨subset_univ _,hcard j⟩⟩)
  have hinj : Function.Injective (witnessTime w) := witnessTime_injective w htree hsep hdisj
  unfold patternWitnessEvent
  apply mem_biUnion.mpr
  refine ⟨w,mem_univ _,?_⟩
  rw [if_pos hinj]
  simp only [requirementsEvent, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
  intro s
  cases s with
  | inl i => simpa [slotAllowed, witnessTime, w] using hlabel i
  | inr p =>
    obtain ⟨j,k⟩ := p
    apply hbucket j
    exact (K j).orderEmbOfFin_mem (hcard j) k

end GraphChoices

GraphChoices.eventProbability.source:
noncomputable def eventProbability {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] (A : Finset Ω) : ℝ :=
  A.card / (Fintype.card Ω : ℝ)

GraphChoices.eventProbability_nonneg.source:
theorem eventProbability_nonneg {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] (A : Finset Ω) :
    0 ≤ eventProbability A := div_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)

GraphChoices.eventProbability_mono.source:
theorem eventProbability_mono {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] {A B : Finset Ω} (h : A ⊆ B) :
    eventProbability A ≤ eventProbability B := by
  apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
  exact_mod_cast card_le_card h

/-- Probability of a union is at most the sum of probabilities, with no
independence requirement on the witness events. -/

GraphChoices.witness_union_bound.source:
theorem witness_union_bound {Ω W : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq Ω]
    (W₀ : Finset W) (events : W → Finset Ω) :
    eventProbability (W₀.biUnion events) ≤ ∑ w ∈ W₀, eventProbability (events w) := by
  unfold eventProbability
  have hc : ((W₀.biUnion events).card : ℝ) ≤ ∑ w ∈ W₀, ((events w).card : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast card_biUnion_le
  calc
    _ ≤ (∑ w ∈ W₀, ((events w).card : ℝ)) / Fintype.card Ω :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hc (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    _ = _ := by simp [div_eq_mul_inv, sum_mul]

/-- Product sampling has exact independence, including empty allowed sets.
A coordinate allows every edge label if it is unconstrained. -/

GraphChoices.probability_coordinate_cons.source:
theorem probability_coordinate_constraints {E : Type*} [Fintype E]
    [DecidableEq E] (T : ℕ) (allowed : Fin T → Finset E) :
    eventProbability (Fintype.piFinset allowed) =
      ∏ t : Fin T, ((allowed t).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card E := by
  simp only [eventProbability, Fintype.card_piFinset, Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_fin,
    Nat.cast_prod, Nat.cast_pow, prod_div_distrib, prod_const, card_univ]

/-- A finite family of per-coordinate witness restrictions can be union-bounded
by the corresponding products of marginal probabilities. -/

GraphChoices.witness_coordinate_union_bo.source:
theorem witness_coordinate_union_bound {E W : Type*} [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E]
    (T : ℕ) (W₀ : Finset W) (allowed : W → Fin T → Finset E) :
    eventProbability (W₀.biUnion fun w => Fintype.piFinset (allowed w)) ≤
      ∑ w ∈ W₀, ∏ t : Fin T, ((allowed w t).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card E := by
  simpa only [probability_coordinate_constraints] using
    witness_union_bound W₀ (fun w => Fintype.piFinset (allowed w))

end GraphChoices
